tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/bla ma o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs rnam thar gsal ba'i phreng ba thugs rje rlabs po che'i mchod sdong zhes bya ba bzhugs
༄༅/bla ma o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs rnam thar gsal ba'i phreng ba thugs rje rlabs po che'i mchod sdong zhes bya ba bzhugs

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ bla ma o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtsho'i 'khrungs rabs rnam thar gsal ba'i phreng ba thugs rje rlabs po che'i mchod sdong zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru padma kā ra ḍākki nī ye/ kun tu bzang po khyab bdag 'gro ba'i mgon/ /drug pa'i bdag nyid snang mtha' 'od mi 'gyur/ /dga' rab klong chen dus gsum sangs rgyas dang*/ /rgyal sras thu bo bden gnyis dbang phyug gi /thugs rje'i nyi 'od 'dzam gling 'o ma'i mtshor/ /shar bas srid khyon mun sel 'gran bral rje/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso mchog rigs kyi bdag /pad 'byung mtshungs med dbang por gus pas 'dud/ na mo gu ru siddhi hūm̐/ e ma ho/ bdag phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor gsang sngags theg chen gyi bka' bab 'dzin pa/ lo tsā sngags kyi btsun chung*/ /phyi ltar na bslab gsum lung rigs kyi bshad rgya dben zhing*/ nang ltar na thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgro 'dogs ba spu'i nyag tsam ma chod cing*/ /don gsang ba ltar na chags sdang srid pa'i rgya mtshor yun ring 'khyams te/ /da ltar yang snyan grags sgro skur sham bu can/ phyi tshul bag ma las btsun pa'i dkor sdud mkhan/ /rang mtho sna lnga'i 'ja' ris kyis brgyan pa'i zog po nga yi skyes rabs rtsom pa la/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter srung yul lha rnams kyis thugs mi khrel zhing bzod par gsol bas bkas gnang ba stsal du gsol/ gu ru ri dhi ma hā a dhiṣṭha ye/ e ma ho/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mchog /smon lam dbang gis drin can gtsug gi rgyan/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam ston sa mkhan pa/ /ratna karma bha dra'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mi kho bo dang po mched pa'i khungs/ /rigs dga' rab rdo rjes lung bstan pa'i/ /don 'khrul med lha bu 'od zer zhes/ /de a 'thas rim brgyud ma yin pa'i/ /rje shāka thub drung du gnas brtan bzang*/

/rje 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la sogs pa/ /lar de nas grub thob mang brgyud de/ /yul 'dul zhing gangs can bod du shar/ /pha sangs rgyas dbang po pad 'byung drung*/ /gnubs lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes rtsal/

sha bha/ sa ra ha/ dge slong ku sā li/ lha lcam bde chen mtsho mchan/ rje bka' drin 'khor med zab chos gnang*/ /pha thugs dgongs dgyes pa'i bskyed rdzogs bsgoms/ /rtags tshad 'dzin brag la phur pa btab/ /bu tshad du phebs gsungs dgyes par gnang*/ /phyag mgor bzhag smon lam mtshams kyis sbyar/ /rtags kha byang shog dril brda dgu gnang*/ /dus kun gyi 'dul zhing lung du bstan/ /gnas yang rdzong brag la gshegs shig gsungs/ /lar rtsa rlung grogs la bsten pa'i tshe/ /don 'chi med rig 'dzin dngos grub brnyes/ mchan lo sum brgya lhag tsam bzhugs/ /dus de nas dgongs pa gshegs tsa na/ /'gro drug rnams 'brel tshad don ldan par/ /chos zab rgya'i gter ston 'ga' re byon/ /lar de nas mi ring nye ba ru/ /mon lho brag phyogs su lan gnyis 'khrungs/ sngags 'chang padma dbang gi bdag nyid mchan/ /gnas der 'phros gdul bya bor ba'i tshe/ dum rgya zhang khrom/ bon po drag rtsal/ dri med kun dga'/ bstan gnyis gling pa mchan/ /yul dwags kong phyogs su 'dun pa che/ /sa der phyin gnas khang btsal ba la/ /lo gsum tsam bsdad pas 'dul zhing rdzogs/ /dus de mtshams mdo khams phyogs su shar/ de yan chad skye rgyud phran bur bsdus pa'o/ dang po skye rgyud khungs btsun zhing gnad kun la rten 'brel ma 'chug pa ste mi brjed dran pa'i gzungs thob pa'i le'u ste dang po'o/ e ma/ pha gcig 'gro ba'i mgon po padma 'byung*/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas bla ma mi gzugs can/ /'gro kun dug lnga'i nad sel sman pa'i rgyal/ /ye shes dpal 'bar zhabs pad spyi bor 'dud/ oṃ dharma pra bha puṣṭaṃ ye/ e ma ho/ dang po skye gnas btsal ba'i rim pa ni/ /shar smad rgya nag yan chod nyul na yang*/ /rten 'brel pha ma bzang po ma 'phrad cing*/ /sdug bsngal ga chad yi mug skyo ba skyes/ /snying rlung ldang zhing 'gro ba'i dus kyi tshe/

/mdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug spras pa zhig /gar thabs lang ling mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs/ /byis pa 'o khyod ma yengs legs par nyon/ /sngon tshe rgya gar ka ma shī la ru/ /pha rgan dam pa sangs rgyas mi dran nam/ /ngo sprod 'khor lo bzhi pa ma bsgoms sam/ /yid blo ma skyo dran pa so mar zhog /'di nas cung zad 'das pa'i sa mtshams su/ /pha yis dngos su byin brlabs 'dra 'bag yod/ /de ru gshegs dang gnas khang rten 'brel babs/ /de skad gsungs pas bdag kyang yid blo brtan/ /bu mo de la bdag gis lan btab pa/ kyai/ mdun na lhags pa'i ḍākki gar ma gzugs/ /res 'ga' ngo thogs res 'ga' ngo ma thogs/ /sprul pa khyed nyid gang yin gsung du gsol/ /bdag gis gus phyag thal sbyar mchod 'bul bstod/ /de skad zhus pas mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas kyang*/ kyai/ nga ni ma gcig mtsho rgyal lab sgron ma/ /bu khyod dus kun grogs yin 'khrul lags sam/ /da rung ting 'dzin thang lhod rkyen gyis bsgribs/ /lo gcig lon nas ma ma mjal bar mchis/ /zhes gsungs mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal te gshegs/ /de nas kho bo dar cig yid 'gyu bas/ /dam pa sangs rgyas 'dra 'bag mdun du slebs/ /bag chags lung bstan dran pas gsol ba btab/ /'dra 'bag de yi thugs las 'phros pa yi/ /mi mo sngon mo mthing gi lan tshar can/ /so dkar 'dzum dang bcas pa'i mdangs ldan zhig /nga yis go tsam mi go'i dbyangs len nas/ /srin mdzub sbrel cig zer nas lag pa bzung*/ /ma yis gnas khang bstan no gsungs nas su/ /dam par bzung ste 'gro ba'i nyams shig byung*/ /ma khyod su yin smros shig byas tsa na/ /tāṃ ta tā re zer nas myur du bzhud/ /dran pas ma zin phyad phyod 'gro bzhin ngang*/ /de ma thag tu ri rong zab mo'i ngogs/ /gnam sa chu rlung 'ur sgra 'byin pa ru/ /rlung dmar zhig gis btums nas bsngangs dus su/

/dran med nag thom zhig tu brgyal nyams byung*/ /de nas cung zhig sangs bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /sngar gyi bu mo de yang mi snang zhing*/ /bar do dang po'i gzugs brnyan lta bu shar/ /gang du bltas kyang ri rong dmar po la/ /tsha zhing rtsub pa 'dra ba'i ri ru mthong*/ /gzugs brnyan de rnams sdang tshul skad kyang 'byin/ /'gro snyam byed tshe lus kyang mi theg par/ /sa khams chu la thim pa'i skabs ltar snang*/ /dngos sam rmi lam bar do the tshom pas/ /shes pa grol thog rjes thob skyong ba'i tshe/ /rjes shes rtogs pas bar do yin par go /da ni mngal du tshud pa thag chod bsam/ /yi dam lha yi bskyed rim gsal btab pas/ /sngar gyi gnas khang de yang ma yin pa'i/ /grong gling mang po 'dra zhig yod par mthong*/ /dper na rmi lam rtsub nyams chen po bzhin/ /bde sdug res mos cung zhig byung ba'i mthar/ /sngar gyi lus de min pa'i sha gzugs shig /yang yang bltas kyang de ltar mthong bar gyur/ /da ni skye ba gzhan zhig blangs 'dug snyam/ /bar do'i snang tshan rnams la dri ba btab/ /nga yi yul 'di gang yin zer tsa na/ /'di ni srid pa mngal gyi grong yin zer/ /de tshe bdag gi yid blor 'khor ba las/ /srid pa yin na ma yi gnas yin 'dra/ /snyam zhing a ma zer nas bos tsa na/ /lan mo byed mkhan yod yod 'dra ba las/ /phyogs su bltas pas ci yang mi mthong 'dug /de nas res gsal res mi gsal ba'i ngang*/ /yun ring gcig tu sdod pa'i nyams kyang shar/ /de tshe mgur ma 'ga' re btang lags kyang*/ /da ltar nges por mi 'dug bzhag pa yin/ /de yan srid par 'jug gnas rim pa'o/ /srid pa bar do dri za gnas 'tshol bgyis pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o/ oṃ dharma garbha dzñā na dzwa la hūm̐/ e ma ho/ ka dag klong yangs ye shes snying po'i sku/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mig gcig pu/ /ded dpon yongs kyi rgyan mchog gtsug gi rgyan/ /pha gcig pad 'byung yab yum zhabs la 'dud/

/gsum pa skyes pa'i gnas yul bstan pa ni/ /rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ka shi ka /rgyal bas byin brlabs dbus gyur 'od ma'i tshal/ /ti se gangs nas gangs dkar mched brgyad yan/ /srin mo gan rkyal lta bu'i chags tshul la/ /gangs dkar ti se shel gyi mchod rten dbyibs/ /rgyal bas lung bstan rdzu 'phrul phyag rjes ldan/ /che ba'i yon tan bde chen 'khor lo'i gnas/ /la phyi gangs ri rin chen maṇḍal 'dra/ /tshe gcig ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i yul/ /che ba'i yon tan longs spyod 'khor lo'i gnas/ /lha sa bsam yas rtsibs stong 'khor lo 'dra/ /rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho byon pa'i yul/ /che ba'i yon tan chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas/ /mdo khams zal mo rin chen spungs pa 'dra/ /pad 'byung sangs rgyas dbang pos byin brlabs yul/ /che ba'i yon tan sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i gnas/ /rong chen gangs ni rdo rje'i rtse gzengs 'dra/ /byang sems skyes bu mang pos byin gyis brlabs/ /che ba'i yon tan bde skyong 'khor lo'i gnas/ /de bzhin 'dzam gling lho phyogs lte ba nyid/ /rdo rje phag mo'i gnas chen ngo mtshar can/ /sa yi ming yang ka dang dpal gyi sgra/ /rgyud sde kun gyi yi ge dbu yi mtshan/ /dpal rgyal rin chen seṅge gnam mchongs 'dra/ /rdza chu lci chu mdo sngags chos 'brel 'dra/ /dpal kha gtam kha ro ma rkyang ma 'dra/ /dpal chu gaṅgā dbu ma'i dar thag 'dra/ /sa rnams thams cad 'dzam gling kha phyes 'dra/ /ri rnams thams cad glang chen ber 'gyings 'dra/ /g.yas ri rin chen khri 'phang 'dra ba'i steng*/ /gze rgyal jo bo rgyal po gdan bzhugs 'dra/ /g.yon du dmar chen rba rlabs 'khyil 'dra'i dbus/ /sku rgyal she ne sngags pa zor thogs 'dra/ /de sogs ye nas srid pa'i gnas chen dang*/ /byang sems byin brlabs gnas chen grangs med bkra/ /mdo sngags brgyud 'dzin byung ba'i gnas de'i rong*/

/ba dbyi khyung gsum bdud yul mun pa can/ /sngon tshe bya rog rngam sgra nag po'i yul/ /bdud po shwa ba ru ring btul ba'i sa/ /byang shar ma ru rtse yi dur khrod char/ /sha za gcan spyang ngar skad sgrog pa'i gnas/ /rtsi shing nags tshal mtshon rtse gzengs 'dra'i tshal/ /brag ri mon pa pho mo khros 'dra'i gling*/ /bya nag gshog sgra stong skad sgrog pa'i gnas/ /shin tu rngam pa rong chen de yi char/ /bka' yis rgyas btab rgya stag can gyi ming*/ /dpal gyis rgyas btab chu rlung 'bab pa'i mthar/ /lcags sdig gan rkyal 'dra ba'i lte ba ru/ /skye ba'i gnas dang lung bstan sa rtags go /gangs can yul du skye ba sku bltams pa'i sa rtags bstan pa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o/ oṃ badzra ma hā dha ri hūm̐/ e ma ho/ kun tu bzang po khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*/ /dga' rab shrī sing dbang phyug padma 'byung*/ /skal bzang bgrang yas shar ba'i cod pan can/ /bdag gi spyi bor brgyan te zhabs la 'dud/ kyai/ rten 'brel lus kyi sgrom bu rnyed pa yi/ /mtshan bzang yab yum cho 'brang bstan pa ni/ /rus kyi che ba rgyal rigs lha las babs/ /'jig rten dbang phyug kha ba can du shar/ /de yi cha shas sprul pa'i 'od zer las/ /tshangs pa gzhon nu dung gi thor tshugs can/ /'bru chen nam mkha' thogs med rgyal po nas/ /rgyal rabs brgyad tsam song ba'i mtshams dag tu/ /sne gdong rgyal po mang gdong stag rtse la/ /btsun mo maṅga dhe wa 'tsho byed bsus/ /sras bdun sras mo gcig dang brgyad 'khrungs pa'i/ /yum gyis drin lan bskur ba'i rkyen la brten/ /sras bdun gnam mtsho phyug mo'i nang du lhung*/ /de nas rgyal rabs chad la thug pa'i tshe/ /sras mo de ni ye shes mkha' 'gro ste/ /pho chas gcugs nas khrom du bskor ba las/ /ya mtshan ldan pa'i bud med gcig dang 'phrad/ /de khrid log nas yab kyi drung du byon/ /rje yis 'di bzhes sras kyi skal bar zhu/

/zhes zhus yab la de nyid phul ba las/ /zla ba ma tshang pa la sras gcig 'khrungs/ /rgyal po'i thugs la nga yi yin nam ci/ /'on kyang dri ba byed dgos bsams nas su/ /btsun mor yin min zhib tu dris pa las/ /btsun mos lhums zhugs nyams kyi rmi lam du/ /mdun gyi mkha' nas gser gyi rdo rje zhig /lus la phog pas bde ba rgyas par rmis/ /de bas 'jig rten las kyis gos pa med/ /de skad rgyal po'i snyan du phul ba'i tshe/ /rgyal po'i zhal nas btsun mor bka' stsal pa/ /'di nyid mi dang mi mthun skyes pa'i sras/ /nga yi gdung rgyud zin par mi rigs pas/ /gtsang po'i nang ngam gang rung zhig tu dor/ /de skad bka' stsal btsun mo thugs kyang mug /btsun mos sras de lag par thogs nas su/ /yar lha sham po gangs kyi mgul du bskyal/ /'di ni rgyal po'i thugs rgyud sras yin na/ /lha gnyan yar lha sham pos legs par skyongs/ /gang phyir rdzun dang kho mo ma dag na/ /skad cig nyid la sras 'di med par gyis/ /zhes pa'i dmod pa bor te nang du log /zhag gsum lon nas sham po gangs ri'i rtser/ /me rlung 'tshub cing khu rlangs nag po zhig /phyogs bzhi'i dbyings la shin tu 'phyur bar mthong*/ /de nas rgyal po blon po bcas pa rnams/ /yid ma ches te gnas der gzigs par byon/ /seṅge dkar mo rngam tshul ldan zhig gis/ khye'u de la nu zho ster bar byed/ /bya rgyal thang dkar rgod pos gshog pas g.yogs/ /mkha' la sdigs mdzub gtad de cog ger 'dug /yab yum 'khor 'bangs rnams kyis phyag mchod bgyis/ khye'u zhal nas hūm̐ hūm̐ singha zhes/ /de ma thag tu yum gyis gdan 'dren zhus/ /yab kyis yum sras gnyis la 'gyod tshangs phul/ /bshags pa sna tshogs byas shing zhu ba mdzad/ /sham po gangs la lha bsang gsol mchod brtsam/ /de nas khye'u nang du spyan drangs te/ /yul mi thams cad bsdus nas mnga' gsol mdzad/ /ming 'dogs mkhan gyi drang srong spyan drangs nas/

/lha bu rgyal sras de la mtshan gsol ba/ /'bru chen rlangs nag seṅge rgod sdigs pa/ /thams cad bsdus pa'i mtshan de legs par gsol/ /sras de 'jam dpal bshes gnyen sprul pa ste/ /ma slob yon tan sna tshogs thugs su chud/ /de la sprul pa'i rgyal sras lnga byung bas/ /sa skya 'khon la bshad sgrub gdung gi rgyud/ /'bri chen gdung la phag mo bka' brgyud pa/ /sangs rgyas bla ma'i gdung la gwa zi ba/ /byang chub bla ma'i gdung la skyu ra ba/ /'bru chen rlangs nag gdung la lha gzigs pa/ /de sogs dang po gdung rgyud 'bru nas chad/ /bye brag so so'i 'dul zhing bab pa ni/ /lha gzigs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan 'phen yul byon/ /rlangs chen gdung nas rten 'brel btags pa'i ming*/ /sa yang 'phen yul rlangs thang bya bar grags/ /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan mkha' 'gros lung bstan bzhin/ khyod kyis 'dul zhing zal mo sgang du babs/ /mdo khams sa yi lte bar 'dongs shig gsungs/ /de nas rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la phebs/ /mdo khams rong gi cha ru babs pa la/ /'dul zhing thog mar rlangs thang sgrol mar grags/ /sgrol ma'i sprul pa jo mo rten 'brel bzhes/ /yul khams yongs kyis rlangs thang sgrol mar grags/ /gzhan yang de'i gong sngar rim mthar chags su/ /bod yul rlangs kyi gdung rgyud ma chad bar/ /slob dpon dus su rlangs chen dpal seng dang*/ gnubs kyi lo tsā thams cad rlangs las 'khrungs/ khams kyi 'dul zhing dag la gtsug lag ni/ nam mkha' kun khyab gtsor byas mang zhig bzhengs/ /de nas gdung rabs gsum tsam 'gro ba'i mtshams/ /dpal chen nam mkha' thog 'bebs bya ba yis/ /bon gyi chos dang gdung rgyud mang bar bzung*/ /de nas gdung rabs mang zhig rdzogs pa'i mtshams/ /grags pa mthu stobs rnam rgyal bya ba la/ /sras gnyis byung ste ban bon gnyis su gyur/ /sras bon de ni 'jang gi rgyal por gyur/ /ban sras de yi gdung rabs 'ga' re'i mtshams/

/du ru dmag gis lan grangs mang du bcom/ /de nas rgyal rdzong thams cad mi la shor/ /rim gyis gdung rabs 'ga' zhig 'das pa'i mtshams/ /grub thob sku mched bya ba byung ba las/ /che ba sras stong sgom shwa yin pa las/ /gdung rgyud bor te phyogs med gnas su gshegs/ /chung ba mgon po rnam rgyal bya ba'i rgyud/ /mdo smad ko rong bya ba'i yul du chags/ /gdung rabs ma chad tsam du lus par gyur/ /res 'ga' chos pa res 'ga' mi nag dang*/ /res 'ga' dar dang res 'ga' rgud pa dang*/ /skyid sdug res mos dpyid ka'i nyi ma bzhin/ /mtho dman phra rags chu bo'i skyed bri ltar/ /mang du gyur kyang tha ma da lta yan/ khungs btsun rus dang cho 'brang shin tu dag /de phyir rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags gdung yin/ /ci phyir deng sang bdud rigs grags che dang*/ /bran g.yog dmangs kyi khol po khrel med sogs/ /dman pa mtho sar smin pa'i rigs ma yin/ /rgyu rtsal dma' yang 'phro bzang gdung gi mtha'/ /dman sar bzung yang bzang po'i rgyud las chad/ /'khos stobs zhan yang lha las babs pa'i rgyud/ /skye mdangs gog kyang grub thob thogs tsam byung*/ /gar srid rtog ge tha snyad mkhan zhig gis/ /de ltar mi rigs 'khos stobs chung zhe na/ /ri rab dang ni gling gi skye thang bzhin/ /mtho ba gnam yin dma' ba sa yang yin/ /mgyogs pa rta yin chad pa rta yang yin/ /sngar gyi gong ma bskal pa bzang po'i gdung*/ kha drag rnam 'phang can gyi cho rigs 'di/ /deng sang bshad na sngar gyi bag med pas/ /mkhas dbang rnams kyis gzigs na khrel srid de/ /mtho dman legs nyes skye 'gro kun la 'byung*/ /dar 'grib phri bsnan chu bo kun la 'byung*/ /sngon tshe bskal pa bzang po'i dus tshod la/ /chos rgyal mang zhig byung ba'i gdung rabs dang*/ /bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag gdan sa sna tshogs kyang*/ /deng dus sdig can dmangs kyi khol po yis/ /bcom zhing yang yang 'gyur ba 'di ltar ltos/

/nye gnas dkon pa'i bla ma grwa pa rang*/ /'khor g.yog 'thor na rgyal po rang g.yog yin/ /longs spyod bkren na phyug po kun kyang dbul/ /'bab chu zhan na 'khyil chu kun kyang skem/ /de phyir snyan grags mtho dman tha snyad yin/ /pha rus cho 'brang bzang po gser dang 'dra/ /gser ni sa dang thal zhag bsres gyur kyang*/ /zhun 'thar sprugs pa'i rang lugs ji bzhin gsal/ /bstan 'gro gzhan phan can gyi gang zag la/ /rigs rgyud cho 'brang bzang ngan ma ltos kyang*/ /nyams mtshar snang sos bde mor bris pa ste/ /dug lnga nyon mongs klong nas ye shes 'khrungs/ /rnam rtog 'khrul pa'i gseb nas mi rtog 'khrungs/ /ma dag mngal du bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'khrungs/ /de phyir bzang ltos nges pa ma mchis kyang*/ /rnam thar zhes ni gsung sgros yin pa'i phyir/ /'di tsam yi ger bgyis pa nyams mtshar te/ /kun rdzob don dam thams cad tha snyad rdzun/ /ci yang dngos po'i mtshan ma ma grub pas/ /rmi lam sgyu ma'i grong gis sprul sgyur 'dra/ /spyan ldan mkhyen shes kun la bzod par gsol/ /bzod pa de don rang mthong khrel gyis dogs/ /de min 'byung khungs legs na bzod pa ci/ /'di yan le'u bzhi ru bsgrigs pa 'di/ /snga rabs dran pas skyo ba bskul ba'i tshig /phyi rabs da lta'i bag chags sad pa'i mtshams/ /dus bzang bco lnga'i tshes la legs par sbyar/ /rnam thar kun la 'di 'dra mi 'os kyang*/ /lung ma bstan 'di kho bo'i nyams mtshar phyir/ /kun shes rig pa'i khye'u chung smyu gu yis/ /gang shar nyams kyis shog bu de la gzugs/ /snga phyi 'char ba bris pa'i rnam thar ro/ /rigs rus dang cho 'brang sa yul bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o/ oṃ sarba buddha dzñā na mant+ra hūm̐/ mi bdag gi spyi gtsug nyi zla'i steng*/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas padma 'byung*/ /thugs rol pa'i rnam 'phrul bha dra ba/ /pha kun tu bzang po mi gzugs can/

/dus rtag par mi 'bral rgyan du bzhugs/ e ma ho/ lnga pa yab yum mtshan dang skyes pa'i dus/ /phyi nang legs nyes rten 'brel gang shar ba/ /mi brjed dran pa'i lcag gis bskul te bstan/ /dang po yul dang sa yi zhib cha ni/ /mdo khams sgang gi lte ba nang chen sar/ khams phyogs rgyal po us jing thi'u ji'i mtshan/ /tshangs pa'i sprul pa de yi yul gyi char/ /dpal gyi rong chen nag ru bya ba ru/ /rgya gtam lung pa lcags sdig nag po'i steng*/ rlangs nag ces bya'i sbra kha zhig na ni/ /sbra nag bkal zhing ru nag bca' ba'i lam/ /shing nag shug pa ljon pa'i tshal dag tu/ /sngags nag hūm̐ nag drag rtsal skyes pa'i tshe/ /dus nag bskal pa nyi shu kha dar ba'i/ /'dre rgod dmod pa nag po bsgral ba'i ched/ /rten 'brel ba dan dkar po gyen du phyar/ /skal bzang chos ston mdzad par smon lam btab/ /rnam dkar phyogs bcur snyan grags chos kyi sgra/ /legs par sgrog mdzad shel ldong dkar po'i rtser/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dkar po 'dzugs mdzad po/ /bkra shis yar tshes dkar po nya rgyas ltar/ /smon lam mtshams sbyor dkar pos rgyas btab bzhin/ /gza' skar me shel dkyil 'khor dus bzang nyin/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba yul lhas bsu ma mdzad/ /dkar gsum bcud kyi gsol mchod rol pa yis/ /rnam bcu thar las dkar po'i dge legs 'grub/ e ma ho/ yab ni bkra shis yum ni dge legs ma/ /dang po yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa'i tshe/ /nub mo yum ni mnal ba'i rmi lam du/ /rgya gar yul nas yin zer a tsa ra/ /skra cog bsdams shing ang rag dkris pa zhig /phyag tu rdo rje bum pa bsnams nas su/ khrus bstsal rdo rje spyi bor bzhag nas kyang*/ /rdo rje stsal 'di 'dzin par gyis gsungs nas/ /spyi bo'i gtsug nas 'od du thim par rmis/ /yab kyi rmi lam shar ba'i nges su ni/ /dam pa sangs rgyas yin zer he ru ka /smug nag rus pa'i rgyan drug ldan pa yis/

/ral gri bcu gsum lag tu gtad nas kyang*/ /bu yi lag tu sprod cig zer ba rmis/ kha mtshar tshul gyis rmi lam bshad pa'i tshe/ /mi mang rnams kyis byad kha yin 'ong zer/ /sngags pa gdan drangs byad bzlog sna tshogs byas/ /sngar gyi rmi lam 'dra ba lan gnyis byung*/ /res 'ga' ma bshad res 'ga' kun la bshad/ /gzhan la bshad pas kha shag mang du brgyab/ /rang gis bsam blo zhib mor bskor ba las/ /mtshon cha 'dzin pa'i bu zhig skye 'ong snyam/ /yum gyi lus la rgyun du gnas pa'i tshe/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa yang yang thos pa dang*/ /bud med mang pos dar thag 'then pa dang*/ /lus la 'ja' 'od mang du zug pa dang*/ /zer thag shar lho nub byang gang ba rmis/ /de nas lus la byis pa sbrum pa las/ /rmi lam de ltar nang du bshad tsa na/ /sngar yang byis pa mang po shi ba'i shul/ /rmi lam de ni sun ka yin 'ong bas/ /lus la yod pa 'di yang mi sos 'dra/ /sku rim phran bu byas na dga' 'ong zer/ /sngags pa rnams la sun zlog byed du bcug /de nas mo ma zhig la mo zhus pas/ khyed tshang sdod pa'i yul de lan 'dug pas/ /mi ring pa nas ru ba spos shig zer/ /byis pa de yang bon la bcol na dga'/ /de skad zer bas bon po btsal du phyin/ /bon po ma rnyed zhag kyang 'ga' zhig 'gor/ /nang du log pas yum yang ma bde nas/ /na zhes ha sgra ring du 'don par byed/ /sang gi zhogs nas 'brog khar spos pa las/ /lam la zhugs nas mi ring de nyid du/ /tsan dan nags tshal ljon pa'i gnas de ru/ /lcags sdig gan rkyal 'dra ba'i lte ba ru/ /yum gyi las rlung g.yos pas snyun gzugs bstan/ /pha wang zhig la dam por bzung nas su/ /spyan nas mchi ma phrom phrom rab tu snang*/ khal rta bkal ba'i chas rnams sngon la brdzangs/ khol mo gcig gis snyun g.yog byed du bcug /btsas pa'i tshe na gzhan las na zug chung*/ khol mos lte ba bregs shing smon lam btab/ /yum gyis phyag tu blangs te dgyes pa mdzad/

/de tshe 'dab chags sna tshogs 'dus nas su/ /gsung dbyangs 'gyur khug tser tser mang du sgrog /dbyings nas 'brug grags rang bzhin hūm̐ sgra thos/ kha char me tog 'ja' 'od rab tu 'khyil/ /ya mtshan che ba'i rtags kyang mang bar skad/ khol mo de la yum gyis smras pa la/ /de ring rten 'brel legs rtags mang byung bas/ /'di ni rigs ldan bu zhig yin par 'dug /ma nga'i bsod nams rten 'dir e shong ang*/ /rtags mtshan 'di rnams mi la ma smra zhig /ci ltar sos na bu mo red zer shod/ /de ma thag tu nang du log pa'i tshe/ /yum la blta ru thams cad bslebs nas byung*/ /sras po sras mo gang red zer ba la/ /bshad mi nus tsam bu ru 'dug go zer/ /yab sogs nye 'brel kun gyis dga' ston byas/ /de nas lha bsang btang ste nang du log /srung skyob la sogs bgyi ba rab tu mang*/ /'di yan skyes tshul rnam thar bsdus pa'o/ srid pa'i yum gyi lhums nas sku bltams pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o/ oṃ ha ho hrī badzra hūm̐/ 'jig rten mi yi yul ngos mthong zhing skye ba srid pa'i nyams phyad phyod du mgur 'di ltar blangs so/ e ma/ pha gtan gyi skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ /don gcig 'dus gu ru padma 'byung*/ /bdag spyi bor mi 'bral rgyan du bzhugs/ /lam ring po srid pa'i grong khyer du/ /sems rig pa'i khye'us g.yar khang btsal/ /lus 'dus byas zhan chags ma lags te/ /pha rdo rje 'chang chen sha gzugs can/ /de'i gzugs sku bsod nams grub par go /lar ngo bo de tsam mi rtag kyang*/ don bzang po'i mtshams sbyor 'brel du re/ /sems 'gyur tsam phran bu'i bag chags de/ /rlung srog 'dzin thig le'i sbubs su tshud/ /rgyud nyi zla kha sbyor lhun gyis grub/ /lam a haṃ gtum mo gsal 'debs kyis/ /dran khengs rnyog med pa'i sha gzugs rgyas/ /gnas lte bar chos 'byung pho brang du/ /zas dka' thub rlung gi 'tsho bar bsten/

/skra sen mo med pa'i nyan thos thob/ /gos phru ma'i chos gos ngang dkar gsol/ /mdog ma bsgyur sha ma'i sham thabs can/ zla dgu dang ngo bcu'i bsnyen par rdzogs/ /pha thabs kyi slob dpon drin po che/ /ma shes rab sbyin ma 'byor ba can/ /rdzas rten 'brel sprul sku lha bris mkhan/ /mtshan dpe byad kun rdzogs mkhas pa'i dbang*/ /don smon lam bzang po gso skyed kyis/ /zhing 'og min bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /rtsal mngon du rdzogs par ster ba la/ /drin 'khor med yin no gus pas 'dud/ /gzhi chags sdang grub pa'i dgon pa ru/ /tshig tha snyad bla ma ma bsten yang*/ /gnas sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor sa lam rdzogs/ /dus snyigs ma'i dge slong 'di tsam chog /tshig kha shag yin min don la dris/ /bdag da ni bar do 'grim tshul bshad/ /lus srid pa'i sbrum du gnas pa'i tshe/ /yum dro grang rgyag ltog rkyen dbang gis/ /rigs drug gi sdug bsngal sna tshogs pas/ /lus mnar sha gcod pa'i nyams tsam byung*/ /rkyen de thog ro snyom gdams pa bdog /grogs phar phyin drug ldan dus gcig rdzogs/ /dus snyigs ma'i bzod pa de tsam rab/ /sgo nor mo rus pa'i chos 'byung nas/ /gnas mi yul btsal te bgrod pa'i tshe/ /lus 'byung bzhi khrol bur brdung snyam sems/ /rlung rtsol bcas lhag pa btab pa'i tshe/ /sha rus pa sil bur 'thor snyam byed/ /gos g.yang lug pags pa gyon pa'i tshe/ /lcag tsher ma'i dbyug pas brabs snyam rtog /zas 'bru mar bcud mchog sbyin pa'i tshe/ khog gcong nad grim pos zin snyam byed/ /skom nu zho mngar mo byin pa'i tshe/ /ro skyug log zas dang 'phrad snyam byed/ /rkyen 'dus byas phung po gcer bu la/ /tshogs drug tu shar ba'i 'jam rtsub kun/ /rgyu ci snang rmi lam lta bur bskyed/ /sems rig pa'i khye'u chung cog ger bzhag /don go bas sgyu ma'i ngang tshul rtogs/ /de lam khyer spyad pa'i rnal 'byor yin/

/dus snyigs ma'i rnal 'byor de tsam chog /yum bzang mo'i pang du gnas pa'i tshe/ /zhing phyogs bcu'i rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro kun/ /sprin 'ja' gur 'brug sgra'i klong nas gtib/ /tshig bkra shis sbrang char me tog 'thor/ /gnas dkar phyogs gzhi bdag bsu ba mdzad/ /bya 'dab chags sna tshogs nyams dbyangs blang*/ /shing tsandan lha mos bro gar 'khrab/ /gnyen 'khor g.yog gdung sems dga' ston byas/ /gnas rgya gtam lcags sdig snying kha ru/ /zhing dag snang zhal gzigs ngang la skyes/ /rgyu rten 'brel de nyid tshogs pa'i don/ /sngon kun tu bzang po'i klong nas mched/ /pha pad 'byung gi sras su byin gyis brlabs/ /chos sde snod kun gyi bka' rgya phog /lung rigs pa smra ba'i lo tsār grags/ /dus rtag tu bskyed rdzogs snying por blangs/ /don 'khrul med rig pa'i btsan sa zin/ /rigs lha yi gdung chen rlangs las 'khrungs/ /yum rje btsun sgrol ma'i rnam par 'phrul/ /yab sngon gyi sbyin bdag smon lam can/ /ma mkha' 'gros lung bstan yab dang yum/ /dus lung bstan 'dul zhing mtshungs pa yin/ /bdag rnal 'byor sngags 'chang skyes lags te/ /deng skal ldan gyi sngags pa phur thogs tshos/ /thugs 'khrul med dgongs pas khrel ma gnang*/ /snying sbu gu'i srub tu ma shong yang*/ /don bzang po'i 'brel tshad don ldan shog /sku 'khrungs pa'i tshe skye gnas bar do sbyangs shing rtags rten 'brel sogs phran bu byung ba mgur du bzhengs pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o/ oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭha hūm̐/ e ma ho/ kun tu bzang po'i thugs rje'i 'od zer las/ /ma 'gags drwa ba'i rnam rol dga' rab pa/ /legs par sprul nas rgya mtshor sku 'khrungs pa/ /mtshungs med bdag gi rje de'i zhabs la 'dud/ /de nas zhag po 'ga' zhig song ba ru/ /sri'u 'tsho ba'i sngags pa btsal ba la/ /yul phyogs gnyis su mi 'grim mngag pa'i tshe/ /ban sngags khro 'bum bon sngags gtso mchog pa/

/phyogs nas ban bon gnyis po spyan drangs te/ /srung ba za yig rang rang lugs su mdzad/ /yum gyis ming btags lam lha rdo rje zhes/ /ban sngags ming btags bkra shis phun tshogs zhes/ /bon sngags ming btags gtso mchog dbang phyug ces/ /grub thob 'ga' la ming zhus byed du btang*/ /bla mas ming btags sgrol ma rdo rje zhes/ /gsol te grib dang 'bag btsog ma bslad dang*/ /bla ma 'dra yi sku skye yin shas che/ /bdag la rmi lam brtag pa legs po byung*/ /'on kyang byed spyod thams cad gsang bar gyis/ /bla ma'i zhal nas de skad gsungs pa dang*/ /'bri gung a phyi'i snyan dar phur mdud gnang*/ /dgon der kho bo'i bla ma bzod pa dang*/ /zhang po tshul khrims dge slong la sogs pa/ /thugs kha nye ba'i dge bshes mang zhig la/ /byin rlabs dam rdzas slong du phyin pa las/ /bla mas brtag pa gang gsung 'dri ba'i tshe/ /sngar kyi gsung brtag yi ge bstan pa las/ /kun gyis 'di ni khyad 'phags yin 'dug pas/ /grib 'dzem sku rim la sogs 'bungs shig gsungs/ /byin rlabs khyer nas nang du log pa dang*/ bla ma'i bka' bzhin bshad pas spro ba skyes/ /ban bon gnyis po lo gcig ma 'khor bar/ /yul der bzhugs shing sku rim rtsom par byas/ /nub mo yum gyi gnyid dang za zi mtshams/ /byis ba'i lus la me tshag 'thor ba dang*/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ zer ba rgyun du thos/ /nad kyang dkon la lus kyi gzi mdangs bkrag /yum yang dga' tshor thugs blo bde bar skad/ /ban bon de gnyis nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /sde brgyad mtshon cha thogs pa'i dmag tshogs kyis/ /rgyun du khyim dang sbra la bskor ba rmis/ /dmigs gtad bzlog zor sna tshogs 'phang ba'i tshe/ /rtsub nyams che zhing dngos su yang yang mthong*/ /yon mchod gnyis kyis byad kha ngos kyang bzung*/ /bzlog pa byas tshe god kha sna tshogs btang*/ /de dag byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gang zhe na/ /rtsub nyams 'dra ba'i chau 'phrul de dag ni/

/sngon nas kho bos bsgrubs pa'i chos skyong kun/ /srung skyob tha tshig skyong phyir rgyun du 'khor/ /gzhan yang gzugs med lha 'dre kun kyang 'tshogs/ /dkar phyogs rnams kyis brtse zhing skyong ba'i tshe/ /yul de'i nag phyogs bdud rigs khros nas su/ /mi khas sdang zhing dgra jag rtsub pa dang*/ /gcan gzan gyis 'tshe god kha kha mchu mang*/ /ma rungs cho 'phrul sna tshogs byung ba'i tshe/ /rmongs pa kha yan rnams kyis shags 'debs nas/ /byis pa de ni rigs ngan yin 'ong zer/ /yum ni ma dgyes kun la kha shag bzlog /yab dang khyim 'khor rnams kyang the tshom nas/ /ban bon rnams kyis zer tshad ma thig zer/ /'on kyang nag phyogs de yi bar chad kyis/ /de'i skabs rten 'brel ngan pa yin zer bar/ kho bos yum la mgur ma 'bul ba'i tshul/ /nyams myong o lo gzhon pas 'di ltar blangs/ e ma ho/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo nyid/ /pha mtshungs med gu ru padma 'byung*/ /bdag gdung ba'i spyi gtsug mkha' la bzhugs/ /byams thugs rjes smin grol dbang bskur stsaul/ /kyai sngon sbyangs bzang po'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyal yum thugs rje'i 'od zer ma/ /byams gdung brtse ba'i dbyangs can ma/ /dal 'byor lus kyi sbyin bdag ma/ /gces par skyong ba'i drin can ma/ /dkyil 'khor lus kyi sgrom bu ma/ /sdug bsngal bzod pa'i go cha ma/ /yum gcig bzang mo bdag la gson/ /bu yis ma la dbyangs gcig len/ /dang po lhums su zhugs pa'i dus/ /rten 'brel bzang po'i rmi lam shar/ /bar du skyes nas zhal mthong tshe/ /lha 'dre mi gsum spro ba 'phel/ /tha ma lung bstan brtag pa'i tshe/ /rten 'brel che zhes gnad kyang tshor/ /ya mtshan can gyi khye'u chung la/ /chos skyong dkar phyogs thams cad dgyes/ /srung mas dpung gnyen bgyis pa la/ /ban bon rnams kyi rtog pa 'khrul/ /gzugs med stong pa'i cho 'phrul la/ /ngar 'dzin 'gong pos sgro btags te/

/dmigs gtad a 'thas bzlog pa yis/ /grogs su ma song rkyen du ldang*/ /nag phyogs 'byung po'i cho 'phrul la/ /ting 'dzin bzlog pas mi bzlog na/ /sku rim mkhan po'i su la phan/ /chos skyong gsol mchod mi shes par/ /zug rngu'i dmigs pas ci la phan/ /dag snang gus 'dun med pa yi/ kha chos lo mas ci la phan/ /rmongs khyu'i kha tshig 'grims pa yis/ kho bor log lta ci la phan/ /pha khyod the tshom chen po de/ /rmi lam bzang pos ci la phan/ /dus ngan snyigs ma'i snga ltas de/ /skyo ba tsam gyis ci la phan/ /sgyu ma zog gi rkyen chag de/ /mi glud mi shes ci la phan/ /zas nor rtswa kha'i zil pa de/ /ser snas bcings pas ci la phan/ /yab kyis the tshom byed lugs dang*/ /rmongs pa'i kha tshig nyan stangs kyis/ /snying gtam dgra la bshad kyis dogs/ /blo yangs mgo chung byed lugs kyis/ /ltag sha khyi khar btsong gis dogs/ kha shags mgo 'phang dma' lugs kyis/ /pha rus gta' mar btsong gis dogs/ /blo rgod las lam chung lugs kyis/ /bu rgyud dma' 'bebs byed kyis dogs/ /glen gtam 'gro 'dod byed lugs kyis/ /pha yul rang sa shor gyis dogs/ /the'u rang mo la bsten lugs kyis/ /phug lha chos skyong khrel gyis dogs/ /don med kha 'chal mang lugs kyis/ /yul mis kha log brgyag gis dogs/ /sngags pas lha srung bzlog lugs kyis/ kho bor bar chad btang gis dogs/ /nag phyogs 'byung pos sdang lugs kyis/ /bskal pa tha mar thug gis dogs/ /dgra rkun jag gsum mang lugs kyis/ /sngon gyi lan chags 'khor gyis dogs/ /mi kha kha mchu ldang lugs kyis/ /byad kha snying la log gis dogs/ /byol song brda than mang lugs kyis/ /zang zing nor rdzas dbul gyis dogs/ /snying rus dge bcu dben lugs kyis/ /sdig to can la 'gyur gyis dogs/ /yum chen a ma yar la bzhengs/ /gti mug gnyid la zad mtha' med/ /'khor ba'i las la zin pa gang*/

/srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba nyung*/ /mtshan ldan bla ma spyi bor sgoms/ /gdams ngag thig le snying du chongs/ /sems bskyed kha taun ma yengs 'tshal/ /ma khyod snying rus ldan pa dang*/ /rigs bzang mtshan ldan yin lags na/ /bu nga yar tsam tshar ba'i dus/ /dge bcu dam pa'i chos la tshud/ /dben ri sgrub phug zungs shig gyis/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grims shig gyis/ /sngon gyi bag chags e dran gyis/ /yum gyis drin lan 'jal dgos gyis/ /sdug bsran snying rus ma chung gyis/ /byang sems 'gro don ma 'chugs gyis/ /kun bkur dman sa zungs shig gyis/ /nges don snying por sbyongs shig gyis/ /lus kyi sgrom bu rin po che/ /nga yang bar chad ma ldang na/ /yum gyi drin lan 'jal du re/ /gnas bzang ri khrod 'grim du re/ /zla med gcig pur 'khyam du re/ /bdag med phug par bskyod du re/ /gang shar ro snyom spyod du re/ /dpon med g.yog med bskyod du re/ /sngon sbyangs las 'phro mthud du re/ /mtshams sbyor bsngo smon 'dud du re/ /phyogs med mi yul 'grim du re/ /yum chen a ma rin po che/ /tshig de ma brjed yid la chongs/ /ngas go shes dus su zer rogs gyis/ /ma khyed kyang bsod nams chung ba dang*/ /ma med gar 'gro cha mi thig /'on kyang ma khyod ma shi bar/ /phyogs med mi 'khyams khas len yin/ /ma khyod dgongs pa gshegs pa'i tshe/ /bu nga'i 'gro sdod de nas bde/ /gang tshe 'gro don dus bab nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ /yum khyod thog mar mngon rdzogs shog /de nas yum yang mnal sad nas/ /tshig kun ma brjed sha ra ra/ /ngu zhing skyo ba skyes pa dang*/ kha ru nu zho byin nas su/ /byams pa'i skyabs 'gro mang du 'don/ /zhag po re zung bar du ni/ /yid blo ma bde phya phyo byed/ /sku rim bzang po yang yang byas/ /de nas rtag par 'bral med du/ /yig drug skyabs 'gro 'bung bar byas/

/de nas lo ngo gcig lon mtshams/ /ban bon rnams kyis sri thar byas/ /yon gyis mnyes par bgyis te brdzangs/ /yul mir dga' ston phye mar byin/ /de bar skyes pa min zer skad/ /de nas lus tshugs phran bu zin/ /chung sri gdug pa'i kha nas thar/ /dal 'byor tshe srog brtan pa yi/ /bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa'o/ chung sri'i 'phrang las grol te tshe brtan pa dang yum la snga phyi sgra don nyams dbyangs glu ru blangs pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o/ oṃ ā yur ekṣa bhe tiṣṭha hūm̐/ e ma ho/ mdangs ldan ge sar dbu ma'i 'khor lo'i steng*/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag dbang phyug padma 'byung*/ /nyon mongs tshogs gzhom sman mchog nyi 'od gsal/ /ye shes drwa ba'i rnam rol zhabs der 'dud/ kyai ho/ da ni bsdus don bstan pa ni/ /lo ni nyung tsam lon pa'i tshe/ /phyi nang 'gro sdod bral ba'i skabs/ /smra brjod tshig sgra thon pa'i dus/ /sngon gyi bag chags sna tshogs dang*/ /lung bstan rtags kyang shin tu gsal/ /nyams dang dag snang mang du byung*/ /byed las spyod 'gro sna tshogs dus/ khri brtsegs khrom sdud dbang bskur dang*/ /zor las drag sngags sgrub tshul ston/ /mdangs bzang lus kyi sha mtshan ni/ /yi ge'i gzugs kyang gsal bar mngon/ /de'i skabs mi rtsa phra ba'i stobs/ /phyogs kyi sprul sku yin gyur na/ /dbang med gzhan la shor gyis dogs/ /rtags mtshan rten 'brel kun kyang sbas/ khrom mang gseb tu ma btang zhing*/ /nang du dam par bsdad pa las/ /nyin gcig khyim mi thams cad kun/ /g.yas g.yon mgron du song ba'i shul/ /phyir log ltad mor 'khyam du phyin/ /bud med mang po 'dus nas su/ /gro ma rko zhing 'dug pa'i sar/ /nyams mtshar de ru lhags te phyin/ /kun gyis byams pa'i tshig brjod cing*/ /gro ma rtswa yi 'bul ba byung*/ /cung zhig kha mig g.yeng ba'i skabs/ /rlung dmar drag po 'khyil ba na/ /bud med bdud rigs nag mo des/

/rgyab gos khyer nas bdag la gtums/ /dar gcig gos dang thal zhags kyis/ /'tshangs te dbugs mi thon par gyur/ /de nas rlung dmar chad pa dang*/ /langs kyang mgo na zhe kha log /lus kyang mi bde lhang nger snang*/ /gro ma rnams kyang phos thabs btang*/ /nang du mgyogs par log nas kyang*/ /cung zad thom mer 'dug pa'i tshe/ /mgron po rnams kyang log nas byung*/ /yum gyis sdang mig bltas nas su/ /thal rlung nang du gar 'gro zer/ /smra ba ma nus had de bsdad/ /'dir shog nu zho sbyin no zer/ /phyin yang nu zho ma 'dod pas/ /bu 'di grib kyis phog 'dug zer/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms bzlas nas su/ /gdong la yang yang spur nas byung*/ /phran tsam phan pa'i nyams kyang shar/ /nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /bud med re thul can zhig gis/ /lus la mi gtsang btab pa dang*/ /mun rub kha char 'thib pa dang*/ /de sogs ngan pa mang zhig rmis/ /de nas nam langs nyi shar dus/ /sha bkrag rtags mtshan rnams kyang yal/ /sngon sbyangs bag chags thams cad dang*/ /dag snang mngon mkhyen ma lus kun/ /rmi lam yal ba'i rjes shul bzhin/ /tha mal dbang po lta bur gyur/ /yum ni blo yang ma bde zhing*/ /sngar gyi rtags dag mi 'dug pas/ /bar chad 'dra zhig yin 'ong zer/ /sku rim skyon sel rab tu 'bung*/ /de phan mi bde med par grags/ /rkyen de byung ba'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /sngon tshe mon kha lho phyogs su/ kho bo sngags 'chang yin pa'i dus/ /bzhin gsal cho 'brang legs pa ste/ /sku rim zhig tu 'gro ba'i tshe/ kha drag can gyi bud med zhig kho bo'i gzugs la chags nas su/ /'dod sred tshig tshogs smras pa la/ kho bos sdang sems 'ba' zhig gi /tshig rtsub ngag 'chal bgyis pa las/ /bdud rigs mo de khros nas kyang*/ /ngag tu mi rung 'di skad zer/ /sngags nag chang skyil ra bsha' mkhan/ khyod la bud med yod pa las/ /sdom pa tsam ni srung mi dgos/ /nag chags lus kun 'dra 'dra la/

/nga la sdang tshig kho na byed/ /deng yang nga la 'bu shub byed/ /da ni thar pa'i re ltos med/ /sdig to dmyal bar lhung ba la/ /ma dag gcig dang gnyis su med/ /ngan 'gro'i gnas su 'gro ba la/ /sdig to'i dpung tshan hrag na dga'/ /nga ni 'dre mor skyes nas su/ khyod la gnod 'tshe nus par byed/ /de skad smon lam log par btab/ /nyi ma de nas bzung ba ru/ /gson 'dre nag mo de nyid kyis/ /rab byung bcu gsum sdom pa phab/ /dug kyang 'ga' re btang ba dang*/ /srog chags rnams kyang mang du bsad/ /de tshe kho bos smon lam du/ /rnal 'byor nga la lha yod cing*/ /yi dam chos skyong mnyes pa na/ /bdud mo'i srog snying har len gyis/ /smyo kha chen po mthu ma chung*/ /bdag kyang skye ba yang yang du/ /bdud mo sgrol ba'i gnyen por shog /ces pa'i lan du de skad btab/ /phyi nangs snga zhogs dkyil 'khor bsdus/ khengs sems dang bcas nang du log /drag gtad nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bris/ /bdud mo bkug ste klu la gtad/ /nā ga kha tham rgyas kyang btab/ /de nas ri khrod gcig tu phyin/ /dpa' bo rta mgrin lcags ral sgrub/ /bdud mo bsgral ba'i dmigs pa gtad/ /de nas lo gsum ma lon gong*/ /bdud mo lcong nad mdze yis zin/ /lo gnyis mtshams nas dbang po bsnubs/ /de tshe smon lam ngan pa des/ /'di'i gong 'di dang bar chad gnyis/ /bdud mo de yi sprul pas gnod/ /'on kyang kho bo rang nyid kyis/ /snying rje'i phan sems chung ba dang*/ khong khro dmod pa drag pos lan/ /nam yang rgyu 'bras gtso che phyir/ /de nas bud med de nyid kyis/ /mi dge bcu spyod rnam smin gyis/ /skyes rabs sum cu rtsa bdun tshun/ /gnod 'tshe sdang sems thong ba med/ /rgya mtshor chu gnas nges par skye/ /sngon gyi las 'bras de ltar dbang*/ /bdud mo de yis ma sdang na/ /lo ni bcu gsum lon pa'i mtshams/ kha byang bka' rgya 'byin par 'gyur/

/de bzhin rgyal bas lung yang bstan/ /deng sang mang po 'ga' zhig gis/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa la/ /bdud dang rkyen gyis ga la tshugs/ /rkyen khar song na byang sems min/ /mngon shes med na grub thob min/ /rang tshod ma zin mkhas pa min/ /bzang ngan mi 'byin drung po min/ /de 'dra zer mkhan mang 'dug ste/ /rkyen gyis bsdus pa'i phung po de/ /'ja' lus tshe srog ma grub bar/ /rkyen gyis mi sgrib rdzun du 'dug /de yang rkyen la phra rags mang*/ /sngon las rkyen dang 'phral gyi rkyen/ /bsgrubs pa'i rkyen dang rnam gsum ste/ /sngon las rkyen gyis dbang gyur na/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shāka thub la/ /lhas sbyin bdud kyis lan gsum 'tshe/ /tha ma skyon chen sku la reg /cung zad snyun pa'i tshul yang bstan/ /slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyi/ /sku la gson sreg lan gsum byas/ /slob dpon bai ro tsa na yang*/ /mthar phud tsha ba'i rong du spyugs/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa la/ /sbyor ba dug gi zas kyang drang*/ /de rnams sangs rgyas dngos lags te/ /sku la bar chad ma tshugs kyang*/ /rkyen de 'phrad pa sngon gyi las/ /mkhyen kyang bzlog tu ma mchis so/ /'phral du langs pa'i rkyen dbang gis/ /dan phag thar pa nag po gnyis/ /chig dril chos la 'bungs na yang*/ /rtogs pa bzang ngan ma 'chams nas/ /thar pa nag po ru trar skyes/ /de rnams don la dgra bcom mo/ /sring mo gaṅgā'i lha mo yis/ /byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya phab/ /de yang 'phral du byung ba'i rkyen/ /rgyal po glang dar sngon gyi tshe/ /mchod rten bya rung kha shor bzhengs/ /smon lam bzang ngan ma 'chams nas/ /phyi mar bstan pa'i ru trar skyes/ /de rnams 'phral du langs pa'i rkyen/ khyad du ro snyom bsgrubs pa yis/ /nā ros dka' ba bcu drug spyad/ /de yang lag pas nyes pa'i rkyen/ /karma pakṣi rgya la phebs/ khrims la gtug te ro yang snyom/

/de rnams khyad du bsgrubs pa'i rkyen/ /bar du legs nyes phran bu yang*/ /mtha' ru mngon pa'i rgyu mtshan de/ /grub thob skyes bu'i gnas tshul yin/ de rnams bskal pa bzang po'i dus/ /deng sang lnga brgya tha ma la/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yang*/ /sgrub tshul ting 'dzin thang lhod kyis/ /grub rtags phran bu ma lags pa'i/ /rkyen dbang mi 'chor sdod pa dkon/ /'dul ba'i kha bshad mkhas pa dang*/ /'brug pa'i rtogs ldan khros po dang*/ /rnying ma'i sgom nag chang brgyag pa/ /'bri stag karma'i grwa rgyun gyis/ /tha snyad tshig tshogs brtsams pa yi/ /rtog ge'i grub mtha' can rnams dang*/ /bskyed rdzogs phyi nang mi 'byed pa'i/ /gter ma rdzun po mkhas 'dod dang*/ /gnad du mi phebs 'ga' zhig gis/ /rtog pa zang thal yin no skad/ /lta ba sgom med yin no skad/ /'bras bur rgyu 'bras mi 'jig skad/ /rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ro skad/ /chags 'dzin 'khri ba zad do skad/ khor yug 'od gsal 'char ro skad/ /'di phyi rang dbang thob bo skad/ /mi 'ong kha rgyang mthon po yis/ /rnam smin g.yang la lhung nyen che/ /gol sa bag med shor ba mang*/ /don med grub mtha' rtsod 'dra'i tshig /mkhas 'dod tha snyad ma yin te/ kho bo skye ba 'ga' re nas/ /rkyen dbang shor ba mang mang bas/ /sngon las bdud mo'i bar chad 'dis/ /lo shas tsam du bsgribs pa yi/ /rnam thar gzhan gyis gzigs tsa na/ /don med tha snyad can rnams kyis/ /gter ston zer mi 'di rnams ni/ /slob dpon dngos su yin no skad/ /rgyud sde thugs nas shar ro skad/ /'di phyi bar gsum dgongs so skad/ /rdzogs chen dgag sgrub bral lo skad/ /rang mtho'i skad cha mang na yang*/ /don la zas gos grib tsam gyis/ /rkyen dang gnod pa mi bzod cing*/ /rkyen de sngon las ma shes par/ /yun ring rkyen gyis bsgribs gyur na/ /thugs rje mngon med zhen pa'i rtags/

/ci phyir dus phyis gter ston rnams/ /gsung la nges pa med pa dang*/ /gti mug can gyi blun gtam gyis/ /gshe skur ngan song sgrub dogs nas/ /skyon dang yon tan phyes pa yin/ /gang phyir ma go ha cang tshig /sbom po smra ba'i rigs rnams kyis/ /rkyen dang bag chags srab 'thug gis/ /gos pa'i sgrib pa med ce na/ /phyis 'byung dbye gsal bstan pa ni/ /tai lo shes rab bzang po yis/ /dka' ba til brdungs spyad pa las/ /grub thob de khar mi bzhugs par/ /dka' las chen pos ma 'tsher ram/ mkhas pa nā ro paṇa chen gyis/ /dka' ba bcu drug bcad pa las/ grub thob de khar mi bzhugs par/ /rkyen kun len pas ci la phan/ /pha rgan mar pa lo tsā yis/ /rgya gar snying rus bskor ba las/ /ma bslab lo tsā ma mdzad par/ /mchil lham zad pas ci la phan/ /rje btsun mi la ras pa yis/ /yun ring dka' thub mdzad pa bas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo mi bskor bar/ /gcig pur bzhugs pa ci la phan/ /mnyam med dwags po rin chen gyis/ /zhen log chos bcu sgom pa las/ /sngar nas dwags sgom mi zhu bar/ /phyogs med 'grims pas ci la phan/ /de sogs grub mtha' so sor yang*/ /nor bu dang ni phyi dril bzhin/ /gser dang g.ya' yi rnam pa ltar/ /cung zad bag chags sbyong ba yod/ /ye nas shes byas ma sgrib na/ /'byung lnga klong du gyur nas su/ /pad 'byung lta bur mi byed pa/ /grangs med mngal sgo 'grim don chung*/ /las rung tsam gyi rtogs pa yis/ /bden pa'i legs nyes 'dor nus na/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mi skam par/ /las ngan sems can mang po 'di/ /sdug bsngal 'khor bar ci la phyung*/ /'di yang bag chags yod pa'i rtags/ /sangs rgyas sems can gzhi gcig kyang*/ /rang ngo shes dang ma shes khyad/ /phran bu bag chags yod pa yin/ /de tsam nyams mtshar tha snyad skad/ /'gro ba'i mgon po bka' brgyud la/ /grub thob bla mar ma bsten pa'i/ /byang sems mang du byon pa yod/

/grub thob dka' ba spyad tshul de/ /a 'thas bag chags sbyangs pa min/ /rjes 'jug snying rus can rnams kyis/ /chos phyir dka' ba spyad tshul dang*/ /grub thob mi 'dra mngon 'dod na/ /'di tsam dgos pa yin zer ba'i/ /kun rdzob brda de bstan pa'o/ /de bas phran bu bdag 'dra tsho/ /rkyen gyis mi sgrib ga la mchis/ /dper na zhing sa bzang po ru/ /so nam sa bon legs na yang*/ /ljang bu nas su ma gyur bar/ /sad dang ser bas bcom pa mang*/ /nas 'bras mngon du gyur pa'i tshe/ /kun rdzob lhag pa'i bdud dang bral/ /de bas lam zhugs rjes 'jug rnams/ /rkyen de lam sbyong tshe na dgra/ /'bras bur reg na grogs kyi mchog /'di yan bdud mo'i bar chad de/ /smon lam ngan pa'i stobs shugs kyis/ /sha rtags mngon shes bsgribs pa yi/ /rgyu 'bras las mtha' mi bslu bar/ /shar tshul tsam du sbyar ba yin/ /tshig 'dis bcad pa yan chod rnams/ /bdud mo'i bar chad byung tshul yin/ /skyon mtshang mthong ba'i gnad de ni/ /don 'dis bcad pa tshun chad de/ /rkyen de'i 'brel ba chad pa yin/ /zhes pa lo rgyus rnam thar ro/ sngon las 'bras bu rnam smin bzang ngan bstan pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o/ oṃ badzra tsitta e khaṃ swā bha hūm̐/ e ma ho/ ye shes 'khor lo'i bdag nyid rdo rje'i dbyings/ /gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi rnam rol ba/ /kun tu khyab pa'i thugs mchog padma 'byung*/ /drin can bla ma rje yi zhabs la 'dud/ kyai/ de nas lo ni 'ga' tsam 'gro ba ru/ /sngon gyi gzhi bdag rnams dang ma 'phrad de/ khrel med rgan po rnams kyis khral log shom/ /de tshe la gcig brgyab nas yul yang spos/ /shar phyogs gnas chen yer phug bya ba'i mdun/ /tshag rag thang zhes bya bar 'brog kha brgyab/ /de nas gnas chen yer phug 'gro bar shom/ /de yi nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /brag dkar mtho la mdzes chags shig tu ni/ /phyin te gnas dang phug pa btsal ba'i tshe/

/shar phyogs 'gyu ba'i phug pa zhig gi nang*/ /bud med mang pos tshogs 'khor btang nas su/ /rgyan ldan gar dang rol mo sgrog pa dang*/ /dri bzang bsregs shing dbyangs ring len pa 'dug /bdag kyang de rnams drung du phyin pa'i tshe/ /gtso mo mthing gi lan tshar can de yis/ /ming po byung zer dga' ba bgyis nas su/ /gdan dkar chung ngu zhig gi kha ru bzhag /grib kyis gos 'dug zer nas khrus kyang bstsal/ /tshogs 'khor rol dang tshe chang myong ba dang*/ /dga' ston gus pas 'dud par bgyi ba la/ khyed rnams su yin ji skad dris pa las/ /ma sring gtso mo de yis lan btab par/ kyai ho rigs kyi skal ldan nyon/ /nged rnams yin pa'i 'dra tshul bshad/ /gnas 'di yang rdzong shel brag yin/ /nged rnams las kyi mkha' 'gro yin/ /rigs khyod gnubs kyi lo tsā yin/ /dus 'di snyigs ma lnga bdo yin/ /deng 'dir rten 'brel bzang po yin/ /smon lam las kyis 'brel ba yin/ /bsod nams mi zad tshogs 'khor yin/ /ro mchog bdud rtsi tshe chang yin/ /rgyan 'di mdzes pa'i cod pan yin/ /glu 'di nyams dbyangs mgur tshig yin/ /don 'di gnyug ma'i gnas lugs yin/ /yin tshul de skad yid la zungs/ /zhes pa'i lung yang bstan pa dang*/ /de ma thag tu gnyid kyang sad/ /sems la skyo ba lhang lhang ngang*/ /bltas na mig gis mthong ngam sems/ /sgo ru thon te phyogs su bltas/ /nam mkhar skar ma deng nger 'dug /gang yang mi snang nang du log /nam langs khyim mi thams cad ni/ /gnas ri mjal du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /shug chen gdong la slebs pa dang*/ /dgon pas 'tshogs dung btang nas byung*/ /'bum khang sgo ru sleb pa'i tshe/ /gser 'phrur nyi ma lhag ger shar/ /dkor gnyer gdan drangs mchod mjal tshe/ /shes pa zin tsam mi zin du/ /yang yang de ltar gnas pa'i tshe/ /mchod khang me 'od 'khyil 'dra'i nyams/ /de nang khro bo nag po zhig /rdo rje phur pa thogs nas su/

/gar thabs khrig khrig bgyis pa dang*/ /thugs las 'od zer 'ga' re zhig /bdag gi snying khar zug pa dang*/ /shin tu bag tsha'i snang ba shar/ /de ltar yang yang de yi ngang*/ /yab kyi sgal par 'byar nas su/ /dpal ldan lha mo mjal du phyin/ /lha mo ji bzhin yin pa las/ /bud med mche ba bsdams pa zhig /a hi kā li zer ba dang*/ /bdag kyang sngangs thabs lta ba las/ /lha mo'i phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su/ /ind+ra nī la'i dbyibs ltar la/ /bang rim mang po yod pa zhig /stong phrag tsam du red pa dang*/ /po ti brtsegs pa 'dra ba la/ /'khor lo bskor ba'i gzugs dod pa/ /mchod khang khyon ni sgrom bu tsam/ /bsam na dpag tshad yin 'dra ba/ /brag dmar dkyil du yin 'dra 'dra/ /rmi lam yul du ji bzhin mthong*/ /de ni nyams snang 'char tshul lo/ /yis phug bla ma sems pas gsol ja gnang*/ /de nas mgyogs par nang du log ste phyin/ /nyin gcig rmo mo de yi phyi la 'brangs/ /yis srib thang shing sgu ru'i rtsa bar bsdad/ /thang shing 'bras bu phab nas mang spungs te/ /rmo mo de la ri zhal gyis smras pas/ /'o na nyon dang ri zhal bya'o zer/ /a phyi'i lag na thur tshags thogs nas su/ kyai/ ri rtser sgom zhu rang byon yod pa ni/ /rig 'dzin grub thob rgyun mi 'chad pa'i brda/ /rgyab tu tshe bum rang byon yod pa ni/ /byin rlabs rgyun mi chad pa 'bab pa'i brda/ /g.yon du dung dkar rang byon yod pa ni/ /snyan pa'i thugs rje rgyangs nas sgrog pa'i brda/ /g.yas su phag zhal nag po yod pa ni/ /phag mo grub pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i brda/ /mdun du slob dpon kha ṭwāṃ rang byon ni/ /the'u rang spun dgu dam la btags pa'i brda/ /de yi 'og tu dre'u zhal yod pa ni/ /dpal ldan lha mor 'khor gyis bskor ba'i brda/ /thang du gtsang chab nar ma 'bab pa ni/ /mchod sprin rgya mtsho phun sum tshogs pa'i brda/ /'gro mgon sangs rgyas yer pa'i zhal nas kyang*/

/gnas 'di bsams nas gom gsum bgrod pa na/ /mi ske chad kyang 'byor nges the tshom med/ khams kyi gla ba rkang gcig 'di yin no/ /chu 'dzul 'gag gi pha bong sbom po'i 'og /the'u rang thams cad dam la btags nas mnan/ /de tshe slob dpon phebs pa'i sgrub phug ni/ /mdzod kyi ri la da lta mjal rgyu yod/ /de skad gnas kyi lo rgyus zer ba de/ /byis pa chung chung de 'dra e go zer/ /da ni grod khog ltogs pa 'dra 'ong bas/ khyod rang a ma'i rtsa ru log song zer/ /'gro grabs byas shing 'bras bu mthu bar btum/ /gnas rir lta zhing thur du bab tsa na/ /lam kha zhig tu bu mo chung ngu 'phrad/ /byis pa gar song shing 'bras ston dang zer/ /shing 'bras sbas shing 'o dod btab pa la/ /a ces 'phrog tu ma yin lta ba yin/ /nga yi lag gi 'di la ltos shig zer/ /lag tu bltas pas me long sbom po zhig /nang du gzugs brnyan sna tshogs shar ba mthong*/ /dar cig de la bltas shing g.yeng ba'i tshe/ /me long de ni zhing khams shig tu gyur/ /dbus su khye'u lo brgyad skra cog can/ /rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba zhig la ni/ /gar mo lang ling mang pos bskor nas su/ /rol mo mchod sprin sna tshogs thogs pa dang*/ /kun gyis bdud rtsi gsol zhing bdag la sbyin/ /byis pa badzra gu ru bgrongs dang zer/ /badzra gu ru ci yin smras pa na/ /gar mo kun gyis bzhad gad lhang lhang byed/ /badzra gu ru au ḍī yā yin zer/ /au ḍī yā de ci yin smras tsa na/ /au ḍī yā de pha yin ma yin zer/ khyed kyi pha de au ḍī yin 'ong zer/ /nga yi pha ni au ḍī yā min smras/ /bud med khyed tsho kha mang 'ga' re 'dug /nga ni a ma'i rtsa ru log 'gro yin/ kha ngan 'dra zhig yin nam snyam pa dang*/ /shing 'bras btums te 'gro grabs byas tsa na/ /dbus ma'i khye'u de yis lan btab par/ kyai/ pha bu tshogs pa'i rten 'brel zhe sdang la/ /bag chags sgrib pas g.yogs pa'i blun po che/

/srid pa'i khye'u 'khrul gzugs tha mal pa/ /don la rmongs pas kha tshig nga rgyal can/ /sngon yang khong khro 'ga' zhig bsags pa yis/ /rang zog pha nor don med gzhan la shor/ /bag chags ngan goms gyis dang 'di 'dra 'ong*/ /rmongs chen khong khro de dang ma bral na/ /pha bu yang yang mjal dka' 'tshogs par dkon/ /'on kyang kha tshig ma yin zhal gdams yin/ /de bas khong khro lang yang khyod rang sdug /ces gsung de ma thag tu dran pa zin/ kho bo'i pha rgan pad 'byung yin par go kyai/ dus gsum sangs rgyas skyabs gcig 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ḍākki ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'gro mgon yab yum thugs rje'i spyan snga ru/ /bag med byis pa'i khro gtum rmongs pa'i tshogs/ /bzod par gsol bas skad cig de nyid la/ /brtse chen bdag cag yal bar ma 'dor lags/ /de skad bshags pa phul zhing phyag kyang 'tshal/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal ba dang*/ /rmi lam sad pa'i snang ba 'dra zhig 'dug /shing thog khyer te nang du log nas song*/ /chu khar slebs tshe a mar yang yang bos/ /chu las a mas khur nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /sngar gyi nyams snang de dag bshad pa la/ /byis pas dgon pa rig pa yin 'ong bas/ kha mang bshad bshad mang po ma byed zer/ /lo gcig yul der bsdad pa yin yod 'dra/ /de mthar gsang gi gad lam bya ba ru/ /lam du zhugs phyir 'brog gi ru ba bskyal/ /nyin gcig gsang rgyal jo mo'i cho 'phrul las/ /thog ser kha char bu yug 'tshub pa dang*/ /gzugs med sgra skad sna tshogs thos par byung*/ /de nas skag nyi'i la rgyab de ru yang*/ /lo shas tsam du de khar bsdad pa 'dra/ /de nas zhang po rgyal tshang yod pa'i sar/ khyab chen lung pa bya bar ru ba bskyal/ /g.yas g.yon phyogs der bdud ru zhes pa yi/ khyi ra rngon pa mang po 'dug pa dang*/ /thams cad rgyun du ri dwags 'gyed 'gro 'dug /de gar lo shas tsam zhig bsdad pa las/ /yul de'i mig ltos ngan pa lobs nas su/

/pha yang ri dwags 'ded par 'gro 'dug pas/ /nyin gcig nga yang khrid rogs gyis byas par/ /thag ring yin no 'khyag dang ltogs 'ong bas/ /byis pa nang du sdod tshugs gyis shig zer/ /nyin mo de la phyi ru 'brang ma bcug /de yi phyir nyin zhogs su sngar lta bu/ /thams cad ri dwags 'ded tu song ba'i rjes/ khyim mis mi mthong sa ru phyi 'brang byas/ /ri dwags 'ded pa'i sa cha de y-i ming*/ /dpag lcam bon po stag thul can zhes bya/ /bon zhwa rtsa ru thams cad phyin te 'byor/ /de nas brag phug zhig tu sleb pa'i tshe/ /me hom sbar te de ru sdod cig zer/ /gzhan rnams thams cad ri dwags 'ded du song*/ /zla grogs med par cung zad bsdad pa'i rjes/ /sngangs skrag yam yom spu zing byed pa la/ /phug pa'i sgo ru lta bar lhags pa'i tshe/ /mi nag 'jigs pa bon zhwa gyon pa zhig /byis pas ci byed su la blta zhes zer/ /yag yag nga ni kha rogs sdod pa yin/ /de skad smras kyang dam gyis bzung ba dang*/ /sngangs thabs shig tu brgyal bar gyur pa'i tshe/ /zangs thang dmar po khrag mtsho khol ma'i klong*/ /zangs ri dmar po rngam la mtho ba'i nang*/ /btsan gzugs mang po 'tshogs pa'i khyim du slebs/ /mi sha skam rlon 'tshod cing za ba dang*/ /shes tsam mi shes mi ro mang du 'dug /bdag kyang g.yang gzhi zhig gi kha ru bzhag /sha dang snying khrag byin pas zos pa dang*/ khyod rnams su yin gling 'di ci zer smras/ /mi dmar gtso bo de yis lan btab par/ /gling 'di mdo khams sa yi lte ba yin/ /nga ni zangs btsan beg rtse 'bar ba yin/ /mkhar 'di sku rgyal she ne bya ba yin/ /nga ni khyod kyi rgyun du grogs po yin/ khyed kyi skye ba 'di yi phyi ma ru/ /rten 'brel dus la bab pa'i nyi ma la/ /pho brang shar lho 'di ru chas shig yod/ /ma brjed shog dang sbyin no sbyin no zer/ /da res bon des bar chad byas 'dug par/ /ngas ni skyong zhing srog skyob byas pa yin/

/skad cha de rnams ma bshad gsang zhig dang*/ /zla bo rnams kyang da lta sleb yong zer/ /de ma thag tu rmi lam sad lta bu/ /sngar gyi bon po de yang mi snang zhing*/ /nye ba'i sa nas mi skad lhang lhang thos/ /bltas pas rngon pa thams cad log nas byung*/ /ha ring 'don bzhin ri dwags ma sod zer/ de yi nang nas nye ba'i bu tsha zhig /tha ba bsad pa'i ro zhig thogs nas 'dug /de ma thag tu mer sreg btang nas su/ /byis pa ltogs yod zer nas nga la byin/ /rnam smin yong yong bsams bzhin zos pa dang*/ /rngon pa thams cad nang du log ste phyin/ /mun rub tsam la khyim du sleb pa dang*/ /yum gyis rdung rdeg byas nas kha po bshad/ /byis pa rgyag pa nang du mi sdod par/ /bzo lta sdug cag da lta 'di tsam nas/ /sdig gsog rngon pa byed pa'i phyi 'brang byed/ /da nas nyin re de bzhin 'gro srid na/ /'ug pa skad po che la sbyin no zer/ /de nas lo shas tsam zhig kha rog bsdad/ /yang cig khyab chen bla ma'i ri yi rtser/ /rngon pa thams cad ri dwags 'ded du song*/ /sngar bzhin yum gyis mi rig byas nas su/ /rngon pa rnams kyi phyi la 'brang nas phyin/ kha la sprel gyi ri rtser thon pa dang*/ /brag gi skar khung mi lus shong tsam nang*/ /ring mo zhig la zhugs nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /shin tu dben pa brag gi spyil bu zhig /mchod khang ka cha chos dang rdza snod bcas/ khyim tshang thor tsam yod pa'i nang du slebs/ /nyams mtshar spro ba skyes te rgyang tsam bsdad/ /nyi ma de yang shin tu dro ba dang*/ /byis pa khyed rang 'di ru sdod cig zer/ /rngon pa rnams ni ri dwags phyi la song*/ /de ru bsdad pas sngar gyi bag chags las/ /yi ge blta'o bsam zhing dpe cha klog /de yi nang nas mgur 'bum 'dra ba yi/ /po ti chung ngu 'dug pa thogs nas su/ /spyil po'i sgo ru nyi ma nang du phyin/ /dpe cha de la mi phyed dad pa thob/ /mgo ru bzhag nas smon lam btab pa dang*/

/sngar ma mi shes pa yi yul yang dran/ /yi ge zhal phyes legs par bltas ba'i tshe/ /yig 'bru ka ta ca yang ngo shes song*/ /sgrub phug de yang rang khyim yin par go /bsam pa bzang ngan rtog pas ma bslad par/ /nye gnas nye gnas zer nas 'bod pa'i tshe/ /spyil po'i nang nas lan mo byas nas su/ /ci red byis pas yi ge ma dkrugs zer/ /nga la gsol ja khur shog bgyis pa la/ /nang du byon dang gsol ja bskol yod zer/ /dpe cha khur nas spyil po'i nang du song*/ /ci ltar dngos po yod pa lta bu la/ khyim yang bag dro lhun chags ldan pa'i nang*/ /chas ka la sogs phun sum tshogs par 'dug /btsun pa kha sho zhig gis ja bskol zhing*/ /nam mkhar thugs rten me gor bzhugs sam zer/ /me gor sdod na 'grigs sam smras pa'i tshe/ /go khar gdan bting 'di ru bzhugs shig zer/ /sngar gyi rtsam phor chen po yod pa de/ /ja yis bkang nas bdag la legs par drang*/ /gzhan yang zas sna 'ga' re mdun du bsham/ /bla ma da bar ga ru byon ces zer/ /bdag gis de la lan mo bgyis pa la/ /nga ni rgya gar zangs gling phyin pa yin/ /dbus gtsang dwags kong phyogs la phyin pa yin/ /lo mang 'u bu mjal rgyu ma byung yang*/ /sku chas 'di rnams chud kyang ma zos drag khyed kyi kha de ci byas sho ba yin/ /ma rgas sdod pa 'di 'dra nyams mtshar a/ /de skad tshig tsam kho la bgyis pa la/ kho yis bdag la lan du 'di skad zer/ /nga ni khyed nyid gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /sku gdung sbyangs nas lo phyed rdzogs pa dang*/ /a ra jag pa mang pos mgo brdungs nas/ /shi ma gson du nyi ma lnga tsam lus/ /de dus sdug bsngal smon lam btab pa yis/ /da lta yul 'dir btsan du skyes pa yin/ /da lan ser chas byas pa ma gtogs pa/ /rgyun du skya chas byas nas sdod pa lags/ /de yi lan du bdag gis 'di skad smras/ khyed nyid yon tan bzang po yod pa la/ /skya chas byas nas sdod pa ga la rung*/

/nga ni sngar gyi yon tan mi 'dug pas/ khyed kyis nga la yi ge slob rogs gyis/ /de ring nged rang dpon slob gnyis po ni/ /nang du a ma'i go ru log nas 'gro/ /sangs gnang bdag gi gos lag khyer nas su/ /'di ru yi ge slob par 'ong dgos grags/ /de skad kho la bdag gis lan btab pas/ kho yi kha spor mi 'dus dgod bzhin pa'i/ /nga yang sngon gyi yon tan brjed pa dang*/ /da ltar ri 'di'i bdag po yin pa la/ /yi ge slob dang 'don pa byed lugs med/ /de bas slob dpon zhang po gyis shig dang*/ /lo 'gar song mtshams dbus su 'gro dgos yod/ /da lta khyod rang bya ra bgyis shig dang*/ /ri dwags bsad nas 'di ru sleb ran zer/ /sgo drung don nas bya ra byas pa'i tshe/ /rngon pas sha khur lang ling log nas byung*/ /nang du skad cha smra bar phyin tsa na/ /mi dang chas rnams gang yang med nas song*/ /sngar gyi dpe cha thang ka gog po rnams/ /bag rdul chags shing kha rog bsdad nas 'dug /po ti gcig tsam bdag gis bklags pa de/ khyim dang sgo drung kun la gtor ste 'dug /de tshe cung zad sems yang mi dga' zhing*/ /gnyid log 'dra ni sdod pa ma yin yang*/ /rmi lam 'dra ba gang yin bsam gzhig btang*/ /de ni cho 'phrul yin bsam ha yang go /de ma thag tu rngon pa slebs nas byung*/ /byis pa gcig pu 'jigs skrag e byung zer/ /de 'dra ma byung mang po 'ga' re mthong*/ /dag tsam ma dag skad cha bshad pa la/ /byis pa lha 'dres khyer grabs byas 'dug pas/ /gnyid 'dra log nas sdod pa yin 'ong zer/ /de nas nga yi skad cha ma nyan zhing*/ /kun gyis me shing bsgrubs nas me btang te/ /ri dwags gsum gyi rgyu ma bsregs te zos/ /sha rnams thams cad mu rim bzhin du bgos/ /byis pa'i skal ba gzhan gyis khyer ces zer/ /de tshe bdag gis yi ge blangs pa la/ /rngon pa rnams kyis sdang tshig sna tshogs kyis/ /sngon gyi ri phug gog po 'di dag nas/

/dpe cha yig rigs khyer yang mi rung zhing*/ /byis pa byed las 'bel po 'di 'dra de/ /nyi ma da nas phyi la ma 'ong zer/ /ngar ngar sdang tshig mang po btang ba dang*/ kho rang rnams kyis skad cha byas nas su/ /yi ge yod sar me yang 'bud pa len/ /ma rungs yi ge blta dang klog pa 'dis/ /ri dwags mi sod de 'dra byed 'ong zer/ /rngon pa'i gral dpon sdig chen de nyid kyis/ /ri dwags g.yang gzhi lan gsum brdab pa dang*/ /lag yog rnams kyis smon lam ngan pa 'debs/ /sha sna snying sna'i mchod pa byas nas su/ /'ur sgra dir dir mthur du babs nas song*/ /nyi ma ma thal tsam du khyim la 'khyol/ /yum gyis dbyug pa thogs te ded nas byung*/ /bros pas ma zin ri yi logs su thar/ /mun rab bar du nang du log ma bcug /byis pa ma dag rigs can 'di 'dra zer/ /byis pa 'di tsam sdig la 'bag 'dug pas/ /da nas song dang rgyus pa breg go zer/ /yum gyis ri dwags sha yang za ma nyan/ /de yi zhogs pa lham yang mi gtad cing*/ /snod kyi nang du dam por brdzangs nas song*/ /yum la sngar ltar skad cha bshad pa las/ /byis pa rdzun ma mkhan khyod kha tshum zer/ /sdang tshig rdung gtag byed pa'i grabs shom 'dug /de nas lo gcig lon pa yin nam mtshams/ /nub mo zhig tu nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /bud med dkar mo rus pa'i rgyan cha can/ /phyag tu ḍā ru bhandha thogs nas su/ /gar thabs khrig khrig byed pa'i zhal nas ni/ kye ho/ skal ldan thugs kyi sras/ /bsod nams las kyi 'phro mtha' can/ kho mo'i sras khyod legs par nyon/ /nga ni rgyal yum rnam 'phrul ma/ /tshe 'dzin lha lcam bde ba mtsho/ /rig 'dzin rgyal sras pad 'byung gi /dbang bskur me tog gnang ba'i tshe/ /klong dgu brda rtags snang ba shar/ /brda dgu ye shes klong du gyur/ /gsal stong drwa ba'i rnal 'byor ma/ /'khrul rtog gzhom pa'i dpa' mo yin/ /nga ni mkha' spyod dbyings su gnas/

/sprul pa mi yi yul du yod/ /da ni bu yi grogs su mchis/ /deng nas sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ /dam pa chos kyi dbu tshugs shig /tshe rabs mdun ma'i gzhi thing zhig /'khrul med rgyal ba'i gnas zungs shig /bag chags sgyu ma'i gos dor cig /lhan skyes ye shes grogs 'tshol cig /'od gsal ma bu'i gnad bsres shig /snang srid brda ru bstan pa yin/ /yi ge klong nas shar ba yin/ /dpe don tshig gis mtshon pa yin/ /smyu gu dran rig so ma yin/ /shog bu kun gzhi rten pa yin/ /'bri mkhan rlung gi ri mo yin/ /slob dpon gcig shes kun grol yin/ /gdams ngag thig le nyag gcig yin/ /man ngag zhal shes snyan brgyud yin/ /nyams len gang shar 'dzin med yin/ /gzer bu rang ngo 'phrod pa yin/ /gnad ni spro bsdu'i 'khrul 'khor yin/ /lam ni shes pa thog grol yin/ /gegs sel rjes shes bag yod yin/ /lag len brtson 'grus 'brel med yin/ blo gtad dkon mchog gsum po yin/ /rtsal sbyang bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin/ /nor rdzas rang sems kun 'byung yin/ pha yul phyogs med dben ri yin/ /snying po rdo rje theg pa yin/ /brda de legs par yid la zungs/ kho mo'i zhal nas de skad gsungs nas su/ /lus la bdud rtsi gtor zhing byin pa dang*/ /dam tshig gnad yin gzhan la ma bshad zer/ /de ma thag tu rmi lam sad pa ltar/ /nam mkha' rnams kyang sangs sangs gsal bar gyur/ /a mar rmi lam de rnams bshad pa'i tshe/ /gzhan la ma bshad kha mang ma byed dang*/ /yi ge slob na lob pa'i rten 'brel red/ /ka tshar 'dra zhig slob mkhan rnyed lags na/ /zhang po'i rtsa ru yi ge slob chog zer/ /de nyin bltas pas zhang po ri khar 'dug /zhang pos dga' tshor dang bcas gar 'gro zer/ /nga ni ka tshar slob par 'ong ba yin/ /zhang pos klog pa'i dpe 'di gang yin smras/ /'di ni byams pa'i smon lam yin no zer/ /de ni nga la slob rogs gyis smras pas/

/'o na 'di ltar smros shig zer nas su/ /sangs rgyas kun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong lha mig ldan pa yis/ /ngan 'gro las ni zlog byed cing*/ /mtho ris lam ni rab ston te/ /rga shi med par 'dren bgyid pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang ni/ /nyan thos rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de tsam tshar gcig khrid pas shes/ /zhang po smra la dgyes nas su/ /da ni ka tshar bzo dgos pas/ khyod kyis g.yam pa longs shog zer/ /rdo g.yam btsal bas gru bzhi la/ /lag pa'i che tsam rnyed de thogs/ /'di yis e yong smras pa las/ /'ong 'ong 'di na ster dang zer/ /lcags kyi rna brus 'dug pa des/ /g.yam pa'i ngos su ka tshar bris/ /bslab pas de yi nyin nas lobs/ /de nas zhag 'ga'i bar du sbyangs/ /ka tshar 'khrul med 'byongs pa'i tshe/ khu bos nang chen sgar thog nas/ /ka tshar bu drug btags pa bcas/ /'bri shog thab ran tsam yod pas/ khyer nas byung ba de dag bslabs/ /de yang mi ring mgyogs par lobs/ /de nas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi/ /shog bu ldeb ma gsum tsam bslabs/ /de yang 'don spro ma byung nas/ /mi la'i mgur 'bum dum bu zhig /rdzong drug skor nas yin pa yi/ /ldeb bu nyi shu tsam zhig rnyed/ /de yang rim par slob pa las/ /zla ba gsum tsam lon pa ru/ /sngags sgra bsdus yig ma gtogs par/ /klog kyang shes pa tsam du gyur/ /lo ngo de yi dgun zla ru/ /yab yum gnyis la smras pa'i tshig /nga ni cis kyang chos la 'gro/ /bla brang zhig la bskyal rogs gyis/ /de skad yang yang tshig smras kyang*/ /da lta byis pa chung ngu yin/ khyed ni sdod tshugs mi zin zhing*/ /gal srid bande ma byung na/ /dam tshig mi thub skyon chen rgyu/ /yi ge mthar ru ma phyin par/ /bande byas pas mi 'ong zer/ /bdag gis de la lan btab nas/ /mgur 'bum 'di ni shes zin yod/ /gzhan rnams rgyab sor slob chog smras/ /'o na thon dang nyan no zer/ /bdag gis dkar me'i ngogs la ni/

/yi ge rig par mi 'dug pas/ /mgur ma blo ru 'dzin yod pas/ /blo nas 'don na chog gam smras/ /blo nas thon dang des chog zer/ /de nas bdag gi bsam pa la/ /gang ltar rdzun zhig lab nas kyang*/ /tshig grangs mtshon du ma thub kyang*/ /gang dran bya'o bsams nas su/ /nyams dbyangs 'di ltar blangs pa yin/ na mo gu ru/ /gnas bka' bab spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i steng*/ /pha rdo rje 'chang chen byin rlabs can/ khyed dad mos cod pan rgyan du bzhugs/ /chos brgyud pa ya mtshan glu zhig len/ /tai lo nam mkha'i rnal 'byor can/ /mkhyen gnyis rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /dran rig gnyis la myang 'das rdzogs/ /mi yi bla ma ma btsal bas/ /rang byung shes rab bzang po yin/ /brgyud pa gzhan la re dgos med/ /tha snyad bla mar mi smon no/ /nā ro drwa ba'i gar bsgyur mkhan/ /'dus byas phung por ma zhen cing*/ /ngo mtshar dka' ba bcu drug spyad/ /bka' bab rgyud sde'i klong chen rdol/ /grub mtha'i tshig gis rgol ba 'joms/ /mkhas pa gzhan la re dgos med/ /paṇḍi ta la mi smon no/ /mar pa sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /gsang sngags snyan brgyud sdong po yin/ /la chu phal pa ma lags pa/ /dug chu khol ma'i pha rol nas/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i snying po blangs/ /gnas lugs dgongs pa mtha' ru phyin/ /nyi zla lta bu grags pa yin/ /grub mtha'i tshig la re dgos med/ /bshad grwa gzhan la mi smon no/ /mi la bzhad pa rdo rje nyid/ /tshe gcig thar pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrubs/ /rdzu 'phrul 'byung lnga'i rtsal chen rdzogs/ /rtsa rlung snang ba dbang du bsdus/ /grub thob rgya mtshos tshad rdo bor/ /mtshungs med bka' brgyud sa bon btab/ /'ja' lus rdo rje'i lam la gshegs/ /bla ma log nas btsal dgos med/ /grub thob gzhan la mi smon no/ /rang lus rdo rje'i gnas mchog la/ /'od gsal dbyings kyi zhing khams yod/ /rtsa khams zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/

/dran rig gnyug ma'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /lhan skyes ma sring sprin ltar gtibs/ /'gyu ba rlung gi 'khor tshogs rgyas/ /'gro 'ong gnas gsum sdom pa ldan/ /ngo sprod gzhan las btsal dgos med/ /rtog ges tshig la mi smon no/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rgya mtsho nas/ /byang sems myu gu'i dpag bsam 'khrungs/ /kun gzhi rdo rje'i rtsa ba hrag /gnas lugs rtsa ba'i sdong po mtho/ /nam mkha' mdzod chen lo 'dab rgyas/ /bla med ye shes 'bras bu smin/ /ro brgya'i ting 'dzin zas kyi bcud/ /dad ldan skal ba can gyis myong*/ /slob ma grwa 'khor re dgos med/ /nyan thos gog por mi smon no/ /'khor 'das chos sku'i rgyal sa na/ /dran rig bshad pa'i slob dpon yod/ /du ma ro gcig lung bstan shar/ /zang thal rigs drug spyod 'gro mthong*/ /nyon mongs dus kyi 'phel 'grib rtogs/ /rten 'brel lugs kyi rgya rtags khrol/ /'pho 'gyu shes bya'i sa gnad rig /rtsa 'khor dgon sde'i 'tsho skyong shes/ /rtags dang mngon shes re dgos med/ /the'u rang sgrub la mi smon no/ /gangs can bod ky-i rdo rje gdan/ /yangs rdzong nam mkha' lding gi phug /'ja' dkar sprin gyi rgyal mtshan can/ /gzi 'od nyi zla'i 'od zer 'khyil/ /byang chub kyu mo'i chu rgyun 'bab/ /mkha' 'gro 'ja' sprin ji bzhin 'thib/ /rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa'i sa/ /byin chags mngon dga' lha yi gnas/ /ma dag tshogs dben rnam rgyal khang*/ /mdangs bzang skyed mo'i shel phug ldan/ /gnas ri gzhan nas btsal dgos med/ /sa mdo'i gyang ral mi smon no/ /mgur 'di dbyangs char sel ma yin/ /tshig 'di kha pho gshog rgyangs yin/ /don 'di mngon na mkhas pa yin/ /drin can rje la mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes pa'i mgur ma de rnams btang ba'i tshe/ /mi la'i mgur ma yin drag bsams nas su/ /yi ge yag po klog 'dug klog 'dug zer/ /tshig zur sgra tsam bcos pa ma lags par/

/byis pa'i dus su btang ba 'di rang yin/ /'di skabs mi ring pa zhig yin pa 'dra/ /sa rtags snga phyi da lta mi dran kyang*/ /don chen tshig 'di yid la bzung ba yin/ /de nas cung zhig song ba'i skabs su ni/ /grub thob karma snying po zhes zer ba/ /rgyu 'bras zhib mor bshad pa'i bla ma zhig /nang chen sgar du pheb skad grags pa la/ /thams cad kun la mngon shes mdzad nas kyang*/ /la la chos pa red zer bzhad pa dang*/ /la la sdig chen red zer bshums pa sogs/ /grub thob chas ka 'ga' re mdzad par thos/ khyim mi rnams kyang mjal du 'gro'o zer/ /lhan du nga yang khrid rogs gyis smras pas/ /'o na sngon du khyed rang gsum song zer/ /de nas dang por kho bo a phyi gsum/ /sngon zhag zhig nas bla ma mjal bar phyin/ kho bo lam du 'gro tshe bsam pa la/ /de ring bla ma ngu'am dgod 'ong bsam/ /grub thob zer de ci 'dra yod pa yin/ /zhwa lugs gos stabs ci 'dra yod 'ong snyam/ khas kyang de 'dra zer nas phyin pa la/ /nyi ma shar skabs bla ma'i sgo ru slebs/ /phyag rten phul nas mdun du bcar ba'i tshe/ /bla ma'i cha byad legs par bltas pa las/ /sku sha chung ngu sngo sangs 'dra zhig la/ /rnal 'byor pa yi chas su byas nas 'dug /dgyes tshul mdzad nas mgur ma 'di ltar gsungs/ na mo gu ru/ /rang lus dug lnga tsher phung 'dra ba'i dbus/ /rig pa byi'u chung gis tshang bcas nas/ /ye shes sgyu ma'i 'bras bu rol pa las/ /dka' ba tsher brdung legs tsam ma bcad na/ /ro mchog zhim mngar rol pa dka' mo 'dug /de bas dge bcur brtson 'grus ma chung gyis/ /nyams len snying po ye shes mtha' nas rgyas/ /dbyangs 'di ma brjed khye'u'i yid la zhog /grub thob pa des de 'dra gsungs pa dang*/ /bdag la snying rje dgos zer brda red bsam/ /de ma thag tu nang du log nas 'ong*/ khyim mi rnams kyis skad cha dris nas su/ /bla ma ngu'am dgod dam ci lags zer/

/bdag gis de yi lan du smras pa la/ /bla ma ngu dgod gang yang mi byed brjod/ /ltad mo 'dra ni legs nyes gang mi 'dug /bla mas mgur ni 'di ltar btang byung bshad/ /de 'dra khyod kyis ma brjed ya mtshan zer/ /de nas lo gcig 'gro'am mi 'gro'i mtshams/ /a khu de yi phyi la 'brangs nas su/ /nang chen sgar du ltad mo blta ru phyin/ /de yi rgyang tsam de ru bsdad pa las/ /nub gcig sbra yi nang du nyal ba'i tshe/ /rmi lam mam ni nyams snang za zi la/ /bud med khro mo'i lus can zhig la ni/ /shin tu mi bzad rtags brgyas rab tu spras/ khol mo lnga tsam byas nas mdun du byung*/ /mchod gtor tshogs 'khor grabs ni gyis shig dang*/ /sang nas rig 'dzin bzang po pheb 'ong zer/ /bdag gis de la lan ni 'di ltar btab/ /rig 'dzin bzang po gang 'dra zer ba yin/ /bud med khyed rnams gang nas 'ong ba yin/ /tshogs 'khor dgos na mon bu gnyer par smros/ /bdag gis de skad lan du btab pa la/ /bud med des ni khro tshul dang bcas par/ /rmongs pa'i gseb tu sdod pa'i bag grib kyis/ khyed kyi rten 'brel mngon shes 'grib zin 'dra/ /rig 'dzin a tsar sa le zhes pa yin/ khyed rnams mchims phur slob dpon zhabs drung du/ /dam tshig gzung thag gcig tu 'brel ba las/ /rten 'brel dga' ston bzang po dgos pa yin/ /nga yi chos skor sang nas 'ong yod pas/ /dbang lung zhus dang bdag po khyed rang yin/ /de yi nang nas ma tshang kha skong gi/ /las mtha' 'ga' re khyod kyi lag tu yod/ /tshig de ma bshad don de yid la zungs/ /zer nas bud med 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /de nas zhag po 'ga' re lon pa'i mtshams/ /sgar pas stag sham rdo rje phebs yod zer/ /gang nas pheb yong blta dgos bsams nas su/ /lha khang zur du blta bar phyin pa'i tshe/ /bla ma phying gur nang du phebs zin 'dug /jas sang 'ga' res phyag dbang zhu 'dug pas/

/rang yang de bar phyag dbang zhu bar phyin/ /nyams dang rmi lam ngogs su shar ba yi/ /rig 'dzin byon 'ong zer ba yin 'dra bsam/ /de nas zhag 'ga' 'das pa'i mtshams su ni/ /bla ma nor bu yin 'dra dbang chen thob/ /de nas dbang khrid 'ga' re gnang 'dug kyang*/ /zhu bar ma sleb rtsed mo'i khrod du phyin/ /de nas nub gcig nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /sngar gyi khro mo rmis pa de dag gis/ /bu rang sang zhogs phyogs su ma 'khyams dang*/ /nga yi sgrub thabs thob pa yod ces zer/ /de yi nub mo bla ma bzhugs sa ru/ /nyams mtshar ltad mo lta ru phyin pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po bla ma'i drung du bzhugs nas su/ /ma mo'i lung zhu maṇḍal 'bul du 'dug /gur gyi rtsa bar phyin te nyan nas bsdad/ /las mtha' sad pa yin 'dra 'ga' re yang*/ /brda yig tshul du sbas nas yod skad la/ /rgyal pos bla mar dri ba bgyis nas su/ /'di yi mtshams kyi brda 'di gang yin lags/ /sgrub dus 'khu ldog byed lugs yod dam ci/ /de skad bla mar snyan zhus phul song bas/ /bla ma'i zhal ras 'dzum par mdzad nas kyang*/ /ma mo bsgrub na 'khu ldog byed lugs med/ /sbas pa'i brda yig gab 'khrugs sprad dgos yod/ /mthu sgrub bya na 'di dag myur yin gsungs/ /bdag gi lung de rdzogs par thob yod 'dra/ /de nas nyin gcig ltad mo blta ru phyin/ /phying gur nang du rje dpon thams cad la/ /bla ma nor bu yin yin 'dra ba las/ /lung zhig gnang ste zhal 'phros mdzad cing 'dug /phying gur g.yas phyogs mchod gzhi'i mdun de ru/ /bla ma a mye'i sku skye 'dra ba yi/ /grwa pa bzhi lnga tsam zhig bsdad nas kyang*/ /mtshon srung mang po srung chings brgyag bzhin 'dug /de tshe sgo gdong g.yas zur de nyid du/ /ma thong dkon mchog tshe ring 'dug pa des/ /mig btsums thal sbyar krong nger nyan nas 'dug /nga yang cung zhig de ru bsdad pa las/ /bkra shis mtsho rgyal nga la 'ga' gzigs te/

/byis pa chung chung skrag snang med pa yis/ /nyams mtshar 'dis kyang nyan nas bsdad 'dug zer/ /ma thong kho yis byis pa phar song zer/ /de tshe kho bo'i 'gyu bas bsam pa la/ /chos byed pa la rgas gzhon ris su med/ /'di phyi rgyu 'bras mi la lhag gzhan med/ /dred po btso ma mi chos sgom log mkhan/ /bla ma'i drung nas phar rgyugs zer ro skad/ /chos rgyal yon mchod 'di tsam 'tshogs nas su/ /gsang sngags chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed pa las/ /rmongs gzugs mngon 'dod ther po kha mang 'dis/ /kun gyis thob na dga' tshor mi shes pas/ /phar song ma sdod la sogs zer ba 'di/ /bdud rigs kha 'jam las ngan yin 'dug bsam/ /de ru ma bsdad gur gyi rgyab logs nas/ /bla ma'i sku yi rgyab du cung zad nyan/ /re 'ga' mi ngan kha ngan khur ba las/ /phyi logs 'gro nas ltad mo blta'o bsam/ /langs te shing rwa'i zur du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /bla ma'i grwa pa zhig gis kha gyong la/ /byis pa khyod ni rdung gtag nyo yag zer/ /bdag kyang khros nas lha khang bskor du phyin/ /shing rwa gcig gi kyog tu phyin nas kyang*/ /nyi ma 'dug par cung zad gnyid la song*/ /de tshe nyams snang rmi lam za zi ru/ /ne'u seng me tog 'khrungs pa'i gl̥ng du slebs/ /de yi mod la mdun gyi nam mkha' nas/ khye'u rus pa'i rgyan drug ldan pa zhig /ḍākki gar mo bzhi yis bskor nas su/ /'ja' 'od thig le nyag thag shig shig byung*/ /de tshe bdag ni dran pa zin pa dang*/ /langs nas thal sbyar gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ kyai/ pha gcig 'gro ba'i mgon po padma 'byung*/ /sangs rgyas dbang po bdag gi drin can rje/ /srid pa'i tsha gdung skyob pa'i dad dpon mchog /ma sring 'khor dang bcas la gdung bas bstod/ /kye ma kyi hud bdag 'dra byis pa nga*/ /mgon po khyed kyi thugs rjes mi skyong na/ /gzhan nas mtshan ldan bla ma mi rnyed 'dra/ /de ring zhag la stag sham rdo rje yis/

/dbang khrid chos gsung 'ga' re byed 'dug kyang*/ /mnga' thang snyan grags can gyi bsnyen bkur la/ /zhal 'debs bse rags can gyi jas sang gis/ /mngon 'dod yi dwags bkres pa'i kha phyung nas/ /gdams pa nyan du ma ster phyin lags na/ /dkor gzan rkang 'dren grwa pa kha mang des/ /byis pa rdung gtag nyo zer sdang sems tshig /chos 'dod blo la bdud ky-i bar chad 'dis/ /rnam smin sngon nas bsags pa yin gyur na/ /pha rgan drung du bshags so bzod par bzhes/ /gdams ngag zhal gdams zhu'o drin can rje/ /'bral med brtse bas skyong nas byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar zhus pa'i lan du gu ru yis/ /zhal 'dzum mdangs ldan mdzes pa'i skur bstan nas/ /ka dag rtsol med dgongs pas 'di skad gsung*/ kyai ho/ skal ldan thugs kyi sras/ /dran rig gnyug mas legs par gson/ /kun gzhi sangs rgyas klong yangs la/ /mi brjed dran pa'i rgyang sos srungs/ /dbyings rig lta ba'i pha rgan la/ /mos gus nyams myong rtag tu 'dud/ /gsum ldan bla ma dam pa la/ /dag snang gsol ba rgyang nas thob/ kha chos tshig gi grub mtha' la/ /snyan grags ltad mo rgyang nas ltos/ /mi chen nga rgyal 'ding zhu la/ /che khyer gseb tu 'gro mang spongs/ /'khor g.yog rnam smin sa bon la/ /dam tshig rdo rje'i lag ma sbrel/ /grwa slob rang mthong khengs sems la/ khong khro'i gling du 'gyu ma rkyen/ /rgyu 'bras phra zhib dar chags la/ /rgya 'byams a 'thas kha ma yengs/ /rang sems bla ma sangs rgyas la/ /byi dor bsnyen bkur rgyang ma ring*/ /dam tshig sgo dgu shar grol la/ /bdag 'dzin 'gong po'i blo ma zhugs/ /brda de zungs shig rigs kyi bu/ /de skad zhal nas gsungs pa dang*/ /gnyid sad nyi ma phyed yol 'dug /de nas zhag 'ga' 'gro ba ru/ /yum gyi go ru log nas phyin/ /'di tsho snga phyi gang yin gyi/ /nges par rang zhig mi dran kyang*/ /'di yi bar skabs 'ga' re ru/

/lung bstan rnam pa mang po dang*/ /dag snang la sogs rnam thar nang*/ /bshad na rgyas pa mang yod kyang*/ /gnad 'gag dus dang 'pho 'gyur dang*/ /thor tsam 'di ru bkod par byas/ /rgyal po lha bzang dmag chen g.yos/ /byang pa ru bzhi bros pa'i tshe/ /na ra gnam thil bya ba ru/ /sog dmag mang po lhags pa dang*/ /'brong pa'i ru ba 'ga' re bcom/ /de tshe mi thar grabs 'dug pas/ /byol song thams cad ded nas su/ /ri rdzong zhig tu phyin pa'i tshe/ /gung thun nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /mtshar stag dmar po yin zer ba'i/ /mi dmar btsan rgod dum gcig dang*/ /rga rgyal jo bo yin zer ba'i/ /mi dkar 'khor g.yog mang zhig dang*/ /rme rgyal rta rna yin zer ba'i/ /bdud chas bcos pa dum gcig bcas/ kho bo'i drung du bsnyegs pa dang*/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad 'ga' re nas/ /sna tshogs mtshon las grub pa yi/ /mgo can sbu gu'i mche ba can/ /mi ring phyogs phyogs tshogs pa dang*/ /yul gling mang po bcom pa rmis/ /de tshe lha bdud btsan dmag gis/ /nga nyid skad cig khyer nas su/ /brag dmar zangs gling 'dra ba'i dbus/ /pho brang zhig tu bzhag nas su/ /da nas bros re btsal dgos med/ /dmag 'khrug 'di yis mi gnod ste/ /dmag 'di 'das pa'i mtshams shig nas/ /bros pa'i dus gcig shar 'ong zer/ /de ma thag tu gnyid kyang sad/ /dgong mau byol song ded nas su/ /nged rnams nang du log ste phyin/ /kaḥrme la sogs yul de ru/ /yun ring tsam du ma 'gor bar/ /dpal gtam la sogs yul du slebs/ /'di skabs dag snang lung bstan sogs/ /phran bu yod kyang 'bri ma long*/ /de nas mi ring nye ba ru/ /bla ma mgar tshang chos sgar nas/ /yul der 'bul sdud phebs nas byung*/ /de tshe skra bcad bsam pa la/ /nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /mi dmar btsan gyi gzugs can gyis/ /bu khyed kyis bla ma 'di dag la/ /skra bcad par bya ba'-i las 'phro med/ /yul 'di nas shar lho'i mtshams shed na/

/dpal thugs rten gl̥ng zhes bya ba ru/ /rngog blo ldan shes rab sprul pa bzhugs/ /gzhi bslab pa'i theg pa de ru zhugs/ /lar de nas mi ring nye ba ru/ /yul 'di nas nyi ma nub kyi phyogs/ /byang 'bri gung rtse zhes bya ba ru/ /'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i sprul pa bzhugs/ /lam nye mo'i gdams ngag de nas longs/ /lar de nas mi ring nye ba ru/ /gnas rnga yab 'od kyi zhing khams su/ /pha 'gro mgon padma 'byung gnas bzhugs/ /don mngon du gyur pa de nas longs/ /mi nga ni 'bar ba rdo rje yin/ /don lung bstan ma brjed yid la zungs/ /rtags de rnams dus la ma bab par/ /tshig zur tsam mi la bshad gyur na/ /rkyen bar chad nyo ba thag gis chod/ /dus rgyun du nga yis grogs byed zer/ /de ma thag tu gnyid yang sad pa dang*/ /skra phud 'bul sa'i bla ma btsal dgos bsam/ /de nas mi ring ba ru yul phyogs der/ /nang chen chos rje sgar du phebs nas byung*/ kho bo dang ni khyim mi thams cad kyi/ /che btsan snyan grags ldan pa'i bla ma ste/ /da lan khyed kyang de ru skra chod zer/ /de zhogs skra rten mdzo pho dkar po khrid/ /a khu dang bcas nang chen sgar du phyin/ /thog mar gnyer tshang nang du phyin pa'i tshe/ /gnyer pa mon bu phrin las dpon g.yog 'dug /phebs zhus byas te cung zad sdod dang zer/ /gsol 'dren la sogs legs par grub pa dang*/ /bande byed rgyu yin zhes bshad pa'i tshe/ /de ga legs zhes dga' tshor byed par 'dug /de nas chos rje'i sgar du mjal bar phyin/ /thog mar bkra shis grags pas mgron gnyer btsal/ /bla mar snyan gsan la sogs phul ba'i tshe/ /bkra shis grags par bslab don gnang nas kyang*/ /ban chung 'di 'dras ci phan cha mi thig /ma phan gnod rang 'ong ba ma yin te/ /mtha' ma grub mtha' ci mngon mi shes pas/ khyod kyis zhu sna ngo ni mi ldog ste/ /de ring btags pa'i ming ni chos la grwa/ /bla mas khur nas de skad gsungs pa de/
