kho bo'i sems kyis lhang lhang go bar 'dug /de nas chos rje'i mdun du phyin pa dang*/ /skyabs yul rtsa ba gsum gyi bslab sdom gnang*/ /ming ni bkra shis phun tshogs gyis shig gsungs/ /de nas bzhugs sa'i 'grim nas log pa'i tshe/ us jing thi'u ji'i mdun du song ba dang*/ /skra bcad grwa pa byas pa e yin gsungs/ /yin zhes skad cha ming bcas zhus pa las/ /blo bzang bkra shis 'dra zhig mi btags par/ /bkra shis phun tshogs ming de nyams kyang mtshar/ /ser skya zhal rgyas dus tshod yin pa las/ /ming de rten 'brel 'dra zhig yin 'ong gsungs/ /nged tsho 'bri gung pa ru skra bcad na/ /dkon mchog la sogs ming btags byed yin gsungs/ /de nas zhag 'ga' song mtshams nang du log /lo shas 'ga' rer bsdad nas dgon du phyin/ /de tshe gzugs dang kha thabs bzo lta ni/ /ja 'dren skabs su lag shugs khyag tsam yod/ /lo shas tsam la zla ba re zung bsdad/ /de tshe yi ge blo 'dzin gyis shig zer/ /thog mar yi ge ga re 'dzin smras pas/ /phyag mdzod dka' bcu shes rab bkra shis kyis/ /thog mar chos spyod mtha' dag zungs shig zer/ /zhag shas tsam du chos spyod 'ga' re bzung*/ /de tshe nub gcig nyal ba'i rmi lam la/ /phyag drug ye shes mgon po'i zhal nas ni/ /sngags 'chang chos spyod bzung ba dgos pa chung*/ /de bas bskang gsol skor bcas sngon du zungs/ /nga ni tshe rabs chos skyong yin mod pas/ /mi la ma bshad nga nyid sgrubs zhes gsungs/ /de yi nyin par mgon po'i dpe cha ni/ /mi yi lag nas g.yar rgyu ma rnyed nas/ /'du khang kha ru dpe nyob mang po 'dug /klog pas mgon po'i dpe cha dum gcig rnyed/ /de dag blo bzung rgyun du kha ton byas/ /lan 'gar grwa tshang rnams kyis thos shor bas/ /btsun pa mi 'dug byed rgyu mang po zhig /bka' med lung sdum thon dang smyo 'ong zer/ /de la bdag gis ngan 'gran byas nas su/

/'jigs gsang dang ni nag po skor gsum sogs/ /cho ga phran bu'i skong ba dgos rim bzung*/ /de tshe nang gi grong 'khor ngan rigs dang*/ /ban shar rnams dang skye bo 'ga' zhig gis/ /ngan bshad byas nas brdungs shing shin tu 'tshe/ /bdag ni de nas mi sdod log 'gro bsam/ /lo shas shig la nang du phyin nas bsdad/ /sngar ltar thugs dam rnams ni chag med byas/ /nub gcig nyams dang rmi lam za zi la/ /rnal 'byor he ru ka yi cha byad can/ /lag na rdo rje phur pa bzung ba zhig /nam mkhar byon pa bdag gis mjal bar rmis/ /de yis zhal nas lung bstan 'di skad gsungs/ kye ho nyon dang skal ldan sras/ /nga ni sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag pa/ /rdzu 'phrul can gyi rnal 'byor yin/ /klong dgu rdzogs pa chen po yin/ /brda dgu snyan brgyud man ngag yin/ /dbang dgu bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin/ don dgu gcig shes kun grol yi/ /chos 'di theg pa rim dgu yin/ /brgyud dgu yang zab snying po yin/ /sang dus tshes dgu'i nyi ma yin/ /lung dgu pra rtags ri mo yin/ /brag de khra chog bya ba'i rtser/ /bu khyed dgos pa'i chos tshan yod/ /brda de ma brjed zungs shig gsungs/ /de tshe rdo rje phur bu gtad nas kyang*/ /smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar byas pa rmis/ /sang der ri la ltas mo blta bar phyin/ /zil tsha nyug nas brag phug 'grim pa la/ /brag phug zhig gi nang du phyin pa'i tshe/ /glegs shing med pa'i dpe cha sgog po zhig /thal zhag skya yam bun bun chags nas 'dug /blang zhing thal ba sprugs nas bltas pa'i tshe/ /yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus zer ba 'dug /lteb tshigs slog nas phrag khar 'chang ste phyin/ /nang du log nas zhag 'gar lon pa'i tshe/ /sngar gyi rmi lam de dag dran pa dang*/ /blo ru zin nas rgyun du thugs dam byas/ /bdag gi 'don pa gzhan gyis thos pa'i tshe/ /dbang lung med par 'don du mi rung zer/ /bden snyam gzhan du bla ma btsal bar song*/

/'ga' rer gtugs kyang dbang lung gnang ma nyan/ /de skabs bdag gis bsam blo zhib tu btang*/ /da ni dbang lung zhus kyang mi thon te/ /sngar gyi rmi lam lung bstan de dag las/ /lhag pa gzhan nas btsal rgyu mi 'ong bsam/ /de nas lo 'khor de yi dgun zla ru/ /ge chags ngag dbang zer ba'i bande zhig /rnying ma'i lag len dga' bar yod par grags/ /de la yon tan slob rogs gyis smras nas/ /g.yag pho zhig ni gtang rag tshul du phul/ /thog mar slob rogs bya'o zer nas su/ /rta mgrin nag po lcags ral la sogs pa/ /bskang ba las byang 'ga' re g.yar nas byung*/ /de rnams zla ba gcig la legs par bris/ /da rung cha tshang g.yar rogs gyis smras pas/ /de ga lag len bslab kyis yon byin zer/ /cha gcig de las g.yar chad ma byas zer/ /bande pha des gtam bshad btang gin 'dug /de tshe kho bo bdag gis bsam pa la/ /dpe cha phran bu 'di yi kha drin la/ /de bas slob pa'i yon tan nyon mongs rgyu/ /gdams ngag mi la re dgos mi 'dug snyam/ /slob dpon gzhan la re ba'i kho thag chod/ /dpe de mi gtor kha rog bzhag pa na/ /nam zhig shes pa'i dus shig mchis 'ong bsam/ /dam du dril nas snod du bcug ste bzhag /de tshe khyim mi rnams kyis 'di skad smra/ /mi la re ba thams cad de 'dra yin/ /da rung slar yang gzhan nas mi btsal na/ /de 'dra phan po 'ga' re myong 'ong zer/ /de tshe blo sems yang yang skyo nas su/ /mi la ma re zer bas mgur 'di blangs/ na mo/ skyabs gnas 'gro ba'i bla ma mgon gcig pu/ /rje pha rgan padma 'byung gnas tur gyis dran/ /gnas mkha' spyod rnga yab dpal ri ru/ /mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i rin po che/ /sku 'ja' lus drwa ba'i 'od zer can/ gsung tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i sgra ldan pa/ /thugs chos dbyings mdzod kyi rlabs po che/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku/ /brgyud zab yangs rgya mtsho'i gter mdzod pa/

/mtshan mthong thos dran pas gdung ba bskyed/ /drin 'khor med brtse chen rgyal ba'i sras/ /bdag mos pa'i skal ldan byin gyis rlobs/ /chos zab mo sngags kyi dngos grub stsol/ /kye ma dus mtha'i bskal pa'i mjug /dkor sdud bla ma'i grwa pa gcig /sngags btsun gsar pa'i mkhas 'dod gnyis/ /dpe rul gog po'i gdams ngag gsum/ /dkrug shing slong pa'i man ngag bzhi/ /nor la brnag pa'i slob dpon lnga/ /g.yo rgyu can gyi gdams ngag drug /rang mthong can gyi nga rgyal bdun/ /gnas lugs mi shes sgom chen brgyad/ /a 'thas 'dzin pa'i sgrub pa dgu /de dgu da ltar dus gcig tshogs/ /bdag ni las 'phro chung ba dang*/ /slob dpon thugs gzhi mnyes dka' dang*/ /dpe cha bka' rgyas non pa dang*/ /sems bskyed gzhan phan chung lugs kyis/ /grub thob 'chal ba min nam ci/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan zhabs su/ /yun ring 'di 'dra gsum yod na/ /chags sdang zab mo'i gcong rong chu/ khengs sems rnyog mar rgyas btab pas/ /gsang sngags chos brgyud bsring ngam snyam/ /da nas sprang ban btsun chung nga*/ kha drin can gyi longs spyod las/ /bdag med shing 'bras mi za bar/ /phyug por re ba ma 'khrul lam/ /mi chos bla mar bsten pa las/ /gnyom chung rang sems mi 'tsho bar/ khas drag ngo srung ma 'khrul lam/ khengs sems slob dpon bsten pa las/ /gnas lugs rang rtsal mi sbyong bar/ /gzhan nas slob sbyong ma 'khrul lam/ /mtshan bcas bslab pa'i theg pa las/ /mtshan med chos sku mi bsgrub par/ /mkhas 'dod re ba ma 'khrul lam/ /de bas rig pa lcags su bcug kho thag snying gi dkyil nas chod/ /skyid sdug dkon mchog kho rang shes/ /las 'phro'i mtha' 'di ma mngon bar/ /slob dpon 'tshol rgyu bzhag na legs/ zhes pa 'di'i yan chod chos sgor zhugs dang yon tan sbyangs pa sogs kyi skabs so/ bla mas dbang bskur du ma nyan/ /slob dpon btsal yang yon tan slob du ma nyan te/

/yid skyo nas gzhan la re dgos chung ba'i mgur ma blangs pa'i le'u ste nyung ngur bsdus pa'o// // om̐ rasmi bhā wa ma hā ma ṇi badzra hūm̐/ de nas lo 'ga' 'gro ba ru/ /sngar ltar dgon par phyin pa'i tshe/ /me nyag nang zhes bya ba ru/ /nub mo g.yag gcig rku la shor/ /phyir nangs nyi ma snga zhogs nas/ /dug khrag khyi khrag sbyor ba thogs/ /me nyag la yi rtse ru phyin/ /la btsas 'jigs par 'dug pa de/ khrag gis bran cing rmang nas bsgyel/ /chu mig kun la rakta bkram/ /drag 'bod ar gtad bgyis pa las/ /thog ser dpag med 'khrigs pa dang*/ /rmi lam dgra bo sod rtags byung*/ /de nas zla ba gsum tsam nas/ /rkun ma ru dud gnyis yod pa'i/ /nor yang phyug nad drag pos btab/ /mi yang re zung shi nas byung*/ /de tshe rang gi bsam pa la/ /chos skyong bran du yod 'dug bsam/ /dga' ba'i tshor snang ye med par/ /phyi mar 'gyod cing bshags pa yin/ /lo shas dgon par sdod pa'i tshe/ /bla mas bdag rkyen gnang ba dang*/ /rang yang na so cung lon pas/ /mched grogs drung 'khor 'ga' re yis/ /chags sdang mtho gnon byed 'dug pas/ /kun la shag drangs mi 'dod pas/ /thams cad btsun chas byed pa'i tshe/ /bdag gis skya chas bsgrigs nas su/ /wa zhwa gos khra sog lham sogs/ /mig la mi sdug chas su bgyis/ /thams cad hor chas byed pa'i tshe/ /bdag gis ser chas byas nas bsdad/ /thams cad 'dul lugs byed pa'i tshe/ /bdag gis gcod lugs byas nas bsdad/ /dus dang nam zhag thams cad du/ /bya ba mi la mi mthun pa'i/ /ma nges spyod pa sna tshogs byas/ /kun gyis 'di 'dra ma byed zer/ /de tshe dur khrod thams cad slog /rlon pa bshas nas rkang gling blangs/ /skam po rnams kyi mgo yang brags/ /kun gyis skyugs log zer ba'i tshe/ /rkang dang tshil bu lag par byugs/ /dge 'dun gling gi dkyil 'di na/ /rnga rdung rkang gling ma btang zer/ /de tshe gzhan nas rnga gcig nyos/

/dus min kun tu 'ur rdung byas/ /dgon pa'i g.yas g.yon thams cad nas/ /rkang gling rnams kyang drag tu tser/ /gzhan yang spyod 'gros mir ma bstun/ /de nas lo gcig lo gnyis nas/ /dpon po'i sku tshab byed du phyin/ /res 'ga' mar khral sdud par phyin/ /lus kyang skya chas kho nar zhugs/ /phyag mdzod gnyer pa thams cad kyis/ /mi sder byams po gyis shig zer/ /de tshe kun las thu ba yis/ /res 'ga' mi mang rdung gtag btang*/ /yul sde kun la khyim zhugs brgyab/ /ngan btsan chas ka mang po 'phrog /lan rer nas brdung byed dus phyin/ /'u lag thams cad ku der brdungs/ /lan rer ston sdud byed dus phyin/ /kun la 'chang rgyag skyur 'gong btsong*/ /lan rer mkhar las dpon po byas/ /ar po rnams la rdung gtag btang*/ /res 'ga' sog po bsu skyel song*/ /yang yang 'dzing dang rtsod pa btang*/ /res 'ga' chang 'dun rgyag sar song*/ /smyo 'khrab rtse mo sna tshogs byas/ /res 'ga' zam kha'i lam 'grim la/ kha 'khyal tshig btsog mang du btang*/ /de skabs bco lnga lon pa'i tshe/ /sngar gyi nyams dang rmi lam dang*/ /rtags dang lung bstan thams cad bor/ /dag snang phran bu ma gtogs pa/ /tha mal kun las sdug par 'dug khyad par dug lnga hrag pa dang*/ /rnam rtog cho lo rgod pa yi/ /mi min 'dre min tsam du 'dug /de tshe so so'i skye bo la/ /phal pas bsam bzang zer rigs te/ khyed kyis byed lugs 'di 'dra la/ /'dul ba'i grwa pa yin pas len/ /rigs dang dbang po'i stobs shugs 'dis/ /chos lugs gzhan 'dra yin gyur na/ /gzhan phan nus pa red mod kyang*/ /da ni dge sdig med pa yi/ /dred po lcags mgo red 'dug zer/ /de nas skabs gcig cung zad bab/ /bdag ni dgon par sdod pa'i tshe/ /yum la snyun nad drag pos btab/ /yum gyis mi 'grim btang nas su/ khyed nyid dgon nas ma sleb bar/ /shi bar mi rigs sgug yod zer/ /bdag kyang nang du log pa dang*/

/yum gyis zhal chems 'di ltar bgyis/ /nyon dang a mas gces pa'i bu/ /nyi ma de ring yan chod bar/ /ring nas snyan pa'i tshig gis bos/ /thung la lta ba'i mig gis 'tshos/ /'gyang na byams pa'i sems kyis brtse/ khor yug snang ba'i blo la 'khor/ /bag chags rmi lam ngos la shar/ /dus drug yid 'gyu kha nas bton/ /skyid dang sdug pa'i nyams snang dus/ /ma brjed dran pas tur gyis dran/ khyad par byis pa chung ngu'i dus/ /yar ltos chos kyi blo la re/ /rkyen dang phran bu'i glo bur la/ /sems brtse 'gyod pas gces par bskyangs/ khog pa'i snying dang dpral ba'i mig /de bas bu khyod skyong la dung*/ /ma ngas drin gyis bos pa'i don/ khyim 'dzin snying ring ma bsam ste/ /dge bcu'i mdun ma sgrub du re/ /byis pa chung ngu'i dus kyi tshe/ /dag snang gus 'dun che ba dang*/ /mos blo chos la dkar lugs kyis/ /las can bu gcig yin la re/ /na so dbang po snyoms pa dang*/ /lo re zla re song bzhin du/ /snying rus btson 'grus zhan pa dang*/ /rnam g.yeng mgo lo rgod pa dang*/ /mig ltos ma dad phyogs la dga'/ khrel med dpon po'i hor 'dra la/ /rnam smin can gyi dkor chus brgyag /'bu shu'i mi kha sna tshogs khur/ /don med nyam chung mi ser la/ /'phrog bcom rdung gtag sna tshogs byas/ /grong pa'i 'u lag sgal ba gcod/ kha drag 'khrugs pa'i ngan snga byed/ /mi 'dod kun gyi mi kha bsdu/ /bong bu phag gi phru gu bzhin/ /che bzhin ngan la lod pa'i rigs/ /byed spyod dag snang chung du song*/ /yang na grub mthas bslad pa gcig /yang na dkor sgrib lan chags shig /bu khyod da nas bsgribs zin snang*/ /'on kyang da lta na so chung*/ /rgyu 'bras dkar nag mtshams su yod/ /yar 'gro mar 'gro'i rdog so yin/ /ma yi da lta'i skad cha 'di/ /shi gson bye kha'i bslab bya yin/ /nyi ma da nas phar rtags su/ /bstan pa'i 'dun ma bsring ba dang*/

/tshul bzhin drin lan 'jal 'dod na/ /rgyu 'bras phra zhib 'dzem pa de/ /mtho ris thar lam them skas yin/ /bu khyod mi dge'i las rnams spongs/ /dag snang mos gus gdung ba de/ /byang chub snying rje'i sa gzhi yin/ /bu khyed chags sdang grub mtha' spongs/ /'bral med bla ma bsgom pa de/ /'phro mtha' can gyi dam tshig yin/ /bu khyod dred po lcags mgo spongs/ /chos phyir brtson 'grus bsgrub pa de/ /phyi chas can gyi bsod nams yin/ /bu khyod dge bcu'i sa bon thob/ /snyan grags rang mthong sgrub pa de/ /rnam smin bsags pa'i sham bu yin/ /bu khyod 'jig rten mi chos spongs/ /kun bkur dman sa 'dzin pa de/ /rtsod med mi kha byams pa yin/ /bu khyod che 'dod nga rgyal spongs/ kha drag dpon po'i hor 'dra 'di/ /mi dge sgrub ba'i sa bon yin/ /bu khyed gzhis dgon las 'dzin spongs/ /'phrog bcom sdig zas dkor nag de/ /nyon mongs can gyi dug chu yin/ /bu khyod sdig zas rang phung spongs/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grims pa de/ /bag chags sbyong ba'i dben ri yin/ /bu khyod 'phags pa'i gnas bzang 'grim/ /'tsho ba chog shes slong ba de/ /dkon mchog drin gyis longs spyod yin/ /bu khyod nor rdzas chags 'dzin spongs/ /sems can pha mar rtogs pa de/ /snying rjes skyong ba shugs 'byung yin/ /bu khyod 'gro la sdang sems spongs/ /pha ma'i bzang bslab nyan pa de/ khrel yod rigs nas chad pa yin/ /bu khyod tshig 'di brjed pa spongs/ /spyir yang rgyu 'bras gzu bor zhog /bla ma sangs rgyas thugs ma dkrugs/ /byang sems tshogs pa'i sgrigs ma bslad/ /lo shas dgon du sdod pa na/ /phyis 'byung sgrub pa'i dben rir snyegs/ /bsngo smon drin can ma la gyis/ /shi khar dga' tsam ma thon na/ /bu rgyud yod pa'i dgos pa chung*/ khyad par sring mo chung ba 'di/ /sdug mnar ngan pa ma byed gyis/ /spun zla chung ba 'di nyid ni/

/skyes skabs la sogs rmi lam du/ khyad 'phags 'ga' re byung ba ste/ /yon tan mkhan zhig 'ong la re/ /bsam blos zin tshe yon tan slobs/ /nga ni 'chi rkyen bar chad 'di/ /mthu dang byad cig yin 'dug pas/ /phung po me ru ma bsregs la/ /lha 'dre drag po gnas sar sbos/ /da ni ma ma kha yang bral/ /nga ni mi rtag shi brod bde/ /zhes sogs bslab bya mang du mdzad/ /de tshe rang gi bsam pa la/ /drin can a ma'i gsungs de bden/ /byis pa chung ngu'i byed spyod dus/ /dge bcu chos la brtson 'grus bskyed/ /rtags dang lung bstan de tsam shar/ /da ltar mi tshad lon pa'i dus/ /dge bcu phan sems med pa'i khar/ /kun la zag pa gsog pa 'di/ /las ngan rnam smin yin par go /yum la mi rtag shar ba 'di/ /rang la 'ong ba'i ngo sprod yin/ /da nas yum gyis gsungs bzhin bya/ /yum 'di gshegs pa'i mtshams 'di nas/ /pha yul spangs nas 'khyams 'gro bsam/ /de tshe yum la 'di skad zhus/ e ma gson dang drin can ma/ /gsung tshig zhal gdams bdag gis go /sngon dbang las 'phro bzang na yang*/ /'phrad rkyen nga rgyal las kyis sgrib/ /don med rnam smin bsags pa de/ /rgyu 'bras shes kyang ma 'dzem bden/ /da nas rnam pa thams cad du/ /bdag med dkon mchog bsten par smon/ /phyogs med ri khrod rten 'brel bsgrig /a 'thas zog po ma yin par/ /smyon pa grub thob cig la re/ /yum chen a ma gshegs pa'i mtshams/ /bdag kyang mi yul 'grim nas 'gro/ /dpon med g.yog med sa mthar 'khyams/ /skyid shog sdug shog ro snyom gyis/ /bya btang rnal 'byor zhig la smon/ /'on kyang lo shas shig la ni/ /chung nas tshar sa sdod pa'i yul/ /bla ma dgon pa'i zhabs tog la/ /skyid sdug 'thab pa zhig brgyab nas/ /bu nga gsha' ma'i chos la 'gro/ /de bar yum la dgongs pa zhu/ /da ni drin can a ma la/ /shi gson bye bas dus kyi tshe/ /skyel ma khams bzang glu zhig len/

/kye ma kye hud bla ma mkhyen/ /a ma lus kyi sgrom bu khyed/ /de ring mi rtag phung po 'di/ /'dus byas g.yar khang 'jig pa la/ /bdag 'dzin snang bas ma chags par/ /tshe 'di'i 'dun ma sgyu mar sbyongs/ khams dang dbang po ma sgṛb bar/ /bu ngas ma yi zhal ras la/ /bzhin mdangs rang bzhin gsal bar bskyed/ /chags med rig pa khams bzang zhu/ /'byung bzhi'i snang ba thim pa'i tshe/ /rigs rgyud 'khor bar ma chags par/ /'byung ba rang rtsal ngo bor ltos/ /yid lus bar dor mi 'gro bar/ /bu ngas yum gyi rjes shes la/ /ngo sprod gsal 'debs tshig gis skyel/ /'khrul med rig pa khams bzang zhu/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal shar ba'i tshe/ /nang tshan gzugs la ma chags par/ /zhi khro'i lha rnams bden med sbyongs/ /sha gzugs mngal sgor ma tshud par/ /bu ngas yum gyi mtshams sbyor la/ /smon lam bden tshig bzang pos skyel/ /bag yod gnyug mar khams bzang zhu/ /skye gnas sdug bsngal myong ba'i tshe/ /'khrul snang 'dzin med ngo bor ltos/ /sprul sku'i zhing du ma bsleb bar/ /bu ngas yum gyi sgrib sbyong du/ /gnas lugs 'od gsal ngang gis skyel/ /tshogs gnyis sku khams bzang bar zhu/ /yang gcig don gnyis bden pa'i mthus/ /yum chen a ma bsu nas mjal/ /'khor lo thog ma'i chos sgo ru/ /btsud te rang rig mngon gyur nas/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i mkha' spyod zhing*/ /ya mtshan gnas mchog de nyid du/ /skyes te thog ma'i mgon po yi/ /go 'phang mngon pa'i smon lam zhu/ /don de yum chen thugs la zhog /tshig de ma brjed yid la zungs/ /zhes sogs btsun chung bdag gis de ltar bgyis pa dang*/ /phyir nangs nyi ma'i ngogs nas gshegs te song*/ /'di yan lo grangs mtho dman 'chug lags te/ /tshig 'di dgos ched che bas yid la bzung*/ /de nas lo shas tsam zhig song ba dang*/ /nang chen chos rje dbus la phebs grabs byas/ /de tshe rang gi bla mar zhus pa la/

/da res nga yang phyag phyir 'khrid rogs gyis/ /thugs kyis mi khrel ba yi bka' sgrub lags/ /jo shāka bsam yas la sogs mjal 'dod mos/ /zhes pa'i tshig de bla mar zhus pa las/ /bla ma'i zhal nas bslab don bka' stsal bar/ /na so chung bas 'gro go mi chod yong*/ /cis kyang 'gro na bshad grwar 'dug dgos 'ong*/ /'gro 'dod yod na de ga'i tshig thag chod/ /ces pas slob ston bzang po gnang nas byung*/ /de nas 'gro chas thams cad bsgrigs te bcug /dpon slob sku 'khor shin tu mang ba dag /gling nas byon pas dpa' thi bya ba ru/ /gnas ra bkra shis khang gsar gong du bzhugs/ /de nyin cham phu dpon gyis gdan 'dren byas/ /bdag kyang dpon la nye 'brel thug yod pas/ /dgong mo dpon tshang nang la rang gnyis tsam/ /gdan 'dren byas te rdzong ba dag kyang btab/ /de nub bu mo mang pos sdud chang 'dug /de ru byon zer glu dang rtsed mo byas/ /rdzong ba byin nas shin tu ngu zhing 'dug /phyir nangs sdom ting thang du drung skor gshar/ /de tshe chos skyong btsan rgod dmag tshogs ni/ /sa gzhi 'ur gyis 'gengs shing 'gro ba mthong*/ /bdag gis gsol mchod tshar gcig btang nas su/ /hūm̐ sgra drag po lan 'ga' btab pa'i tshe/ /btsan rgod dmag tshogs bdag la thim par byung*/ /kun gyis ci byed ci skad zer ba la/ /bdag gis gcod lugs bya ba yin zhes bshad/ /de nas gsang gzhung zhes par slebs pa'i tshe/ /rgyal po bkra shis mtsho rgyal phebs nas byung*/ /chos rje'i chibs bsu rten 'brel mdzad pa dang*/ /rgyal pos bdag la mar sogs sku rdzongs mdzad/ /de nas byang lam rgyud de dbus su byon/ /'bri gung gzhung nas rim bzhin phebs pa'i tshe/ /ri bo dga' ldan gling nas grwa tshang gis/ /chibs bsu bang chen rnams kyang slebs nas byung*/ /de nas la mo gzhis kar sleb pa'i tshe/ /thab bsu chibs bsu bcas pa tshan gcig dang*/ /de nas gtsang 'dog zhus su slebs pa dang*/

/dga' ldan grwa tshang phal cher chibs bsur byung*/ /phyir nangs dga' ldan gling du phebs pa'i tshe/ /rol mo snyan dbyangs dpag med btang nas byung*/ /grwa tshang gzhung la 'gyed dang mang ja gnang*/ /zla ba kha shas de ru thogs pa dang*/ /de nas mi ring ba ru lha sar byon/ /sku zhabs rtse la khri 'bul dpag med brgyab/ /de tshe po tā la yi lhun rtse ru/ /rgyal bas bdag rkyen ston mo dgyes dgu gnang*/ /rgyal ba la yang mjal dar tshab chen phul/ /de nas se 'bras gnyis la byon nas su/ /'gyed dang mang ja la sogs legs phul bas/ /bsnyen bkur bdag rkyen rnam pa dpag med byung*/ /lha sar zla ba kha yar tsam du 'gor/ /de nas ri bo dga' ldan gling du phebs/ /grwa tshang rnams kyis nan zhus byas pa las/ /chos rje dga' ldan dgon du bzhugs dgos byung*/ /phyag g.yog drung 'khor nyung ngur ma gtogs pa/ /thams cad yul du log pa'i sta gon gyi/ /chas ka phyes nas 'gro sdod ran par byas/ /bdag la bla mas bka' stsal 'di ltar gnang*/ /btsun chung gzhon po khyed kyis gnas 'di ru/ /slob gnyer brgyab nas rab 'byams mi byed par/ /nang du log na 'ong ba don go chung*/ /dbang po yang rab yon tan 'ong ba'i gral/ khyod la re che 'di bas drag med pas/ /cis kyang mi 'dug thag chod yin nam ci/ /nub mo bsam blo thongs shig gzhan la dris/ /sang nas de yi lan mo gyis shig gsungs/ /de ma thag tu bsam blo btang ba dang*/ /phyi yi ri skor ched du longs nas song*/ /zhal gzigs mdzad cing nyams yang dga' ba dang*/ /brag dkar zur gyi ri rtse de ru phyin/ /bsam blo btang bzhin phyogs bzhir legs par bltas/ /de tshe sngar gyi bag chags 'ga' re dang*/ /yer pa'i phug par bsdad pa'i dus shig dran/ /de tshe lho nub kha bltas sdod pa las/ /gu ru'i rnam thar lhang lhang dran pa dang*/ /sang nas bla mar 'bral dgos yod pa las/ /thams cad mi rtag rang bzhin go nas su/

/nyams kyi shugs las mgur ma 'di ltar blangs/ na mo gu ru/ bdag spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i steng*/ /rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che/ /pha 'gro ba'i mgon po pad 'byung gis/ /gnas ka dag klong nas byin gyis rlobs/ /kye ma kyi hud mi rtag snang ba la/ /snying po skor sdug mi byed pa/ /snang ba blo brid nga re 'khrul/ /dang po byis pa bag med tshe/ /rgya 'byams snang ba lhug par shar/ /ci snang dgag sgrub mi shes pas/ /byar med blo sna thung ba byung*/ /bar du sha gzugs rgyas pa'i tshe/ /rnam rtog kho na'i 'dam du tshud/ /dred po bag med le lor shor/ /de yang mi rtag rmi lam 'dra/ /a ma lus kyi sgrom bu de/ /gtan du sdod pa re na yang*/ /glo bur drag po'i rkyen dbang gis/ /rmi lam lta bur bral nas thal/ /de yang mi rtag sgyu mar go /tha mar da lta thug pa'i tshe/ /bka' drin thugs rjes skyong ba yi/ /mtshan ldan bla ma dam pa dang*/ /sang nas so sor 'bral dgos 'di/ /mi rtag tshong 'dus mgron por go /grub mtha' kha chos lo ma yi/ /tha snyad tshig gi rnam bshad kyis/ /rgyud sder 'brel ba btang na yang*/ /nga rgyal drag po'i khengs sems kyis/ /tshe rabs 'dun ma gtor ba'i dpes/ /mkhas pa'i grub mtha' sgyu mar go /bdag rang da lta 'di ru yod/ /sang nas chags sdang lam la zhugs/ /mi med byang thang bgrod du ran/ /dbang chen sa ru dmus thag chod/ khas drag mi kha stong par go /da ni las 'di mtha' 'khyol na/ /zla med gcig pur ma 'khyams par/ /gzhis dgon gnas la chags re shi/ /glu 'di don la mi khel na/ /nga bdag shi ba'i mgo bo spongs/ /kye ma chos med btsun chung nga*/ /thog mar lung bstan bka' bab dus/ /bdag med ri khrod ma 'grims par/ /grub mtha'i dgon par sdod pas 'khrul/ /bar du ma bslab chos 'ga' shar/ /nyams myong de thog ma bskyangs par/ /che 'dod rnam smin bsags pas 'khrul/ /da lta sngar gyi bag chags dran/

/'phro bzang 'di dag ma mthud na/ /nges shes skyes kyang don la 'khrul/ /lho gro bo lung gi rtse mo nas/ /sprin dkar po seṅge 'gyings 'dra khyed/ /gnas lho nub phyogs su 'gro ba na/ /nga'i pha rgan padma 'byung gnas la/ /gnubs lo tsā sa mthar 'khyams 'dug gyis/ /dus deng sang mi la rgyag 'dug gyis/ /las bag chags 'thib rmongs sgrib 'dug gyis/ /dus do nub sa mtshams yin 'dug gyis/ /rab dngos su pha rgan phebs shog gyis/ /de ma 'byor mkha' 'gro thongs shog gyis/ /sems dung dung skyo ba che 'dug gyis/ khas nyams dbyangs 'o dod 'bod 'dug gyis/ /zla med 'khyams 'dod byed 'dug gyis/ /ngas de skad gsol 'debs 'phrin bskur tshe/ /sprin dkar de yang lang ling bkyags nas su/ /lho nub zangs mdog dpal ri'i phyogs su song*/ /de tshe bdag ni mig chu btang bzhin du/ /de las langs te skor ba brgyab nas phyin/ /de nub nyal ba'i gung thun rmi lam la/ /bud med dmar mo rus pas brgyan pa zhig /mkha' klong dbyings nas 'ja' ltar lhags nas su/ /thog mar mi go'i brda skad mang du gsung*/ /bar du nyams dbyangs tshig las 'di skad thos/ kye ho gson dang skal ldan pa/ /nga ni rnga yab gling nas 'ong*/ /gu ru rje yis bka' phebs las/ /sras gcig buddha dzñā na ba/ /tshe rabs kun nas skal bar ldan/ khyad par mchims phu'i gnas mchog tu/ /bka' gtad gdams ngag mi dran nam/ /skyes nas lo shas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /dngos su lung bstan ma dran nam/ /bcu gsum rang lo skag thog la/ kha byang bka' rgya len dgos kyang*/ /bdud mo ngan pa'i bag bsgribs kyis/ /lo yang bco lnga'i bar du bsgribs/ /bar du bcu drug lon pa'i tshe/ kha byang zab mo gtad dgos kyang*/ /mi chos dpon po'i las 'dzin gyis/ /dkor sgrib bag chags 'thug po yis/ /bco brgyad lo yi bar du bsgribs/ /da nas lo gsum tshun chod la/ /mdo khams sgang bzhir ma bsleb na/

/skye ba gsum gyi gter rgya yol/ /gsang mdzod bcu bdun don med yin/ /da ni rings par gnas su log /bus kyang pha la gsol ba thob/ /phas kyang thugs rje'i 'od zer 'gyed/ /de rnams ma brjed dran pas zungs/ /zhes pa'i tshig de gsung ma thag tu ni/ /bud med de yang 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /yang gcig tho rangs rmi lam za zi la/ /mi dmar btsan chas byas pa gcig lhags nas/ /rigs ldan rje yi sras khyed legs par nyon/ khyed kyis rgyun du bsten pa'i bla ma de/ /rngog gi lo tsā blo ldan shes rab yin/ khyed dang da lan 'brel ba 'byung don ni/ /lan gcig rgya gar yul du mched grogs skabs/ /dam tshig sbrel nas smon lam btab pa ste/ /de yi rten 'brel de ring tshogs pa yin/ /da ni rang rang 'gro don dus la bab/ /skyes bu khyed nyid gzhan gyis phyogs su bzhud/ /bdag gis phrin las rogs dan legs par bsgrub/ /nga ni chu mig byang chub btsan rgod yin/ /da ni 'brom ston sprul pa mjal bar yod/ /gdams ngag gzer bu'i skor ni de nas longs/ /lde mig gze rgyal gangs ri'i phyogs su yod/ /de ru rten 'brel smon lam 'grig par gyis/ /zhes pa'i tshig 'di ma brjed zungs shig gsung*/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal ba rmis/ /de yi zhogs par bla ma'i drung du phyin/ /nga ni cis kyang pha yul rang la 'gro/ /grwa tshang 'di yi sgrigs la zhugs na yang*/ /yon tan mi lob rdung gtag nyo ba zhig /gang nas bltas kyang 'ong pa thag gis chod/ /nga ni gzhi ru log kyis dgongs pa zhu/ /de skad zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas kyang*/ /sngar yang grwa tshang chen po 'di nyid la/ /rdung btag byas nas su yang bsad rab med/ /bslab na yon tan mi lob mi srid ste/ /lar phugs sdod nyan ma 'dod yin 'dug pas/ /da nas rang gi dgon du log pa'i tshe/ /bla brang nang gi sku chas la sogs pa/ /ca ga gang 'thag chud du ma gzon gyis/

/lo re bzhin du khral sdud byed pa'i tshe/ /gong mas bcad pa'i gsho srol ma gtogs par/ /mi 'os rnam smin la sogs bsags pa na/ /rang rang sdig la 'bag pa ma gtogs par/ /nga la nyes pham ltung ba 'ong dogs med/ /de bas rgyu 'bras zhib mor lag len gyis/ /'on kyang nga la 'phral du phan tsam red/ khyod kyis slob gnyer byed rogs ma byas pas/ /cung zad re khar bzhag rgyu ma byung gsungs/ /de tshe rang gis bsam pa brtags pa la/ /bla mas gsung de nga yi don yin 'dug /byis pa 'gro thub tsam nas bla brang du/ /nyi ma da lta phan chad sdod pa las/ /dbang lung tshar gcig thob kyang ma myong bas/ /da ni bka' bsgo byin rlabs zhu dgos bsam/ /bla mar zhus pas mgon po'i bka' bsgo gnang*/ /de tshe bla ma'i phyag gi phreng ba nas/ /me 'bar tsha tshwa thor thor byed par mthong*/ /bla mar mi phyed dad pa dpag med thob/ /de nas 'bri gung rtse bar sgar pa 'gyogs/ khams su log pa'i lam chas de nas brdzangs/ /de dus la der sgar pa 'gyogs pa'i tshe/ /bka' shog bla ma'i mdun du lus pa dran/ /nub mo zhig gi dus tshod yin pa las/ /kun gyis nam gung 'gro yang mi phod zer/ /de tshe rogs pa rnams la 'di skad smras/ khyed rnams kha thabs sdug pa'i mi zhig red/ /nam la 'gro bar sngangs skrag ga la yod/ /nga ni srin po'i yul yin 'gro bar nus/ /nga la 'gro chas sgrigs dang nga rang 'gro/ /nga yi zla bo su yis byed ces smras/ /gzhan su 'gro'o zer mkhan mi 'dug pas/ /phyag mdzod lcam sring pra ti zer ba yi/ /swa ra kau rī chung chung yod pa des/ /'gro ba'i zla grogs nga yis bya'o zer/ /de ma thag tu kau rī khrid nas ni/ /nam 'gros brgyab nas glo bur phyin pa'i tshe/ /dom rgan yan gyi btsan ri de yi mdun/ /mi dmar btsan rta zhon pa dum gcig 'phrad/ khyed gnyis nam la gang du 'gro zhes zer/ /nged gnyis ring tshad dga' ldan 'gro ba yin/

khyed rnams da lta ga ru 'gro yin smras/ /nged rnams la mo chos skyong tshangs pa yin/ /da lta 'bri gung sba khar nor sdud 'gro/ /snga phyi'i dus tshod da lta ma sleb kyang*/ /ti sgro'i grogs de kau rī 'di yin pas/ /rten 'brel dam tshig bsrung ba gnad che zer/ /da ni lam der ma 'gro rkun ma yod/ /lam gong sa yi phug der nyal sdod zer/ /de ma thag nas lam gong yar tsam phyin/ /sa yi phug tu nyal nas bsdad pa dang*/ /kau rī de yis skad cha dris nas su/ khyed kyis kher gtam de 'dra ci yin zer/ /de la bdag gis lan du 'di skad smras/ khyed kyis da lan de rnams ma mthong ngam/ /rkun ma yod do lam la ma 'gro zer/ /mang po gzhan 'ga' mthong yang mi bshad smras/ /de 'dra ma gsungs nga ni 'jigs drag zer/ /de nas snga zhogs dus su phyin pa las/ /dga' ldan gling du mun rub tsam du 'byor/ /phyir nangs bla ma'i drung du mdun gral skabs/ /kau rī de dang bsgrigs nas bsdad pa la/ /bla ma'i thugs la ci dgongs bsam nas su/ /bdag kyang shin tu ngo tsha che bar byung*/ /bla mas sku rtsed zhal ta ma gtogs pa'i/ /legs nyes sogs ni gang yang gsung ma byung*/ /de skabs brda med byis pa'i rnam par 'dug /phyir nangs zhogs khar bka' shog blangs te log /la mo'i sku rten rtsa ru gung tshigs btang*/ /de nas lam du chang ma zhig 'dug pas/ /ja sder gang gi chang zhig nyos nas 'thung*/ /rim bzhin phyin te 'bum pa'i rtsa ba ru/ /mal bso byas pas gnyid yang log song 'dug /de tshe za zi nyams kyi rmi lam du/ /'bri gung dkar nag gnas nas yin zer ba'i/ /bud med nyi shu tsam zhig 'dug pa des/ /lnga ldan tshul gyis dar yug brkyangs nas su/ /bla ma yab yum 'di nas zungs shig zer/ /de tshe bdag gis dar thag bzung ba dang*/ /pra ma ti ni lus chas 'gyur nas su/ /rigs lnga la sogs rgyan gyis spras par mthong*/ /bdag ni sngar gyi gos lag de rang 'dug

/dar yug ma shor phyi la shog ces zer/ /de ma thag tu gnas der sleb pa'i tshe/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen mo yin zer ba'i/ /them skas mang po zhig gi thog tu phyin/ /mjal bas lta na sdug gi pho brang zhig /sna tshogs rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan rdzogs dbus/ /chos 'byung dmar po sum brtsegs steng du ni/ /bud med bcu drug lo lon na tshod can/ /sna tshogs mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis spras mdzad pas/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bar 'dug /de tshe bdag gnyis mdun du shog gsungs nas/ /spyi bor bdud rtsi'i sku khrus gsol ba dang*/ kha byang yin zhes brda yig 'dra 'dra yi/ /po ti glegs bam dgu tsam 'dug pa de/ /spyi bor bzhag nas bka' gtad smon lam btab/ /da ni mdzod sgo 'di nas ltos shig gsungs/ /rin po che yi sgo zhig 'dug pa de/ /phyes nas nang log dag tu mjal ba'i tshe/ /zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor 'ja' ltar shar ba la/ /yig rigs mi 'dra bye ba 'bum phrag rnams/ /'od skor nang du chem chem 'khyugs par mjal/ /gzhan yang nor bu la sogs ka cha'i rigs/ /bsam las 'das pa grangs med spungs nas 'dug /de tshe gtso mo mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas kyang*/ /gnas 'di mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen mo yin/ /ma nga mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yin/ /brda 'di gnas lugs nam mkha' rgya mtsho yin/ /tshig 'dis bka' gtad dbang lung rdzogs pa yin/ /don 'dis bu khyod shes rgyud grol ba yin/ /dus 'di rten 'brel brtag pa'i mgo mo yin/ /gnas 'di dben ri 'grim pa'i smon lam yin/ /lam 'dir yar 'gyu phyogs med 'gro don gyis/ /deng phan 'gro la dbang skur chos shod ston/ /'di phan bka' gtad gnyer byang 'bog pa yin/ /da nas mi ring lo shas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /yang gcig tshogs khang 'di yi nang du 'dzoms/ /gnad bdun gdams pa de tshe sbyin par byed/ /de tshun ma nga'i rnam thar gsol ba thob/ /bu khyed lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes yin/

/mtshams sbyor sngon gyi bag chags dran par gyis/ /lam gyi bar chad bdag gis bsal nas yod/ /de tshe po ti thams cad khur nas kyang*/ /brag phug sgo'i drung 'gro snyam byed pa'i tshe/ /de ma thag tu gnyid yang sad pa dang*/ /nyi mar bltas pas ma zad tsam zhig 'dug /zla bor skad btang lan mang bos pa'i tshe/ /a bo tshab chen gnyid du song nas 'dug /me tog skyed mo'i tshal du slebs pa rmis/ /me tog thus nas khur grabs yod pa yin/ /de skad zer nas mgyogs par 'ong ba'i tshe/ /la phug khur ba'i bud med gnyis dang 'phrad/ /a ce rten 'brel la phug slong dang byas/ /la phug rdog po lnga tsam byin nas byung*/ /la phug thogs nas yar tsam 'ong ba'i tshe/ /bud med gnyis des kha dal lab pa la/ /a bo kau rī chung chung gzhon mdzes gnyis/ /sgrom bu khur nas 'dug pa ma lags pas/ /bros nas 'gro ma'i yin yin 'dra 'dug zer/ /de tshe phaṭ sgra drag po byas pa las/ /nag chags gnyis des phyi mig lta nas kyang*/ /smyon pa'i las lta byed byed zer nas song*/ /dgong mor bar zhag mi tshang gcig la slebs/ /phyir nangs snga zhogs phyin pas nyin phyed slebs/ /de nas rim bzhin byang lam brgyud de phyin/ /mer gyi mtsho dmar la nas mgo bzung ste/ kha ba pus nub tsam bab bgrod lam dka'/ /rim bzhin 'bri rgan la ru phyin pa'i tshe/ kha ba mi yi sked par snyob tsam 'dug /de yi nub mo sha tsam ma gtogs pa/ /ja khol la sogs gang yang med par lus/ /la de'i lto rgyab nyi ma gsum tshun la/ /mdzo g.yag drug cu tsam zhig lus nas song*/ /de nas rim bzhin lho kha brgyud nas ni/ /rme yi sha pho sna ru ma bsleb bar/ kha char bu yug 'thib pas dka' las la/ /nyi ma da lta bsam yang rgyus pa tsha/ /dpon po'i dkor zas sgrib pa de nas sbyangs/ /rme rur rta rna dgon par 'u lag brgyab/ /dgon pas 'u lag mi phud zer ba la/ /dgon pa'i mdzo g.yag ri nas phab ste ded/

/grwa mang thams cad mdzo g.yag phyi la byung*/ /de tshe ma 'cham kha shag ngan smras btang*/ /'thab pas rta rna dgon mi'i mgo yang bcag /grwa pa thams cad 'u lag byed du khrid/ /gru ya'i brag dkar gong ka bar du bskyal/ /de nas dba' wa kha la sleb pa dang*/ /grwa mang thams cad rong nas dgon la log /bdag gis rim bzhin 'u lag brgyab nas su/ /stod nas rang gi nang du log nas song*/ /zhag po gsum la snem gyi nang du slebs/ khyim mi kun gyis dga' tshor dpag med bcas/ /dbus la lam stabs yag po e byung zer/ /phyi nang gsang gsum skad cha legs par bshad/ /dbus kyi lag rtags chas ka thams cad byin/ /zhag gsum tsam nas nang chen sgar du song*/ /e ke thi'u ji'i sku mched lhan rgyas la/ /mjal dar phul nas skad cha thams cad zhus/ /lam sogs phyi nang byon don legs grags gsungs/ /de nas zhag 'ga' song mtshams nang du log /dbyar mgo ma bsleb bar du nang la bsdad/ /gos lag la sogs tshems grub mang du brgyab/ /de nas mi ring pa ru dgon par phyin/ /de yi dbyar la mar khral sdud du song*/ /mar khral 'dus nas mar rnams dbus su brdzangs/ /de yi ston khar nas ldom byed du phyin/ /nang du log nas zhag 'gar mi ring bar/ /gzims khams dbu rtse'i nyi ra zhig la ni/ /btsan rgod rnga thug yod sa'i rtsa ba ru/ /nub mo rgyun du gcod thun btang nas nyal/ /nub gcig zam khar dge bsnyen 'dul du phyin/ /gcod thun 'bring po tsam du sleb pa'i tshe/ /gcan gzan lus la sgra gcan lta bu yi/ /mgo mjug gnyis su kha yang ji bzhin dod/ /che chung tshad ni wa mo tsam zhig la/ /mche ba krig krig skad ngan 'don pa dang*/ /gdong la lta zhing mchong grabs byed 'dug pas/ /gzugs can yin nam gzugs med yin nam bsam/ /rkang dung blangs shing kha ru srub pa dang*/ /'o dod byas pas sa yang 'gul nas byung*/ /de tshe gzugs med lha 'dre yin bsams nas/

/dbang sdud ar gtad cha dgus legs par gzir/ /de ma thag tu chu yi 'khor du thal/ /cung zad rmi lam za zi 'gro ba ru/ /bdag ni sa mdo zhig tu slebs snang bar/ khri gdan mthon po'i steng du bsdad nas su/ /lag tu ḍā ru rkang dung thogs nas ni/ /de tshe 'dzam gling kun gyi mi 'dus pas/ /thams cad chos rwa'i gral ltar bsgrigs nas 'dug /bdag gis gcod dbyangs ma cig ldem glu dang*/ /pha gcig dam pa'i seng chen 'gying 'gros dang*/ /rgya nag gcer bu'i khrab ring la drangs nas/ /dbang gtor la sogs gang yang mi 'dug kyang*/ /dbang bskur ḍā ru rkang gling rnams kyis byas/ /na mo chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*/ /zhes sogs chos tshig rnam pa sna tshogs bshad/ /de tshe khrom rnams rang sar log nas song*/ /bdag kyang shing nag yod pa'i sa ru sleb/ /skyel bu bzang po nyams dga' 'dug pa dang*/ /de ru bud med 'ga' re snang ba des/ /da ni sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzugs ran pas/ /phyogs med dben pa'i ri khrod 'grims shig zer/ /de ma thag tu rmi lam rtags kyang sad/ /nang du log pas nam mkha' sangs nas byung*/ /de nas mi ring zhag 'gar 'gro ba ru/ /nub gcig gung thun nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug yin zer ba'i/ /phyogs mtshams 'ja' dang 'od kyis khengs pa dang*/ /de yi nang nas ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /gar mo lang ling grangs med sprin ltar gtibs/ /rol mo sna tshogs gdung dbyangs len par byed/ /sgrub phug de ni gzhal yas khang zhig la/ /sna tshogs rin po che las grub par 'dug /dbus su padma nyi zla'i khri 'phang du/ /slob dpon padma sambha'i cha byad can/ /rdo rje bhandha tshe bum kha ṭwāṃ bsnams/ /nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid ldan par 'dug /g.yas g.yon gnyis su bzhengs thabs mdzad nas su/ /gzhon tshul mdangs ldan mdzes byed rgyan spras pas/ /mda' dar bhandha lag tu thogs pa gnyis/

/bde ba'i cha shas tshul du bzhugs nas 'dug /mdun du mkha' 'gro'i rgyan ldan mang po yis/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba dang*/ /brda skad nyams dbyangs dir dir len par 'dug /g.yas g.yon ri rab 'dra ba'i stegs kyi khar/ /che mchog bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas/ /pho brang lha bcas mngon sum lta bur 'dug /dkyil 'khor g.yas phyogs rin chen snod yangs su/ /gter gyi sgrom bu yin zer mang po dang*/ /rdza yi spos phor 'dra ba mang du 'dug /de yi g.yas g.yon zur rnams thams cad la/ /phyag mtshan grangs med bkram te bsgrigs nas 'dug /gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di ru srid pa yi/ /dkor nor longs spyod gzugs 'gros dpag med snang*/ /de yi mod la ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis/ /dar yug dkar po 'dra zhig 'phangs nas su/ /'di nas zungs la nang du shog cig gsungs/ /dar la 'jus te nang du phyin pa'i tshe/ /mdun du yod pa'i mkha' 'gro de rnams kyis/ /grib kyis rlan pa'i gos log gyon 'dug zer/ /thams cad 'dus nas nga yi gos phud de/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid thams cad mi 'dug pas/ /thog mar grib sbyong khrus bstsal byed dgos gsung*/ /mtsho rgyal phyag gis dar thag blangs nas su/ /sgo ru 'gro dang khrus bstsal bya'o zer/ /bud med rnams kyis pang khar btegs nas su/ /sgo ru bhandha yangs pa'i nang du bzhag /de ma thag tu mtsho rgyal byon nas su/ /shel bum nang nas khrus chab bstsal ba dang*/ /bdag gi lus kyang zang thal lta bur gyur/ /mdun nas tsaṇḍa lī yin zer ba yis/ /bud med dmar mo rus rgyan gyon pa des/ khyod kyi gtum mo 'gags nas mi 'dug pas/ /nga yis gtum mo'i rtsa sgo phye'o zer/ /lag g.yon bdag gi rdo rje dha ra nas/ /ka ling ka gtad dung ltar bus pa dang*/ /bdag gi spyi bor rlangs pa nag po zhig /lan gsum spur bas sangs te gtor ba dang*/ /rtsa yang mtshan nyid bzhi ldan lta bur gyur/

/rdo rje'i rtse mor ma rāau te sbyar nas/ /'di ni las kyi rgya yis gdab pa yin/ /lam du ma lhong bar la ma gzigs zer/ /bdag kyang bhandha'i nang nas phyi la langs/ /mtsho rgyal phyag tu dkar chas gos 'dug pas/ /bdag la g.yogs te rab gnas mdzad pa dang*/ /da nas rnal 'byor dkar chas zungs shig gsungs/ /mtsho rgyal phyir 'brangs pho brang nang du phyin/ /de tshe gu ru'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ e ma/ dal 'byor don yod 'bras bu rdo rje'i theg /snying po len phyir mchis pa'i skal ldan bu/ /da ni sngon gyi smon lam 'phro bzang skyongs/ /bka' rgya lung gi sgrom bu bla med chos/ /da nas zhal phye 'dul zhing dus la bab/ /'gro la chos kyi 'khor lo zab mo bskor/ /lung gi kha byang dgos pa'i ri mo sbyin/ /dam tshig dbang bzhi 'di ltar 'chang bar gyis/ /de skad gsungs nas dkyil 'khor de dag gi /dbang bskur bskyed rdzogs ngo sprod legs par gnang*/ /dkyil 'khor lha rnams bdag gi snying khar bstims/ /gzungs thag rdo rje lag tu gtad nas kyang*/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsal yin gsungs/ /de ma thag tu slob dpon gnas gyur nas/ /kun tu bzang po yab yum dngos su gyur/ khru gang tsam gyi nam mkhar 'phags te bzhugs/ /yab yum mkha' lam 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba dang*/ /gsang ba'i rdo rjer ljags rkyongs gsungs pa'i mod/ /bdag gis ro 'dzin legs par rkyang ba'i tshe/ /dam tshig dkar po dmar po 'bru gsum drug /'phros nas bdag gi lce la thim pa dang*/ /lus kyang mi phyed bde bas gang ba dang*/ /gsang ba'i dam tshig bcu drug zungs shig gsungs/ /sngar ltar slob dpon sku ru gyur pa dang*/ /tshogs mchod dga' ston dpag med gnang ba'i mthar/ /bud med rgyan can mang po de yi nang*/ /dhakki dhe wa dha ra yin gsungs pa'i/ /dar dmar yug gos gsol ba zhig 'dug par/ /slob dpon phyag gis de la reg nas su/

/bu khyod grogs kyi rten 'brel 'di yin pas/ /deng nas brtsam ste 'dzin par gyis shig gsungs/ /bud med de dang bdag gi srin mdzub la/ /tshangs skud dmar po zhig gis sbrel nas su/ /dkyil 'khor nub tu khrid de ngo sprod mdzad/ /deng nas brtsam ste padma gter bdag gling*/ /tshe la dbang zhing rig 'dzin 'du ba yin/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa mngon gyur nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rtag tu skor byed cing*/ /gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron mer bkra shis shog /ces gsungs dkyil 'khor dag kyang gu rur thim/ /da ni khyod kyi rten 'brel rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs 'dod rgu'i mdzod gling 'di dag nas/ /rang gi gang ltar mos pa 'doms shig gsungs/ /de tshe bdag gis gang 'dam ma rnyed nas/ /zla grogs bud med de la dris pa las/ /bud med de yi lde mig 'doms shig gsungs/ /de ma thag tu lde mig btsal ba dang*/ /rin chen sna tshogs las grub lde mig ni/ kha dog ma nges tshul du 'dug pa las/ /bdag gis ind+ra nī lar grub pa yi/ /lde mig sngon por 'dug pa de dag blangs/ /da rung lde mig gcig longs zer ba las/ /padma rā ga'i lde mig de dag blangs/ /da ni lde mig ngas len zer nas su/ /bud med de yi dngul gyi lde mig blangs/ /de nas gu ru'i mdun du tshur log pas/ /mtsho rgyal zhal ras dgyes tshul mdzad nas su/ /bu yis lde mig 'dam pa ma nor gsungs/ /lde mig 'di rnams gang ltar lags zhus pas/ /baiḍūrya yi lde mig sngon po 'di/ /gnas lugs rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i lde mig yin/ /dmar po padma rā ga'i lde mig 'di/ /shes rab gsung dbyangs drug cu'i lde mig yin/ /dkar po dngul las grub pa'i lde mig 'di/ /bskyed pa thabs dang 'brel ba'i lde mig yin/ /mthar thug sku gsum 'bras bu 'di kho na/ khyed kyis lde mig ser po 'di blang na/ /longs spyod 'khor los bsgyur rgyal ltar 'byung ste/

/zab mo'i chos de rnam g.yeng bdud kyis 'joms/ /lde mig ljang gu'i rigs shig blang gyur na/ /rang mgo thon tsam sna gcig ma gtogs par/ /'dod rgu phun tshogs rnyed par mi 'gyur na/ /de bas 'khrul med ji bzhin 'dams pa yin/ /da ni de la phan pa 'di yin gsungs/ /shog dril dkar mthing dmar gsum gtad nas ni/ /sku gsum brda de legs par chongs shig dang*/ /da lan skyel mkhan nga yis bya'o gsung*/ /gu ru'i phyag nas rdo rje dril bu zhig /'chang bar gyis shig gsungs te bdag la gnang*/ /de tshe bdag gis gsol ba yang yang btab/ /gu rus srin mdzub sbrel ba'i tshangs skud de/ /bkrol nas shog dril gsum de legs par dkris/ /bdag gi phrag khar dam du gnas par bcug /de tshe gu ru'i zhal nas bka' stsal te/ /bu khyod 'di nas mi ring nye ba ru/ /jo bo gze rgyal bya ba'i gangs ri'i g.yas/ /mu khri 'bum khri brgyad khri bya ba'i sar/ /seṅge dkar mo mkhar mchongs 'dra ba ru/ /lde mig dmar po de yi gdams pa yod/ /tshes 'di'i bco lnga'i nyi ma tshun chad la/ /de ru mgyogs par 'phrad du ma bsleb na/ /rgya rtags ri mo gzhan la shor dogs yod/ /de bas 'phral du phyogs med ri khrod 'grims/ /de nas mi ring lo gcig 'das pa ru/ /bu khyed bsu ba'i bang chen gtong 'ong gsungs/ /de ma thag tu gsol ba btab ste phyin/ /mtsho rgyal sngar gyi lus chas bsgyur nas su/ /phal pa'i bud med rgyan can lta bur mdzad/ /dhe wa dha ra sngar gyi lus ltar 'dug /mtsho rgyal mdun dang bdag ni bar du bzhag /dhe wa dha ra phyi byas phyin pa dang*/ /shel gyi phug pa zhig tu slebs nas 'dug /'di ming gang zer bdag gis smras pa la/ /'di ni yang rdzong shel phug 'og ma yin/ khyed nyid sngon gyi sgrub phug yin zhes gsungs/ /de nas shar du kha gtad phyin pa las/ /mi ring ba ru mtsho kha zhig tu slebs/ /mtsho 'di ci zhig bya ba yin smras pas/

/'di ni padma'i bla mtsho yin zhes gsungs/ /de nas gangs ri rngam po lhun 'thug rtsar/ /mtsho mdog dung ltar dkar ba'i mtsho khar sleb/ /'di yi ming la gang zer dris pa las/ /'di ni gze rgyal dung mtsho bya ba yin/ /rgyal bas lung bstan gangs ri 'di yin pas/ /mtsho 'dir khrus rgyobs smon lam gyis shig dang*/ /ma 'ongs gnas 'di'i bdag po bu khyed yin/ /de skad gsungs pas khrus brgyab smon lam btab/ /de ma thag tu 'gro ba'i nyams byung bas/ /rdza ri dkar dmar glang chen 'gyings 'dra'i rtser/ /brag dkar seṅge gnam du mchongs 'dra 'dug /de yi byang phyogs log nas phyin pa'i tshe/ /dkar dmar sngo nag spel ba'i rgya rtags ni/ /rim pa bdun gyi tshul du dod nas 'dug /brag gi ngos la 'ja' ltar lhags nas su/ /drag mo seng gdong sha za dngos su byung*/ /mtsho rgyal phyag gis sdigs mdzub mdzad nas su/ hūm̐/ gsang ba'i gnyer gtad bka' yi las byed pa'i/ /sha za las kyi ma mo mi bsrun ma/ /sngon gyi dam tshig ji ltar bsgos pa bzhin/ /deng 'dir pha nor bu la sbyin pa'i dus/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /rin chen gter gyi rgya 'khrol dus la bab/ /legs par sgo phyes brda yi chos rnams kun/ /padma gter bdag gling zhes 'di la sprod/ khyed kyang lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du/ /chos 'di spel ba'i grogs dang mel tshe mdzod/ oṃ ma tri singha mu kha ni dhi pa ti ya dza dza dung dung thun thun pra bha ya swā hā/ de ma thag tu brag de sgo phyes te/ /'di nas dgos pa'i chos de gang yin zer/ /mtsho rgyal spyan gyis legs par gzigs nas su/ kha byang don gsal me long gtod ces gsungs/ /ma mo de yi lag pa brkyangs nas ni/ /la sgrom dmar po rgya rtsis bsdams pa zhig /drag mos bdag gi lag tu gtad pa la/ /smon lam dang ni gsol ba thob ces gsungs/ /bdag dang dhe wa dha ri'i mgor bzhag nas/

/dbang bzhi blangs shing smon lam legs par btab/ /bdag gi snam phrag bcug nas 'ong bsam par/ /drag mos zhag bdun bar du nga yis bzung*/ /da lta khyod nyid smon lam skabs yin pas/ /'khyer yang dbang du ma mchis stong nyid do/ /de bas dngos su shog dang sbyin no gsungs/ /de tshe sgrom de ma mo'i lag tu gtad/ /nga ni rgyab sor 'ong gis gtod c-ig smras/ /de nas dar gcig tshur la 'ong pa'i tshe/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /da ni bu khyod nang du log cig dang*/ /mkha' 'gro nged gnyis u rgyan yul du 'gro/ /yun ring ma 'gor ba ru mjal lo gsungs/ /de tshe bdag gis lan du btab pa la/ /grogs 'di bdag dang mnyam du mi 'gro na/ /nga yi grogs ni su yis bgyi zhes zhus/ /de tshe mtsho rgyal zhal nas bka' stsal pa/ /thog mar rten 'brel grogs dag nye bar yod/ /'di nas rta shod bya ba'i lung pa ru/ /ye shes ḍākki'i sprul pa khyad par can/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags tshang ba yod/ /smon lam dbang gis dus gcig tshogs te byung*/ /rten 'brel grogs su de nyid btsal bas chog /dhe wa dha ra rgyab sor sleb 'ong gsungs/ /de ma thag tu mkha' la gshegs nas song*/ /bdag kyang gnyid sad phyogs bcur bltas pa'i tshe/ /nyi ma shar la khad tsam red nas 'dug /de nas mgyogs par langs shing gsol ba btab/ /mal sa thams cad legs par bsdus pa dang*/ /'gro chas thams cad grabs su bcug pa'i tshe/ /gsol ja phul mkhan de ru slebs nas byung*/ khyed kyis chas ka bsdu nas ci mdzad zer/ /nga ni chu tshan zhig la 'gro dgos yod/ /de skad smras pas ja yang drangs zin song*/ /gzhis gnyer rtsa ru phyin nas lam chas bslangs/ /da res

gte sdud phyogs la 'byon ran pas/ /zhag mang ma 'gor mgyogs par byon shog zer/ /de ma thag tu mgon khang nang du phyin/ /gser skyems phran bu tsam zhig mchod nas su/ /lus la go khrab mgo la wa zhwa gyon/ /sked la rkang gling rgyab la gri ring dang*/ /'phrag la ther gzan 'phangs nas sgo ru don/ /mthong ba kun gyis bzhad gad byas nas su/ /gcod lugs rkang gling sog lugs wa zhwa gyon/ /hor chas go khrab rab byung ther gzan dkris/ /mi nag chas ldan gri ring btags pa 'di/ /cha lugs chos lugs mi byed dgu byed las/ /de bas rta chibs bu tsha mi 'khrid par/ /chu tshan byed mi 'di 'dra ma mthong zer/ /de la bdag gis lan du 'di skad smras/ /'o na ri gcod gtong du 'gro ba yin/ /nga yi zla bo bu tsha e 'gro smras/ /grwa pa rnams dang nang zan thams cad kyis/ khyed kyis ri gcod byed na mi 'gro zer/ /chu tshan yin na nged rnams 'gro'o zer/ /nga ni lha 'dre ar gtad byed du 'gro/ /snang srid dbang sdud zil gyis mnan nas 'gro/ /chu tshan dgos pa'i nad 'dra mi 'dug smras/ kha shag klog ste pho brang sgo ru don/ /rlangs kyi grwa pa don 'grub dbang rgyal la/ /nga ni don skor zhig la 'gro dgos pas/ khyed kyang nga yi zla bo e 'gro smras/ /ring thung gang du yin kyang 'gro chog zer/ /grwa pa de ni bu tshar khrid nas su/ /gro ba la nas don pa'i mtshams shig la/ /na thā su n+yai'i chang zom khur nas byung*/ /chang 'di khyed rang gsum la 'dren yin pas/ /lam thug phog snang da ni ci byed zer/ /nga ni zhag po bcu tsam 'gor ba yod/ /chang 'di gzhan ma rnams la drongs shig smras/ /'o na 'di ru cung zhig bzhugs ces zer/ /chang gi them tsa btsags nas phul ba ni/ /rten 'brel legs por 'grigs te song ba'i tshe/ /rme ba kha ru rnga ba'i bu mo gsum/ /chang zom khur nas lam bar 'phrad pa la/ /phud nas mchod cing bdag gis cung zad 'thung*/

/de nas ting bzang grong du sleb pa dang*/ /gsol chang la sogs zhabs tog legs par byung*/ /de yi nub mo sprel ngu bya bar bsdad/ /phyir nangs zhogs nas myur du phyin pa las/ /bya rong la khar sleb dang dus mnyam par/ /rlung dmar 'tshubs te 'ur sgra 'byin pa dang*/ /lam yang mi shes the tshom gyur pa'i tshe/ /slob dpon rje la gsol ba yang yang btab/ /chos skyong rnams la tha tshig bsgrags pa dang*/ /gcan gzan zhig gis ngar skad 'byin nas song*/ /de yi phyir bsnyegs myur du phyin pa dang*/ /de nub rgyal mo ri yi rtsa bar slebs/ /yul yang ma 'byed rmi lam brtags pa'i tshe/ /nub mo srod la lha btsan 'bar ba ni/ /dpon g.yog dgu tsam de ru lhags nas ni/ /nged rnams rten 'brel thabs bsur 'ong yin zer/ khyed rnams su yin ming la ji skad zer/ /sang zhogs 'gro ba'i lam de gang du yod/ /gter gnas phyogs la ring thung ci tsam yod/ /dus tshod tshes grangs gang la bsleb pa yod/ /lung bstan 'khrul med brda ru ston rogs gyis/ /de skad smras pas lha btsan zhal na re/ /padma gter bdag gling pa ma yengs nyon/ /nga ni gze rgyal lha btsan 'bar ba yin/ /sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin du deng 'dir mchis/ /sang ni 'di nas yar tsam 'das pa'i mtshams/ /lung sgo byang shar bstan pa de ru byon/ /gter gnas phyogs su 'di phan la gsum yod/ /da rung deng sang mi mang 'tshogs nas yod/ /bco lnga'i tshes la khrom de'i dkyil dag tu/ /bud med ral pa'i thor tshugs can zhig yod/ /de la dris na gnas de shes yod zer/ /rgya de bco lnga yol na rtags rdzogs yin/ /lam du ma yengs kha mig sgrims byon zer/ /dkar tshan 'ga' re'i 'tsho ba phul nas kyang*/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /de nas gnyid sad tho rangs sleb pa dang*/ /yar langs zhogs ja 'thung nas lam du zhugs/ /sngar gyi rmi lam lta bu'i lung pa 'dug /mgyogs par phyin te gangs kyi la mo brgyab/

/de yi nub mo lung bzang phu la bsdad/ /zhogs la lung bzang gung gi la chung brgyab/ /'brong bu thang la tsha 'bog brgyab pa dang*/ /sgrung mkhan bud med gzhon gnyis 'phrad nas byung*/ /de dang cha ru 'brong pa'i la chung brgyab/ /gnas mdun de ru brag thog zhig la ni/ /tsā ri byon pa yin zer bskor mkhan ni/ khrom yang stong phrag ma zin tsam du snang*/ /de ru nyi ma phyed yol tsam la sleb/ /ja thengs gnyis tsam bskol te 'thung nas su/ /rmi lam bzhin du khrom pa nyul bar phyin/ /rtags ldan bud med de 'dra mi 'dug pas/ /dri sa ma rnyed go khar log nas 'ong*/ /cung zad bsdad pas mi ring de nyid du/ /rta shod yul nas 'ong ba yin zer ba'i/ /bu mo ma bu bzhi tsam slebs nas byung*/ /de yi nang nas bu mo chung chung la/ /mgo la skra cog bsdams pa gcig kyang byung*/ /de la byung khungs zhib mor dris pa las/ kha brda gsal por gang dris zer mkhan 'dug khyed kyi lo ni ci tsam 'gro dris pas/ /bcu gsum tsam zhig lon pa e 'ong zer/ /nub mo bzang ngan 'phros pa ma byas par/ /bdag ni ri khar gcod dmigs btang bar song*/ /phyir nangs zhogs nas ja zhig bskol ba dang*/ /bu mo ma bu gnyis la ja yang byin/ /de nyin bu mo de la skad cha dris/ kha yi rten 'brel legs po byed par 'dug khyed kyi ming la ci zer rus ci yin/ /da nas khyim la sdod pa yin nam ci/ /de skad dris pa'i lan du 'di skad zer/ /nga ni lha lcam skye ba 'od zer lcam/ /ming ni rig 'dzin skyid ces bya ba yin/ /rgyun du khyim la sdod pa mi 'ong ste/ /padma bkod du e bsleb bsam pa yin/ /ngag nas de skad tshig bzang bshad pa dang*/ /bdag gis de yi lan du 'di ltar smras/ khyed kyang padma bkod du 'gro 'dod na/ /nga yang de ru bgrod pa byed dgos pas/ /lo ni drug bdun tsam zhig song ba'i tshe/ khyed kyang gnas der sleb par gyis la shog

/de ring tshes pa bco lnga yin pa la/ /rten 'brel dga' ston bzang po dgos lags pas/ /rten 'brel kun gyi grogs ni e 'ong smras/ /yong yong ci 'dra dgos kyang legs par 'ong*/ /nga yis rten 'brel gang drag chog yin zer/ /de tshe bdag gis legs par bsam gzhig la/ /snga ma rten 'brel byed pa mi shes kyang*/ /nyams dang rmi lam lung bstan gzu dpang dang*/ /lung nas bstan pa de ni yin 'dug bsam/ /tshogs rdzas bsags te dkyil 'khor gtor ma bzos/ /brag rdog de yi mdun du phyin nas ni/ /dkon mchog spyi 'dus zhal phyes cho ga btang*/ /kau rī ma la tshogs rdzas btegs su bcug /tshogs 'khor grub nas dngos grub rol pa'i tshe/ /bskor ba bskor mkhan mang po de ru byung*/ /kun la tshogs rdzas byin nas me tog 'thor/ /de nas nang du me gor log pa dang*/ /de ru rgas mo 'ga' zhig 'dug pa des/ /sems la phan pa'i chos shig ston dang zer/ /de tshe bdag gis mgur glu 'di blangs nas/ /sems la phan pa'i chos ni 'di yin smras/ na mo gu ru/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /pha padma 'byung nas zhabs la 'dud/ /dad pa yid kyi sa gzhi la/ /mos gus so nam ma bzang na/ /sa bon smin pa ya re cha/ /sems skye med nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /log rtog khu rlangs ma dwangs na/ /zla skar bkrag pa ya re cha/ /skyabs yul dpag bsam sdong po la/ /mos pas gzhi rtsa ma smin na/ /lo 'bras rgyas pa ya re cha/ /tshogs zhing yid kyi maṇḍal la/ /'byor pa'i brtson 'grus ma bsring na/ /don gnyis smin grol ya re cha/ /gnas lugs lta ba'i rgya mtsho la/ /rba rlabs rtsal du ma mthong na/ /'khyil ba'i don rtogs ya re cha/ /rgyu 'bras dkar nag sa bon la/ /rjes shes blang dor ma go na/ /mtho ris bsleb pa ya re cha/ /'jig rten mi nag dad pa la/ kha tshig drang don chos bshad kyis/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa ya re cha/ /gshis lugs sems rgyud ma dul na/

/nyan thos gog po'i lta ba yis/ /don rgyud smin pa ya re cha/ /'o skol 'dir 'dus rten 'brel la/ /dga' ston chos kyi smin 'dod kyang*/ /sems rgyud kheng lam 'gro stabs bde/ /bag chags 'thib po goms yun ring*/ /mtho ris bde 'gro sa thag ring*/ /ngan 'gro'i skya lam g.yang kha zab/ /rig pa'i mi chung 'gro 'dod skyen/ /tshogs drug bu mo bslu brid mkhas/ /rang dbang ma 'dus sa bzung dka'/ /sbyin bdag dga' bo nyal du song*/ kho bo rnal 'byor dben ri 'grim/ /de tsam chos kyi 'brel ba mdzod/ /de sogs mgur dang rgyu 'bras chos kyang bstan/ /de tshe khrom pa thams cad 'dus nas byung*/ /sgrung mkhan de ni ma ṇi bskor nas su/ /dal gcig red tsam thams cad nyal du song*/ /bdag kyang gcod khrid 'gro ba yin smras nas/ /brag rdog de yi sked par phyin pa dang*/ /mi rkang gling bu drag tu lan gsum bus/ /gos log phyi ma thams cad de ru bzhag /dkon mchog gsum la blo gtad gsol ba btab/ /rkang dung de ni lag tu thogs nas su/ /gnas ri de la kha gtad legs par phyin/ /la sked tsam la phyin nas bltas pa'i tshe/ /spyang ki mang pos ngu sgra 'byin nas 'dug /de tshe bdag gis gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ phaṭḥ gnas mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings rum nas/ /pha padma 'byung nas byin rlabs can/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus/ /lus 'dus byas phung po tshogs su bzhes/ /rkyen ro snyom lam du lhongs bar shog phaṭḥ gnas rten 'brel bden tshig pho brang nas/ /ma ye shes mtsho rgyal byin rlabs can/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus/ /lus 'dus byas phung po tshogs su rol/ /rkyen ro snyom lam du lhongs bar shog /phaṭḥ phaṭḥ gzugs can gyi dgra phaṭḥ gzugs med kyi bgegs phaṭḥ snang srid kyi cho 'phrul phaṭ/

/nga bdag gi 'gong po phaṭ/ /re dogs kyi 'dzin pa phaṭ/ /gcig chod de thog tu phaṭ/ /de skad brjod nas rkang dung lan gsum btang*/ /gcan spyang ngu sgra de yang med nas song*/ /de ma thag tu la nyag de ru sleb/ /de tshe zla skar gsal po 'dug pa'i ngogs/ /mi nag rta nag bzhon pa'i seng zhal can/ /mgo bo ri rab de dang mnyam pa zhig /mdun du slebs te lam yang bkag nas byung*/ /bdag gis zhing skyong mgon po yin snyams nas/ /chos skyong chen po bdag gi lam sna khrid/ /rin chen gter gyi sa mchog myur du stsol/ /zhus pas de ma thag tu lag gis bkyags/ /rta yi mjug tu bzhag nas glo bur khyer/ /zhing skyong sku la tsha tshwa 'phro ba dang*/ /bdag gi gdong yang tsha 'ub chil chil byung*/ /gter gnas de yi brag ni mi snang bar/ /bud med dmar mo seṅge'i gdong can ma/ khrag gi ral pa nam mkhar 'khyil ba dang*/ /phyed skyil tshul du bu ga re re nas/ khrag gi ser ba chil chil 'khrigs pa dang*/ /lag tu kha ṭwāṃ tsitta thogs nas su/ /mi ro ring po kha la za bzhin 'dug /g.yas g.yon gnyis su stag dang seṅge gnyis/ /rngam zhing ngar sgra 'ur 'ur 'byin pa 'dug /bdag ni rta mjug de nas blangs pa dang*/ /bud med de yi mdun du bzhag nas song*/ /de ma thag tu dran pas ma zin nas/ /cung zad brgyal ba lta bu byung nas song*/ /de tshe sa gzhi thams cad me 'bar bar/ /mi ro dpag med spungs pa'i dkyil du slebs/ /mi ro'i gseb nas bgrod du ma gtub pas/ /de ma thag tu dran pas zin pa dang*/ /cho 'phrul sgyu ma lta bu'i don de go /dngos med stong pa'i rang gzugs yin bsam nas/ /dran pa rang sar bzhag ma thag tu ni/ /sngar gyi gzugs rnams skad cig gnas 'gyur te/ /brag ri yod pa'i la rtser slebs nas 'dug /sngar gyi rmi lam ngogs su shar ba yi/ /bud med dmar mo zhi ma khro de yis/ /brag gi sgo de had kyis phyes nas su/

/'di yi nang du yar la shog cig zer/ /lag pas bzung nas yar la btegs nas song*/ /nang du bltas pas rin chen sna tshogs kyi/ /dkor mdzod kha phyes ji bzhin lta bur 'dug /sngar nas bcol ba 'di yin zer nas su/ /mu men bum pa 'dra zhig gtad nas byung*/ kha chod rnams kyang legs par bsgrigs nas 'dug /'di nyid mi la ston dang ma bshad zer/ /shin tu gsang dang kha ni rang dbye 'gyur/ /'di nyid 'gro ba mi la bstan lags na/ /sha za nga yis bka' chad yong nges zer/ /de nas brag gi rtsa ru bzhag nas song*/ /brag gi sgo dang mkha' 'gro ma lus kun/ /'ja' tshon yal ba lta bu langs nas song*/ /g.yas g.yon zla ba kha yang dkar ba dang*/ /brag ri za zi skyi yang g.ya' bar 'dug /lam de gang yin ma shes bsdad pa'i tshe/ /ri dwags shig ni mdun nas lang ste song*/ /de yi phyi ru bsnyegs te phyin pa'i tshe/ /brag ri rdzub po'i rong du slebs te 'dug /lam phran gnyis 'dug 'gro tshod ma thig pas/ /bla mar gsol ba yang yang btab pa'i tshe/ /de yi rong nas rlung dmar zhig langs nas/ /ya ki lung pa'i sbubs su phyin nas thal/ /lung bstan yin 'ong bsam zhing de phyir 'brang*/ /sngar gyi zhing skyong mjal sar slebs nas 'dug /de nas thur du mgyogs par phyin pa dang*/ /ri yi klung du ma sleb mtshams de nas/ /sngangs skrag zing zing de yang med pa dang*/ /thang chad kha skom gnyug kyang bud pa dang*/ /chu khar slebs te ngal gso byas nas kyang*/ /chu zhig btungs pas dbugs 'thum 'gro grabs byung*/ /lus kyang 'khyags shing sems kyang shin tu skyo/ /ngu snying brod pa 'dra ba byung ba las/ /rten 'brel byed la ngu ni mi rung bsam/ /shin tu sdug bsran tshul du bsdad pa dang*/ /bskor lam ma ṇi dbyangs kyi skad thos pas/ /de la sems rtsa cung zad spro ba byung*/ /ki sgra chen po 'ga' yang btab nas btang*/ /de nas mi ring ba ru bskor lam sleb/

/nyal sar phyin nas gos log 'dug gam bltas/ /mi yis ma khur khrig ger bsdad nas 'dug /cung zad nyal bsam sked rags bshig pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha' langs nas sangs sangs gsal bar byung*/ /cung zad nyal bas gnyid kyang mi 'khor 'dug /ri yi rtse la nyi ma shar ba dang*/ /gter rdzas bsdad nas e 'dug bltas pa'i tshe/ /la bswe dmar po snying gzugs byas pa yi/ /tshad ni mkha' 'gro ma yi tshon gang 'dug /legs par bltas shing rna bas nyan pa'i tshe/ /nangs nas bong ba rtsi la 'khor 'dra ba'i/ /'gyur skad gsung dbyangs len pa 'ga' re 'dug /mgo ru bzhag nas dbang bzhi legs par blangs/ /dar nang dril te phyi nas ras kyis g.yogs/ /sku reg nang gtums lung zhig sbyar ba dang*/ /nang la sha tshags dam por byas nas su/ /mchan 'og g.yon la sbas pa'i tshul du 'chang*/ /de nas mthur du babs te me gor phyin/ /ja yang bsu ni ran pa tsam du 'dug /gcod dmigs lam du 'gro ba e byung zer/ /gcod dmigs rten 'brel legs par byung zhes smras/ /de nas ja 'thung lha bsang phran zhig btang*/ /de ma thag nas rim par log ste song*/ /dgon du slebs pas lto sdud byon ces zer/ /mgo bskor na tshul bstan nas ma phyin pas/ /bdag gi tshab mar gzhan zhig bcug nas thal/ /de yi phyir nangs drag 'dug smras pa dang*/ /'gro chas gra bsgrigs nang du log nas phyin/ /de yi nub la dba' ther sleb pa dang*/ /cham phu dpon tshang zhes byar bsdad nas kyang*/ /sgom pa a dung bya ba'i rtsa ru phyin/ /gshin rje khro chu sgrub pa'i dpe cha g.yar/ /phyir nangs song bas yis kyi lung du bslebs/ /de yi phyi nyin nang chen sgar du phyin/ /de ru zhag gsum tsam zhig bsdad pa dang*/ /de yi phyi zhogs mi chos nang du song*/ kho tsho'i lug rnams jag pas ded 'dug zer/ /de la dmigs pa'i mthu sgrub byed bsams te/ /zhag po bdun la gshin rje'i sgrub pa byas/ /dam nyams dgra la zor mda' bstan pa'i tshe/

/rlung rtags la sogs legs po byung ba dang*/ /de yi nub mor nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /bdag ni brag ri rngam pa'i logs su phyin/ /lcags kyi pha bong steng du bsdad pa dang*/ /bdag nyid rdo rje 'jigs byed skur gyur nas/ /lcags rwa nam mkha'i dbyings su gzengs pa dang*/ /rwa khros rwa brdar la sogs byed pa'i tshe/ /stong gsum shig shig yam yam 'gul ba dang*/ /de yi mod la bdag gi thugs ka nas/ /gshin rje khro chu dug gdong 'khor bdun dang*/ /zhal phyag rdzogs pa grangs med 'phros nas ni/ /dgra bo mi nor mang po'i bla srog dang*/ /tsitta thams cad dngos su blangs nas su/ /gtso 'khor rnams kyis zhal du gsol ba dang*/ /dgra yul phyed tsam phung ba yin no zer/ /bdag kyang 'jam dpal gshin rjer gyur pa rmis/ /mthu des skya ser bdun tsam lon yod skad/ /de yi phyir nangs zhogs pa nas bzung ste/ khyim mi rnams la mgo bskor byas nas su/ /bdag ni zla ba gcig gnyis tsam gyi lam/ /'bul sdud byed nas log 'ong smras pa dang*/ /lam du zhugs pa'i chas ka thams cad khyer/ /de yi zhor la bon po tshang la phyin/ /de nas sgar chas 'ga' re blang nas ni/ /bon po dbus su 'gro rogs gyis smras nas/ /lam du zhugs te a 'bum brgyud nas song*/ /yul du phyugs nad mang po 'dug par bcad/ /nyin gcig khal ma gcig kyang ma lus par/ /rkun mas ded nas gar song mi snang bas/ /ngar mi sgo rdung ltas ngan btang ba dang*/ /chu la nā ga kha thun 'khor lo bskor/ /zhag gsum song mtshams snga zhogs skabs shig la/ khal ma rnams ni sgo rtsar bskyal nas ni/ 'di rnams khyed kyi e yin ma shes pas/ /mthol bshags bzod gsol bcas 'bul bzhes mdzod zer/ /mi tshang de la ltas ngan 'di ltar byung*/ /chu mig nang du sbrul chen 'khyil ba dang*/ khal rta rnams las me tshag 'thor ba dang*/ khyim nas rnga sgra chen po 'don pa sogs/ /mi rung ltas ngan sna tshogs byung bar skad/

/phugs ma gang byung de rjes ha ma go /de nas rim bzhin lci stod 'brong pa'i sar/ /sbyin bdag 'ga' res re bzhin song nas bsdad/ /de nas zhag 'ga' 'das pa'i mtshams su la/ /gzhi bdag ja mo shang bzang zer ba'i bdun/ /nub mo sgar pa de gar sdod pa la/ khal ma gnyis tsam rkun mas khyer zin 'dug kha ba babs nas rjes kyang mi 'dug pas/ /mthu sgrub phran bu'i cha lag thams cad bsags/ /bon pos nang du dregs pa'i gsol kha btang*/ /bdag gis khrag sna thams cad thogs nas su/ /gzhi bdag a mye ral pa'i rtsa ru phyin/ /gnas der mtsho gnyan shin tu 'jigs pa ni/ /rgya khyon mda' rgyangs ring mo tsam yod par/ /rba rlabs 'khrugs shing lhog lhog khol bar 'dug /mtsho yi 'gram du pha bong zhig 'dug par/ /de yi steng du phyin te gcod dmigs ni/ /gnyan chen mtha' gtad nag po cha dgu dang*/ /nag sbyor bzlog med bcu gsum drag gtad bzhi/ /gnam sa go ldog gling bzhi mtha' sdud sogs/ /drag dmigs bzung zhing rakta mtsho la gtor/ /slar yang me bus me zor mtsho la brgyab/ /de nas gyen du log ste la rtser phyin/ /phyi mig bgyis nas mtsho la bltas pa'i tshe/ /mtsho yang khrag mdog ltar gyur khol zhing 'dug /nyi ma ma nub tsam la nang du sleb/ /nub mo yul de'i mtsho la me 'bar mthong*/ /sku chas ma drongs pa rnams rdza la sbas/ /snga zhogs dus su sgar pa bkyags nas song*/ /zhag gnyis tsam la hor gyi nang du slebs/ /de ru zhag bcu tsam zhig sdod pa'i mthar/ /slar yang chas rnams len par phyin pa'i tshe/ /rkun ma ru dud gcig tsam yin skad pa'i/ khyi gnyis nag mo gcig dang gsum tsam shi/ /nor rnams glo gor btab dang than ltas sogs/ /mi rung sna tshogs 'phyur nas yod do skad/ /hor gyi yul der chos ra tshugs pa la/ /rtags dang rten 'brel shin tu legs par byung*/ /byang pa a rig zhes bya'i yul du song*/ /chos ra btsugs te zla phyed tsam du bsdad/

/slar yang hor gyi nang du log pa dang*/ /sbyin bdag ban bon la sogs mang bar yod/ /dus der gangs chen nang zhes bya ba ru/ /phyi nang lhog rgod khrag skyugs nag po yi/ /ru khag phyug po'i dud tshang gnyis la ni/ /mi rdog gcig kyang med par shi nas 'dug /ri yi nor rnams nye du kun gyis ded/ /ro dang sbra gnyis yul der bskyur nas bros/ /lung pa de yi phyogs tsam mthong ba tshun/ /mi 'grim chad nas stong par lus pa'i shul/ /dgong mo tsam nas 'o dod 'bod pa dang*/ /cho nge 'debs mkhan mang po 'dug go skad/ /thams cad bred sngangs bzod blag med par 'dug /yul der srung ba za yig legs par byin/ /nyin gcig he ru ka yi chas zhugs te/ khal ma dum gcig ded nas bon gcig khrid/ /yul de'i nad bdag 'dul du song ba la/ /de nub lung pa de yi sgo ru bslebs/ /gnyid log srod 'phros tsam zhig sleb pa'i tshe/ /yum chen ma gcig lab kyi sgrol ma nyid/ /ḍā ru rkang gling thogs nas mdun du lhags/ /skye med yum gyi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ ho/ bdag ni ma cig lab sgrol yin/ /sras mchog rgyal ba don 'grub nyon/ /sham po gangs su sdod pa'i tshe/ /theg chen lta ba gtan med gcod/ /dug lnga tshogs drug lam khyer dang*/ /rig pa'i rdzogs-chen bcu gsum sogs/ /ro snyom gcod yul bstan pa de/ /da lan rgyun du 'gel ba'i dus/ /bdag 'dzin nga bdag dbyings su gtor/ /rtog med shes pa mi 'jigs pas/ /rkyen la thog brdzi ma nus na/ /phaṭ sgras ri lung khengs lags kyang*/ /lung stong smyon pa'i ku sgra 'dra/ /rkyen de da lta myur du yod/ /'di la yo lang ma bsres na/ /nad bdag 'dul ba'i a nyan med/ /thos smyon pha rgan de dag gi /bsre ba rnam gsum gsal thob cig /ma yengs ma 'khrul rig pas zungs/ /gsungs te phaṭ sgra gnang ba dang*/ /gnyid sad 'ur sgra 'byin par 'dug khal ma rnams kyang 'drogs par thos/

/bdag ni glo bur lang ba dang*/ /dred mong zhig ni slebs nas 'dug /phaṭ sgra lan gsum btab pa dang*/ /gos de phud nas gcer bur don/ /dred mong mgo la brdegs pa'i tshe/ /ngar sgra 'byin bzhin 'tham nas byung*/ /de tshe bon po gnyid sad de/ /gri ring thogs nas byung ba'i tshe/ /dred mong bros thabs byas nas song*/ /de nas me btang ja zhig bskol/ khal rnams btsal bas rnyed pa dang*/ /rgyang zhig nyal bas nam yang langs/ /de nas phyin pas yul der slebs/ /bon po chu yi phar khar bzhag /bdag gis ral gri lag tu thogs/ /sbra yi ltag tu phyin pa dang*/ /gcod dmigs btang zhing rkang gling bus/ /nad bdag ar gtad drag po byas/ /chon thag bregs shing sbra yang bsgyel/ /g.yas g.yon so sor dag tu phyes/ /ro la gri khram btab pa dang*/ /dur gcod btang zhing drud nas su/ /chu yi nang du rim par bskyal/ /'di dus ro snyom mdzad pa sogs/ /'ga' zhig yod pa gud du sbas/ /de nas chas bkal sgar du log /nad bdag thul nas med par skad/ /de nas rim bzhin sgar pa bkyag /byang lam bsnyegs nas rim bzhin song*/ /'bri gung mthil zhol sleb pa'i tshe/ /nub mo 'bri gung rten chags khar/ /gcod dmigs btang du phyin pa'i tshe/ /gnyid dang rmi lam za zi la/ /mi nag shin tu mi bzad pa/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can de dag gis/ /gnod 'tshe btang du 'dug pa la/ kho bo khyung gi ting 'dzin gyis/ /btul te dam la bzhag pa rmis/ /de nas cung zad mtshams shig la/ /mi dmar kha sho zhig gis ni/ /bud med rta sngon bzhon pa yi/ /zhabs phyir byas nas lhags te byung*/ /bu khyod 'di na ci byed zer/ /bdag gis ri gcod byed pa yin/ khyed rnams su yin gang du 'gro/ /bdag la legs par ston ces smras/ /bud med de yi zhal na re/ /nyon dang skal ldan rigs kyi sras/ /nga ni a phyi chos sgrol yin/ /deng sang ti sgro brag nas 'ong*/ /sngon tshe tshogs khang chen mo ru/

/rgyal bas gnyer gyi tha tshig bzhin/ /deng 'dir bu la bshad du 'ong*/ /ti sgro gnas chen bya ba ru/ /bod yul gzho stod tshogs khang ste/ /gnas yul dur khrod ma lus kyi/ /ma sring mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ khyad par ma hā gu ru yis/ /zab gter dpag med sbas pa'i gnas/ /kun las khyad 'phags bkod pa'i zhing*/ /mkha' spyod 'ja' lus grub pa'i sa/ /ma bsgom ting 'dzin 'char ba'i yul/ /rten 'brel rgya mtsho smin pa'i lung*/ /gnas mchog dam pa de nyid la/ /rab ltar sang gi nyin par byon/ /de ltar gnas skabs ma 'grigs na/ khyu mchog cang shes zla ba la/ /rten 'brel gza' skar bzang ba'i nyin/ /dga' ston rnal 'byor chas su zhugs/ /brtul zhugs grub thob smyon pa'i tshul/ /zla med gcig pur byon par gyis/ /bu khyed mi zad gter chen gyi/ /zab mo chos kyi skal ba yod/ /las 'phro 'dul zhing dus la bab/ /tshig de ma brjed yid la zungs/ /da ni 'bri gung pho brang du/ /'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung nas bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas dbang po de nyid la/ /tshe gcig 'ja' lus 'grub pa yi/ /lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor yod/ /rtse gcig gdams ngag de dag longs/ /rje 'di yang yang mjal bar dkon/ /bu khyed dbang po mi zhum par/ /gzhan gyi sgrigs zhugs slob gnyer spongs/ /chos rnams kun gyi gzhi 'dzin phyir/ /ma yengs 'bri 'don cung zad sbyongs/ /da ni phyogs med 'grim dus su/ /nor rdzas sgyu mar re ba spongs/ /dpon med g.yog med sa mthar bskor/ /grub thob gong ma'i spyod 'gros ltos/ /skabs 'gar bar chad 'byung srid kyi/ /bdud kyis rig pa shor ba yod/ /bag yod snying rus ma chung gyis/ /ma nga ma brjed rgyun du bos/ /rtag tu bu yi grogs su mchis/ /de bas tshig de yid la zungs/ khyed kyang dus rgyun smon lam thob/ /'bri 'dis bstan la phan par gyis/ /da nas ring du mi 'gor bar/

/dam pa'i chos kyi snying po longs/ /mi brjed dran pa thob par gyis/ /tshig 'di ma brjed rig pas zungs/ /kun la ma bshad snying du sbos/ /chos dang bdud gnyis zung 'brel bas/ /rtags mtshan mngon 'dod chung bar gyis/ khyad par nyer lnga'i skag dang ni/ /lo skag rgyab ma ma yol bar/ /zur tsam gzhan gyis mthong gyur na/ /bar chad chen po 'byung lags te/ /'tsho byed sman dang reg phung dug /gang la 'phrad pa cha med pas/ /gsang rgya kha tshig dam par gyis/ / ghu hya ghau shrī ram̐/ de skad gsungs te 'bri gung bzhud nas song*/ /de ma thag tu bdag kyang gnyid sad 'dug /nam yang sangs sangs langs shing 'dug pa dang*/ /sku reg bcings shing sgar sar log nas song*/ /de nas rim gyis 'bri gung rtse bar slebs/ /zla shas tsam zhig song ba'i mtshams dag tu/ /bon po la sogs thams cad khams la brdzangs/ /bdag ni rgya gar gnas mjal 'gro yin smras/ /kun gyis de dag mi 'thad zer ba la/ /bdag ni nyi ma de ring nas bzung ste/ /rnal 'byor grub thob chas shig ma gtogs par/ /mi chos tshig la bstun par byas gyur na/ /mi nga shi ba las kyang thu ba yin/ khyad par bdag ni bsod nams chung ba dang*/ /las ngan rkyen dbang 'di yi hrag lugs kyis/ /sa mtshams 'di nas gsha' ma ma byung na/ /mi lus stong log don med 'khyams nyan 'dug khyad par mthu gtad la sogs mang ba yi/ /da lan sdig pa 'phral du ma bshags na/ /ngan song phyis nas 'gyod pa 'phyis pa yin/ /de bas grogs po sku khams bde bar phebs/ /sprang po ras pa ri khrod 'grim du ran/ /de don bdag gis mgur ma glu ru len/ na mo gu ru/ mkha' dang nyi zla skar tshogs gsum/ /nam zla stod smad ngos rim bzhin/ /nyin mtshan 'brel ba yad yud tsam/ /de yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe/ /grogs po khams bzang rang yul phebs/ /sprang po ras pa ri khrod 'grim/ /snying po rdo rje theg pa len/ /da lan bya btang blo sna stung*/

/de nas rim bzhin mjal bar smon/ /rgya lam mgron po gnas khang gsum/ /dus dang gnas skabs rim pa bzhin/ /lo shas 'brel ba yad yud tsam/ /de yang mi rtag rmi lam ltar/ /grogs po khams bzang rang yul phebs/ /sprang po ras pa ri khraud 'grim/ /snying po rdo rje theg pa len/ /da lan bya btang blo sna stung*/ /de nas rim bzhin mjal bar smon/ /de tsam dga' ston byon skyel mdzod/ /de rnams thams cad khams su brdzangs/ /bdag ni gzhis ka nang du yi ge sbyangs/ /po ti brgya tsam ma thon bar du bklags/ /de nas zla shas tsam zhig 'gro ba ru/ /tshe bdag khro chu'i dbang dang bka' gtad zhus/ /thugs rje chen po'i ljags lung 'ga' re dang*/ /phyag rdzogs khrid kyi po ti'i bka' gtad zhus/ /nyin gcig byang sems bslab pa'i gdams pa gnang*/ /ming la dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis zhes gsung*/ /de gar zla shas tsam zhig bsdad pa dang*/ /nub gcig gong thun nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /brag ri dkar po seṅge 'gyings 'dra'i mgul/ /yang dben 'ja' tshon 'khyil ba'i shel phug tu/ /'jig rten dbang phyug 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ /phyag bzhi shel phreng pad dkar thal sbyar mdzad/ /sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' bklubs pa yi/ /skyil krung gzi mdangs lham mer bzhugs nas 'dug /gsol ba 'debs bzhin gyen du phyin pa dang*/ /thugs rje chen po'i mdun du ma sleb tsam/ /bdag gi phyi ru bud med chung ngu zhig /mnyam mnyam tsam du slebs nas byung ba la/ /bdag gis 'di ni ma legs bsam nas su/ /myur du phyin te zhabs pad mgo gtugs pas/ /bud med de yang g.yon du mgo gtugs song*/ /bdag gis gsol ba smon lam btab pa dang*/ /bud med de yis de ltar 'debs nas 'dug /bdag gis bud med de la smras nas su/ /bud med khyod ni 'di ru ci byed 'ong*/ /gang du 'gro yang gnod pa'i rgyu zhig 'dug /bdag ni 'phags mchog mgon po 'di nyid la/

/rab tu byung ba'i dge slong byed 'dod pas/ khyod kyis nga la mi kha bya bar nges/ /nag chags khyod ni gzhan du 'gro bar gyis/ /bdag gis sdang tshig de skad smras pa dang*/ /bud med de yis gad mo byas nas su/ /dus mtha'i gter ston ca co kha mang po/ /gti mug don la rmongs pa'i nga rgyal can/ /thugs rje chen po gcig gis bdag bzung min/ /'gro ba'i bla ma phyogs med mgon mchog yin/ khyed kyis slob dpon padma'i bka' bcags nas/ /mgo zlum nyan thos grub mthas bslad pa yis/ /rabs chad zhu bar ngas ni mi gnod ste/ khyed nyid rdo rje theg pa'i rkang 'dren nas/ /theg pa gong ma 'og mar 'jug pa ste/ /rig 'dzin kun gyis gsan na mi kha che/ /nyan thos gog po 'dod khyed phar bzhud cig /nga ni phar la 'gro dgos ma yin te/ /bdag 'dzin med do bu mo nga la nyon/ kyai/ ka dag dgongs pa'i klong chen gsal/ /tha dad gdul bya'i ngo bo nyid/ /'gro don sgyu mar bzhengs pa'i sku/ /dbyings rig drwa ba'i gar sgyur mkhan/ /skye 'chi spangs pa'i bla ma de/ /padma 'byung nas ma lags sam/ /gnas lugs lta ba'i rgya mtsho la/ /rig pa'i cho 'phrul so so'ei ngogs/ /'dul zhing don du bzhag pa de/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal ma lags sam/ /dran rig sgyu ma'i gdan sa nas/ /lhan skyes gzhon nu rol pa'i sras/ /sprul pa'i lo tsār byon pa rnams/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga ma lags sam/ /bag yod brten pa'i gshis lugs kyis/ /bsam bzhin srid pa'i rigs drug don/ /rgyal ba'i gdung gsob 'khrungs pa yi/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i slob dpon de/ /rig 'dzin sprul sku ma lags sam/ /bka' bab nyi zla'i snyan grags tsam/ /'ja' lus grub thob rnal 'byor tshogs/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas bsgrub pa rnams/ /dge slong zhus nas byung lags sam/ /nga ni sngags kyi sgrub sde mo/ /jo mo ye shes mtsho rgyal yin/ /lta ba gang shar 'dzin med la/

/rtogs pa'i gdams pa zhus pa med/ /sgom pa tshogs drug lhug bzhag la/ /dgag sgrub lhan pa zhus pa med/ /spyod pa ro snyom man ngag la/ /blang dor 'thib pos g.yogs pa med/ /gtum mo bde stong gsal lam la/ /ring po'i sa mthar bskor ba med/ /'tsho ba dkyil 'khor zhabs tog la/ /bse rag dka' thub byed dgos med/ /rtsa rlung 'ja' lus reg ma la/ /tha mar nag mo 'dzin dgos med/ kho mo ye shes mtsho rgyal la/ khro gtum kha tshig btang dgos med/ /sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur 'di la ltos/ /de skad gsung ma thag tu gnas 'gyur nas/ /sngar ltar ye shes mtsho rgyal red nas song*/ /de tshe bdag gis ngag nas 'gyod bshags phul/ /zhabs mthil spyi bor blangs nas gsol ba btab/ /mos gus gdung ba drag po skyes pa dang*/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sku la thim nas song*/ /'phags mchog phyag g.yas bdag gi mgor bzhag ste/ /skal ldan khyod ni rab tu byung mi nyan/ /sngon nas dkyil 'khor mang po khas blangs pas/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i gsang mdzod bzung nas su/ /rin chen gter la spyod pa'i gang zag yin/ /gdung rgyud bzung mkhan zhig kyang rten 'brel 'dug /gtum mos 'ja' lus lam mchog brtson cig gsungs/ /shel phreng de ni bdag la gtad ma thag /ratna karma bha dra'i sku ru gyur/

'bri gung dkon mchog phrin las bzang po mchan/ /gtum mo 'ja' lus yin gsung dpe cha zhig /bdag la gnang bas lus la 'chang bar rmis/ /de ma thag tu gnyid kyang sad nas 'dug /de yi zhogs nas gsol dpon legs bzang la/ /bdag gis gtum mo 'ja' lus zhu 'dod pas/ /rin po che la snyan gsan phul zhus pas/ /de ma thag tu gsol dpon mdun du bcar/ /cung zhig song mtshams gsol dpon sleb nas byung*/ /nyi ma phyed kar byon dang 'ong ba yod/ /de skad thos pas rang yang gzhan du phyin/ /nyin phyed gung tshigs thon pa'i mtshams de ru/ /lus la khrus sogs gtsang bar byas nas su/ /bla ma'i drung du sku bcar zhus pa dang*/ /zab pa'i man ngag khyod kyis ci 'dod gsungs/ /bdag ni 'ja' lus rdo rje lam mchog 'dod/ /de skad zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas kyang*/ /'di ni gdams ngag kun gyi snying po yin/ /man ngag yod kyang khyad chos 'di 'dra med/ /chos rje dkon mchog ratna man chad nas/ /'di nyid bsgoms pas grub pa thob pa yin/ /'ja' lus 'grub nas mkha' la gshegs pa mang*/ /chos drug la sogs spyi chos mang na yang*/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs ma yal ba'i/ /gcig brgyud snying gi thig le dam pa yin/ /'di la zab khyad gdams pa lnga yod kyang*/ /nyung la zab pa 'di nyid gnad yin gsungs/ /gtum mo'i gdams pa shog ldeb chung ngu gsum/ /'ja' lus 'grub pa'i shog ldeb bdun tsam gyi/ /lung dang zhal shes 'khrul 'khor bcas pa gnang*/ /slob dpon bla ma lha dbang gyis shig gsungs/ /de nas zhag po bdun la zas bcad de/ /gshin rje'i sgrub khang nang du legs par sbyangs/ /zhag po gsum tsam song ba'i mtshams dag la/ /gtum mo rang 'bar lus la bde drod phebs/ /zhag bzhi'i skabs su g.yo ba'i rlung yang brtan/ /lnga yi skabs su mi rtog ye shes brtan/ /drug la chos sku'i brda don sgyu mar rtogs/ /bdun la 'khor 'das gnyis med mnyam par go

/lam du lhong ba 'dra ni dka' mod kyang*/ /brda ni kun kyang byed pa shes par byung*/ /brgyad nas mtshams grol bla ma'i drung du bcar/ /'khrul 'khor tshar gcig brgyab te spyan gzigs phul/ /de dag chog 'dug rgyun du ma chag gsungs/ /'o na spyod lam ji ltar byed lags zhus/ /gang shar gang snang 'dzin med gyis shig gsungs/ /'o na bskyed rdzogs gtso bor gang 'don zhus/ /zung 'brel ngang nas rdzogs chen gtsor thon gsungs/ /'o na 'gro don gang la smin lags zhus/ /dus la bab pa de la smin no gsungs/ /'o na gnas ri gang la 'dzin lags zhus/ /phyogs med dben pa'i ri de zungs shig gsungs/ /gnas la sdod yun ring thung gang byed zhus/ /'os 'tshams 'gro sdod ran par gyis shig gsungs/ /zhwa lugs gos stabs gang 'dra byed na zhus/ /dus la bstun pa'i rang lugs gyis shig gsungs/ /pha yul 'gro'am mi yul sdod lags zhus/ /bdams ris med pa'i gnas dang yul yin gsungs/ /bla ma byed dam rtogs ldan byed lags zhus/ /'gro don dus la bab pa'i lugs gyis gsungs/ /gnas skor bya'am sgrub pa bya lags zhus/ /bogs dang yon tan gang che de gyis gsungs/ /rnam rtog zad na chos sku 'dod dam zhus/ /'khrul pa zad pa'i mtshams de rang yin gsungs/ /mi rtog shar nas kun rtog e yod zhus/ /'phel 'grib med par shar na de yin gsungs/ /de sogs zhal gdams rnams kyang 'ga' re zhus/ /lo res dus la ma bab sbas pa yin/ /rten 'brel zhabs brtan rnams la yang yang 'tshogs/ /de nas grwa slob rnams kyis gsung rigs la/ /lo shas tsam la 'di ru mi bzhugs par/ /phyogs med ri khrod 'grims ni ci zhig byed/ /gnas dang bla ma yul 'dir bzang yin zer/ /de tshe kho bos de la lan btab par/ /gnas dang bla ma 'di ru khyad 'phags kyang*/ /na so gzhon tshe phyogs med ma 'grim na/ /rgas pa'i dus su 'gyod pas 'phyis pa yin/ khyad par mtshan ldan bla ma sangs rgyas drung*/
