/gdams ngag sna re zhu bar ma gtogs par/ /yun du bsrings nas zhu dgos ci yang med/ /yun ring 'grogs na sangs rgyas skyon yang mthong*/ /nye gnas dred pos gdams ngag dpe la lus/ /rang tshul rmongs pa'i spyod 'gro 'ba' zhig de/ /ha cang ma go yus che bzhag la btang*/ /de bas dam tshig 'brel ba ma dor na/ /gnas dang bla mar rgyang nas gsol 'debs dga'/ /rtsa rlung gtum mo'i gdams ngag 'di nyid ni/ /ma sring mkha' 'gro kun gyi snying khrag yin/ /da ni bla ma lo brgyar bsten na yang*/ /zab pa'i man ngag 'di las lhag pa med/ khyed rnams rgyun par drung du bzhugs pa rnams/ /nga yi gdams ngag 'di tsam lon par gyis/ /drin can ratna karma bha dra 'di/ /skal ldan nges shes can gyis mjal gyur na/ /gu ru padma'i sku dang dbye rab med/ /gdams ngag gsang rgya mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag 'di/ /mos gus snying rus can gyis bsgom gyur na/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par the tshom med/ kho bo bdag ni gdams ngag 'di gas chog /shes na tshig gi grub mtha' rang la 'dug /de bas lung stong ku sgra mi 'debs par/ /chu yi so nam bsags pa'i snying po 'dra/ /de bas bdag 'dra phyogs med ri khrod 'grim/ /ltas ngan mi rung sna tshogs g.yang du len/ /mi 'dod rkyen dang 'phrad tshe bogs re thon/ /kun khur dma' sa zin pas sgrib pa dag /bstod mkhan 'ong ba'i re med nga rgyal chung*/ /blo 'dri gzhan la mi dgos rang thag chod/ /sems 'dzin ngo srung mi dgos 'gro sdod bde/ /dge 'dun dkor la mi 'bag phyi mar yang*/ /mi kha'i 'jigs dang bral ba'i ro snyom bde/ /rgyu med dgra sdang 'jigs pa bral 'di bde/ /de bas rgyal khams phyogs med sangs rgyas zhing*/ /sang nas 'gro ba'i grabs shig bya'o smras/ /chas rnams 'ga' re yod pa gtor ba dang*/ /btsun chas spus legs cha gcig yod pa de/ /bla mar khams bzang zhus pa'i rten du phuul/

/bdag ni he ru ka yi chas su zhugs/ /rten 'brel ched du pad zhwa mthong grol gyon/ /'gro ba'i gos dang rgyan gyis spras nas su/ /bla ma'i drung du phyin pas rab gnas dang*/ /bkra shis smon lam dag kyang mdzad nas byung*/ /byin rlabs rten gsum khyad 'phags 'ga' re gnang*/ /bu la re che'i zhal gdams mdzad pa dang*/ /phyag mdzod gzhung nas ja dar dngul ras dang*/ /gos lag la sogs legs par gnang nas byung*/ /de yi nang nas dngul dang dar ras thogs/ /ja yang bzhi thig tsam gyi chas 'khor bcas/ /de min thams cad gzhan la byin nas su/ /dus tshes bzang po yin zhes zer ba'i nyin/ /zla med gcig pur phyogs la spyod pa gshegs/ /mtshan ldan bla mar rgyang nas phyi phyag 'tshal/ /'di yan sgyu ma'i byis pa 'khrul 'byams can/ /rang ngo ma shes pa kho snying rje nas/ /de tshe bdag gis mgur glu 'di skad bzhengs/ na mo gu ru/ gnas dbus yul 'bri yi 'o ma'i tshal/ /byang gtsang chab kyu mo 'khyugs pa'i 'gram/ /shing rgya lcang ljon pa'i nags tshal dbus/ /bya ne tso ngang pa khrung khrung dang/ /byis 'jol mo la sogs yid mtshar rigs/ /gsung dbyangs snyan 'gyur khug bsgrog pa'i yul/ /sa 'dab brgyad ru sbal 'gyings 'dra'i steng*/ /zhing padma 'od kyi bkod pa'i gling*/ /mkhar mdzes sdug rnam rgyal khang bzang gi /rgyan yid 'ong lhun rtse'i mngon dga' ru/ /mtshan brjod par dka' ba'i rin po che/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /pha ratna karma bha dra'i zhabs/ bdag mos pa'i spyi bo'i rgyan du 'dud/ /sngon smon lam bzang po'i las 'brel gyis/ /mtshan thos pa tsam gyis gdung ba skye/ /sku mjal ba tsam gyis 'khrul pa zhi/ /brda thos pa tsam gyis snying po lon/ /lam sbyangs pa tsam gyis rim pa rdzogs/ /don bsgoms pa tsam gyis 'bras bu thob/ /gnad snyan brgyud nyung ngus rgyud sde shar/ /pha gsang sngags sdong po drin du che/

/dus da lan sku khams bzang bar bzhugs/ /bdag phyogs med dben ri nyul ba yi/ /thugs 'bral med yid kyis mjal bar smon/ /mgur dbyangs snyan mchod pa'i dga' ston shog /bdag da ni dga' ba'i glu zhig len/ na mo gu ru/ /rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi gzugs can/ /rgyud nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin/ /yid 'dod rgu'i gter mdzod rlabs po che/ /pha karma bha dra'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag brtul zhugs smyon pa 'gro ba'i tshe/ /pha nyi zla lta bu'i bu rgyud la/ /mtho gling bzhi'i yul la gshegs tsa na/ /rkyen chu 'dzin lta bus sgrib g.yogs tshe/ /rlung gsal 'debs drag po'i gdams ngag 'dogs/ /zer phyogs bcur mi khyab bsam pa med/ /yul mi chos can la de re tshim/ /pha khyung chen lta bu'i phru gu nga*/ /lam yangs mo'i bya lam gcod pa'i tshe/ /rlung spu gri ngar mas gnod gyur na/ /gdan gshog 'gyur lta bu'i gdams ngag 'dogs/ /rlabs gnam 'phang mi chod bsam pa med/ /tshig kha bshad gog po de re tshim/ /pha g.yu 'brug lta bu'i bu rgyud nga*/ /lam 'byung ba tsha grang bgrod pa'i tshe/ /zer 'khyug mo'i 'od zer snang srid la/ /rtsal mnyan 'gyur gding mo'i gdams ngag 'dogs/ /sgra snyan pas mi khyab bsam pa med/ /chos grub mtha' can la de re tshim/ /pha seṅge lta bu'i bu rgyud nga*/ /bsil gangs dkar khrod du gshegs tsa na/ /log spyang ki bu yug sdang srid tshe/ /lus rtsal chen sder 'gyed gdams pa 'dogs/ /rgyan g.yu ral mi rgyas bsam pa med/ /lus ral bcings chas la de re tshim/ /pha bya rgyal rgod po'i phru gu nga*/ /grogs 'ja' lus gzan la bab pa'i tshe/ /dgra 'khor ba'i thag rnyis sdang srid na/ /'gran 'phur lding rdo yi gdams pa 'dogs/ /gnad gsang la rkyen 'jigs dgos pa med/ /lus tha mal tshogs pa de re tshim/ /pha rgya stag khra bo'i bu rgyud nga*/ /nags tsan dan ljongs la 'phyo ba'i tshe/ /rkyen thug phrad sa mdas sdang srid na/

/lam mchong rtsal 'dzin med gdams pa 'dogs/ /gzan mi sha mi rag bsam pa med/ /mi sgro skur can la de re tshim/ /pha bzang po lnga yi bu rgyud nga*/ /tshig don 'bras mi mthun bsam pa med/ kha grub mtha'i bla ma dkor sdud mkhan/ /don 'khrul med rtogs yod bsam pa med/ /de'i yan de re sems brda yi mgur/ /gling mgo nag skye bo'i chos skal gyis/ /mi kho bos da ni glu len na/ /lam go yul shes pa'i bshad pa rgyag na mo gu ru/ /pha 'gran gyis zla bral rgyal ba'i zhabs/ /yid gdung ba drag po'i gus pas 'dud/ /phyi tshogs drug shar ba'i yul kun nyon/ /bdag gnas lugs snying po'i ngang tshul gyis/ /lam bzhi po'i go yul 'di ltar shar/ /zhing tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sa gzhi la/ /lam don gnyis shes pa'i ngang las grol/ /zhing ngo sprod dag pa'i mthong yul la/ /lam buddha'i rang rtsal bgrod du 'gro/ /gzhi gshis lugs sgom pa'i rgya mtsho la/ /lam gcig shes kun grol ngang la 'gro/ /bu de tsam 'gro lugs mgur ma yin/ /pha mnyes shing dgongs pa dgyes par mdzod/ /bu 'gro na dga' ba'i glu gcig len/ na mo gu ru/ gzhi ka dag dgongs pa'i dbyings rol na/ /pha brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang chen bzhugs/ /don gsal 'grib med pa'i gnas lugs bde/ /lam zang thal ngang la 'gro ba dga'/ /rtsa klad pa dung khang gzhal yas su/ /byams thig le nyag gcig kun zla la/ /lus cha shas gzhon pa'i bzhin mdangs rgyas/ /lam bde stong ngang las 'gro ba dga'/ /rlung mgrin pa longs spyod dag pa'i dbyings/ /sgra sdeb sbyor ston pa'i bla ma bzhugs/ /gsung 'khor lo'i rtsa kha bye bas bde/ /dbyangs grags stong len cing 'gro ba dga'/ /gnas snying kha gsal ba'i 'od klong nas/ /sems dran rig lta ba'i dkyil 'khor bkrag /gnad gcig shes kun grol gnyug ma bde/ /lam bya rtsol bral zhing 'gro ba dga'/ /mdud lte ba chos 'byung mu kha ru/ /rtsa gtum mo gsal 'dzin sgron me 'degs/

/lus bde stong 'bar bas spyod lam bde/ /gar 'khrul 'khor ngang gis 'gro ba dga'/ /grogs bde chen ston pa gsang ba'i dbyings/ /rlung dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i shes rab yod/ /bcud dga' bzhi len pa'i zag med bde/ /lam pho nya brten cing 'gro ba dga'/ /yul sa phyogs dben pa'i rgyal khams na/ /dad ma nges 'tshogs pa'i sbyin bdag yod/ /rkyen legs nyes sbyong ba'i bogs 'don bde/ /lam brtul zhugs ngang gis 'gro ba dga'/ /de yan tsam 'gro sdod bde ba'i glu/ /drin che'o karma bha dra mchod/ /tshig snyan dbyangs 'gro ba'i dga' ston shog /'di'i yan chad rang tshugs ma zin skabs/ /bu da ni sgom chen gcig skya pher/ /yul phyogs med 'grims kyang 'gro sdod bde/ /deng phan chad zang zing sgyu ma'i ngang*/ /bag yon tan med par na so rgas/ /las don med 'ga' res mi tshe zad/ /bdag da ni rig pa lcags su bcug /rkyen bzang ngan thams cad dang du len/ /lam mi 'dod dgu la bsre sbyang bya/ /grogs mi 'dod dgu la 'dun ma byed/ /zas mi gtsang dgu yi ro la myong*/ /nad mi rung dgu la thog brdzi byed/ /gnas ngan pa dgu la sgrub pa rgyag /rkyen mi kha dgu po dang du len/ /lam ngan pa dgu der bsre nas 'gro/ /gdon pho gdon mo gdon lus la brgyan/ /dgra phung sbyor sna dgu'i steng der brdzi/ /bu 'gro lugs glang chen smyon pa'i 'gros/ /bu spyod pa rgya yan zung 'jug yin/ /bu gdams ngag gcod lugs gang shar yin/ /bu man ngag bzang ngan ro gcig yin/ /bu bskyed rdzogs 'khor 'das gnyis med yin/ /bu lta ba thag chod ral gri yin/ /bu sgom pa kun gzhi gtad med yin/ /bu spyod pa gang shar ris med yin/ /deng tshun chad 'gro lugs de 'dra byed/ /de rnam thar ma legs dgongs na yang*/ /rgyud ma dag bla mas bzo bcos med/ /mgo khrel med dpon la bzo bcos med/ /bu rang sgo zhan la bzo bcos med/

/sman skye lo gog la bzo bcos med/ /yul sa bzung ngan la bzo bcos med/ /ban chos med mkhregs por bzo bcos med/ /rkyen glo bur ba la bzo bcos med/ /bdag smyo spyod gshis lugs bzo bcos med/ /sems gdod ma'i gshis la bzo bcos med/ /de bzo bcos med pa'i dpe dgu'i mgur/ /'phral byung yang mi brtan dgu yi mgur/ /de yin min rang bsam blo la dris/ /mi gti thug rnams la zer ba yin/ /tshig brda don go la zhu dgos med/ /de tshun chad lam glu ring mo'o/ /de nas phyin pas rdzong gsar bya bar bsdad/ /phyir nangs song bas ri mdo zhes par sleb/ /bu mo ma bu zhig la gnas tshang bcas/ /ti sgro'i gnas dang sa lam thams cad dris/ /de yi zhogs nas bya ra bye bzhin phyin/ /ti sgro'i zam pa'i thog nas bgrod pa dang*/ /chu zom khur ba'i mi 'ga' 'gro bar mthong*/ /zam gyi phar khar bgrod dang dus mnyam par/ /ti sgro'i brag la 'ja' sprin 'thib pa dang*/ /me tog char sogs bkra shis rtags 'ga' byung*/ /de nas gsol btab bden tshig brjod bzhin phyin/ /ru ba zhig ni 'dug pa'i khyim du song*/ /rnal 'byor chen po gang nas byon ces zer/ /nga ni 'bri gung rtse nas 'ong yin smras/ /gcig pur byon pa 'di 'dra ya mtshan pas/ /mngon shes brtag pa mdzad rogs gyis shig zer/ /bsnyen bkur zhus nas mar yang sprad pa la/ /rten 'brel legs snang 'char nas song ba'i tshe/ /lam phran ma 'byed the tshom zhugs nas ni/ /bsam gzhig btang nas cung zad sdod pa'i tshe/ /ting shags snyan po'i skad gcig tser gyis thos/ /de yi skad la nyan nas phyin pa dang*/ /chu mig ne'u sing rgyun 'bab zhig gi 'gram/ /btsun pa rnal 'byor chas gos byas pa yis/ /gtor ma brgya rtsa 'dra zhig btang nas 'dug /grub thob rnal 'byor gang nas pheb ces zer/ /nga ni rgya gar yul nas 'ong yin pas/ khyed kyi ti sgro'i lam de ston dang smras/

/cung zad bzhugs dang gtor ma 'di thon nas/ /bdag gis lam ston zhabs phyi zhu zhes zer/ /gtor ma thon nas 'di ru pheb dgos zer/ /'ding rgyas sgrub sde 'dug pa de ru song*/ /gsol chang la sogs 'tsho ba zab par byung*/ /de nas rim gyis ti sgro la la song*/ /gnas kyis zhal gzigs la sogs gtan la phab/ /de tshe las kyi mkha' 'gros bsu ba byung*/ /de nas tshogs khang sgo ru song ba dang*/ /dri bzang 'thib dang gling bu'i sgra skad thos/ /ngo mtshar rtags ni phun sum tshogs pa byung*/ /de nas tshogs khang nang du song ba dang*/ /dag snang buddha zhi khro'i lha ltar mjal/ /de nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ /spyan 'dren mchod bstod la sogs bgyis pa'i tshe/ /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /dge bsnyen sde bzhis dngos su gzugs kyang bstan/ /sngon gyi smon lam tha tshig brjod pa dang*/ /sgo yi log nas g.yang la 'byar ba'i tshe/ /las kyi mkha' 'gros dngos su khrid nas su/ /brda rtags gnyis kyi shog ser a ma dang*/ /sku tshab gsang ba yai shes la sogs pa/ /gter rgya phyes te bdag la gnang ba dang*/ /'ja' 'od 'thib nas lus kyang zang thal ltar/ /ye shes lnga ldan lta bu'i nyams kyang 'bar/ /nam mkhar lding yang chog par 'dug go bsam/ /za zi rmi lam skabs kyi nyams ltar 'dug /de tshe gnas la dad pa thob pa dang*/ /rten 'brel dga' ston mgur 'di bzhengs pa'o/ na mo gu ru/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /dpal kun bzang thugs kyi rol pa las/ /pha mtshungs med 'gro mgon padma 'byung*/ /dbyings nam mkha'i gos can mtsho rgyal la/ /bdag rtse gcig gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas ma la ya zhes nye ba'i yul/ /bod dbus ru gzho stod ti sgro 'di/ /brag dkar po gnam la bsnyegs pa 'dra/ /steng sprin dkar lho bun ldem ma ldem/ /bar me tog char 'bab sil ma sil/ /log 'ja' tshon sna lnga gya ma gyu/

/mtha' gtsang chab rgyun 'bab na ra ra/ /shing ljon pa'i me tog skyed tshal bkra/ /rong chu dang rlung 'thab brda skad sgrogs/ /phu gangs gsum bgrod lam zhing khams 'dra/ /mda' rong gsum rngam lhun dur khrod 'dra/ /bar gcan gzan rgyug lam byang lung 'dra/ /thang skyed tshal bltas na rgya gar 'dra/ /shing nags khrod bltas na bal po 'dra/ /rdza g.ya' mar bltas na srin yul 'dra/ /char na bun bltas na sbas yul 'dra/ /ma mkha' 'gror bltas na mkha' spyod 'dra/ /gnas ya mtshan bltas na dpal ri 'dra/ /mtho yangs pa bde chen stong dang mnyam/ /rtags kun tshang zangs mdog dpal ri 'dra/ /gnas 'di yi mtshan thos tsam na yang*/ /yul rgya gar 'dug kyang mjal 'dod spro/ /pha gu ru padma rin po che/ /rtags lung bstan ngo mtshar rlabs po che/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i rgya rtags 'od po che/ /'di che ba rnam gsum smon lam drin/ /dbyings ḍākki'i smon lam ma yal ba'i/ /brda mkha' 'gro'i shog ser snying po lon/ /sku mthong grol gsang ba ye shes rnyed/ /rdzas myong grol skye bdun sman dang 'phrad/ /bka' gter srung pho nyas bsu ba byung*/ /lha buddha'i zhing khams dngos su mjal/ /bu bla ma mjal ba mang yod kyang*/ /gnad dus gcig rtogs pa'i gdams ngag 'di/ /bu gter bdag gling pa ma lags sam/ /bu gdams ngag yod pa mang yod kyang*/ /brda dngos kyi shog ser len pa 'di/ /bu gter bdag gling pa ma lags sam/ /bu zab chos ri mo mang yod kyang*/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya 'gyed pa 'di/ /bu gter bdag gling pa ma lags sam/ /bu kha bshad mkhas pa mang yod kyang*/ /gnad sangs rgyas lag bcang rnyed pa 'di/ /bu gter bdag gling pa ma lags sam/ /bu gnas bzang 'grim 'dod mang yod kyang*/ /gnas zhing khams dngos su bgrod pa 'di/ /bu gter bdag gling pa ma lags sam/ /yul sa mthar bskor ba mang yod kyang*/ /don yid bzhin nor bu rnyed pa 'di/ /bu gter bdag gling pa ma lags sam/

/bu gter bdag gling drug don dang bdun/ /pha rje la gus pas dmigs nas su/ /dbyangs tshangs pa'i mgur khug mchod pa 'bul/ /gter yid bzhin sbas pa'i gnas mchog khyed/ /dus rtag cing brtan cing byin chags pas/ /dpal dge legs bkra shis 'byung gyur cig /ces pa'i mgur ma 'di rnams btang ba'i rjes/ /gter rdzas thogs shing tshogs 'khor rol pa dang*/ /smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar byas nas su/ /dgong mo 'bong ngu gzim khang nang du song*/ /de tsam ga la byon pa yin no zer/ /gnas ri mjal nas kha rogs sdod yin smras/ /dag snang gsung 'phros rnams kyang mang po mdzad/ gu ru badzra sarba sidhi dza/ de nas gsol btab 'dun pa bgyis pa'i tshe/ /nub mo nyams dang rmi lam za zi la/ /dri bzang dag gis lung pa khengs pa dang*/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs sogs mang po thos pa'i tshe/ /ḍākki'i gzugs can bud med mdzes ldan ma/ /bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod ldan pa lnga/ /thor tshugs lcang lo sku rgyab kheb par 'phyang*/ /rigs lnga'i rgyan dang cod pan 'phur ba dang*/ /lha rdzas na bza' du mas spras nas su/ /phyag na gling bu spos sgrom dar yug thog /snyan dbyangs len bzhin bdag gi mdun du byung*/ /bu mar mar ma nyal yar yar longs/ /gu ru rje la gsol ba legs par thob/ /rten 'brel dus 'dzoms smon lam da lta yod/ /nged rnams u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul nas yin/ /bu khyed rnga yab dpal rir bsu ru 'ong*/ /rig 'dzin rgyal bas pho nya bsngags pa ste/ /mkha' 'gro stong gi gtso bo 'gro yang ran/ /da ni 'jig rten yul 'dir ma chags par/ /'du byed phung po sgyu mar shes par gyis/ /ming po 'gro'o zer nas lag pas bzung*/ /yar la bslangs nas 'di ru sdod ces zer/ /dar yug dkar po 'dom tshad gnyis 'gyur tsam/ /shin tu che ba mdun du btings nas su/ /bdag la lkog gtams legs par byas nas su/ /ming po 'di yi kha ru sdod cig zer/

/de tshe bdag gis bsam mno btang ba la/ /'di ni mkha' 'gro'i sun ma yin 'dug pas/ /bzlog pa'i dmigs pa drag po bya bsams nas/ /gu ru drag po sgom zhing drag sngags bzlas/ /sun ma zlog pa'i dmigs pa yang du byas/ /nga ni khyed rnams phyi la 'gro dgos med/ /gu ru padmar rgyang nas gsol ba 'debs/ /rnga yab gling zhes srin po'i yul yin pas/ /phar la thar yang tshur la btang mi yong*/ /'jig rten bod yul gling 'dir ma gtogs par/ /gzhan gyi gling du bdag ni mi 'gro smras/ /drag sngags bgrangs shing de gar sdod pa'i tshe/ /bu mo zhig gis dar yug sne mor 'jus/ /gcig gis nga ni 'degs shing pang pa dang*/ /'phags kyang ma thub dar yug steng du sleb/ /de ma thag tu nam mkhar btegs pa dang*/ /gling bu btang mkhan de yis sngon byas te/ /mkha' la thogs med bya ltar lding nas song*/ /de tshe bdag gis legs par bsam blo btang*/ /sngon gyi gter ston rim byon thams cad ni/ /srin yul bgrod mkhan rkyang rkyang yin 'dug pas/ /'di rnams mgo skor 'dra zhig ma yin na/ /bdag kyang phyir log rgyag rgyu rnyed 'ong bsam/ /bu mo rnams kyis mgur dbyangs 'dra ba la/ kha shag mang po 'ga' re rgyag nas 'dug /tshig kyang thos tsam mi thos 'dra bar snang*/ khyed rnams bdag la ci skad zer ba yin/ /da ltar mthong ba'i sa 'di gang yin smras/ /da lta mthong ba'i sa 'di mon yul yin/ /brag ri yod pa 'di ni sha 'ug yin/ /nged kyi da lta'i mgur tshig ma go na/ /shes chung blo rgya med pa'i ming po red/ /sring mos bslu brid byed pa ga la srid/ /da rung gdam ngag gnad la ma khel rtags/ /jo jo the tshom chen po ngo tsha zer/ /de nas sa rnams so sor dris pa la/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rim bzhin 'di skad zer/ /'di ni sprin nag 'khrigs pa'i tshal chen 'di/ /bal yul yang le shod ces bya ba yin/ /pha gi ri bo lhun chags 'dug pa 'di/

/rgya gar rngam pa la zhes zer ba yin/ /bye thang gling du mchod rten yod pa 'di/ /go ma sa la ghandha bya ba yin/ /chu bo gser ldan dar du 'babs pa 'di/ /nāai rañdza na gaṅgā bya ba yin/ /pha gi g.yas phyogs za hor lung pa yin/ /g.yon phyogs dur khrod bsil tshal bya ba yin/ /da ni ri dmar ri nag spel ma 'di/ /rngam pa rgyang grags la zhes bya ba yin/ /mdun du bye thang zur gsum yod pa 'di/ /dha na dha ri ta zhes bya ba yin/ /pha gi ri rong dmar po rngam 'thug 'di/ /rgya gar srin yul gnyis kyi sa mtshams yin/ /da ni 'di nas sa la bob ces zer/ /la de bgrod pa'i rjes su brag ri ni/ /nub phyogs kha bstan rngam pa zur drug pa/ /logs su phug pa mang po yod par 'dug /'di yi ming la gang zer smras tsa na/ /raksha ru ni ko ṭa'i sgrub phug yin/ /'di ru srin po'i sa mtshams 'dzin pa yin/ /rig 'dzin ghauo shrī bya ba yod/ /g.yas phyogs ri dmar gong lam mang po 'di/ /srin po dza tu sha yi rgyu lam yin/ /mdun phyogs bsgrigs pa'i ri dmar bcu gsum 'di/ /had pa go la sha yi rgyab ri yin/ /g.yon phyogs shing ri dmar po'i tshal chen 'di/ /ya ma shanti sha yi dur khrod yin/ /rong gi chu bo dmar chen 'bab pa 'di/ /gu ra ha yi rakta'i chu rgyun yin/ /mi mgo'i rgyan dang g.yang gzhis spras pa'i mkhar/ /zam pa ldem chen drug tu 'dug pa 'di/ /srin zam ma dun sha zhes bya ba yin/ /'di ru srin po gha raksha zhes/ /sa mtshams srung ba'i 'khor g.yog mang po yod/ /'di dag srin po mi gzan ma yin te/ /snyan gnas srung sdoms byed pa 'ga' re yod/ /'di yi rong nas bsnyegs te phyin pa na/ /srin po ma he ra yi grong khyer yod/ /de dag sha dang khrag la dgyes pa yin/ /de yi phyogs su sa mtshams srung ba ni/ /rig 'dzin a tri ta zhes bya ba yod/ /chu 'di'i stod nas gyen du phyin pa na/ /srin yul ya ba sha yi grong khyer yod/

/de yi phyogs su sa mtshams srung ba ni/ /rig 'dzin ka ra bha hi bya ba yod/ /de rnams phyed tsam chos la dad pa yod/ /dus bzang rdo rje gdan yang mjal bar 'gro/ /de yi yan tsam chu yi 'gram zhig la/ /ta ra ha na bya ba'i grong khyer yod/ /de rnams zas kyang mi gtsang la sogs bza'/ /gzugs gcig mgo gnyis mgo gsum bya ba yod/ /de la sogs par sa mtshams srung ba ni/ /ma hā ri ra bya ba'i rig 'dzin bzhugs/ /'di ni srin po'i byang smad sgo yang yin/ /spyir ni srin yul phyi yi chags tshul ni/ /mi lpags g.yang gzhi phyal gyis brdal ba'i steng*/ /rakta'i rgya mtsho phyogs brgyad bskyod 'dra'i dal/ /seṅge bco brgyad kha 'thab brgyab 'dra'i brag /de yi dbus su zangs mdog dpal ri chags/ /bar rnams chu gling zangs thang srin shing skyes/ /phyogs ni bzhi yi tshul du gnas pa las/ /phyogs rer rig 'dzin grub thob bzhi tsam dang*/ khrims kyis mngags pa'i sde dpon sa srung bzhi/ /de rnams phyi yi gling sgo srung ba yin/ /zangs mdog dpal rir ma thug bar du ni/ /sa btsan sha za'i 'gyu lam dgu tsam yod/ khyad par brag ri seṅge kha 'tham gyi/ /mdun gyi thang la laṅka pu ri yod/ /mi ma yin gyi srin gling grangs med yod/ /de rnams skyong ba'i sde dpon dag la ni/ /mgo bo bdun dang mgo bo lnga pa dang*/ /mgo bo gsum sogs mi min 'dra ba yin/ /gshog pa can dang sder mo can zhes bya/ /mkha' ru rgyu zhing lding nas 'gro ba yod/ /de rnams sha za srin po bya ba yin/ /raksha gling dgu'i rgyal po mgo dgu pa/ /da yang rgyal rabs ma chad tsam zhig yod/ /srin yul rnga thug grong du ma sleb bar/ /da ni ri ltas la sogs 'dod na yang*/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i srin por 'dzem dgos pas/ /mig tsam lta yang mi nus mang po yod/ /gzugs kyis rgyang grags re rer khyab pa tsam/ /dug gi rlangs pa 'phyo ba'i srin po yod/

/de rnams mthong na tshe la bar chad yong*/ /de bas gnas 'dir yod pa'i rig 'dzin ni/ /raksha gling drug byang gi mi yin pas/ /'di yi gzugs por blta na rung ba yin/ /de bas nged kyi phyi la 'brongs shog zer/ /bu mo gcig gis bdag la bzung ba dang*/ /bzhi pos phyogs bzhir bskyor nas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /brag ri de yi mdun du sleb pa dang*/ /srin po'i bu mo g.yang gzhi dkris pa gcig /lus tshad shing rdum tsam zhig yod pa yi/ /lag tu chu bum snod gcig thogs nas byung*/ /bu mo rnams kyis de la tshig dris nas/ /da lta rig 'dzin mjal na 'ong ngam zer/ /rig 'dzin mjal chog khyed rnams su yin zer/ /nged rnams pho brang nang nas bod du phyin/ /ming po 'di nyid gdan 'dren btang ba ste/ /nged rnams khra tsha shar gyi grong nas yin/ /nga ni dzu na dza zhes bya ba yin/ /g.yas kyi khol mo lam lta bhi ra yin/ /g.yon gyi khol mo dha ra ha ri yin/ /rgyab kyi khol mo ni ra sha li yin/ /mdun gyis khol mo dhwa dza ka ri yin/ /lcam mo khyed kyi ming la ji skad zer/ /lcam mo de yi zhal nas lan btab par/ /nged la bhi sha gha ti zer ba yin/ /lcam mo khyed kyi skye sa gang du yin/ /lo dang 'di ru sdod yun gang tsam yin/ /nged kyi lo ni brgya dang so bdun 'gro/ /rig 'dzin drung du brgya dang nyer gcig yin/ /skye sa ha ti sha ri'i grong nas yin/ khyed rnams bod yul song ba yin lags na/ /gdong dmar bod la bde sdug ci 'dra 'dug /mtha' bzhi dbus la 'ong ran zer 'dug gam/ /drang srong lo tsā gang zhes bya bar 'dug /dus bskal da lta gang la sleb zer 'dug /bdud kyi kha gnon gang zhes bya ba 'dug /gdong dmar rgyal po ci zhes bya bar 'dug /lam 'phrang srung ba'i drang srong 'dug gam ci/ /ming po 'di la ji skad bya ba yin/ /'di yi lo ni gang tsam 'gro ba yin/ /'u mu 'u yis brda de legs par shod/

khol mo lnga yis de la lan btab par/ /deng sang bod la bstan pa dar so 'dug /mtha' bzhi dbus su bsnyag pa mi ran zer/ /drang srong lo tsā rjes 'brangs nyer lnga 'dug /dus skabs tshe lo brgya pa'i dus yin zer/ /bdud kyi kha gnon gnam lcags rdo rje 'dug /da lta'i rgyal po 'jam dpal sprul pa 'dug /lam 'phrang srung ba'i grub thob mang po ni/ /rdzu 'phrul gar gyi dbang phyug thams cad 'dug /srin po bya ba ming ni ma thos zer/ /ri rlung spu gri'i 'khor los rgyas bsdams nas/ /sngar gyi rig 'dzin ma hā gu ru de/ /da lta mchims phu'i gnas su bzhugs yod skad/ /ming po 'di ni rtsa gsum gling pa yin/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gsum lon pa ste/ /da yang lnga brgya bod la bzhugs dgos yod/ /de skad lan btab de yi phyi la phyin/ /brag phug sgo nas legs par bltas pa'i tshe/ /rig 'dzin ghau shrī bya ba de/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i bam ro chen po ni/ /dbugs song drod ma bral ba'i gdan steng du/ /sku mdog nag po zhi ma khro yi tshul/ /zhal gsum phyag drug sgaig cing sbom pa ni/ /che chung rgyang grags khyab pa'i sku lus la/ /dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan nas kyang*/ /phyag na gri khug dang ni klad khrag dang*/ /mi mgo skam rlon rnying pa thogs nas 'dug /nang gi brag phug de yi logs rnams su/ /'jig rten mchod bstod lha rnams rang byon la/ /gshe dang gar sgeg rngam gtum dpa' bar 'dug /nang gi chas dang longs spyod thams cad ni/ /mi yi sha khrag gcal du bkram nas su/ /nang rnams g.yang gzhi'i 'phan dar bla bre brkyangs/ khyad par drag po'i chas su yin 'dra 'dug /rig 'dzin de yi sku la bltas pa'i tshe/ /me tshag thor thor tsha tshwa kem kem 'dug /drag pos rig 'dzin gang nas byon zhes gsungs/ /bdag ni bod yul dbus nas 'ong yin lags/ /rig 'dzin khyed kyi grub mtha' gang yin lags/ /bdag la dngos grub gdams ngag zab par stsol/

/gnas lugs gdod ma'i ngang tshul maṇḍal 'bul/ /rig 'dzin de yi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /bdag ni rgya gar yul du sdod pa'i tshe/ /rig 'dzin rombu gu hya bya ba yin/ /da lta rig 'dzin dregs pa tshar gcod kyis/ /drag sngags ting nge 'dzin la yod pa yin/ khyed la dngos grub gdams pa ci ltar dgos/ khyed la med pa'i gdams ngag nga la med/ /'on kyang rten 'brel ched du sna gcig 'bul/ /de skad gsungs pas bdag gis lan btab ste/ /bdag la drag po mthu yi dngos grub stsol/ khyad par dregs pa'i srog thig gnang bar zhu/ /de ma thag tu slob dpon de nyid kyis/ /sdigs mdzub mkha' la lan gsum gtad pa'i tshe/ /mdun gyi mkha' la ser sprin glog dmar g.yos/ /'brug sgra thog bcas tsha tshwa khol ba'i nang*/ /sde dpon sum cu dregs pa bco brgyad rnams/ /shin tu mi bzad gtum drag zhal bstan nas/ /phyag tu las kyi shog dril re re thogs/ /bdag dang nye bar tshur tshur byung ba'i tshe/ /sngar gyi srin mo chu len de nyid ky-is/ /bhandha lcang lo ldan pa'i klad khrag gtad/ /'di yis dregs pa sde brgyad mchod ces zer/ /bdag gis mdun du lan gsum gtor ba'i tshe/ /dregs pa thams cad dgyes shing tshim par gyur/ /slob dpon ghau shrīs bka' stsal pa/ /rig 'dzin khyed rang cung zad mig tshums zer/ /bdag gis mig kyang ma bltas bsdad pa dang*/ /'ur chom dang bcas rlung dmar chen po zhig /bdag gi lus la dngangs shing btab par gyur/ /bltas pas dregs pa thams cad bdag la thim/ /shog dril rnams ni pang du slebs nas 'dug /ghau shrīs de dag klogs shig gsungs/ /bdag gis shog dril de rnams klog pa'i tshe/ /ya ma snying gzer gtad rgyud nag po dang*/ /dregs pa'i bsha' gri gdan cha gong 'og bzhi/ /nā ra chu 'thung dug mtha' 'khor lo drug /gzhan yang man ngag las tshogs 'ga' re 'dug /bdag gis shog dril klog zhing smon lam btab/

/phrag par dam du bcug nas 'dzin par byas/ /ghau shrī'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /da ni drag po mthu yi dngos grub thob/ /las kyi dregs pa dbang du 'dus pa yin/ /shog dril de nyid ma bu byas pa yi/ /gdams pa thams cad gcig tu dril ba ni/ /da lta rin chen sgrom gyi nang du yod/ /'di nas lo ngo mang po ma 'das tshe/ /gsang mdzod zab mo'i klong nas rnyed pa yod/ /de dang shog dril 'di rnams rgyud gcig yin/ /'di ni rten 'brel ched du 'bul ba yin/ /da ni 'dud rtsi 'di la rol cig gsungs/ /bhandha lcang lo'i klad khrag gtad nas byung*/ /bdag gis rol cing zla grogs rnams la byin/ /grogs mo rnams kyang sku thang chad yod mod/ /thag ring 'di ru me tshugs tshabs gyis smras/ /bdag gis kha nas bton te ma smras kyang*/ /thag ring yin bsam skom ltog tshul du snang*/ /grogs mo lnga yis bdag la lan btab nas/ /nged rnams gling bzhi thams cad bskor nas 'ong*/ /me 'bud tsha tshugs zer ba go ma shes/ /ming po tshu tshod gcig la gnyug bud na/ /da rung dpag tshad bcu gsum bgrod dgos yod/ /klad khrag de ni lhag med bzhes par gyis/ /bhandha de yang 'cha' na e 'thad zer/ /bdag ni ngo tsha kha yang skyengs ba dang*/ /bhandha de nyid zor ltar 'phang ba'i tshe/ /ha ha ming po bzod bsran chung ba zer/ /de nas rig 'dzin de yi phyag nas bzung*/ /smon lam btab nas sgo drung log ste 'ong*/ /sngar gyi srin mo chu len bu mo des/ /sa la babs pa'i mtshams de'i bar du bskyal/ /de nas sngar ltar dar yug steng du bzhag /shin tu mtho bar gnam 'phang bkyags nas song*/ /de tshe gtso mo de yis 'di skad zer/ /da ni gu ru'i drung du bcar ba'i tshe/ /rten 'brel legs sam gsungs na legs zhes gyis/ /dus bskal rgyal po la sogs gsungs pa'i tshe/ /snga ma nged kyis bshad pa de bzhin smros/ /ma hā gu ru phyogs bcur bzhugs pa la/

/dgongs pas mi mkhyen dogs pa ma lags kyang*/ /rten 'brel ched du bzang por zhu dgos yod/ /sngar ma nged kyis skad cha bshad pa yi/ /rig 'dzin drung gi srin mo chu len ni/ /nyin re bzhin du bod yul gnas lnga la/ khrus mtsho sku khrus rgya gar byon kyin yod/ /rten 'brel ched du skad cha ma gtogs par/ /de ni 'byung lngar rang dbang thob pa yin/ /nged rnams snga ma tshig 'phro byed ma myong*/ /de skad gsungs par bdag gis lan smras pa/ /'o na mkha' 'gro khyed rnams lho nub 'o ma'i mtshor/ /sku khrus rgyag tu byon lugs med lags sam/ /'di yi yul la drag po'i mtsho med dam/ /de skad bdag gis dri ba bgyis pa'i tshe/ /gtso mo mkha' 'gro de yi zhal nas kyang*/ /sngon tshe 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho de/ /da lta yul gling zhig tu gyur pa dang*/ /de'i nang 'khor ba'i chu gnas thams cad kun/ /da lta grub thob pho mor gyur nas yod/ /de ru gtsug lag chen po lnga tsam yod/ /sngar gyi mtsho yi shul yin zer ba yi/ /chu mig 'dom gang bskor ba'i tshad tsam yod/ /da lta'i ming yang u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling*/ /gtsug lag mkha' spyod ma zhes bya ba yin/ /ma 'ongs byams pa'i bstan pa shar ba'i tshe/ /gtsug lag klu yi yul du gdan 'dren zer/ /gtsug lag de yi nang rten gtso bo ni/ /padma sam bha phyag rdor ma hā ya/ /klu sgrub arya de wa yod pa yin/ /gzhan yang mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i chos skor yod/ /tshes bcur nged rnams de ru sleb pa yin/ /de bas rgya gar yul du ming che ba'i/ khrus mtsho 'ga' re yod kyang byin rlabs yal/ /mu stegs rnams kyis mi gtsang btab nas yod/ /srin yul nub phyogs khrus mtsho gcig tsam yod/ /de bas bod khams yul gling ma gtogs par/ khyad du 'phags pa'i khrus mtsho de 'dra med/ /da ni zangs mdog dpal ri mjal yod pas/ /gu ru rje la gsol ba thob cig zer/ /dar yug steng nas langs te mjal ba'i tshe/

/rnga yab dpal ri rim gsum gzhal yas la/ /'ja' 'od sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs pa'i gseb/ /lha yi khye'u 'dra ba mang po yis/ /sna tshogs rol mo dpag yas 'bud mkhan ni/ khye'u lo brgyad 'dra ba'i gzugs dag la/ kha ṭwāṃ nyi zer thogs pa grangs med rnams/ khor yug gang du bltas kyang khyab par mjal/ /de tshe bdag gis gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ na mo/ /rnga yab dag pa mkha' spyod dpal gyi ri/ /mngon dga' zhing mchog ngo mtshar bla na med/ /'gro ba'i mgon mchog mtshungs med padma 'byung*/ /gsol ba 'debs so u rgyan sprul pa'i sku/ /byin gyis rlobs shig gu ru thugs rje can/ /bdag gi mi mthun phyi nang bar chad sol/ /mchog thun dngos grub deng 'dir thob gyur nas/ /chos kyi dga' ba ston pa'i dpal du shog /de skad bdag gis bsol ba btab pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis sa la 'bab bo zer/ /de nas rim bzhin sa la bsnyag pa'i tshe/ /zangs brag dmar po rtse gsum yod pa'i mdun/ khra tsha grong gi thad kar sleb pa dang*/ /da ni thang la 'bab ste 'gro'o zer/ /cung zad ngal bso'i tshul du bsdad pa'i tshe/ /slob dpon mjal ba'i phyag rten e yod zer/ /de 'dra khur yang ma shes med byas pas/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo de yi phrag mdun nas/ /gser gyi maṇḍal sgol mtho'i tshad tsam la/ /sna tshogs rin chen zur brgyad nor bu yi/ /tshom bu bsgrig tu chog par 'dug pa de/ /ming po'i phyag rten maṇḍal gyis shig zer/ /bu mo bzhi po de yi am phrag nas/ kha thag bzhi ldan dar yug re re bton/ /'di yang ming po'i phyag rten gyis shig zer/ /de tshe kho bo bdag gis bsam pa la/ /ya mtshan mngon sum 'di ru sleb gyur kyang*/ /gser sogs nor phangs che ba med na yang*/ /dngul dang dar zhig khur nas ma yong ba/ /da lan bsam chung blo de ma thig bsam/ khyad par bu mo 'di rnams ma yin na/ /lag stong slob dpon mjal ba ma gtogs par/

/gsol 'debs tsam ni bya ba los chog kyang*/ /bdag la gang yang med pas thabs re sdug /bu mo drin can bzang mo 'di rnams kyis/ /bla mar phyag rten bzang po 'di 'dra bsnams/ /lan gcig bdag la phyag rten byung ba'i tshe/ /drin lan bzang po gcig ni 'jal lo bsam/ /de nas mdun du srin shing mang po ni/ /shin tu dmar ba'i tshal chen 'dug pa'i dbus/ /gcong rong zab mo rngam zhing rtsub pa ru/ /chu bo dmar chen 'dra ba rba rlabs 'phyur/ /de la zam chen ldem pa dgu yod pa'i/ /phan tshun dbus dang gsum du mkhar re 'dug /de yang bhandha skam po'i mkhar chen la/ /steng du phyogs bzhir mi lpags rgyal mtshan rer/ /mi mgo rlon pa'i lcang lo bskyod pa 'dug /skar bug mi lus shong tsam bzhi bzhir 'dug /de yi nang nas srin po'i bya ra mkhan/ /bshugs sgra la sogs 'ur 'ur 'don par 'dug /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis da ni 'byon ran zer/ /gtso mo de yis bdag gi lag par 'jus/ /bzhi ni g.yas g.yon phyogs bzhir byas nas su/ /rim bzhin nags tshal de nas 'grim pa'i tshe/ /srin shing tsher ma rgya khab gshibs ltar 'dug /de yi gseb nas gcan gzan dug sbrul sogs/ /sha za dug gi mche can mang du 'dug /bu mo rnams ni sa la ma reg 'gro/ /bdag ni rkang par na tsha che bar byung*/ /zam rdzong de yi 'gram nas 'grim pa'i tshe/ /stag gzig rnams ni bsnol thabs bskor nas 'dug /de rnams ngar sgra 'byin cing spu zing byed/ /sgo srung gri thogs srin po mang du 'dug /rkan sgra thag thag 'jigs tshul byed par snang*/ /zam pa brgal te phar khar phyin zin kyang*/ /sngar ltar srin shing tsher ma can du 'dug /mkha' 'gro rnams la bdag gis smras nas su/ /sngar ltar dar yug steng la bzhag rogs mdzod/ /rkang pa tsha drag bgrod par mi nus smras/ /mkha' 'gro gtso mo de yi zhal na re/ /zam pa 'di yi phar khar brgal zin na/ /dar yug stegs nas nam mkhar 'phur mi chog

/sgo srung srin po rnams kyis khrims 'cha' 'ong*/ /de bas bdag gi sgal par khur ro zer/ khol mo de yis sgal par khur ba'i tshe/ /ming po da dung shes sgrib ma sbyang na/ /bag chags sgyu lus lci bo 'dug go zer/ /mjing par dam du 'chang nas bzung ba'i tshe/ /u li ma dgag g.ya' zi lang 'ong zer/ /mgo bo skyog skyog gad mo bgad nas song*/ /de tshe bdag gis o tri 'phur ba las/ /de 'dra ma byed sa khar btang 'jog zer/ /de nas shing tshal de dag yol nas song*/ /da ni sa khar bobs dang byon no zer/ /de tshe bdag kyang sa khar babs pa dang*/ /g.ya' spang 'dra ba'i bye thang chung ngu 'dug /de las brgal ba'i sa mtshams dag la ni/ /dmar nag rakta'i rgya mtsho lta bu la/ /rba rlabs khrug khrug khol ba mda' rgyang tsam/ /dpal ri'i mtha' nas khor yug bskor te 'dug /mgo gnyis mgo gsum yod pa mang po ni/ /mtsho la rgyu nas snyan sgra sgrog pa dang*/ /la la rngam tshul mche ba krig krig 'dug /de yi dbus su dpal ri bya ba ni/ /brag ri rngam chen dpag tshad gnyis 'gyur tsam/ /rtsibs stong mtho ba zangs thang lta bu'i steng*/ /dbyibs ni tsitta gnam du bslangs pa 'dra/ /dbu rtse mig gis bsnyobs la thug pa dang*/ /phyogs bzhir zur phur bslangs 'dra'i brag ri bzhi/ /rngam la rgya che mdung rtse gzengs pa bzhin/ /zangs dung lta bu'i mig dkyus 'dra bar 'dug /brag dmar zangs gling 'dra ba'i thog de ru/ /srin yul raksha gling dgu bya ba ni/ /grong khyer re rer 'bum phrag yod pa la/ /shin tu 'jigs pa'i mkhar bcas tshang bar 'dug /grong khyer mtshams su bla mtsho yin zer ba'i/ /rakta 'khyil 'dra'i mtsho gling chen po dang*/ /de yi nang nas bla shing yin zer ba'i/ /srin shing ko ri ha ti bya ba yi/ /rtsa ba gcig la rtse mo gsum yod pa'i/ /lo ma spu gri'i dbyibs dang ral gri'i dbyibs/ /tsher ma rgya khab gshibs pa ltar yod par/

/thams cad dmar ser dmar po rgya mtshal ltar/ /sdong po rtsub la rakta 'bab pa yi/ /rtse mor srin bya kaṅka yin zer ba'i/ /bya dmar mgo bo gsum pa zhig la ni/ /ze ba me ri'i dbyibs su 'bar ba dang*/ /mchu ni ring la lcags kyu lta bur 'gugs/ kha ni mdun rgyab steng dang gsum du blta/ /sgro gshog thung la rtse mo gug pa dang*/ /mjug ma dug sbrul lta bur yod pa yi/ /lto ba lhung la phag gi rnam pa can/ /sder mo zangs kyi sog le ltar yod pa/ /shing la gnas dang mtsho la rgyu bar 'dug /mtsho yi kha ru mi mgo'i gsas mkhar ni/ /ka las mtho ba g.yang gzhis brgyan pa 'dug /de nas mtsho yi kha ru sleb pa dang*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gling bu btang song bas/ /grong khyer zhig nas srin po bcu gsum byung*/ /mtsho khar bgrod pa'i gru gzings dag la ni/ /gru bzhi ser po shan pa rta mgo'i dbyibs/ /g.yang bzhi'i sham bu mi mgo phyogs bzhir spras/ /logs su rgyu ma'i lda ldi 'phyang bar 'dug /de dag btang nas tshu ri'i phyogs su byung*/ /ko ṭi sha ni ra li dza hi zer/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis de la lan btab par/ /bha shwa dha dha gha hi dza ti zer/ /de nas gru yi nang du zhugs pa dang*/ /mtsho ni lhog lhog mkha' la 'phyur nas byung*/ /rba lcag phran bu lus la reg pa'i tshe/ /sha la chu sgong thor thor shar nas byung*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis ma tam̐ ka tsam zer/ /de yi phar kha dag la bgrod pa dang*/ /srin po rnams ni sngon nas langs te song*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bdag la bltas nas su/ /mtsho bdag kha rlangs 'thor ba yin no zer/ /'di la phan pa'i gdams ngag yod dam smras/ /'di la padma rakta byug dgos zer/ /'o na bdag la gnang rogs zhu smras pas/ /sbyin na nged rnams ngo tsha mchis 'ong zer/ /mkha' dbyings bdud rtsir ngo tsha mi 'ong smras/ /'o na khyed kyi phyag g.yon zod dang zer/ /lag pa bzed pas gtso mo'i mkha' lam nas/

/mu la thig le lnga tsam byung ba de/ /chu sgong gang 'dug thog tu byugs pa'i tshe/ /chu sgong yal rjes me tog ri mo dang*/ /ze 'brur mkha' 'gro'i gzugs can shar nas 'dug /mi la ma bstan nged rnams ngo tsha zer/ /de nas zangs gling de na 'byor ba'i tshe/ /skas la them pa drug cu tham pa tsam/ /skas mgor thod pa'i tog dang ldan par 'dug /skas gcig skas mgo de ru sleb pa'i tshe/ /dpal ri shar gling de yi phyogs nas ni/ /'ja' dkar dar yug brkyangs 'dra shar nas byung*/ /de yi steng nas khye'u pho mo ni/ /bcu drug lo lon 'dra ba mang po zhig /sna tshogs mchod pa rol mo thogs nas su/ /la la 'phur dang la la gar stabs tshul/ /la la brkyang bskum la la gya gyu'i tshul/ /rigs lnga dar dpyang ldan pa mang po byung*/ /la las bdag la dgyes tshul gos log 'dzin/ /la las zla grogs rnams la 'chang bar byed/ /bhandhar bdud rtsi yin 'dra dkar po zhig /nged rnams mi rer re re gtad nas byung*/ /bdag gis phyed tsam 'thung nas gtad pa'i tshe/ khye'u pho mo rnams kyis 'thung ba dang*/ /lus la byugs shing gar thabs byed par 'dug /srin gling phyogs nas srin po mang po zhig /sgo ru don nas ltad mo blta bar byed/ /sngar gyi bud med de rnams rgyan chas dang*/ /gos log la sogs rnam pa 'gyur nas ni/ /gcer mo rus rgyan gri thod 'dzin pa lnga/ /sku mdog dkar ser dmar ljang mthing ga 'dug /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bdag la smras nas su/ /da ni nged rnams thams cad sngon la 'gro/ /ming po khye'u rnams dang lhan cig byon/ /de skad zer nas nang du byon nas song*/ khye'u rnams kyis bdag la smras nas su/ /bod kyi rig 'dzin 'di ru byon pa 'di/ /'di ru bzhugs par byed pa e yin zer/ /bdag gis de la lan du smras nas su/ /'di ru 'dug par byed pa rang yang min/ /ma hā gu ru mjal du 'ong ba yin/ /'di ru bsdad na skyid po yod dam smras/

/'di ru skyid po dpag med yod pa yin/ /byang gling ri nas ltad mo mang po mthong*/ khye'u tshogs rnams skad cha byas nas su/ /sngon yang lan 'gar 'di sor byon byung yang*/ /bod yul phyogs su ring chad byed 'dug pas/ /da lta 'di ru bzhugs na mi 'ong zer/ /de nas shin tu dog pa'i brag rong du/ /lcags ri rngam la 'thug pa'i mdun du slebs/ /de ru shar sgo bsrung ba'i mkhar dag la/ /thog so bcu re tsam pa yod 'dra 'dug /sgo srung rnams kyis mkhar sgo phyes nas byung*/ /mkhar gyi sgo yang sum brtsegs rim pa dang*/ /bar khyams grong gling mang po yod par bslebs/ /de nas rim bzhin brgal nas phyin pa'i tshe/ /lcags ri sngon po thod pa'i kha bad can/ /de yi sgo khang thog so gsum tsam la/ /sgo srung nyi shu tsam zhig yod par 'dug /de yang brgal nas nang du phyin pa dang*/ /g.yu yi rdo rgyas bsgrigs pa'i steng du bslebs/ /de yang rgya khyon mda' rgyang tsam du 'dug /de yi dbus su shel gyi pha bong ni/ /gru bzhi 'dom pa bcu drug tshad tsam la/ /de yi steng du zhabs rjes gnyis tsam snang*/ /srin po'i rgyal pos zhabs rjes bzhag yin zer/ /de nas mkha' 'gro gsum gyis mdun byas te/ /pho brang 'og ma'i sgo yi 'gram du phyin/ /sgo srung srin po'i sde tshogs mang po zhig /lag tu mtshon cha zing zing thogs pa 'dug /de yi nang du shar gyis phyin pa'i tshe/ /sngar gyi bu mo lnga yang sleb nas byung*/ /de rnams sngon byas yar la phyin pa'i tshe/ khye'u mang ma rnams ni mi 'dug cing*/ /bar du gser gyi pa ṭa chen po yi/ /sgo mo shin tu mdzes pa'i nang du slebs/ /bu mo rnams kyis bdag la smras nas su/ /deng 'dir gu ru zhi drag gang mjal gsungs/ /bdag gis deng 'dir drag po mjal lo smras/ /de ma thag tu skas 'dzeg gsum brgyud mtshams/ /pho brang mthing nag rngam zhing 'jigs pa'i nang*/

/dur khrod chas kyis rab tu mdzes pa'i dbus/ /bhandha skam rlon brtsegs pa'i khri 'phangs su/ /g.yang gzhi rnam gsum spel ma'i gdan steng du/ /gu ru padma srin rgyal cha byad can/ /sku mdog smug nag zhi ma khro dag la/ /dbu skra dmar ser thog cog bsdams shing 'phyang*/ /seṅge glang chen pags pa stod la g.yog /zhing lpags sked dkris stag lpags sham thabs bcings/ khrag gi thig le zhag gi zo ris ldan/ /sma ra rgyas shing ag tshom brang du slebs/ /gsus pa rgyas dang sku che yan lag rag /phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams/ /me ri 'bar ba'i kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten/ /zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs tshul du bzhugs/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis su khri gdan chung ngu'i khar/ /manda ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis/ /sku mdog dmar nag sgeg pa'i cha byad can/ /dur khrod chas ldan skra dmar rgyab tu gzhol/ /dbu la zangs zhu a ṭa dmar po gsol/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas pa bslangs dang g.yon pa phab/ /phyag na gri gug dang ni klad khrag thogs/ /nang 'khor bu mo mang po 'dug pa rnams/ /thams cad sha za dur khrod chas su bcug /mdun du bhandha yangs pa'i snod nang du/ /dbang po rnam lnga skam rlon spungs nas 'dug /spos kyang sha chen dud pa bun bun gtong*/ /rol mo rkang gling thod rnga mang du 'dug /bdag dang mkha' 'gro lnga ni mdun du bcar/ /sngar nas yod pa'i phyag rten maṇḍal phul/ /gsol ba btab ste byin rlabs zhus pa dang*/ /bdag la thugs kyis dgyes tshul dpag med bcas/ /bu khyod ring ba'i lam nas 'ong ba las/ /dka' las thang yang chad pa ma byung ngam/ /bod la bskal pa rten 'brel ci tsam gnas/ /chos kyi dar so bab tshul gang zhig yod/ /de la bdag gis zhu lan phul ba ni/ /sangs rgyas dbang po bka' drin bla med kyi/ /ngal dub dka' bas sgrib pa ma byung zhing*/ /bod la rten 'brel bskal pa bzang po yod/ /rdo rje theg chen bstan pa dar tshul gnas/

/mdo sngags sgron me ji bzhin gsal tshul lags/ /zhes pa'i don sogs phran bu 'ga' re zhus/ /de nas bdag gis gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ na mo/ skyabs kyi dam pa 'gro ba'i mgon gcig pu/ /thar 'dod yongs kyi ded dpon gtsug gi rgyan/ /rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i mtshungs med rje/ /gu ru padma kā rar gsol ba 'debs/ /byin gyis rlobs shig u rgyan thugs rje can/ /bar chad sol cig rgyal sras sprul pa'i sku/ /skal ldan bdag la zab yangs rgyud sde yi/ /dbang bskur smin grol zab mo'i gdams ngag dang*/ /gtsug lag mi dgos brda sprod thugs chud pa'i/ /mkhyen gnyis shes bya mi brjed gzungs dang ni/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi gter chen rlabs bstsal nas/ /'gro la rgya chen chos 'khor rab bskor shing*/ /skye ba 'di 'phos rnga yab dpal ri 'dir/ /pha gcig mtshungs med pad 'byung rje nyid kyi/ /rig 'dzin sras su 'khrungs pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /tshe rabs 'bral med rjes 'dzin smon lam shog /de skad gdung bas gsol ba btab pa dang*/ /gu ru rgyal po'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /skal ldan bu khyod legs par yid kyis nyon/ kho bos dbang bzhi ngo sprod gdams pa dang*/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bka' gtad lung 'bog kyis/ /rten 'brel tshogs 'khor grabs du shoms shig gsungs/ /de nas bdag gi grogs mo mkha' 'gro la/ /tshogs 'khor btang ba'i tshogs rdzas gang drag zhus/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis tshogs rdzas las sla zer/ /de ma thag tu sgo ru long nas song*/ /cung zad lon mtshams bam khog chen po lnga/ /g.yang gzhi bam shun thog tu bzhag nas song*/ /de tshe las kyi ma mo 'dra ba yis/ /mi rkang gling bu lan gsum bus pa dang*/ /gnas yul kun gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams/ kha char bu yug ji bzhin gtibs nas byung*/ /de yi nang nas mkha' 'gro phra men gzugs/ /mi bzad gar bsgyur ston pa bcu gnyis kyis/ /lag na gri khug bhandha thogs nas su/

/bam ro rnams la bskor ba byed pa ni/ /gar stabs tshul gyis brda 'gros sna tshogs bsgyur/ /de tshe bam ro oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs kyis/ /byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes tshogs su bsgyur/ /tshogs las skabs su mkha' 'gro de rnams kyis/ /gri khug 'bar bas bam ro'i mgo lus phral/ /klad khrag gcig dang dbang po lnga bcas pa/ /ma hā gu ru'i phyag tu phul nas song*/ /klad khrag gnyis dang dbang po dum pa re/ /lha lcam mtsho rgyal gnyis la phul nas song*/ /klad khrag gcig dang dbang po dum pa re/ /bdag dang mkha' 'gro lnga la gnang nas byung*/ /klad khrag gcig de kun la 'gyed pa dang*/ /bam ro rnams ni dum bur gtubs nas su/ /la las sha thob la las khrag thob dang*/ /la las rus thob la las pags pa thob/ /la las rgyu ma 'dren zhing rgyug pa dang*/ /la las rkang mgo lag mgo thogs nas su/ /ha ha hi hi'i gad mo sgrogs pa dang*/ /shin tu rngam pa mi bzad gar sgyur ston/ /rje btsun ma hā gu ru yab yum gyis/ /lhag ma bzhag nas zhal phrus bran nas song*/ /bdag gis lhag ma mi bzhag snyam pa dang*/ kho mo zla grogs rnams kyi zhal nas kyang*/ /ming po khyed kyis lhag ma bzhag nas su/ kha chus bran cing byin gyis rlobs shig zer/ /bdag gi kha chus bran na mi 'ong smras/ /dam tshig yin pas kha chus bran dgos zer/ /'di yi rgyu mtshan gang ltar lags sam zhus/ /'da' ka rdo rje'i dam tshig yin zhes gsungs/ /gu ru'i zhal nas lhag ma bsngos song bas/ /sngar dus tshogs gral dbus su med pa yi/ /bud med gzugs can rgas dang gzhon pa yi/ kha dog ma nges rngam stabs ldan pa dang*/ /sha med keng rus gar mo 'dra ba sogs/ /lhag ma de dag gang thob byas nas song*/ /bzhi lnga tsam zhig ma thob lus pa'i tshe/ /bhandha lhag gzhong bshal chu byin nas song*/ /las 'dzin mo des rkang gling btang ba dang*/ /bya rgod 'ur ltar skad cig byer nas song*/ /de tshe ma hā gu rus 'di skad gsung*/

/skal ldan bu rang gsol ba legs thob dang*/ kho bos rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbang sbyin gsungs/ /de tshe bdag gis mig btsums thal sbyar nas/ /gdung bas gsol ba drag po btab pa dang*/ /mi phyed gsol 'debs thon nas mjal ba dang*/ /gu ru yab yum che mchog sku ru gyur/ /pho brang de yi nang gi phyogs rnams su/ /stong pa'i dbyings la 'ja' ltar shar nas 'dug /mdun du lha lcam manda ra ba yis/ /ngo sprod brda yi dbang rdzas dkyil 'khor ni/ /phyag gis yar gtegs zhabs gnyis bzhengs nas 'dug /de tshe mkha' 'gro lnga yis zhus nas su/ /kyai ho rdo rje 'dzin pa che/ /ma hā gu ru dpal rab bzhengs/ /gar dgu stong nyid snying po yis/ /brda de rgyud sde'i dbang mchog stsol/ /yang dag dam tshig ldan lags so/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis de ltar zhus pa'i tshe/ /che mchog ma hā gu rus bka' stsal pa/ hūm̐/ rdo rje snying po bla med kyi/ /yang dag chen po'i don rtogs pa/ /deng 'dir rigs kyi skal ldan la/ /rgyud sde bla med gter chen gyi/ /bskyed rdzogs grol ba brda yi don/ /bka' gtad dbang bskur yongs rdzogs shog /oṃ dha swa bhā wa a hūm̐ tsitta hrī ga ga /sku yi dbang bskur bskyed pa thob/ /gsung gi dbang bskur zung 'jug thob/ /thugs kyi dbang bskur rdzogs rim thob/ /yon tan dbang bskur 'chad rtsom thob/ /phrin las dbang bskur las tshogs thob/ /ngo sprod gsang dbang ye shes thob/ /brda sprod gnad dang lag lan thob/ /deng nas brtsam ste bu khyed nyid/ /dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtsor gyur nas/ /rdo rje bdud 'dul las rab rtsal/ /rtsa gsum gling pa'i ming thob shog /oṃ badzra ku mu ṭa dharma siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ /de skad brda yis rgyud du dbang yang bskur/ /ngo sprod la sogs re re mdzad pa'i tshe/ /lha lcam phyag gi dbang rdzas thams cad kyis/ /rim bzhin bdag la yongs rdzogs dbang yang bskur/

/de ma thag tu dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi/ /phyag mtshan sa bon lha dang gzhal yas rnams/ /bdag gi gnas lngar ba spu'i bu ga ru/ /'od zer lnga ldan tshul du thim nas byung*/ /de tshe bdag gi lus la tshur bltas pas/ /zang thal mja' tshon gur khang lta bu la/ /lha tshogs til sgo'i bang mdzod kha phyes ltar/ /rtsa yi drwa mig rnams su shar ba mjal/ /de ma thag tu gu ru gnas 'gyur nas/ /sngar gyi sku gzugs rgyan chas de gar 'dug /da ni 'dir shog bkra shis bya'o gsungs/ /phyag phul khri yi mdun du mgo bsgul bas/ /mkha' 'gro lnga yang mnyam par bsgrigs nas 'dug /phyag g.yas bdag dang g.yon pa mkha' 'gro'i mgor/ /bzhag nas bkra shis smon lam 'di ltar gsungs/ ho/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum dang*/ /dga' rab shrī sing rig 'dzin brgya rtsa brgyad/ /rtsa gsum lha tshogs mkha' 'gro chos skyong gis/ /thugs kyi sras la bkra shis smon lam stsol/ /zung 'jug dga' bzhi'i grol lam rnam pa brgyad/ /yas babs mas brtan pho nya'i ḍākki'i dbyings/ /gegs med gsang sngags rlabs chen 'dzin pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor yang dag don ldan shog /oṃ ma hā gu ru mu dra gu hya sarba siddhi hrīḥ /de skad gsungs nas smon lam mdzad pa dang*/ /gu ru'i thugs dang shes rgyud 'dres par byung*/ /de nas phyag 'tshal maṇḍal phul ba dang*/ kha byang la sogs lung bstan 'ga' re gnang*/ /shog dril brda dang gnyer gtad mdzad pa la/ /dbang bzhi blang zhing 'chang ste smon lam btab/ /de tshe ma hā gu rus bka' stsal ba/ /da ni bu khyod gling bskor bgyis nas su/ /bde gshegs bka' brgyad chen po'i pho brang de/ /mjal nas gsol 'debs smon lam bgyi ba dang*/ /dbu rtse rnga yab dpal ri mjal du song*/ kho bo'i thugs kyi sprul pa de ru bzhugs/ /chos dbang la sogs de nas longs shig gsungs/ /de nas mkha' 'gro lnga yi sngon byas te/ /rim bzhin g.yas bskor tshul du song ba las/

/shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad du/ /bka' brgyad pho brang shin tu che ba la/ /dkyil 'khor bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ /rang rang lha yi gtso 'khor thams cad ni/ /nam mkha'i dbyings nas 'ja' shar lta bur 'dug /pho brang rnams kyi bar mtshams thams cad du/ /srin po'i las 'dzin mkhar yang dgu tsam 'dug /de yi gru dang sa bcad 'ga' zhig tu/ /sems gnad skyong ba'i sgom chen mang po dang*/ /sgrib sbyong phyag 'tshal byed mkhan mang po 'dug /klu yi khang pa 'dra ba'i dbus shed na/ /mtsho dang bya rigs rnams kyang mang po 'dug /gzhan yang khang bzang rgyan bkram mang po'i nang*/ khye'u pho mos rtse gar byed pa 'dug /de yi drwa mig rgya'am mtshams 'ga' rer/ /sna tshogs lag bzo byed pa mang po 'dug /mu ran 'dra ba'i khri yang 'ga' re 'dug /bud med mang pos mi rnams bsad pa dang*/ /sha khrag 'gyed dang rgyu ma gtong ba 'dug /bdag gis mkha' 'gro rnams la dris nas su/ /'di rnams las byed gang 'dra yin smras pas/ /'di yi phyi nang chags tshul mi 'dra zhing*/ /la la dkyil 'khor chen po'i pho brang du/ /tshogs dang smon lam byed mkhan 'di rnams ni/ /tshes bcu gtong dus mchod pa brtson pa'i tshe/ /tshogs rdzas bzang po'i sbyin bdag bgyis nas su/ /'di ru skyes pa'i smon lam btab pa yin/ /gar rtsed byed pa'i khye'u 'di rnams ni/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe/ /rigs lnga gyon nas tshogs bro brdungs pa dang*/ /dad pas smon lam bzang po btab pa yin/ /bzo rigs nyams mtshar mang po byed pa 'di/ /gsang sngags chos 'khor la sogs rgyan rnams la/ /gus 'dud legs pos zhabs phyi bsgrubs pa yin/ /bud med mang pos mi bsad byed pa 'di/ /sngags la log lta byed pa'i rigs rnams yin/ /klu yi mtsho la mtsho bya 'phyo ba 'di/ /dad pas smon lam btab pa'i rigs rnams yin/ /dar yug gyon pa'i pho mo gang rigs 'di/

/sngags la dad pas smon lam btab pa yin/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis de skad smras pa dang*/ /zangs kyi them skas 'dra ba'i ring po zhig /rgyud nas gyen la ring du song ba'i tshe/ /g.yu yi lcags ri sngon po yod sar slebs/ /de yi nang nas rim par phyin pa'i tshe/ /sa gzhi thams cad gser gyi maṇḍal ltar/ /'jam zhing dwangs ba 'od dang ldan pa ni/ /tshad kyang rgyang grags che ba tsam du 'dug /de nas nang du phyin pa'i sgo srung ni/ khro bo rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'dug /de yi nang du phyin pa'i sgo srung ni/ /rab tu mdzes shing dwangs ba'i mdangs ldan la/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga 'dra ba'i grub thob tshogs/ /grangs med mang pos mgur dbyangs len nas 'dug /'di ni rnga yab mngon dga' yin zhes zer/ /de yi steng khang pho brang gcig la ni/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad pho brang brgyad kyis bskor/ /de yi pho brang che ba bzhi po ni/ /bde mchog zhi rgyas dbang drag rnam bzhi yi/ /tshogs khang 'ja' 'od gzi mdangs ldan pa ru/ /drag po rigs bzhi yab yum mdun du ni/ /dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i tshogs gral byas nas 'dug /dbus ma'i tshogs khang dai yi nang du ni/ /gu ru drag po'i lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i mdun/ /ging chen pho mos tshogs gral byas nas 'dug /mtshams kyi tshogs khang chung ba bzhi yi nang*/ /mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rang mdogs rgyan ldan la/ /rang 'dra 'khor tshogs mang po 'dus nas kyang*/ /bro gar tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor nas 'dug /'di ni rnga yab 'thug po bkod yin gsungs/ /de steng thog so gcig la phyin pa'i tshe/ /pho brang gcig la bzhi yi bskor nas 'dug /shar du shel las grub pa'i pho brang du/ /sa la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum la/ /dkar mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor nas 'dug /lho ru baiḍūrya yi pho brang du/ /tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin yab yum la/ /ser mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor nas 'dug /nub tu padma rā ga'i pho brang du/

/phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin yab yum la/ /dmar mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor nas 'dug /byang phyogs ind+ra nī la'i pho brang du/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin yab yum la/ /ljang mo ḍākki 'bum gyis bskor nas 'dug /thams cad sna tshogs mchod pa thogs nas su/ /gar sgyur rol mo dbyangs snyan len cing 'dug /'di ni zhing khams bzhi'i gnas yin zer/ /dbus su sna tshogs rin chen las grub pa'i/ /'od zer lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ /mtshan nyid kun tshang ngo mtshar de yi dbus/ /rin chen khri 'phang dar 'bol gdan steng du/ /gu ru padma snang srid zil gnon ni/ /sku mdog dkar dmar nyi zer 'bum 'khyud mdangs/ /mdzes 'dzum ldan pa'i spyan gyis phyogs bcur gzigs/ /dbu la pad zhwa mthong grol rgyan ldan gsol/ /phyag tu rdo rje bhandha tshe bum dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten pa rgyan gyis spras/ /phod kha dmar smug stag lpags gong lag can/ /chos gos ngur smrig gser gyi pa tra ris/ /za 'og ber chen smug nag g.yung drung ris/ /sngo khras gong lag rgyan du mu tig phreng*/ /stag lpags mu ran rnams kyang brgyan pa yi/ /lhab lhub mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol/ /sku reg dmar sngon spel 'dra gsol mdzad nas/ /zhabs la rgya lham sngon po 'ja' ris mnabs/ /bag dro brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs nas 'dug /mdun gyi phyogs su g.yas g.yon gnyis la ni/ /manda ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyi spras te bzhugs nas 'dug /de yi g.yas phyogs dag gi stegs kyi khar/ /gzhal yas blos blangs 'dra ba'i pho brang gcig /'ja' 'od lu gu rgyud du 'phros nas 'dug /de yi stegs kyi kha rnams rim bzhin du/ /rin chen sna tshogs sgrom yang dpag med 'dug /mdun du mkha' 'gro rig ma rgyan ldan ni/ /stong phrag tsam zhig yod yod 'dra ba la/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras nas su/

/mchod sprin bzung ste gar thabs bsgyur bar 'dug /'di ni padma 'od kyi zhing yin zer/ /de yi steng khang rin chen pho brang du/ /rma bya'i sgro mdangs sham bur bskyod pa'i dbus/ /rin chen sna tshogs dar 'bol khri steng du/ /drang srong he ru ka pa'i gzugs can ni/ /sku mdog dkar dmar mdzes 'dzum ldan pa la/ /rus pa'i rgyan dang dpa' bo'i thod bcings chas/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas bhandha bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying bag tshul dang ldan/ /gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor nas su/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i gar stabs bsgyur bar 'dug /'di ni zhing khams lta na sdug yin zer/ /rig 'dzin 'di ni dga' rab rdo rje la/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor gyis bskor yin zer/ /de yi lding khang nor bu'i rigs la ni/ /lnga ldan tshul gyis spel ma'i pho brang nang*/ /rig 'dzin chen po rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /ḍākki gar mo 'bum gyis bskor ba 'dug /rtse mo za ram bya 'dab pu shu dang*/ /gser las grub pa'i rgya phibs rgyan 'dab can/ /g.yu 'brug gshibs pa'i kha nas mu tig gi /chun po dang ni rgyan sogs 'phyang ba 'dug /de steng gañdzi ra yis rtse mo ru/ /thig le 'ja' gur tshom bu 'ga' re 'dug /pho brang zang thal de yi nang du ni/ /thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum la/ /ye shes rig ma lnga yis bskor ba ste/ /snang srid 'ja' shar 'dra ba'i dbyibs dag la/ /thig le lu gu rgyud du 'phro ba rnams/ /'gro 'ong gya gyu yam yam 'dra zhig la/ /zer thag shig shig 'phro ba'i dbyibs dag snang*/ /'di ni zhing khams 'og min gnas yin zer/ /de yi klong nas phyogs bzhir bltas pa'i tshe/ /'dzam gling thams cad mthong ba yin yin 'dra/ /'dzam gling 'di dag gang yin dris tsa na/ /da ni gu ru'i mdun du mgyogs par 'gro/ /de 'dra lta dang bshad pa'i long med zer/ /de ma thag tu skas las babs pa dang*/

/ma hā gu ru'i mdun du phyin nas kyang*/ /lha phyag 'tshal zhing byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe/ /dgyes tshul smon lam bzang po mdzad pa dang*/ /bu yis zhing khams thams cad mjal lam gsungs/ /skyabs mchog pha yi drin gyis mjal lags zhus/ /de ma thag tu mkha' 'gro mang po yis/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor nas song*/ /skabs su rig 'dzin srog sgrub yin gsungs nas/ /dbang dang snyan brgyud mang po gnang nas byung*/ /de nas nor bu 'dra ba'i dbyibs can la/ kha dog lnga ldan tshul du yod pa'i ngogs/ /yi ge la sogs grangs med shar ba zhig /'od zer phrom phrom bdag la gnang ba dang*/ /da ni dgongs brda shog ser sna tshogs kyi/ /gter rgya'i lde mig 'di yi nang du yod/ /bha ri la ti badzra shwa ṭa si/ /gu ya a ghra sha ra si ba ra/ /si ma gha tri ma ti ya laṃ ta/ /handzu gu na sha ra ti la tha/ /de yi dus su brda de legs par zungs/ /de nas g.yon phyogs mtsho rgyal zur logs su/ /bhandha skam po phreng ltar brtsegs pa'i khrir/ /g.yang gzhi'i ngos su chos 'byung bris pa yi/ /gdan gyi steng du bdag la sdod ces gsungs/ /bdag kyang de yi steng du sdod pa'i tshe/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis sngags chas thogs te byon/ /bu khyed 'di dag lus la gyon nas ni/ /dmod pa'i las mtha' thams cad zungs shig gsung*/ /gzhan yang mtshon cha mang po gtad nas byung*/ /slob dpon chen pos rab gnas gnang ba dang*/ /da ni gdan gyi kha nas yar longs gsungs/ /langs te slob dpon mdun du phyin pa dang*/ /lcags kyi par bu mang po gnang nas su/ /ha tri ya na ma shanta'i skor yin gsungs/ /de nas mkha' 'gro rnams kyis phyag tu ni/ /he ru ka yi chas shig thogs nas byung*/ /bu khyed 'di dag lus la rgyan no gsungs/ /sngags chas bzhag nas chas de lus la brgyan/ /da ni tshogs bro bya'o zer nas su/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bdag gi lag nas 'jus/

/lug rgyud ltar du sbrel nas bro yang rdung*/ /rten 'brel brtul zhugs chas 'di 'chang gyis zer/ /de tshe slob dpon phyag na me long zhig /bdag gi mgo ru bzhag nas smon lam mdzad/ /spyod lam brtul zhugs gnad de 'di zungs gsungs/ /me long bdag gi lag tu gtad nas byung*/ /de nas g.yas su maṇḍal 'dra ba yis/ /stegs bu zlum po zhig ni 'dug pa'i khar/ /mthing dkar dmar po gdan gsum brtsegs nas su/ /bu khyed 'di yi kha ru sdod ces gsungs/ /de yi steng du bsdad ma thag tu ni/ /pad zhwa phod kha chos gos ber rnams dang*/ /sku reg lham bcas cha gcig gnang ba dang*/ /da ni lus la 'di nyid chongs ces gsungs/ /bdag kyang de dag lus la 'chang ba'i tshe/ /dar yug dkar sngon dmar gsum sbrel ba'i sner/ /gser gyi 'khor lo gnyis kyis brgyan pa de/ /'khor lo gcig ni gu ru'i phyag tu bsnams/ /'khor lo gcig de bdag gi lag tu bzhag /bar gyi dar yug mkha' 'gro rnams kyis 'jus/ /de tshe smon lam mang po mdzad pa de/ /gsang sngags chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /de yi brda yin legs par chongs shig gsungs/ /bdud rtsi spar mthil gang tsam gnang nas byung*/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis rab gnas shis brjod byas/ /da ni yar la bzhengs dang chog ces gsungs/ khri de'i kha nas yar lang thang la babs/ /bdag gi grogs mo mkha' 'gro lnga po yis/ /chas rnams nga tsho'i khyer rogs bya'o zer/ /rgyan chas bkrol nas kho tsho'i lag tu bzhag /bdag ni he ru ka yi chas de gyon/ /gu ru'i drung du gsol 'debs smon lam byas/ /de tshe bdag gis bsam blo btang ba la/ /spyir ni bla ma mjal ba shin tu dkon/ khyad par rnga yab dpal ri 'di nyid la/ /lam du 'gro ba'i sa thag ring bas na/ /da lan skad cig sleb pa'i dus 'di ru/ /cung zhig bsdad na dga' ba'i tshor snang byung*/ /de tshe gu ru rje la 'di skad zhus/ e ma/

bdag gi bla ma gu ru rin po che/ /da lta skad cig mjal ba'i dus 'di ru/ /gnas 'dir cung tsam zhig ni mi sdod par/ /phyir log brgyag na skyo ba skye ba dang*/ /shin tu dka' ba'i srin yul bgrod pa la/ /bar chad 'dra yang gang 'ong cha mi thig /de bas rje yi mdun du sdod dgos grag /byin gyis rlobs shig pha yi thugs rjes zungs/ /de skad bdag gis gu rur zhus pa'i tshe/ /gu ru rje yi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /kyai ho nyon dang skal ldan thugs kyi sras/ /pha yi thugs rjer phyogs ris bcad du med/ /bzhugs pa'i yul la nye ring ris su med/ /rnga yab dpal rir phyi nang gzhal du med/ /dad ldan bu yi drung du nga nyid bzhugs/ /srin yul 'di ni longs sku'i rtsal snang yin/ /bu khyod da lan 'di ru bsdad pa na/ /skye ba gsum gyi 'gro don yol te mchis/ /sa rtags 'dul zhing mthun pa khyed yin pas/ /nga yi gter rgyu chud zos nyams nas 'gro/ /sems dpa' yid blo ma skyo rtsa gsum gling*/ /da lan 'dul zhing smon lam 'di dag la/ /nga yi brda rtags lung bstan ji bzhin du/ /brtson 'grus drag po'i go cha ldan par gyis/ /'dul zhing 'di dag rdzogs pa'i mtshams su ni/ /bu nyid bsu ru sring mo btang nas 'ong*/ /de bar gdung bas pha la gsol ba thob/ /nyams dang tshes bcur rgyun du mjal bar byed/ /da lan nang du log la bar chad med/ /sngar ltar sring mo rnams kyis bskyal bar yod/ /de bas bdud rigs gter min gsum yod pas/ /'gro don 'dul zhing dag la gnod par 'dug /'on kyang gcig ni mkha' 'gro'i sha khral bgyis/ /gnyis po bus rang bzlog par gyis dang chog /hi ṭa sha lu ka ni gtad par gyis/ /da ni mgyogs par nang du log dgos pas/ /dpal ri'i phyogs bzhir legs par ltad mo gyis/ /dad ldan dri mkhan byung na bshad dgos yong*/ /de tsam zhal gdams yid la chongs zhes gsungs/ /de ma thag tu mkha' 'gro lnga po yis/

/ltad mo bya na 'di ru 'gro dgos zer/ /thog mar shar phyogs logs su phyin pa las/ /dpal ri'i thog steng rgyan rnams thams cad kun/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan dang 'phan dar dang*/ /gdugs dang gañdzi ra ni mang du 'dug /bar khang zangs mdog pho brang thams cad la/ /thod pa'i kha bad skam rlon spel ba dang*/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad rang mdog de dag ni/ /rin chen las grub tog dang rgya phibs sogs/ /pho brang re re'i steng du lnga lnga 'dug /pho brang chen po de rnams steng du ni/ /mi mgo'i kha bad rgyu ma'i 'phan 'phyangs ba/ /g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan dang bcas brgyad brgyad 'dug /de 'og lcags ri'i steng rnams thams cad du/ /sgo mor thod pa'i phreng ba bsgrigs nas 'dug /dpal ri'i mtshams bzhi'i brag ri'i mtshams dag tu/ /rtse mor mi mgo mang po'i la btsas la/ /g.yang bzhi'i rgyal mtshan mang po btsug nas 'dug /srin po 'ga' re brag der 'byar mkhan 'dug /brag de'i skad pa rtsa ba ldem bzhi ru/ kha dog dkar ser dmar ljang mtsho bzhi 'dug /mtsho 'gram me tog skyed tshal mang po dang*/ /de ru byol song 'dra yang mang po 'dug /tshes bcur tshogs sha bgyis dag skye yin zer/ /de ni thod phreng sde bzhi'i mtsho yin snang*/ /mtsho khar dpag bsam shing sdong mang po dang*/ /de yi bar mtshams spang ljongs 'ga' re ru/ /bro ra yin zer sgor sgor kha shas 'dug /de yi gong du chos khri 'ga' re snang*/ /gu ru khye'u tshul du byon pa'i tshe/ /sku rtsed byed sa'i bzhugs khri yin ces zer/ /brag ri de rnams logs ni 'ga' re ru/ /gu ru dang ni mkha' 'gro la sogs kyi/ /sgrub phug yin zer 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba la/ /skas 'dzeg dgos sam mi dgos 'ga' re snang*/ /de yi rong gi phyogs bzhi'i mkhar dag ni/ /dmar nag shin tu 'jigs pa'i tshul can la/ /thog so re rer thod pa skam rlon khar/ /g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan don snying rgyan sogs 'dug

/dpal ri'i zhol gyi mkhar rnams thams cad la/ /g.yang gzhi'i rgyan sogs shin tu mi bzad 'dug /mkhar rnams che ba re re dag la ni/ /chung ba rnams kyis bskor ba'i tshul du 'dug /mkhar rnams de yi sgo drung re re ru/ /zur gsum zangs kyi rdo che re re'i steng*/ khrims bcad bsad cing gtubs pa mang po dang*/ /mi dang rta glang ma he la sogs pa/ /bsha' gtub bsad dang bcad pa grangs med 'dug /de 'dra'i srang sgo dag ni re re ru/ /srin po mdog nag khram shing thogs pa la/ /mgo bo gsum pa yod pa bzhi re 'dug /de dag khrims bcad bsad pa'i dpon yin zer/ /gzhan ni lus chas gzugs sogs mi 'dra ba/ /ma nges byed mkhan la sogs mang dag 'dug /'di ni dpal ri'i nang skor rgyag sa yin/ /da ni phyi gling phran bu bshad pa ni/ /shar du srin yul khra tsha brag zhes pa'i/ /brag rtse bdun pa ral gri gzengs 'dra 'dug /lho ru srin yul laṅka zhes bya ba'i/ /brag ri rtse lnga nor bu slangs 'dra 'dug /nub du srin yul glog phreng zhes bya ba'i/ /brag rtse gnyis pa mdung ring bslangs 'dra 'dug /byang du srin yul ma la zer ba yi/ /brag ri rtse dgu mdung rtse gshibs 'dra 'dug /brag rnams dmar la rngam pa'i tshul du snang*/ /brag dang nye ba'i sa cha thams cad ni/ /zangs thang khrag mtsho 'khrugs 'dra'i dbyibs ltar 'dug /de yi mtshams su ko sha ru ḍī ṭa/ /dar ma sha ra ru ti ma ya dang*/ /ma ru sha zhes la sogs brag rnams ni/ /rtse mo gzengs shing rngam pa lta bur 'dug /de dag rnams kyi mdun phyogs dag la ni/ /srin mkhar dmar po thod pa'i kha bad can/ /thog so dgu re yod pa dag la ni/ /rgya khyon mtho dman rgyang grags 'bring po tsam/ /de la grong khyer mang pos bskor ba 'dug /rtse mor g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan thod dbyug sogs/ /skra yi ba dan 'phyang ba'i rgyan rnams 'dug /re re'i nang du gu ru'i sprul pa ni/

/srin po'i rgyal po mgo dgu mgo bdun dang*/ /mgo lnga mgo gsum la sogs ma nges pa/ /srin po'i kha gnon ched du bzhugs yod zer/ /de yi phyogs mtshams phyi ma dag la ni/ /srin brag srin mkhar grong khyer grangs med 'dug /yul rnams phar cher dmar shas che ba la/ /g.ya' spang thams cad spu gri gshibs 'dra 'dug /nub phyogs de ru gangs ri dkar po'i mdun/ /mtsho dkar 'o ma las grub lta bur 'dug /gangs ri de na dzñā na ku ṭa zhes/ /mtsho la mkha' 'gro'i sku khrus gnang sa yi/ /yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i mtsho yin zer/ /shing ljon me tog skyed tshal mang po 'dug /de ru gtsug lag khang yang du mar snang*/ /phyi yi rgyan ni rin chen sna tshogs dang*/ /nang du gu ru mtshan brgyad bzhugs yod skad/ /mtsho de gu rus gter nas bzhes yin zer/ /gangs ri de yang phyi mor chags pa dang*/ /gtsug lag shing rnams phyi mor gyur yin zer/ khyad par 'phags pa'i ri bo de tsam 'dug /gzhan yang srin yul grong gling mang po la/ /spyod 'gros sna tshogs byed mi mang mthong yang*/ /yi ger 'jigs nas bri tshod med pas sbas/ /gzhan yang srin po'i yul gling thams cad kun/ /phran bu skye rten me tog 'dra bar skad/ /gzugs ni mdzes dang mi mdzes khro ba sogs/ /sgyu ma'i longs sku'i zhing khams tsam du 'dug /de nas gu ru'i mdun du log pa dang*/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor nas 'dug /bdag la dngos grub tshogs 'khor khyad can dang*/ /zhal gdams gsang rgya shog dril mang po gnang*/ /chos dang chos bdag gter dang gter grogs sogs/ /rnga yab gling nas bdun tsam lung du bstan/ /gzugs sku de ru yod pa gang zhig la/ /sprul pa bod du yod pa mang po 'dug /'di yi zhib cha lung bstan la sogs ni/ /bka' rgya dam pas ma bris skabs 'dir sbas/ /dus la bab tshe mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhir yod/ /zhib gsal 'dod na de yi nang du ltos/

/de nas smon lam rgya btab sgo ru phyin/ /dpal ri'i shar gyi phyogs su don pa'i tshe/ /phyogs mtshams kun nas 'ja' tshon zug pa dang*/ /'ja' sprin gseb nas khye'u pho mo yis/ /rol mo sna tshogs lag tu thogs nas 'dug /dbu la rtse zhu rtsai khra gsol ba dang*/ /gar sgyur mi bzad ston pa mang po yis/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan 'khrol bzhin tshogs te byung*/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro rnams kyis sngar bzhin du/ /dar yug btings nas 'di ru bzhugs shig zer/ /de yi steng la bsdad ma thag tu ni/ /gu ru'i thugs kar 'ja' tshon lnga ldan zhig /bdag gi snying khar zug pa'i tshul du byung*/ /de tshe gsol ba smon lam drag tu btab/ /de nas sngar ltar nam mkhar stegs nas song*/ /bdag gis mkha' 'gro rnams la smras nas su/ /da ni rgya gar yul du sleb pa'i tshe/ khyed rnams bdag la ri ming ston cig smras/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis de la lan btab nas/ /da ni mgyogs par gnas su log dgos yod/ /ri ming brjod cing ston pa'i long khom med/ /da lan ming po'i yul la nye yod zer/ /de nas chu tshod gcig tsam song ba'i rjes/ /sa la bobs dang gnas su sleb yod zer/ /de ma thag tu langs shing bltas pa'i tshe/ /ti sgro la yi rtse ru slebs nas 'dug /sngar gyi 'ja' de ma yal 'dug par mthong*/ /mi bzod skyo ba skyes nas smon lam btab/ /de nas sa yi steng du bzhugs ces zer/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis dar yug bsdus nas song*/ /da ni ming po sku khams bzang bar phebs/ /nged rnams rnga yab gling na log 'gro zer/ /de nas bdag gis bsam blo bskor ba las/ /yun ring 'grogs pa'i sring mo 'di rnams la/ /gtang rag bzang po zhig ni dgos 'ong bsam/ /da ni sring mo khyed rnams nga phyir 'gro/ /bdag gis sku dran gtang rag bya'o smras/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis de la lan btab nas/ /bdag cag ma hā gu rus bka' mchis pas/ /da lan ming pos gtang rag ma gnang kyang*/

/mi ring ba ru lan gcig 'ong dgos yod/ /de yi dus su zhib par bya ba lags/ khyad par sring mo dhwa dza kā ra 'di/ /dhe ba ā yur dha ra bya ba yin/ khyod kyi chos kun grogs ni 'di dgos pas/ /'di la smon lam bzang po mdzod cig dang*/ /sprul pa da ltar mi yul slebs zin yod/ /mkha' 'gro chos bzhi lta bu de tsam dang*/ /smon lam rten 'brel shin tu rgyag par rigs/ /nged rnams tshes bcu la sogs dus bzang skabs/ /ming pos tshogs 'khor dus su slebs nas 'ong*/ /da lan sku khams bzang bar phebs ces zer/ /de nas bdag gis mkha' 'gro de rnams kyi/ /phyag tu 'jus nas smon lam legs par btab/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro dhwa dza kā ra yis/ /sor gdub phud de bdag la gtad nas ni/ /ma mjal bar du 'di nyid 'tshogs zhes zer/ /mgyogs par bdag gi srin mdzub g.yon par brgyab/ /de ma thag tu mkha' 'gro de rnams ni/ /nam mkhar bya ltar lding ste gshegs pa dang*/ /sngar gyi 'ja' rnams rim pas yal nas song*/ /bdag ni nang du log ste 'ong ba yi/ /nyams dang rmi lam de dag yal ma thag /nam mkhar bltas pas sangs sangs langs nas 'dug /de tshe gcer bur sgo ru thon nas ni/ /gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba yang yang btab/ /bla ma rjes su dran pa'i dbyangs 'di blangs/ na mo gu ru/ dbyings ka dag klong chen pho brang nas/ /pha kun tu bzang po mi gzugs can/ /lar mngal skyes rang lus mi dmigs kyang*/ /don rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i slob dpon mkhan/ /thugs de las rnam sprul shar ba'i dpal/ /rje brdzus skyes bla ma padma 'byung*/ khong sangs rgyas kun gyi dbang po ste/ /sku 'ja' lus rdo rje'i zlos gar bsgyur/ /zhing dkyil 'khor kun la mnga' bsgyur ba'i/ /lha dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog rje/ /gnas rnga yab dpal rir bzhugs pa yis/ /skyabs 'gro ba'i mgon po u rgyan pa/ /pha thugs rje'i bdag nyid gu ru dran/

/bdag gus ldan spyi bo'i cod pan 'dud/ na mo/ rje gtan gyi skyabs gnas padma 'byung*/ /bdag gdung ba drag pos gsol ba 'debs/ /gnas dbus yul gzho stod ti sgro 'di/ /sa gangs can bod kyi ma la ya/ /lam ma bsgom sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i zhing*/ /mi tha mal slebs kyang rtogs pa 'char/ /bu skal ldan rnams kyis snying po lon/ /mi bdag dang 'dra na nga phyir shog /lam theg chen 'dod na gnas 'dir snyegs/ /grogs mkha' 'gro rgya mtshos bsu ba byung*/ /zhing dpa' bo rgya mtshos skyel ma 'dug /bka' rdo rje theg pa'i gdung brgyud rnams/ /chos zab rgya'i dga' ston 'gyed pa de/ /bdag padma gter gling ma lags sam/ /ma mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bsu ba'i tshe/ /dbyings mkha' la bya ltar 'gyu nas song*/ /gnas rnga yab dpal rir bgrod pa'i lam/ /gzugs mi bzad sha za srin po'i tshogs/ /phar rgyang mig mthong yang rgyud pa 'dar/ /rdza g.ya' ma spu gris gtams 'dra de/ /mtho dbyings nas bltas kyang sha lus gcod/ /mtsho rakta dug chu khol ma de/ /ngad rlangs par bsam yang mgo bo 'thom/ /lam ring mo'i them skas grangs med de/ /bgrod mi dgos rig kyang lus myug chad/ /sgo srung ba'i pho nyar bltas tsa na/ lam dka' ba yod kyang dad pa skye/ /bdag de tsam skyo bar ma gyur yang*/ /lus sha gzugs sgyu mas snang tshul red/ na mo gu ru/ /lar spro ba'i ya mtshan bshad tsa na/ /grogs ma sring mkha' 'gro blo thag nye/ /dbyings nam mkha' yangs pa'i bya lam bde/ /gnas rnga yab dpal ri ngo mtshar che/ /pha rje dang mjal bas skal bar bzang*/ /rgyud zab rgya gnang bas snying po lon/ /dbang man ngag rdzogs par smin grol thob/ /lung bka' gtad thob pas chos khungs btsun/ /rje dngos su mjal bas brgyud pa bzang*/ /tshig snyan brgyud gnang bas byin rlabs myur/ /pha'i zhal rgyun thob pas grub mtha' gtsang*/ /don rim dgu thob pas srung sdom bde/ /lar ya mtshan de 'dra bshad tsa na/

/tshig thos pa tsam gyis don chen rtogs/ /sems sgom sgrub tsam gyis 'bras bu thob/ /bu smon lam can gyis spyod yul te/ /mi bdag dang 'dra na nga phyir shog /tshe 'di phyir 'dod na gsol ba thob/ /zhing rnga yab dpal rir bgrod par 'dug /pha padma 'byung nas mjal bar nges/ /lha dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral sleb/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub lon te mchis/ /gnas srin yul rnga yab bgrod pa'i bu/ /bdag gter bdag gling pa ma lags sam/ /bdag rang mtho'i khengs sems ma lags te/ /sngon rten 'brel smon lam bab tshul gyis/ /dus deng sang pha rje'i mdzad pa'i shul/ /nyams kha thabs chung yang bsnyag tshul te/ /mi nges shes can gyi gdung ba skyed/ /mi skal med blun po chags sdang lang*/ /mi grub mtha' can gyi dmyal ba bsag /de yin kyang legs bshad mgur 'di la/ /pha gtan gyi skyabs gnas padma 'byung*/ /rje mtshungs med rgyal ba 'bri gung pa/ /mthu nus pa'i gter mdzod rnying ma pa/ /lam rtsod med grub thob rgod tshang pa/ /mkhas mnga' ris paṇa chen sa skya ba/ /mi bdag gi blo bskyed mkhos chung yang*/ /thugs khrel bar ma gnang byin gyis rlobs/ /mgur snyan dbyangs sil mas mnyes par stsol/ /de skad tsam gyi mgur zhig btang ba dang*/ /nang du log ste spro ba'i nyams ldan ngang*/ /ja mar gos lag la sogs khyer ba rnams/ /de ru bzhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo la/ /thams cad ma lus tshogs 'khor btang nas byin/ /ras gos rkyang gcig gyon te phyin nas song*/ /nyams rtogs rnams kyang sngar las gsal ba dang*/ /rkang mgyogs 'dra ba'i dngos grub thob 'dra bsam/ /nga ni zangs mdog dpal ri mthong ba yin/ /rgya gar byang gling zhig tu 'gro'o snyams/ /rim bzhin gzho rong lung par phyin pa'i tshe/ /rgyab nas ku sgra chen po byed mkhan 'dug kha lo bskor te phyir logs bltas pa'i tshe/ /skyes pa zhig ni ling ling slebs nas byung*/

/rnal 'byor grub thob gang nas byon zhes zer/ /bdag ni ti sgro gnas nas 'ong yin smras/ /da ni sa phyogs gang na byon zhes zer/ /bdag ni rgya gar byang gling 'gro yin smras/ /grub thob khyed kyis sgo them ma spang na/ /nang du phebs nas 'brel ba bzhes rogs mdzod/ /bdag ni thun mong ma yin dad pa skyes/ /grub thob da lan lam du byon pa'i tshe/ /zhabs kyis sa la ma reg byon par mthong*/ /da lan grub thob nang du ma pheb na/ /nga ni sdug bsngal chen pos non 'ong zer/ /de ma thag tu de yi phyi la phyin/ /lam thag ring mor zhig tu grong yang 'dug khri gdan mtho bar brtsegs nas ja chang sogs/ /'tsho ba'i tshogs 'khor legs par btang ba dang*/ /gser dngul dar ras la sogs gang rigs shig /bla mar 'brel ba 'dod pas gang mnyes zer/ /bdag ni grub thob bzang po ma lags kyang*/ /da lan bya btang chas 'di 'dzin pa yin/ /til 'bru tsam yang blang bar mi bya smras/ /de ma thag tu sgo ru thon pa dang*/ /grong pa rnams la kho yis skad btang nas/ /grub thob 'dug zer 'o dod byas nas song*/ /bdag gis de skad ma smra bgyis pa dang*/ /bar rlung bzung te mgyogs par phyin nas 'ong*/ /mi rnams thams cad sgo ru thon pa dang*/ /bdag ni mig rgyang gang tsam sleb par bsnyegs/ /de yi nub mor dbu ru zhwa yi nang*/ /lha khang mdun du chang tshong ma zhig 'dug /gcod thun zhu 'dod 'di ru bzhugs zhes zer/ /'tsho ba bsnyen bkur legs par zhus nas byung*/ /de nub bsdad pa'i nam phyed tsam la ni/ /lam du zhugs te rim par bgrod nas song*/ /nub mo 'phan yul lung pa'i mda' ru slebs/ /bu mo spun gnyis yod sar gnas tshang byas/ /phyir nangs zhogs nas rim par song ba dang*/ /dur khrod klu mo rgyal zhes bya bar slebs/ /nyin mo mi ro gsum tsam bsha' bzhin 'dug /bam tshogs sbyor te klad pa phran bu zos/ /nub mo gcod thun byas nas bsdad pa'i tshe/

/dur khrod sha za mang po 'dus nas ni/ /cho 'phrul gar sgyur sna tshogs 'gyed nas 'dug /de yi zhogs la yer pa'i phug par song*/ /nub mo nag mo dre'u bzhon pa yis/ /gnas 'dir bzhugs dang grogs mo bya'o zer/ /dam rdzas khyad 'phags phul nas song ba rmis/ /phyir nangs brag gseng mang po 'grim pa'i tshe/ /sngar gyi brag lhu 'dug pa de phud pas/ /la cha'i sgrom bu mthe bong tsam zhig 'dug kha bshig nang du gang 'dug bltas pa'i tshe/ /myong grol 'ja' lus ril bu bdun phrag byung*/ /gnyis tsam min par thams cad zos pa dang*/ /lhag ma am phrag sbubs su bcug nas song*/ /phyir nangs lha sa'i chos 'khor gling du slebs/ /gnas mo ma ga dhe wa'i rtsa bar bzhud/ /de ru zhag po bcu tsam 'gor nas song*/ /de skabs nub mo zhig gi rmi lam du/ /mi dmar srin po khros pa'i gzugs can zhig /rta mchog rag pa bzhon nas mdun du slebs/ /gnam lcags rdo rje yun ring ma 'gor bar/ /mon kha sha 'ug gnas su byon dgos zer/ khyod ni su yin rings khyad ci yod smras/ /de tshe mi dmar de yis lan btab nas/ /nga ni chu mig byang chub ring mo nas/ /sngon tshe slob dpon padma'i bka' nyan pa/ /btsan rgod beng chen myur mgyogs bya ba yin/ /da lan khyed kyi srung mar mchis dgos te/ /tha tshig drag pos gnyer gtad srung ma yin/ /da phan nged kyis bsrungs pa'i zab chos ni/ /bdud sprul mang pos glags btsal byas pa las/ /rten 'brel gnad kyi che ba nyams zin yang*/ /rgya rtags rnams ni sbas bzhin tshang bar yod/ /da ni mi ring ba ru ma pheb na/ /bdud kyi sprul pa gter min de dag ni/ /lcags kyi sdig pa ra tsa'i lus blangs te/ /gter rgya'i mtshams nas 'tshe dang sdang bar yod/ /gzhan yang bdud sprul de yi 'khor rnams ni/ /srin bu ra tsa dmar por gyur nas su/ /sgrom bu'i phyi nas za zhing gnod par 'dug /des na thog mar drag dmigs 'phang ba dang*/

/gnas kyi mdun du glo bur ma sleb par/ /shin tu gsang zhing lam du bgrod par gyis/ /de yi grogs ni da ltar khrom 'dir yod/ /sang nas btsal te nga phyir byon shog dang*/ /'u yu gha hi la ru bsu 'ong zer/ /de ma thag tu glo bur bzhud de song*/ /de nas mi ring ba ru nam mkha' sangs/ /gnas mos zhogs ja srub te khur nas byung*/ /jo jo mnal lam legs po e byung zer/ /rmi lam cho 'phrul 'dra bar byung smras pas/ khyed ni 'byung lnga dbang du 'dus pa la/ /cho 'phrul zer ba'i rtsub nyams yod dogs med/ /nged cag tshang la rkyen ltas yin 'ong zer/ /de tshe bdag gis bsam blo yang yang btang*/ /lha sar khrom mang 'di tsam 'dug pa la/ /'di yi nang nas su yin cha mi thig /gal srid yod kyang zhib mor bshad mi nyan/ /zhib mor bshad na gsang rgya mi 'ong bas/ /de bas dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro 'bod dgos bsam/ /ti sgro las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsang zhig btang*/ /gnas mo khrom du phyin pa'i mal de la/ /zhwa mo gyon nas kha ṭwāṃ lag tu thogs/ /dam rdzas phran bu zhig ni sder mar btab/ /sgo ru thon nas rten 'brel brtags te song*/ /g.yu thog zam pa'i kha ru sleb tsa na/ /bu mo gsum gyi mda' dar chang phud dang*/ /'bru sna 'ga' re thogs te slebs nas byung*/ khyed rnams gar 'gro ci byed smras tsa na/ /nged rnams ma cig dpal lha'i mdun du 'gro/ /de ring tshes bzang tshogs 'khor dgos yin zer/ khyed rnams ming la ci zhes dris tsa na/ /tshe 'dzoms bu khrid padma rgyal ma dang*/ /sras mo bha ya dag ni ming yin zer/ /chung ba tshe 'dzoms bu khrid bya ba de'i/ /lag par sor gdub 'dug par ston dang smras/ /bstan nas lag khar bzhag nas byung tsa na/ /chang phud gtor te rlung thun gcig bzung nas/ /bang kha brdzangs te mgyogs par song ba'i tshe/ /lcags po ri yi mdun du slebs pa dang*/ /phyi mig bltas nas 'ong ngam bsam tsa na/

/yong mkhan 'dra ni gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ /rim bzhin lcags po ri rgyab yol ba'i sar/ /rdza snod stong pa gsum ni khur mkhan byung*/ /phaṭ sgra drag po zhig ni btab pa dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ brgyab te snod khog gnyis tsam bcag /rlung thun bzung nas bros thabs song ba dang*/ /cung zad phyin te phyir logs bltas pa'i tshe/ /mi de langs te gzhan du 'gro zin 'dug /de nas 'bras spungs yol ba'i mtshams shig la/ /bud med chang bem khur ba zhig dang 'phrad/ khyed rang ga ru 'gro zhes byas pa las/ /nga ni 'bras spungs zhol du 'gro'o zer/ /'o na bdag la chang zhig byin dang smras/ /chang 'di drang na yong ba med ces zer/ /thams cad phos na yong ba e yod smras/ kha ṭwāṃ rtse mo bem la tshad pa'i tshe/ /ma pho sku mkhyen gsol chang 'dren lags zer/ /ca phor khengs pa gsum tsam blugs byung bas/ /phor pa gang de mo rang gdong la btab/ /phaṭ sgra brgyab te lang nas song ba dang*/ /rnal 'byor grub thob ngan mthu ma gnang zer/ /de yi nub mor grong chung zhig la sleb/ /de nas bza' bcas phran bu khyer nas su/ /nam dang nyin mtshan thams cad sbrel nas song*/ /lam du ngag bcad mi rnams thugs tshad la/ /smra ba ma byas lag brda btang zhing song*/ /lam las cung zad 'das pa'i pha rol du/ /yar 'brog mtsho yi kha ru slebs pa'i tshe/ /nub mo nyal ba'i srod 'phro'i mtshams su ni/ /mi dmar sngar gyi btsan de slebs nas byung*/ /'khor ni bcu gsum tsam du 'dug pa dag /thams cad bswe khrab zangs khrab gyon pa dang*/ /mda' mdung ral gri la sogs 'dzin nas ni/ /nged rnams khyed nyid bsu bar yong ba yin/ khyed kyis gter grogs ma btsal yin 'dug pas/ /da lan gnas 'di drag po'i yul yin pas/ /gter grogs med par bgrod du mi rung zer/ /de la bdag gis lan du 'di skad btab/ /lha sa'i khrom chen dpag med de 'dra'i nang*/ /lung bstan med na gar yod mi shes shing*/
