/gsang rgya ma bkral yong na mi nyan bsam/ /sor gdub 'di yis tshab 'dra e yong smras/ /btsan rgod rnams kyis de la lan btab par/ /sor gdub bdag mo gter grogs de yin mod/ khyed kyis sor gdub 'di yang ma lon na/ /lo brgya bsgugs kyang gter rgya 'phrad pa med/ /'on kyang grogs shig med pas mi 'ong gsungs/ /de nas bdag gi bsam gzhig legs par btang*/ /'di nas grogs shig da lta ga la rnyed/ /de bas las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bod do bsam/ /mkha' 'gro rnams la gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /gzho stod lung nas 'ja' dkar snam yug tsam/ /bdag gi mdun du thad dkar zug pa la/ /de yi steng nas a phyi chos sgron ma/ /ma mo mched bzhis bskor te byon nas byung*/ /ming pos yi chad 'bod pa ci yin zer/ /bdag ni rten 'brel 'di 'dra yin zhes smras/ /'o na gter grogs nga yis bya'o zer/ /btsan rgod thams cad shin tu dgyes tshul 'dug /de tshe las kyi ma mo'i zhal nas ni/ /ming po nga yi rta mjug 'di ru zhon/ /sring mos lan zhig ma btang bar du ni/ /mig gis ma lta nga la zungs shig zer/ kha ṭwāṃ thogs nas mig btsum bzung ba'i tshe/ /yeng yeng bar snang 'gro ba 'dra zhig ngang*/ /chu tshod gcig tsam song ba'i mtshams su ni/ /ming po da ni 'di ru 'bab chog zer/ /sha 'ug brag gi rtsa ru slebs nas 'dug /de tshe bdag gis brag la ltas tsa na/ /lung pa'i stod smad thams cad gsal ba yi/ /me ri kem kem gar yang 'bar ba 'dug /de yi nang nas brag ri mang po la/ /rgya rtags 'dra ba 'ga' re 'dug pa'i tshe/ /rdzu 'phrul nyams kyis kha ṭwāṃ thogs nas su/ /brag gi logs la gyen du 'dzegs pa'i tshe/ /las kyi ma mos lag nas 'then pa dang*/ /de ma thag tu gyen la bgrod de phyin/ /gter rgya de yi sgo yi nang du ni/ /sdig pa zhig gis sbrul la 'dzin nas 'dug /bdag gis hūm̐ sgra drag po bsgrags pa dang*/ /dmar nag drag po'i bskul pa tshar gcig btang*/

kha ṭwāṃ de ni sdig pa'i lto bar bsnun/ artsig nirtsig drag sngags sgrogs pa'i tshe/ /sdig pas tsir sgra dang bcas shi ba dang*/ /brag gi ngos nas g.yang la lhung nas song*/ /bdud sprul bstan pa nub pa'i smon lam btab/ /brag der kha ṭwāṃ rtse mo bsnun pa dang*/ /sbrul de la bswe dmar nag sgrom du gyur/ /sgrom la srin bu mang po 'byar 'dug pas/ /thams cad bsal te rdog pas dril nas bsad/ /sgrom bu de dag dar gyis dril nas blangs/ /de ma thag tu gter rgya 'grigs nas song*/ /sdig pa'i ro de sa khar brgyab 'dug pas/ kha ṭwāṃ rtse mos dum bur gtubs byas te/ /rdog dril bsnags nas phye mar btul ba dag /sa la bsres nas ming yang med par byas/ /la bswe'i sgrom de srin bus gnod 'dug pas/ /bcag ste zhib par byas nas phyogs su gtor/ /shog dril hril bur phyung nas dbang bzhi blangs/ /ma rungs bdud bzhi sgrol ba'i smon lam btab/ /slar yang gnas srung 'khor la bka' bsgos pas/ /de tshe las kyi ma mos lung bstan te/ /'di ru 'gro dang gter rgya yod ces gsung*/ /phyin pas de yi 'dabs logs zhig la ni/ /me hom 'bar ba'i skar bug sgo gcig 'dug /de yi nang du legs par mjal ba'i tshe/ /sku tshab phyag mtshan shog dril mang du 'dug /'di dag bton nas 'gro'o snyam tsa na/ /lung bstan gter grogs bu mo de med na/ /da lta 'di dag thon pa'i thabs med zer/ /bdag gis yod bsam lag pa bstan pa'i tshe/ /gter rgya 'grigs nas me tshag 'thor te byung*/ /ri rnams 'ur sgra chom chom byed nas 'dug /de ma thag tu slar yang brag rtsar babs/ /btsan rgod phyogs kyi mi ro khyer nas byung*/ /skad cig dgyes rngam tshul gyis rol nas song*/ /bdag kyang ro snyom ched du klad khrag 'thung*/ /mkha' 'gros sngar ltar rta mjug 'di nyid la/ khyed kyis dam du bzung nas zhon mdzod cig /ming po de ring gang du byon zhes zer/

/bdag ni rgya gar phyogs su 'gro yin smras/ /rgya gar 'gro ba'i dus la ma bab zer/ /'o na mkhar chu phyogs su 'gro'o smras/ /mkhar chu da lta dus la ma bab zer/ /'o na sham po'i gang du 'gro'o smras/ /de ru da lta byon pa'i dus yin zer/ /de ma thag tu glog bzhin bgrod de song*/ /nam mkha'i skar ma ma yol tsam zhig la/ /gangs gnyan sham po'i mdun du slebs nas song*/ /'di yi skabs su rmi lam tsam du 'dug /da ni de ru bzhugs dang 'grigs 'ong zer/ /de ma thag tu btsan rgod thams cad ni/ /sham po gangs la gyen du 'byar nas song*/ /las kyi mkha' 'gros bdag la 'di skad gdams/ /gter dang sa 'dir byon tshul thams cad ni/ /lo bdun bar du gsang rgya dam par gyis/ /'di ni shin tu bar chad che lags pas/ /brda dang shog dril mi la ma ston cig /shog ser dum tsam mi la ston mi rung*/ /da ni sring mo mgyogs par log nas 'gro/ /ming po'i grogs su 'bral med bgyi'o zer/ /mkha' 'gro gtso 'khor rnams kyang log nas song*/ /bdag kyang thum par gnyid du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /lus la nyi ma dag kyang shar nas 'dug /ngal dub thang chad rkang pa na ba dang*/ /mgo na kha skom grod pa ltogs nas 'dug /'gro yang rkang pa 'dzugs thub tsam gyi ngang*/ /cung zad phyin pas mi tshang zhig la slebs/ /btsun ma mgo dkar 'dra zhig don nas byung*/ /rnal 'byor pa khyed gang nas byon zhes zer/ /nga ni rgya gar yul nas 'ong yin smras/ /'o na bdag gi nang du phebs zhes zer/ /de yi phyi la nang du song ba dang*/ /'tsho ba bzang po'i zhabs tog byas nas byung*/ /zhag gsum ngal bso brgyab ste de ru bsdad/ /rlung dang 'khrul 'khor mang po sbyang ba dang*/ /thang chad rkang pa na ba sos nas song*/ /de nas sham po gangs la rim bzhin song*/ /bar sked la mtshams de ru sleb pa dang*/ /'brug sgra glog dmar drag po 'tshubs pa'i nang*/ /mdun du dngos su khyab mjug ljang sngon nyid/

/mi bzad me 'bar rab tu 'khrugs nas byung*/ /bdag gis zil gnon 'dra zhig bgyis pa la/ /me tshag 'ga' re de ru 'thor ba las/ /bdag kyang mgo na zhe kha log pa dang*/ /thom zhing 'gyel la khad tsam byung ba'i tshe/ /he ru ka yi ting 'dzin gsal btab pas/ /gza' yi gzi brjid cung zad nyams nas song*/ /de tshe gza' yi kha nas srog sngags dang*/ /sgrub pa'i las sngags 'ga' re 'phros nas byung*/ /drag sngags de dag lan gsum bklags pa'i tshe/ khyab 'jug sku de bdag la thim pa dang*/ /lus kyang du ba bun bun lang nas song*/ /de nas ser sprin thams cad chad pa'i shul/ /nyi ma dang ni 'ja' 'od shar nas byung*/ /de yi nyin mo gangs skor byas te phyin/ /nub kyi gung la nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /bud med rgyan gyis phyug pa lnga byung nas/ /ming po tsā ri'i phyogs su byon ces zer/ khyed rnams su yin tsā ri gang du yod/ /song na dngos grub dam pa ci yod smras/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis de la lan btab nas/ kyai/ nged rnams dbyings nas shar ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /yum chen khros ma nag mo'i sprul pa yin/ /'dus byas phung po sgrogs kyis bcings pa min/ /ye nas gnas pa ming po'i sring mo yin/ /gnas chen tsā ri ṭa zhes bya ba de/ /'di nas nyi ma shar gyi mtshams shed du/ /gsang sngags pho brang drag po'i zhing khams ni/ /byin brlabs gnas tshul me ri 'bar ba 'dra/ /gtum drag tshang tshing bsil ba tshal dang mtshungs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas yul gtso bo ste/ /u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling ltar ma sring 'du/ /ma bsgom sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i tsā ri ṭa/ /skal ldan rnams ni gnas der sleb pa tsam/ /'ja' lus 'grub nas mkha' spyod lam la gshegs/ /'bring po bsleb na gnas lugs rtogs pa 'char/ /tha ma bsleb na ma sbyang sdig sgrib dag khyad par smon lam skal ldan gang zag rnams/ /mchog thun dngos grub thob pa'i gnas mchog ste/ /ming po'i gnas kyi gtso bo 'di yin pas/

/gnas chen tsā ri ṭa ru gshegs pa na/ /gsang sngags sgron me sbar ba'i rten 'brel yod/ khyad par 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa yi/ /rin chen zab mo gter gyi skal ba yod/ /sbas yul kun gyi lde mig gdams pa yod/ /de phyir ming po nged kyi yul du byon/ /sang nas lam du zhugs te byon ces zer/ /mda' dar dkar po lag tu gtad pa rmis/ /de nas rgyang tsam song mtshams nam gsal bas/ /langs te mgur ma 'di ltar btang nas song*/ na mo/ spyi bo ye shes dung khang steng*/ /sangs rgyas bla ma padma 'byung*/ /drin can ratna bha dra ba/ /mi 'bral spyi bo'i rgyan du bzhugs/ kho bo ri khrod ras pa nga*/ /gnas chen ti sgror sleb pa'i tshe/ /ma sring mkha' 'gros bsu ba byung*/ /lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos skor rnyed/ khyung zhon drag po'i brda rtags rdzogs/ /sku tshab gter dang myong grol sman/ /ya mtshan can gyi snying po lon/ /brag dmar g.yang la bya ltar lding*/ /rnga yab dpal ri'i zhing khams bgrod/ /bla ma gu ru rje dang mjal/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bka' bab gnang*/ /rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rje/ /rnal 'byor ras pa ma lags sam/ /dbus yul bde chen thag ring la/ /he ru ka yi brtul zhugs kyis/ /ro snyom rnam rtog 'khu 'khrig bcad/ /yair par dam rdzas gter chen spyod/ /chos 'khor lha sar rten 'brel babs/ /ma sring mkha' 'gro'i rkang mgyogs thob/ /lho mon phyogs su gshegs pa'i tshe/ /btsan rgod rol pas mdun nas bsus/ /tshe ring mched lngas skyel ma mdzad/ /thogs med rdzu 'phrul rlung rtar zhon/ /shes bya mun pa'i smag rum gtor/ /gnas chen sha 'ug stag sgor song*/ /ma rungs bdud kyi srog snying phral/ /yang phur gwa'u dmar nag gi /zab mo rin chen gter kha rnyed/ /thogs med brag la bya ltar bgrod/ /yang gter snying po mang du mjal/ /drag sngags mthu yi bka' chen bab/ /me 'bar sa g.yos lung pa khengs/

/btsan rgod 'bum gyi gtso bo byas/ /dgra bgegs bsgral nas bam chen gyi/ /sha khrag phung po tshogs 'khor rol/ /gnas chen de la rab gnas bskyar/ /dmod pa chen po phur thogs pa/ /rig 'dzin padma gter bdag gling*/ /rnal 'byor ras pa ma lags sam/ /rta zhon mkha' 'gro'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /sham po gangs chen gnas la bgrod/ /lha btsan 'bar bas lung yang bstan/ /gza' bdud rgyal po rā hu las/ /'brug sgra thog gis bar snang bkang*/ /gza' brgyad ki kang gzugs kyang mthong*/ /ting 'dzin dmigs pas zil mnan pas/ khas blangs srog gi snying po phul/ /sgra gcan rlung gi dngos grub thob/ /rbad pa pho nya'i bka' yang bab/ /drang srong brda dgu'i shog dril lon/ /sham po'i grub thob smyon pa'i bu/ /gnam lcags rdo rje ma lags sam/ /tsā ri gangs kyi rwa ba nas/ /lung bstan mkha' 'gros bsu ba mdzad*/ /ngo mtshar gnas chen bka' bab pa/ /snang srid buddha'i klong du grol/ /karma las 'brel gling pa rje/ /rnal 'byor ras pa ma lags sam/ /'gro yang ka dag ngang du 'gro/ /spyod 'gros dbyings rig zang thal bsre/ /lam kun rgya yan shugs las bgrod/ /rnam rtog lha 'drer thog brdzi gtong*/ /dgag sgrub mdzes mo rgyab tu bskyur/ /spang blang bse rag g.yang la g.yugs/ /rang bcing mug ge'i zhags pa gcod/ /mi chos mgo bskor sna thag bstung*/ /legs nyes slob dpon dam tshig bsre/ /rkyen ngan bla ma dwang du len/ /kun khur dman pa'i grwa tshang 'grim/ /tshogs drug gang shar slob gnyer rgyag /kun rgyu ro gcig sgro 'dogs gcod/ /gcig shes kun grol bshad pa gtong*/ /gnas lugs lta ba'i rab 'byams byed/ /tha snyad grub mtha'i rgol ba 'joms/ /dug lnga ye shes phug pa ru/ /ro gcig khye'u'i sgrub pa rgyag /ye nas rang byung 'ja' lus grub/ /tsitta'i klong du mngon sangs rgyas/ /sgyu ma'i longs sku'i zhing re bgrod/ /blo bde bu yi 'gro lugs yin/

/sprang po ras pa'i bsam tshul yin/ /bsal bzhag dran pa'i 'char sgo yin/ /mkhas grub slob dpon ma bsten yang*/ /rgyud sde kun gyi babs so yin/ /bdag 'dzin sgom sgrub ma thon yang*/ /tha mal shes pa'i 'dra tshul yin/ /sgyu ma'i nor sdud mi shes kyang*/ /dgos 'dod sems nyid skyong tshul yin/ /glu 'di gnas chen sham por phul/ /mnyes shig gnas ri dbu 'phang bstod/ /dgyes so sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /'gro'o bkra shis bdag gis bya/ /de skad brjod nas rim par bzhud de song*/ /byang stod brgyud nas dag po'i yul du phyin/ /'bri gung phyogs nas tsā ri mjal mkhan gyi/ /mi nag mang po gnas der slebs nas byung*/ /de dang bsdebs nas sgam po mjal du phyin/ /ri bskor byas nas trag shad mtsho khar phyin/ /tshogs mchod phul zhing rten 'brel brtags pa'i tshe/ /mgon po'i bla rdo khyad 'phags shig kyang rnyed/ /de nas rten 'brel brtags shing song ba'i tshe/ /bud med shing khur khyer ba gsum dang 'phrad/ /de nas lha khang mdun du sleb pa dang*/ /btsun ma mang pos bskor ba byed par 'phrad/ khyed rnams su yin gang nas 'ong yin smras/ /nged rnams dga' ba lung nas 'ong yin zer/ /de ru gnas tshang bcas nas ja zhig bskol/ /de nas sprul sku mjal du song ba dang*/ /mgron gnyer ngan pa ma legs shig 'dug pas/ kha gshis gyong skad mang po byas nas byung*/ /de tshe bdag gis rno bsam bskor ba la/ /sngar yang sgam po'i grwa pa ther po 'gas/ khams pa'i mi gsum dus kyang 'di 'dra byas/ /dred po lcags mgo 'ga' re 'dug go bsam/ /gnas 'gram ma bsdad dur khrod sgang du song*/ /gcod dmigs byas te rlung mkhar zhol du bzhud/ /de yi nub mo de ru bsdad pa dang*/ /de nas rim bzhin grub chu kha la song*/ /nub mo srod thun nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /zhing skyong gtso 'khor mang po byon nas su/ /tshogs 'khor byas nas phyag mtshan bdag la byin/

/mkha' spyod ri 'di'i bdag po nga yin pas/ /ci bcol las bsgrub sbyin bdag byed pa yin/ /rig 'dzin 'di ru lo shas tsam du bzhugs/ /sa rtags thams cad rim par shar nas su/ /bod kyi 'phel 'grib dus ni 'di skad zer/ /ki maṃ shwa ri wa wur kha ra li/ /'u muṃ dza yi kho si ya dzi ha/ /zi tshi pu ri na sha bu ra hi/ /taṃ ri si ti mi ri dza tha ka /des ni gnas chen tsā ri sbas pa'i yul/ /brda de zungs la bzhugs par gyis shig zer/ /'o na rten 'brel shar nub gang du yod/ /mchog gi dben gnas gang du sgrub smras pas/ /bzhugs gnas nub phyogs rdo rje phag mo'i gnas/ /zil chen gsang ba'i phug ces bya ba ru/ /gu ru padma rje yi sgrub phug yod/ /rig 'dzin tshe yi sgrub gnas khyad par can/ /ma rā ti ka'i gnas dang gnyis su med/ /de la dur khrod bzhi yis bskor nas yod/ /bsil ba tshal gyi gnas dang gnyis su med/ /de la sgrub phug bzhi yis bskor nas yod/ /yang rdzong mchims phu'i gnas dang gnyis su med/ /yul smad mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi tshogs khang yod/ /u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gnas dang gnyis su med/ /yul stod dpa' bo rgya mtsho'i bro ra yod/ /bya rgod phung ri'i gnas dang gnyis su med/ /rong la mi ma yin gyi sha za rgyu/ /srin yul ma la ya dang gnyis su med/ /dzñā na shrī'i gsang sngags lha tshogs gtibs/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gnyis su med/ /de ltar gnas chen rgyu mtshan lung bstan bzhin/ /gung mo la la sgur sgur langs te song*/ /cung zad song mtshams nam yang lang nas song*/ /de nas chos zam sgang du sleb pa dang*/ /dag pa shrī'i shar phyogs dag la ni/ /'ja' 'od 'khyil nas me tog char yang babs/ /rten 'brel che ba'i rtags kyang mang du byung*/ /de nas rdo mtshan cig car lwa ba phug /sgrol ma'i bla mtsho kha ru sleb pa dang*/ /gzhi bdag la thod dmar pos bsu ba dang*/ /rten 'brel che ba'i gnad kyang 'ga' re byung*/

/lwa ba phug gi sgrub chen de dag gis/ /tshogs brgya btang nas dga' ston byed par 'phrad/ /zas sna phun sum tshogs pa drang ba dang*/ /de ring de ni rten 'brel yin no zer/ /zab mo tshogs 'khor bskor ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de nas mkha' 'gro snying phug song ba dang*/ /kang po yin zer bu mo bcu bzhi ni/ /'bru sna dar chos thogs nas byung bar bshad/ /'brel ba yin zer gos zung sor gdub dang*/ /phreng ba ci rigs mdo 'dzin legs po dang*/ /rta sga la sogs 'ga' re phul nas byung*/ khyed rnams nga yi phyi la e 'gro smras/ /'jags po khrid rogs byed na gshar 'gro zer/ /mig rgyang gang tsam gyen la skyel ma byas/ /de yis gsang sngags brgyud 'dzin rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de nas mi lpags thang dang stag ma lar/ /bgrod nas pho brang g.yu mtshor phyin pa'i tshe/ /char rgyun babs nas 'ja' gur legs par zugs/ /chos bzang rnam rgyal tshogs brgya btang nas 'dug /de yis bskyed rdzogs 'bras bu'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de nas pho brang skyong mor song ba dang*/ /dpa' bo khams ldis bya ba zhig gis ni/ /sindhu ra rnams blangs nas thogs par 'phrad/ /de yis gsang dbang bzhi sbyor rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de nas stag tshang mkha' 'gros tshogs gzhong du/ /phye mar mang po spungs pa dag dang 'phrad/ /phur zhing tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe/ /dag pa shrī'i sked pa tsam de nas/ /gangs rgyud 'ur sgra ldir ldir nyil nas byung*/ /de yis dngos grub rnam gnyis rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de nas stag tshang rong du sdod pa'i tshe/ /sha za mkha' 'gro stag la brdzus nas su/ /ngar sgra hring hring sngas khar slebs nas byung*/ /ting 'dzin dmigs pas bcun te dam la bzhag /sgrub pa mthar ru skyong dgos zer ba'i brda/ /dom tshang rong nas lcags thag zam bgrod tshe/ /me lce 'bar ba'i rdo rbab bsgril nas byung*/ /dus 'khrug dmag gis bod gling gtor ba'i brda/

/zhing skyong la ru snod stong khur bar 'phrad/ /gnas gzhi gog por lus song zer ba'i brda/ /srin mo ni ring zhol g.yag rwa 'dzing 'phrad/ /dmag 'khrug yol nas bros dgos zer ba'i brda/ /rta mgrin rong gi mtshams su sleb pa dang*/ /gling du sgug nas khur ba 'ga' re 'phrad/ /tha ma zas mchog 'di yin zer ba'i brda/ /mkha' 'gro 'bum thim mchod khang sgo dbye 'phrad/ /gnas chen kun la thogs med bgrod pa'i brda/ /de nas ratna tshang zhes bya ba des/ /'di ru bzhugs dang 'tsho ba zhu'o zer/ /zla phyed tsam du de ru bsdad pa dang*/ /nub mo zhig ni nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /bud med btsun ma'i chas su zhugs pa bdun/ /bdag gi mdun du slebs nas 'di skad zer/ /nged rnams spu ri yi dam sgrub gnas nas/ /ming po bsu ru 'ong ba yin lags pas/ /phebs pa'i rten 'brel sang zhogs yin no zer/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /de yi zhogs nas bza' bcas cha tshang dang*/ /skyel mi gsum tsam byas nas song ba'i tshe/ /spu ri brag rtser sprin 'ja' 'khrigs pa dang*/ /bya rigs rnams kyis 'gyur khug gtong nas 'dug /sgrub phug de yi sgo ru sleb pa dang*/ /bkra shis brtsegs pa la sogs rigs gsum nas/ /gangs rgyud 'ur sgra thon pa gsum tsam byung*/ /de yis thun mong dngos grub rten 'brel 'grigs/ /skyel mkhan thams cad nang du log nas song*/ /de yi zhogs nas gu drag sgrub par zhugs/ /drag sngags me yi 'khor lo bzlas pa'i tshe/ /lus la tsha tshwa me stag chem chem 'thor/ /lung pa thams cad 'ur sgra 'byin par gyur/ /de yi nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam la/ /mdze pho shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can zhig /gcer bus sgo de khrig ger bcad pa dang*/ kha rlangs tshub tshub lag pa snyob nas byung*/ /de tshe rang nyid gu drag gsal btab nas/ /gnam lcags rdo rje'i phur pa lag tu thogs/ /mdze pho de nyid gan rkyal sgyur nas su/

/dmigs pa gsal btab phur bu snying khar bsnun/ /de tshe mdze pho de yis tshig smras nas/ kyai/ dpa' bo dgongs pa legs lhod dang*/ /sraug snying 'bul ltar bka' bzhin bya/ /zhes zer mdze pho 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /de nas tho rangs rmi lam sad pa dang*/ /lus kyang bde zhing nyams kyang gsal ba dang*/ /lus kyi shu thor rnams kyang sos nas 'dug /de yi nub mo srod 'phros yin 'dra zhig /mi nag bdud rta zhon pa'i 'khor tshogs dang*/ /bud med mda' dar thogs pa mang po zh-ig /'ur sgra ldir ldir spyil bu'i sgo ru byung*/ /rnal 'byor pa rang sgo ru don dang zer/ /cho 'phrul yin nam bsams nas bltas pa'i tshe/ /snang tshul sgyu ma'i gzugs brnyan lta bur bzhag khyed rnams su yin ci byed smras tsa na/ /nged rnams rngam pa rong gi btsan rgod dang*/ /dur khrod ḍākki rnams kyi dbang phyug yin/ /daing 'dir gu ru rje yi sgrub phug tu/ /ma bsgoms sangs rgyas grub pa'i dam rdzas dang*/ /dregs pa sde brgyad kun gyi bla rdo yod/ /rten 'brel zungs la da lta byon no zer/ /de ma thag tu bdag kyang nang du log /tshogs rdzas phran bu tsam zhig grabs pa dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ thogs nas sgo ru don pa'i tshe/ /bud med rnams kyi sngon du lam sna byas/ /mi nag de rnams phyi byas 'gro ba'i tshe/ /gu gu rong gi chu khar slebs nas 'dug /bdag ni 'gro ba'i thabs shig bsam pa'i tshe/ /mi nag de nyid rta las babs nas ni/ /'di la zhon ste byon par chog ces zer/ /rta nag de yi gong du sleb pa dang*/ /rlung dmar drag pos 'ur sgra dang bcas pa/ /shin tu g.yos pa'i klong du khyer nas song*/ /rim gyis tho rangs kha tsam yin 'dra ru/ /rngam pa sgra sgraugs mdun du slebs nas 'dug /de nas phar khar brgal te phyin pa'i tshe/ /gu ru'i sgrub phug gong 'og dag tu slebs/ /de nas nam mkha' had de langs nas song*/ /sgrub phug nang du tshogs 'khor legs par btang*/

/rten 'brel brtags pas dam rdzas bla rdo rnyed/ /tshogs 'khor rol nas lhag ma btang ba dang*/ /shin tu thib thib gnyid 'dra log nas song*/ /de tshe za zi nyams kyi snang ba la/ /rgya gar yul gling zhig la slebs pa dang*/ /a ru ra sogs shing 'bras mang 'dug pas/ /zos shing nags tshal dag tu nyul ba'i tshe/ /rig 'dzin chen po dga' rab rdo rje mjal/ /lung bstan chos dang zab rgya yin gsungs pa'i/ kha byang shog dril mang po gtad pa rmis/ /de nas yad yud mang po zhig gi mtshams/ /za zi gnyid kyang sad nas 'dug pa dang*/ /sa yang rub ste zla ba shar nas 'dug /thom mer bltas pas sngar gyi zla grogs rnams/ /tshogs gral byas nas lhod kyis bsdad nas 'dug /chad brtan phul zhing 'gro grabs byas pa dang*/ /thams cad lang te sngar ltar sgo ru phyin/ /da ni sbas yul zhig tu 'gro'o zer/ /sngar ltar rta de bdag la gtad nas byung*/ /de ma thag tu sngar bzhin song ba'i tshe/ /lho nub gro ma lung yin zer ba yi/ /ri rtse thams cad gangs kyis bskor ba dang*/ /lung chen gsum ni gcig tu 'dus pa'i sar/ /rong rnams dag la skya lam dog pa yi/ /shin tu btsan gyi yul gling chen po 'dug /'di ru gro ma'i longs spyod yod do zer/ /shing 'bras sogs ni mang po smin nas 'dug /sngar gyi rtsig pa'i shul yang 'ga' re'i nang*/ /de nas rim bzhin song ba'i mtshams su ni/ /mi ma yin gyi grong khyer 'ga' re 'dug /dbang bskur dgos zer phyag dbang zhu ba dang*/ /'brel ba yin zer shing 'bras 'bul bar 'dug /de nas rim bzhin spyil bu'i nang du slebs/ /dregs pa rnams ni slar yang log nas song*/ /de yi mtshams su mang po yod yin te/ /yi ger 'jigs nas ma bris bzhag pa'o/ /de nas zhag po bdun gsum mtshams su ni/ /drag po'i bsnyen sgrub dag kyang grol ba'i tshe/ /rten 'brel che ba'i gnad kyang 'ga' re byung*/ /de nas yul smad dag la phyin pa'i tshe/

/nub mo zhig tu nyal ba'i rmi lam ngor/ /bud med dkar mo rus pa'i rgyan ldan ma/ khye'u mang po'i tshogs kyis bskor nas su/ /mda' dar tshe bum thogs pa mdun du byung*/ kho mo de yis bdag la bka' stsal pa/ kyai ming po skal ldan pa/ /bdag 'dzin ma rig grong gling du/ /a 'thas gnyid la ma zhen par/ /dran rig 'od gsal ngo bo skyongs/ /bag chags bdag tu ma bzung bar/ /'dzin med dran pas rgyang so srungs/ /ma nga gshis lugs mkha' 'gro yin/ /tshig 'di snyan brgyud zhal gdams yin/ /brda 'di smon lam bden tshig yin/ /sang zhogs tshes pa bco lnga'i nyin/ /rten 'brel lung gi bka' bab yod/ /'di nas nyi ma nub byang phyogs/ /zil chen gsang phug bya ba yi/ /gu ru rje yi sgrub gnas su/ /yang zab gter gyi skal ba yod/ /zab mo'i tshogs 'khor thogs gyis la/ /gnas der gsol ba thob ste byon/ /'di nas yul stod bya ba ru/ /grogs ni tshe yi ming can yod/ /gnad de gsang zhing sba bar gyis/ /tshig de snang ba'i ri mos zungs/ /zhes pa'i tshig de thos pa dang*/ /bud med de ni rdo rje phag mo dang*/ khye'u rnams ni rje 'bangs nyer lngar gyur/ /rje 'bangs rnams kyis bdag la smras nas su/ /dzñā na khyod nyid deng phan gang du phyin/ /'gro don rten 'brel legs par 'grigs lags sam/ /de ring 'o skol 'tshogs pa ya mtshan zer/ /de tshe bdag gis gyen du bltas pa la/ /zil chen gsang phug tshe bum logs shig la/ /'ja' dkar dar yug brkyangs 'dra zug nas 'dug /'ja' sner byi ru'i bum pa mang po dang*/ /g.yu yi rdo rje rtse lnga yod par mthong*/ /de tshe bdag dang rje 'bangs nyer lnga rnams/ /phyag rgya sbrel nas smon lam btab pa dang*/ /gar stabs mi 'dra sna tshogs bsgyur nas ni/ /'chi med tshe yi rig 'dzin grub pa yi/ /mtshams sbyor bzang po smon lam btab pa rmis/ /de ma thag tu nam yang sangs sangs langs/ /tshogs rdzas phran bu zhig ni thogs nas su/

/rten 'brel brtags te sgo ru don pa dang*/ /a ce pur ṇyai su khaṃ zhes bya bas/ /'o ma khyer nas nang du log par 'phrad/ /de yis rten 'brel legs par byung ba dang*/ /de nas rim bzhin lam du zhugs pa'i tshe/ /zil chen gsang phug gnas su sleb pa dang*/ /dri bzang 'thul zhing gling bu'i skad kyang thos/ /bya rigs mang pos gsung dbyangs sna tshogs sgrogs/ /gsang phug gnas su 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba dang*/ /'phan dar bla bre 'phyong ba'i pho brang ni/ /byin chags bag dro ldan pa zhig dang mjal/ /phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs bzhin song ba'i tshe/ /gter gyi sgrom nas tshe chu rdol te 'dug /smon lam btab nas kha ru myong ba dang*/ /zangs snod nang du blugs te byin rlabs zhus/ /de nas tshogs 'khor btang zhing spyan 'dren skabs/ /tshe bum steng du 'ja' gur 'dom gang tsam/ /shin tu bkra ba lnga ldan shar ba'i dbus/ /chos longs sprul gsum zhing khams mngon sum mjal/ /phyag dang smon lam gsol ba legs par btab/ /tshogs 'khor thon nas tha tshig bsgrag pa'i tshe/ /zhing skyong mgon po gtso 'khor mdun du byung*/ /gtor ma phul zhing phrin las drag po bcol/ /de nas tshe bum logs nas rgya rtags mthong*/ /rdo yis gter sgo drag tu brdung ba'i tshe/ /gter gyi sgrom bu mngon sum mjal nas byung*/ /lag tu blangs nas dbang dang byin rlabs zhus/ /gter rdzong la yang 'bru sna rin chen bzhag /de yi g.yon phyogs shing sdong de yi gong*/ /me ri 'bar dang tsha tshwa khol ba yi/ /gter sgo chen po zhig ni 'dug pa de/ /rdo phur thams cad legs par phud pa dang*/ /zangs lcags mang po'i phye ma nang du ni/ /zangs sgrom chen po zur gsum pa zhig snang*/ /gdan drangs spyi bor blangs te dbang yang zhus/ /gter rdzong phul nas gter rgya sngar ltar bsgrigs/ /sgrom bu rnams ni zhal phyes mjal ba'i tshe/ /mchong sgrom nang du gu ru'i sku tshab ni/

/ka ma ru las grub pa'i ya mtshan can/ /padma mthong grol tshon gang tsam zhig dang*/ /'chi bdag zil gnon shog dril dam rdzas bcas/ /'brel tshad don ldan khyad par 'phags pa 'dug /zang sgrom dmar po de yi nang du ni/ /dbang chen rta 'grin khro rgyal stobs 'dus kyi/ /shol dril dang ni sku tshab khyad par can/ /bla rdo srog gi 'khor lo dang bcas 'dug /de yi nyin la thams cad ri de yi/ /g.yas phyogs shig tu mi mthong sba gter bzhag /gtor 'bul bgyis te slar yang log nas song*/ /de nas mi ring ba ru de nyid la/ /zil chen dgon zhes bya bar mtshams bcad de/ /phur pa rta 'grin seng gdong la sogs bsgrub/ /de yi sgrub pa thams cad grol ba dang*/ /yul smad sgrub mchod gtor zlog byed du song*/ /de nas mgon po rong gi gnyer pa yis/ /de ru byon dang sbyin bdag byed ces zer/ /de ru song nas rgyangs par bsdad pa dang*/ /ston kha byar gnyan phyogs su bgrod nas song*/ /gnyal phyogs drin las bya ba'i dgon pa ru/ /'brug pa kun legs sprul sku bzhugs nas 'dug /de nas na ro chos drug gdams pa dang*/ /ro snyom skor bzhi snyan brgyud 'ga' re zhus/ /de nas gnyal gyi rgyab ri brag rtsar song*/ /grub chen chos bzang rnam rgyal bzhugs nas 'dug /de ru gsung gleng zhib par byas pa dang*/ /grub chen de yi bdag la smras nas su/ /grogs po tsā rir bzhugs yun ring mi nyan/ /tha mar 'jig rten pa ru 'gyur 'ong bas/ /gnas kyi phyi na bzhugs dang dga' bo gsung*/ /de la bdag gi lan du 'di skad btab/ /'o na khyed kyang tsā rir bzhugs nas su/ /mi lo bcu gsum sgrub pa bgyis pa dang*/ /gnas nang 'jig rten pa ru 'gyur song na/ /gnas kyi phyi nas sangs rgyas ga la rnyed/ /rkyen la thog brdzi dngos grub kun gyi mchog /nā ro chos drug ro snyom bdag po la/ /'jig rten gling nas grol cha ma thob na/

/sangs rgyas zhing la grol dang ma grol med/ /'on kyang bdag ni 'di lo'i phar btags nas/ /kong po'i phyogs su 'gro ba'i grabs yin smras/ /de dag mdzad pa legs 'ong legs 'ong zer/ /de yi zhor la dur khrod skya bor song*/ /mi ro 'ga' re bsha' zhing 'dug pa la/ /dur gcod btang nas rkang dang klad pa rol/ /dge ri brag gi sgrub phug mjal du phyin/ /rten 'brel brtags te de ru nyal nas bsdad/ /nub mo rtags dang rten 'brel legs po byung*/ /de nas rim bzhin rten 'brel brtags te song*/ kha byang nang du gsal kha mi 'dug kyang*/ /rten 'brel brtags par bya pha sde par song*/ /sde pa de yi rdzong zhol sleb pa dang*/ /bud med bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod la/ /mkha' 'gro'i mtshan rtags tshang ba zhig gis ni/ /chu zom khur te gyen la 'gro bar 'phrad/ /de la rten 'brel brtags nas 'di skad smras/ /sde pa e bzhugs rten 'brel e yod smras/ /rten 'brel 'phyis song sde pa ma bzhugs zer/ /chu zom de nang mchod pa bgyis pa dang*/ /slar yang rim bzhin lo ro phyogs su song*/ /ras chung phug tu bsnyen sgrub rlung yang sbyangs/ /de yi zhogs nas byams chen song ba dang*/ /bya pha sde pa de ru byon nas 'dug /rten 'brel byas nas gos shig bslangs pa dang*/ /ras gzan spus legs shig ni sprad byung bas/ /ma 'ongs sbyin bdag 'ong bar 'dra'o bsam/ /de nas rong du lho yul 'gro rtsis la/ /rten 'brel cung zad ma 'grigs phyir log byas/ /byar smad jo bo dpe dkar song ba'i tshe/ /de yang ma 'grigs rim bzhin 'gro dgos byung*/ /slar yang la thog ri phu'i jo bor phyin/ /nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam ngogs su ni/ /la thog sde pa tshang nas yin zer ba'i/ /bud med na chung mdzes pa'i cha byad can/ /lag tu bhandha khyer ba zhig byung nas/ /'di nas dag stod log lon bya ba ru/ khra mo brag zhes bya ba'i sgrub gnas yod/

/'di nas kong smad dag gi lung pa ru/ /gu ru thim brag bya ba'i sgrub gnas yod/ /de ru byon dang nga yis grogs byed zer/ /bdag gis de la lan du 'di skad smras/ khyed kyi rus dang ming la ci zer smras/ /bud med de yis bdag la lan btab par/ /rus ni dwags po zur mkhar dag gi gdung*/ /ming ni a ce dbyangs can bya ba yin/ /sngon tshe nga nyid rgya gar shar gling du/ /lha lcam pur ṇyai dzī wan bya ba yin/ khyed nyid shākya pra bhar gyur pa'i tshe/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i grogs mo bgyis pa yin/ /da yang lan gcig grogs su mchis dgos pas/ /dus 'dir rten 'brel mdzad rogs gyis shig zer/ /de ma thag tu gnyid yang sad nas 'dug /rim bzhin la thog de ru song ba dang*/ /gnas tshang zhig gi nang du bsdad pa'i tshe/ /sde pa tshang gi sras mo yin zer ba'i/ /bu mo gnyis tsam mgron du slebs nas byung*/ /bdag gis de rnams ming sogs dris pa'i tshes/ /sngar gyi ming rus sha stag lag yig sogs/ /thams cad tshang ba dad ldan zhig tu 'dug /de tshe bdag gis bsam blo bgyis pa dang*/ /tshig gis rten 'brel bzang po bgyis pa yod/ chad pa 'dra/ /gter rgya gnyis tsam de ru yol nas song*/ /de nas log ste tsā rir phyogs su song*/ /rim bzhin mtsho dkar mjal du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /nags la spang la rdza la thams cad brgyab/ /ri yi rtse la thon te mjal ba'i tshe/ /dri bzang 'thib dang 'ja' sprin sna tshogs zug /gnas kyis zhal gzigs mjal zhing smon lam btab/ /mtsho skor dus sogs rten 'brel legs pa byung*/ /glo bo rong gi u rgyan sgrub phug tu/ /phyi nang rten 'brel la sogs legs par byung*/ /de nas tsā ri'i gnas nang bgrod de song*/ /rim bzhin gsar ma yang mdzod mjal nas ni/ /dmar nag rakta'i mtsho khar song ba'i tshe/ /'brug sgra glog dang ser ba 'thor nas byung*/ /bdag kyang dbang drag padmar gsal btab nas/ /ting 'dzin ngang la tha tshig drag po bsgrags/

/rkang gling gtser zhing hūm̐ sgra bgyis pa'i tshe/ /ser sprin dwangs nas nyi ma legs par shar/ /de nas mtsho yi kha ru song ba dang*/ /sngags bdag ma mo'i sku gzugs dngos su bstan/ /mtsho yi rba rlabs drag po 'khrugs pa'i tshe/ /ma mos bla rdo shog dril bcas pa de/ /thag 'dom lnga yi mtshams su 'phang nas byung*/ /smon lam btab nas dbang bzhi legs par blangs/ /'bru sna mchod nas tshogs 'khor legs par btang*/ /rten 'brel brtags te rim bzhin log nas song*/ /yang gcig snga skor skabs su song ba'i tshe/ /pho brang skyog mo sgres pa'i mtshams sleb par/ /gangs rgyud chen po 'ur sgra ldan pa zhig /rgya mtsho 'khrugs 'dra g.yos te byung ba'i tshe/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dmigs pa drag po yis/ /phur pa bton nas gangs la btab pa'i tshe/ /gangs 'ur rnams kyang zhun ltar bsdad nas song*/ /de gar bskor mi mang po'i bgrod lam gyur/ /de nas zil chen dgon du sdod pa'i tshe/ /thog mar sbyin bdag byed mkhan de dag gis/ /rlung khrid zhu nas rtogs ldan bya'o zer/ /bud med des kyang chos la 'gro'o zer/ khong gnyis skra bcad ming phog sdom pa byin/ /sems khrid rlung khrid la sogs zhib par byas/ /da ni 'khor ba stong zer khas len byung*/ /zla ba gnyis tsam chos la sbyangs nas song*/ /skyes pa des ni 'bri gung 'gro zhes zer/ /bud med des ni kong por 'gro'o zer/ /chos dang gnas skor byed pa'i dam bca' blangs/ /bdag ni sgrub pa grol ba'i mtshams shig la/ /rta mgrin rong gi rta dbu'i brag phug tu/ /mal sa mchod gzhi me ra la sogs pa/ /chos 'byung gru gsum dbyibs su bcas nas ni/ /rta mgrin khro rgyal stobs 'dus sgrub pa btang*/ /zhag po lnga tsam song ba'i skabs shig la/ /gter lhong cho 'phrul 'dra ba'i nyams snang ni/ /rta mgrin mtsho nas me chen 'bar ba dang*/ /brag ri thams cad yam yom 'gul ba sogs/

/rtsub pa'i nyams 'gyur 'ga' re ston nas 'dug /slar yang ting 'dzin ngang la sgrub pa'i tshe/ /cho 'phrul zhi nas rten 'brel legs pa byung*/ /de nas sgrub pa grol ba'i mtshams su ni/ /gter sgrom dang ni sku tshab mtsho der sbas/ /ki kang rā hu la la gter gtad bzhag /sgrub pa grol nas mgon po rong du song*/ /nub mo zhig ni nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /byang phyogs 'bri yi yul nas yin zer ba'i/ /bud med sngon mo mthing gi lan tshar can/ /mda' dar me long thogs pa slebs nas byung*/ /da ni ming po sa 'di'i 'gro don rdzogs/ /bsam yas mchims phu'i gnas su byon ces zer/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal nas thal/ /de nas nam lang gnyid kyang sad pa dang*/ /bdag gis bsam rno legs par btang ba yis/ /rmi lam ltar na 'gro yang ran 'dug kyang*/ /lo shas bar du 'di ru sgrub pa bya/ /rim bzhin rmi lam lung bstan brtags bsams kyang*/ /kun gyis bdag la skur pa 'debs nas su/ /rta mgrin dbu rtser sngar mi sdod ma myong*/ /da lan ngan rdzas mthu sgrub yin 'ong zer/ /gzhan yang skur pa 'ga' re byed nas 'dug /sngar gyi sbyin bdag chos sgor btsud pa des/ /kā li de dang bdag gnyis sbrags nas su/ /ngan bshad sma 'bebs sna tshogs btang nas 'dug /de tshe bdag gis bsam blo mang du bskor/ /don med ngan bshad 'di tsam byed pa ci/ /yang na ngan mthu drag po 'dra zhig rgyag /yang na gzer thum ngan sngags drag po rgyag /slob ma dam log med na phyi 'phro gtsang*/ /yon bdag gzhungs ngan med na 'gro stabs bde/ /bdag gis gsang sngags theg chen sgor btsud nas/ /dbang khrid thams cad yongs rdzogs bgyis pa la/ /gtang rag maṇḍal bzang po med na yang*/ kha bshad sgro skur ngan pa ma 'os bsam/ /de ma thag tu liṅga bshos pa dang*/ /ming yig la sogs thams cad bris pa'i tshe/ /mdun gyi mkha' las skye med rang sgra ni/ kyai/ yang zab nam mkha'i gter gyi bdag po khyod/

/tha snyad tshig gis rgol ba mi bzod na/ /spyod pa ro snyom 'dzin med gang du gshegs/ /zhe sdang drag pos mthu gtad bgyis pa de/ /shan pa spu gri can gyi mtshon btags 'dra/ /'di phyi gnyis kar sgrib pa'i las ma byed/ /slob ma dam nyams de rnams skyur la shog /dad ldan dam tshig can de chos la tshud/ /ma nyes kha ngan skur 'debs sgrogs pa de/ /zab mo gter lhong cho 'phrul shes par gyis/ /zhag bcu tshun nas mchims phu'i gnas su gshegs/ /de skad sgra de legs par thos pa dang*/ /liṅga de nyid me yi nang du bsregs/ /'gro grabs gos tshags la sogs bgyis pa dang*/ /sngar gyi skra bcad bu mo de nyid kyis/ /gsol chang btsos nas bdag la drang ba dang*/ /ngas ni sngar gyi chos tshul zhus pa bzhin/ /da lan bla ma kong por byon pa na/ /kong por ma sleb bar du khrid rogs mdzod/ /bla ma bzhugs tshe chos la ma thar na/ /nga ni sngar ltar khyim 'dzin dgos par 'dug khrel med slob ma rnams ni dad pa log /da res bla mas cis kyang khrid rogs zer/ /de la bdag gis lan du 'di skad smras/ bdag ni kong por 'gro ba'i nges pa med/ /'bri gung bsam yas phyogs su 'gro yang nges/ khyad par bdag ni gcig pur 'gro ba dga'/ khyod ni thag ring chos phyir ma bgrod smras/ /cis kyang kong po'i phyogs su ma sleb par/ /bla mas da res khrid rogs ma mdzad na/ /de bas chu yi nang du mchong ngo zer/ /de la bdag gis lan du smras nas su/ /chos la mos pa de ltar yin lags na/ /'o na bdag gis khrid rogs bya'o smras/ /bu mo de ni kong po'i khyer nang du/ /a ne bsam gtan bzang mo'i chos gral du/ /bskyal te blo ni chos su 'gro bar byas/ /sgrub khang dar chas rgyan gyis mdzes par spras/ /de nas rim bzhin zil chen dgon du song*/ /gsol mchod tshogs 'khor legs po bgyis nas su/ /gnas bstod mgur dbyangs dga' bro bgyis pa'o/

na mo/ rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon/ /pha gtan gyi skyabs gnas padma 'byung*/ /mi bdag gi gtsug rgyan bha dra'i zhabs/ /drin 'khor med cod pan dam par 'dud/ /bdag 'phro bzang rten 'brel glu zhig gtong*/ /gnas rgya gar yul gyi maṅga dha/ /shing a shwa li yi nags kyi tshal/ /chu mar 'bab nai rañdza ra'i phug /gangs rtse rgyal dag pa shrī'i mdun/ /mtsho zla ba nor bu 'khyil ba'i 'gram/ /rtswa klu bdud rdo rje 'khrungs pa'i yul/ /bya 'dab chags dbyangs snyan len pa'i sa/ /gcan ri dwags tser skad 'byin pa'i sa/ /sngon rgyal bas byin rlabs ya mtshan gnas/ /bgrod ma lags thos pas dad pa skye/ /phyi tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags tshal 'di/ /dbyings rngam sgra 'bar ba'i dur khrod de/ /mi skal med rnams kyi bgrod lam 'gag /g.yang rngam pa mi med glo yi rong*/ /tshul rna bas thos kyang snying rtsa 'dar/ /nang klong yangs gsang sngags pho brang nas/ /bu skal ldan snying por lon pa'i sa/ /zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /don zab mo gsang sngags 'byin pa'i gling*/ /yul ma bcos rdo rje theg pa'i gnas/ /lam ma bsgom sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i sa/ /pha pad 'byung byin rlabs sbas pa'i yul/ /gnas mngon dga'i ya mtshan ldan pa de/ /zhing mkha' spyod tsā ri ma lags sam/ /gnas 'dir 'khrungs skal ldan pho mo rnams/ /lha dpal bo mkha' 'gro'i tshul du grub/ /rgyu bsod nams bsags pas skye tshul yin/ /ri khor yug lcags ris gtims 'dra 'di/ /lha zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs khang nyid/ /gnas ngo mtshar che'o brtan par bzhugs/ /yid dga' ston glu yi gar mchod 'di/ /gnas dag pa shrī mnyes phyir 'bul/ /yul phyogs kun bkra shis dge legs shog na mo/ gnas spyi gtsug 'khor lo'i rtse mo ru/ /mtshan brdzod par dka' ba'i drin can rje/ /pha zla bral gu ru padma 'byung*/ /drin mtshungs med karma bha dra'i zhabs/ /lag so sor snying ngos zlum ste 'dud/

/bu sgra tshig g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i skad/ /gsung mgur dbyangs nam mkha'i klong nas stong*/ /bu sa chod 'dab bzang khyung chen rtsal/ /lam bsgom med rtogs pa'i rang skad 'don/ /bu snyan grags snang srid nyi zla'i 'od/ /rgyud smin grol thugs rje'i bzhin mdangs ston/ /bu sems klong ri rab lhun po 'gying*/ /sgom bag yod gnyug ma'i spyod 'gros nges/ /bu sa bzung seṅge lha bu'i gnas/ /lam theg dman nyan rang zil gyis gnon/ /bu spyod 'gros glang chen smyon pa'i gshis/ /rgyud srung sdom 'gog pa'i mu ge sangs/ /bu snying stobs rgya stag kha che'i rtsal/ /rkyen thog brdzis dug lnga grogs su 'char/ /bu rang mtho gshog brgyangs ma yin te/ /lam rdo rje theg chen 'dzin tshul yin/ /rje rgyal ba gong ma'i snyan brgyud yin/ /pha gsang sngags sdong po'i che ba yin/ /gnad ru shan 'byed pa'i gshis lugs yin/ /rlung 'khor lo sbu gu'i rang sgra yin/ /bdag rtsa gsum gling pa'i chos skad yin/ /gnas tsā rir bgrod pa mang lags kyang*/ /gter yid gzhin nor bu lon pa'i 'bangs/ /mtshan nyi zla lta bur grags pa yi/ /gnubs lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes mchog /dus nam yang mi brjed gzungs thob 'di/ /bdag rtsa gsum gling pa ma lags sam/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya bzhi bskor phyes/ /lha zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor dngos su mjal/ /zhing dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bsu skyel mdzad/ /bka' gter srung pho nyas phrin las sgrub/ /bu mi la ma mthun lha la mthun/ /spyod sdig la ma mthun chos la dkar/ /grogs sbyin bdag bor yang lha 'dre rnyed/ /gnas gzhis dgon shor yang dben ri zin/ /lam 'gog pas bskyur yang snying po bzung*/ /yul skye bos sdang yang chos pas bstod/ /grogs mi chos lad kyang lha chos btsun/ /tshe 'di ngogs dka' yang phyi mar yangs/ /yul gdam ris med kyang rang tshod zin/ /sgom bzlas brjod med kyang grub rtags thon/

/phyi zol zog dkon yang 'byung tshul shes/ /lar lung rig sdeb sbyor med pa yis/ /sgra zur cha snyan po mi shes kyang*/ /tshig blun gtam gyong po'i glu len 'di/ /bdag rtsa gsum gling pa'i rang gshis yin/ /de mnyes shing gnas gsum mkha' 'gror 'bul/ /mi kho bos sgrub pa'i grogs mo yis/ /bu 'gro lam bkra shis gnang ngo yag /dpal de ring phun tshogs yar ldan shog /de nas rim bzhin g.yo yi lam du gshegs/ /ma gcig lab sgron sgrub phug nang du song*/ /nub mo nyal ba'i nyams dang rmi lam la/ /lab sgron mkha' 'gro sde lnga 'khor bcas kyis/ /dbang bskur gcod yul bka' gtad gnang ba rmis/ /tho rangs lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus/ /ting 'dzin dmigs pas 'khrul snang dam la btags/ /'di skor bdud rigs yod pas ma bris so/ de nas rim bzhin phag mo gru nas song*/ /nub mo nyams dang rmi lam za zi la/ /bud med dmar mo rus rgyan gyon pa zhig /mkha' 'gro sde bzhis bskor nas mdun du byung*/ khyed rnams gang yin gar 'gro smras tsa na/ /nged rnams gdan sa mthil nas 'ong ba yin/ /de ring skal ldan zhig ni slebs yod pas/ /spyan drongs gsungs nas bla mas btang ba yin/ /da lta gdan sa mthil du byon cig zer/ /bud med rnams kyi phyi la phyin pa'i tshe/ /bla ma lha khang 'dra ba'i nang du ni/ /phag mo grub pa mngon sum bzhugs nas 'dug /grogs po phebs zin sku khams bde'am gsungs/ /nyams 'phel bla ma sku khams bzang ngam zhus/ /byin chags gnas legs skabs su yod ces gsungs/ /bla ma sngar las gzi mdangs ldan pa la/ /zhal ras de yang snum zhing smug pa dang*/ /ag tshom rgyas nyams cung zad yod par snang*/ /bdag gis snyan brgyud stsal bar gsol btab tshe/ /'gro mgon shin tu dgyes tshul dang bcas par/ /rdor dril cha gsum bdud rtsi bhandha rnams/ /bdag gi lag tu legs par gnang ba dang*/ /da ni snyan brgyud 'di yin gsungs nas su/

/shel gyi me long mdangs ldan thogs nas ni/ ho/ rtsa rlung rdo rje lus kyi ngo sprod las/ /gtum mo rnam gsum yas babs mas brtan bzhi/ /rtsol bcas rtsol med 'khrul 'khor sbyor ba drug /spro bsdu gnad kyi gzer bu nyi shu gcig /drwa mig tshig bsdus blo chod spyi rdol dang*/ /gnas lugs khro lugs lhan cig skyes sbyor gsum/ /rdo rje'i gur te na ro'i chos drug rdzogs/ /skal ldan sras la de dag yongs rdzogs shog /ces gsung snyan brgyud brda yi tshul du gnang*/ /slar yang bla mas bdag la bka' stsal nas/ /bu khyod rdo rje theg pa'i gzhung yin pas/ /bdag la bka' gtad lung 'bog gnongs shog gsungs/ /bdag gis rdo rjai dril bu thogs nas su/ /dgra bcom nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen gsum/ /phar phyin drug ldan kṛ yog rnam pa dgu/ /ma hā a nu a ti lung chen po'i/ /bskyed rdzogs dgongs brda snyan brgyud rdzogs par shog /de ltar brjod ma thag pa'i 'phro nyid la/ /phyag bzhi mgon po mngon sum byon nas ni/ /bka' bstan bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa rmis/ /de ma thag tu nam yang gsal ba dang*/ /zhogs la gdan sa mthil du phyin nas song*/ /pho brang nang nas dung btang mkhar rnga brdung*/ /gdugs dang dar lcog gsar pa 'dzugs pa sogs/ /byed las gang yang rten 'brel 'grigs pa byung*/ /phag gru'i sku 'dra la sogs mjal ba'i tshe/ /zhal mdangs gsal zhing byon ni legs po 'dug /ya mtshan che ba'i gnad kyang 'ga' re byung*/ /de nas rim bzhin bsam yas phyogs su song*/ /had po ri yi gdong la sleb pa dang*/ /bsam yas pa yi mi sde thams cad kyis/ /gos bkrag rgyan mdzes legs par bgyis nas su/ /bka' 'gyur 'dra ba'i po ti phrag tu gzar/ /a 'o chung ngu a ce gzhon pa rnams/ /rigs lnga'i rgyan sogs yid 'ong bgyis pa dang*/ /mda' dar dang ni bdud rtsi lag tu thogs/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen sngags chas brgyan pa yis/

/dpal ldan phyag bzo rdza dung 'bud pa dang*/ /gzhan yang rol mo sna tshogs 'then nas su/ /bsam yas gling la bskor ba lan gsum brgyab/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba sogs/ khyad par 'phags pa'i rten 'brel 'ga' re 'grigs/ /de nas nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /lho nub rnga yab gling nas yin zer ba'i/ /bud med sngon mo mthing gi thor tshugs can/ /phyag na nor bu bum pa bzung ba yi/ /'khor yang rang 'dra bzhi yis bskor ba la/ /sna tshogs phyag mtshan lag tu thogs nas ni/ /thams cad dgyes tshul bdag gi mdun du byung*/ /ming po da res rten 'brel legs byung zer/ khyed rnams su yin gar 'gro smras tsa na/ /nged rnams u rgyan yul nas 'ong ba yin/ /sngon tshe gu ru mchims phur bzhugs pa'i dus/ /zab pa'i mthar thug khyad 'phags sbas pa de/ /da lan ming por sprod ces bka' stsal bas/ /nged rnams ming por lung bstan ched du 'ong*/ /da ni byon zer phyi la phyin pa'i tshe/ /mchims phu brag gi 'debs srub zhig la ni/ /mthing gi rgya rtags lam mer gsal ba 'dug /mkha' 'gro de yis rgya rtags phyes nas su/ /'di ru gzigs zer nang du mjal ba'i tshe/ /gu ru snang srid dbang sdud dkyil 'khor ni/ /ye shes dbyings la 'ja' shar lta bur gsal/ /gzhan yang sku tshab phyag mtshan dam rdzas dang*/ /sgrom bu la sogs ka cha mang du 'dug /de las bu yi chos ka 'di yin zer/ /sgrom bu sngon po g.yu yi kha bad can/ /mi shigs rgya rtags ri mo ldan pa dang*/ /sku tshab mthong ba don ldan khyad par can/ /padma rgyal po yid bzhin nor bu dang*/ /a ma ril bu mthong grol 'ja' tshon ma/ /de dag gsum ni bdag gi spyi bor bzhag /dbang bskur byas shing smon lam mdzad nas su/ /da nas 'di yi chos skor thams cad kun/ /gzhan la ma spel nyid kyis nyams su longs/ /'di ni ming po'i chos skal yin no gsungs/ /phyag gis bum pa 'dzin pa'i bdud rtsi ni/

/bdag la dbang bskur kha ru myong ba dang*/ /nor bu bum pa bdag la gtad nas su/ /da ni ming po byon pas chog go gsungs/ /de las cung zad phar la song ba'i tshe/ /lha khang ka ba gsum tsam yod pa'i nang*/ /gu ru padma sam bha'i cha lugs can/ /mkha' 'gros 'khor gyis bskor nas bzhugs par mjal/ /gsol ba btab cing byin rlabs zhus pa'i tshe/ /thugs ka'i gnas nas hūm̐ yig dmar po zhig /'od ldan 'phros nas bdag la thim pa dang*/ /gu ru dgyes tshul mdzad nas 'di skad gsungs/ /da ni bu khyod 'gro don dus la bab/ /gangs ri dkar po de yi mdun du gshegs/ kho bo'i brda bzhin zab rgya legs par skyongs/ /rnam g.yeng 'khrul gtam long yod bag ma nyal/ /le lo ngan goms de la brtson 'grus lcag /rgyu 'bras phra zhib nyams len snying por skyongs/ /'phags pa'i nor bdun snag shog smyu gu brtson/ kho bo bdag gi byed las spyod 'gros gyis/ /'khrul gtam rmongs pa'i kha tshig gtam ma nyan/ /zang zing nor la gsang sngags chos ma 'tshong*/ /las 'phro skal ldan rnams la lhags med byin/ /don de zungs la kha bshad tshig ma mang*/ khyad par rtags dang lung bstan gang byung yang*/ /gsang zhing gud du sbas na bar chad chung*/ /nyams len gcig dril kho bo'i zhal gdams yin/ /mi brjed zungs shig-i atsha sa ma ya/ /zhes pa'i brda de thos nas log pa dang*/ /za zi nyams kyi rmi lam sad nas 'dug /de yi zhogs nas bsam yas yang rdzong gi /mchod khang thams cad lus pa med par mjal/ /de nas rim bzhin mchims phur bgrod de song*/ /sgrub khang sgo ru tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /rten 'brel smon lam bzang po bgyis pa'i tshe/ /sngon tshe gu ru bzhugs pa'i dus kyang dran/ /mi rtag skyo ba dung dung skyes nas su/ /gdung shugs nyams kyis glu 'di blangs pa'o/ na mo gu ru/ rje mtshungs med 'gro mgon gtsug gi rgyan/ /dpal padma kā ra'i zhabs la 'dud/

/bu mi rtag skyo ba snying nas skyes/ /sngon skal ldan thog ma'i rtse mo ru/ /yul mtha' 'khob mi stegs bsam yas gzhung*/ /dad skal ba ldan pa khri srong tsam/ /gzhi gnas lugs ston pa bo dhi tsam/ /byams snying rje'i bag yod srong btsan tsam/ /sa zhag med bye thang tshad pa'i gling*/ /'bru skad grags can la nas 'bras tsam/ /chos mu stegs stong lta'i grub mtha' can/ /lung mtshan nyid ldan la ma ṇi tsam /bka' chos bzhin gsho sgros dben sa tsam/ /rje mun gling sgron me padma 'byung*/ /pha thugs rje'i mnga' bdag phebs pa'i tshe/ /dbyings nam mkhar me tog 'ja' 'od 'khyil/ /log bar snang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gtibs/ /dma' sa gzhi bkra shis 'bru bcud smin/ /dad rgyal pos bsam yas chos 'khor grub/ /bu rje 'bangs nyer lngas snying po lon/ /bod mun gling gsang sngags chos la btsud/ /rgyud ma dag grub mtha' tshar yang bcad/ /bdud lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags/ /rje grub thob rgya mtshos tshad rdo bor/ /chos rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i rmang rdo btings/ /bka' lung rigs kun ni brda bzhin bkod/ /gter skye dgu 'tshing ba'i zab chos sbas/ /dus phra rags rten 'brel lung bstan bzhag /'gro kun la gang 'dul zhal gdams gnang*/ /tshig rgyud lung rgya mtsho'i bka' gtad phog /dbang smin grol zab mos rjes 'jug smin/ /yul gangs can bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan btsug gnas ya mtshan can kun byin gyis brlabs/ /dpal mchims phu bsam yas dge'u gong du/ /pha kun bzang mgon po mi gzugs can/ /rigs kun gyi gtsug rgyan padma 'byung*/ /rje bka' drin che'o yang yang dran/ /bka' rgyud sde ston pa'i ma gcig ma/ /ma dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal gdung bas dran/ /lus sha gzugs rdzu 'phrul paṇḍi ta/ /grogs rje 'bangs nyer lnga tur gyis dran/ /bod mgo nag brten pa'i srog shing rje/ /don shul yod chos rgyal khri srong dran/ /rgyud nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i sgrom bu'i phug

/gnas mchims phu'i sgrub khang lam gyis mthong*/ /dus de tsam yar ldan bskal pa'i mgo /rtags rten 'brel 'dzoms pa rmi lam tsam/ /lar de yang mi rtag sgyu ma'i dpe/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas padma 'byung*/ /dus deng sang 'ja' yal nam mkha' bzhin/ /dpe de yang mi rtag sgyu mar mtshon/ /ma dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma/ /dus deng sang za zi'i rmi lam bzhin/ /dpe de yang mi rtag sgyu mar mtshon/ /grogs skal ldan rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i tshogs/ /dus deng sang tho rangs skar ma bzhin/ /dpe de yang mi rtag sgyu mar mtshon/ /dad 'byor ldan chos rgyal lde'u btsan/ /dus deng sang bya 'phur lam shul bzhin/ /dpe de yang mi rtag sgyu mar mtshon/ /dpal bkra shis chos 'khor bsam yas gling*/ /dus deng sang bdud sprul khrims kha tsha/ /dpe de yang mi rtag sgyu mar mtshon/ /mi kho bo sangs rgyas ye shes nga/ /dus deng sang sprang gzugs sa mtha' 'grim/ /dpe de yang mi rtag sgyu mar mtshon/ /dus da lta snyigs ma lnga brgya'i tshe/ /chos mdo sngags mya ngan 'di 'dra la/ /pha gu ru'i thugs rjes mi gzigs par/ /skyabs bslu med da lta gang na bzhugs/ /bod mgo nag thabs sdug nyams nga la/ /pha gu ru'i byams pas mi skyong bar/ /drin 'khor med bla ma gang du bzhugs/ /bu yi mug ga chad smre sngags la/ /pha gu ru'i zhal ras mi ston par/ /rje yid kyi sgron me gang du bzhugs/ /bdag deng sang mi tshab tho co la/ /pha gu rus dngos lung mi ston par/ /mgon dwangs ma'i srog thig gang du bzhugs/ /skyabs mtshungs med pha gcig padma 'byung*/ /dus de ring bzhugs na dga' ba la/ /skyabs da lta mjal na skyid pa la/ /pha thugs rje ma chung spyan gyis gzigs/ /bdag gsol 'debs bu la byin gyis rlobs/ /mos skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol/ /bdud dam sri rgol ba zhi bar mdzod/ /yid gdung bas 'bod do bla ma mkhyen/ /bdag 'bral med rjes 'dzin stsal du gsol/

/de skad bdag gis snying nas gsol ba btab/ /bdud sprul rnams kyis sgrub phug bshig pa la/ /shin tu skyo ba skye nas mig chu btang*/ /bla ma bsam bzhin cung zad bsdad pa'i tshe/ /char pa zim zim thor tsam babs pa'i shul/ /mdun du 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan shar/ /de yang phub skor 'khyil ba'i tshul can la/ /che chung mda' rgyang gang gi tshad tsam ni/ /de yi nang nas mdangs ldan 'od lnga la/ /gu ru padma bde chen rgyal po ni/ /sngar gyi sku yi gzi mdangs lta bu la/ /zab ber phod ka pad zhwa gsol nas su/ /phyag gnyis mnyam zhag dam tshig bhandha'i nang*/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'bar bas rab tu bkang*/ khro 'dzum spyan rtsa 'khyil te bdag la gzigs/ /manda ra ba ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis/ /rje 'bangs nyer lnga khri srong lde'u btsan bcas/ /snang stong lha sku ji bzhin lam mer shar/ /bdag gis snying nas yang yang gsol ba btab/ /tshogs mchod phul nas cung zad song ba'i mtshams/ /'ja' tshon gyu gyu phrig phrig 'gul ba dang*/ /gter rgya'i brag dang dbyer med 'brel nas song*/ /gsol ba btab pas gter rgyar thim nas song*/ /smon lam btab cing gter rgya phyes pa'i tshe/ /sgrom dang sku tshab 'ja' tshon gtibs nas 'dug /spyi bor blangs shing dbang zhus gsol ba btab/ /de tshe sku tshab rang sgra'i gsung grags nas/ oṃ ma hā gu ru padma rā dza ḍākki siddhi hūm̐/ zhes pa'i rang sgra bung ba'i skad lta bur/ /che dang 'bring ba chung dang lan gsum thos/ /snying nas smon lam gsol ba yang yang btab/ /mi bzod dga' brod drag po skyes pa'i tshe/ /pheṃ sgra btab nas rkang gling bus pa dang*/ /zhabs bro brdungs dang hūm̐ sgra mang po bgyis/ /de tshe gter srung ma mo slebs nas byung*/ /tha tshig bsgrags te gtor mchod drag po bgyis/ /ma mos bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs byung*/ /de nas gter rdzong phran bu btab pa dang*/ /bkra shis smon lam rab gnas 'thor ba'i tshe/

/sngar ltar gter rgya mi mthong 'grigs nas song*/ /lhag ma btang nas lam du zhugs pa'i tshe/ /'ur sgra chen po shin tu 'jigs pa byung*/ /de ni lam gyi bar chad la sogs pa/ /'di yang rtags zhig yin pa 'dra 'dug pas/ /shog dril ma gtogs bskyur nas bzhag go bsam/ /gter sgrom kha phyes nang du mjal ba'i tshe/ /shog dril dang ni a ma gsal bar 'dug /a ma shog dril rnams ni 'phrag khar brdzangs/ /gter sgrom sku tshab khur nas log ste song*/ /cung zad tsam du bsam blo btang ba dang*/ /sku tshab 'di nyid bskyur nas 'gro ba las/ /de bas mi yis bsad kyang gang dga' gyis/ /bsam ste sku tshab brag kha dag tu bcug /gter sgrol nang du rin chen sna lnga blugs /gter rgya de yi rtsa ru bskyal ba dang*/ /las kyi ma mor dmod pa bor te bzhag /cung zad mar tsam 'ong ba'i mtshams su ni/ /mi bzhag khur nas 'gro'o bsam pa byung*/ /phyir log brgyab te gter rgya'i mdun du phyin/ /gter sgrom 'ja' ltar yal nas med par 'dug /bor ba ma thig bsam ste log nas su/ /yang gcig bzod gsol bshags pa bgyis nas 'ong*/ /res 'ga' nyams mtshar mgur dbyangs blangs shing 'ong*/ /rim bzhin bsam yas zur gyi grong zhig na/ /bud med chang bum khur ba zhig dang 'phrad/ /nang du pheb nas 'tsho ba bzhes rogs zer/ /dga' tshor dang bcas gsol zho drang ba dang*/ /tshogs 'khor la sogs rgyas par zhus nas byung*/ /de yis rten 'brel legs tshogs che bar 'grigs/ /de nas g.ya' ma lung du song ba'i tshe/ /nub mo za zi nyams kyi skabs su ni/ /bud med nag mo mdog nag zhig gis ni/ /bu rang ring bar ma 'gor lam du gshegs/ khyod kyi bla ma snyun gyis zin yod pas/ /zhag gsum tshun du 'bri gung ma 'byor na/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa 'og min gshegs pa yod/ /zhes pa'i brda rtags tshig 'gros rdzogs pa dang*/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /rmi lam sad tshe blo yang mi bde 'dug

/de yi zhogs la mgyogs par bgrod nas song*/ /lha sar tha mas lam bkag zer ba la/ /zhag po gcig ni 'then nas 'gro dgos byung*/ /de nas rim bzhin mgyogs par song ba las/ /dga' ldan zhol du sbyin bdag tshang zhig la/ /zhag gcig bcag nas de ru sdod dgos byung*/ /rten 'brel lam zhag gnyis des sgrib pa yis/ /nyin grangs phyi nas bla ma gshegs zin skad/ /yi mug smre sngags 'don bzhin phyin pa'i tshe/ /thams cad slebs nas gdung mjal byed du 'dug /bdag kyang gdung mjal byas te byin rlabs zhus/ /phyag mdzod gsol dpon rnams dang khams dri btang*/ /de yi zhogs nas mchog sprul mdun du song*/ /phra rags gsung 'phros 'ga' re gnang nas bsdad/ /thugs 'dun chen po dpag med gnang ba dang*/ /nyid kyang phyogs med gshegs pa'i skad kyang gsungs/ /'bri gung rtse ru zhag po bdun tsam bsdad/ /de yi zhogs la sku gdung sbyangs nas song*/ /sku gdung de yang rang yal song nas ni/ /byis pa lo brgyad pa yi tshad du 'dug khyad par sku las bdud rtsi babs pa yis/ /rgya zangs 'bring po'i phyed mthong tsam zhig 'dug /de nas sku la zhun me phul ba'i tshe/ /me tog char babs 'ja' yi ka ba zug /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sku gzugs ma mthong yang*/ /stong pa'i sgra las rol mo dbyangs snyan dang*/ /pi wang gling bu'i skad kyang thos nas 'dug /de la shin tu skyo ba skyes nas ni/ /gzhis khar ma bsdad brgya tsa thang mgor phyin/ /dung dung smre sngags dbyangs 'di bos pa'o/ /kye ma kyi hud mtshungs med rje/ /pha gcig 'gro mgon bha dra ba/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /gtan gyi skyabs mchog rin po che/ /byams gdung bu la brtse bas gzigs/ /mya ngan gcong rong zab mo'i gling*/ /skye 'gro mun ljongs sgron me nub/ /rjes 'jug thugs rjes mi skyong bar/ /'gro mgon ratna gang du gshegs/ /sems nyid dran pa'i pha rgan de/

/bu la brtse phyir dbyings nas gzigs/ /bu yi rig pa pha la bstim/ /ye shes dbyings dang deng 'dir bsre/ /sgyu ma 'dul bya rnams kyang 'thor/ /de bas deng 'dir 'phro ba dga'/ /bsdus bya mi rtag rmi lam ngogs/ /kun rgyu shes pa stong pa'i dbyings/ /ka dag dbyings dang deng 'dir bsre/ /mnyam rjes dgongs pa gcig rdzogs shog /de skad bgyis nas 'pho lung sbyangs pa dang*/ /mgo 'thoms khra zi chem chem 'gro ba'i tshe/ /mdun gyi mkha' nas 'ja' sprin shar ba'i dbus/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma ratna bha dra ba/ /sku mdog dmar smug he ru ka pa'i chas/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje gdeng thabs mkha' la phyar/ /g.yon pas bdud rtsi bhandha thugs kar bsnams/ khro 'dzum mdangs ldan dbu skra spyi bor bcings/ /yan lag rags la gsus pa shin tu mtho/ /zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum 'gying bag gar stabs can/ /nyi zer 'bum phrag 'khyud pa'i mdangs ldan pa/ /gsang ye dmar mo bzhi yis bskor nas su/ /mdun du 'ja' tshon lta bur shar nas kyang*/ /skye med rang sgra'i tshig las 'di skad gsungs/ kyai ho/ bu yi gshis lugs rig pa nang du khug /chos rnams thams cad rmi lam gzugs brnyan te/ /bdag med gshis lugs gnyug ma mi skyong bar/ /tha mal 'gyu ba'i mya ngan ci zhig bya/ /bla ma dbyings rig 'du bral med pa la/ /'od gsal ngang gis ro gcig mi bsre bar/ /mtshan ma'i rgyangs 'bod dmigs gtad ci zhig bya/ /'o skol pha spad nam yang 'du 'bral med/ /de bas cir snang 'dzin med lam du khyer/ /nam yang yengs med tsittar sgoms shig ang*/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal ba dang*/ /'pho lung de yang 'don 'phro lus nas thal/ /rlung rig dag kyang rang mal tshud de 'dug /de yis bla ma dngos su mjal tsam byung*/ /chos sku rmi lam sgyu ma thugs bden bsam/ /sdug bsngal rnams kyang sangs sangs yal nas song*/ /slar yang gzhis ka dag tu log nas 'ong*/ /sku gdung de ni spur sbyang thon grabs 'dug

/gsol dpon legs bzang pa la smras nas su/ /bdag la dad rten ched du dam tshig rdzas/ /sku las babs pa'i bdud rtsi cung zhig gnang*/ /sang zhogs snga mor phyogs med 'grim 'gro smras/ /bdud rtsi de las babs pa'i dam rdzas ni/ khu tshur sbom pa tsam zhig gnang nas byung*/ /de yi zhogs nas rim par bgrod de song*/ /ti sgro mjal zhing gter rdzong dag tu phul/ /ti sgro'i chu tshan kha ru bsdad pa'i tshe/ /nub mo nyal ba'i gung thun rmi lam du/ /dge bsnyen sde bzhi mngon sum mdun du byung*/ /gter ston 'phral du byon pa da lan 'tshings/ /da lan dus kyi chad pa drag po yis/ /'bri gung mthil du yams nad mi bzod pa/ /phyi nad khrag skyugs nag po na bzhin yod/ /da lan khyed kyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab/ /sang nas 'phral du dgon par ma bsleb na/ /'go nad de yis mi thog 'bud pa yod/ /'di skabs brtul zhugs drag po ma bgyis na/ /gu ru'i gdams ngag zab mo chud zos yin/ /brtul zhugs ro snyom zhu'o he ru ka /de skad zer te ti sgror langs nas song*/ /de nas rgyang tsam song ba'i skabs su ni/ /nam mkha' dag kyang sangs sangs lang pa dang*/ /de yi zhogs khar skyes pa chung ngu zhig /ti sgro'i chu tshan kha ru slebs nas byung*/ /mi khyod su yin gar 'gro smras tsa na/ /nga ni 'bri gung mthil nas 'ong ba yin/ /thams cad 'go nad khrag skyugs na nas su/ /sngar yang yul mi mang po shi ste song*/ /bdag kyang nad g.yog byed pa'i mi yin pas/ /shi khar ti sgro bskor du 'ong ba yin/ /de skad zer te yid zhum ngus nas byung*/ /sngon ma shi ba gang tsam song smras pas/ /yul nas mi tshang 'ga' re rtsad brlag song*/ /dgon pa'i bla ma grwa pa 'ga' re 'das/ /da ni dgon bskyur bros 'gro zer nas 'dug /dgon pa'i phyogs kyi mgron po chad nas song*/ khyed kyang de ru byon sa med ces zer/ /de la bdag gis lan du smras nas su/

/nga ni brtul zhugs smyon pa'i rnal 'byor yin/ /'go nad 'dug na thog brdzis byed pa yin/ /yams nad de tsam bsre ba ma thub na/ /phyogs med ro snyom byed pa don go chung*/ /de bas khyod la bdag gis sngags chu sbyin/ /'chi chos ti sgro bskor ba los legs kyang*/ /cung zad khyod rang thang la sdod cig dang*/ /sngags chu dang ni byin rlabs sbyin no smras/ /mtshams gcod btang nas sngags chu kha ru byin/ rdzas rgod 'dogs sa e yod smras pa la/ /'di ru 'chi bar 'ong ba ma gtogs par/ /gos dang lus chas gang yang med ces zer/ /rdzas rgod kha ru byin dang lus la byugs/ /da ni khyod kyang tshe thar yin no smras/ /bden par mi shi sdod par yong ngam zer/ khyod tsam mi bslus gdams ngag ci byed smras/ /da ni khyed kyi zhabs zhu 'gro'o zer/ /de nas rim bzhin 'bri gung mthil du song*/ /gling smad rnams la 'go nad slebs nas su/ /thams cad gling stod phyogs su bros zin 'dug /bdag ni skyob pa'i sprul sku'i rtsa ru song*/ /de ru bsdad pa'i bla ma drag rim rnams/ /bdag la gus 'dud drag po dang bcas te/ /da lan nad 'di bcos lta mdzad rogs gyis/ /nged rnams bla ma zhing khams phebs pa dang*/ /grwa pa thams cad 'go nad 'dis shi na/ /chos dang bstan pa nyams par gdon mi za/ /srung ba sngags dang za yig mdzod ces zer/ /nub mo bdag gis lha 'dre ma 'dul bar/ /srung ba za yig byed rgyu mi 'ong smras/ /de nub dur khrod rten chags steng du song*/ /rang nyid gu ru drag po khyung zhon gyi/ /bskyed rim gsal btab lha srin dbang du bsdus/ /nad bdag rnams la drag sngags mtshon gyis brabs/ /de tshe 'go nad chad pa'i dam bca' byung*/ /tho rangs dgon pa'i gling du log ste 'ong*/ /sngags chu srung ba la sogs byin pa'i tshe/ /thams cad dga' tshor dpag med byed par 'dug /da ni nad bdag ar gtad byed dgos pas/

/da lta gling 'dir ro 'dra yod dam smras/ /gling smad tshes bcu bla ma gshegs pa yi/ /sku gdung da lta nang du lus yod zer/ /'o na de nyid nga la ston dang smras/ /nged rnams bstan par 'gro ru mi nus zer/ /'o na rgyang mig phyogs nas sgo slobs smras/ /rgyang mig phyogs nas khang pa bslabs te byung*/ /de tshe lag tu thun dang kha ṭwāṃ thogs/ /sgau mo phyes nas nang du 'gro ba'i tshe/ /bla ma khrag skyugs hreng thabs 'das nas 'dug /ngo sprod byas te 'pho lung spar ba dang*/ /thun gyis brabs nas kha ṭwāṃ snying khar bsnun/ /nad bdag bkug ste spyi bor phur pa btab/ /klad pa rol zhing snying khrag lan gsum 'thung*/ /phaṭ sgra sgrogs bzhin khang khyim thun gyis brabs/ /rang nyid skad cig khyung nag gsal btab nas/ /yan lag bsgrogs te sgo ru drud pa dang*/ /rkang dung btang nas mthing zhol bsgril te btang*/ /de nas rim bzhin phyi la phyin nas su/ /res 'ga' pang zhing res 'ga' khur ba dang*/ /res 'ga' drud sogs byas nas chu khar bzhag /dur gcod rgya mtsho tshar gcig btang ba dang*/ /phung po bshas nas yan lag zor du 'phang*/ /de tshe 'go nad chad pa'i rten 'brel byung*/ /ro snyom lta ba'i gdeng chen de ru bskyed/ /zhag gsum lam zhugs mgron po chad nas song*/ /de tshe yul gyi 'go nad thams cad chad/ /nad bdag dpung 'joms rten 'brel de nas 'grigs/ /de tshe rang gis rang la yid ches nas/ /gdeng ldan rtogs pa'i glu 'di blangs nas song*/ na mo gu ru/ gnas gshis lugs dbu ma'i yul rtse ru/ /dbyings 'du 'bral med pa nyi zla'i steng*/ /rje dus gsum sangs rgyas padma 'byung*/ /don rol pa las byung bha dra ba/ /pha mtshungs med rgyal ba'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bdag brtul zhugs smyon pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /pha gu ru'i rgyal sras rtsa gsum gling*/ /gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes paṇḍi ta/ /chos gsang sngags snying po'i mtshan nyid rtogs/

/rje tai lo nā ro'i bu rgyud de/ /phyi ro snyom snang ba dbang du sdud/ /nang gnas lugs dran pa'i rgyal sa zin/ /gnad rtsa rlung gar gyi 'khrul 'khor mkhan/ /bdud gnyis 'dzin 'dul ba'i gdams ngag zab/ /dus de ring rtogs pa'i mdangs bzang bskyed/ /tshig kha bshad drang don sgom pa la/ /rkyen phra mos 'go nad ma dar na/ /sgom mtshan ma'i lta stangs sus kyang byed/ /rkyen thog brdzis rang rtsal ma bsleb na/ /tshig gog pos ro snyom sus kyang nus/ /lar 'di phyi'i sa mtshams ma thug na/ /gos 'ba' la'i bla ma sus kyang 'ong*/ /dus de ring lag len pang du blangs/ /'di tho co'i kha drag ma bsam ste/ /rgyud bdag 'dzin bral ba'i bsre ba yin/ /bam dngos grub 'byung ba'i tshogs rdzas dang*/ /rje grub thob gong ma'i spyod pa yin/ /lam spang blang bral ba'i byed tshul yin/ /gnas dur khrod 'grims pa'i dgos pa yin/ /don nyams len myong ba'i rtags tshad yin/ /nad lhog rgod khrag skyugs dmar po la/ /grogs dbyer med gcig tu bsre ba 'di/ /bu spyod pa'i rang mdangs ma lags sam/ /dus snga phyi med pa'i grub thob pa/ /bam gdul bya sgyu ma lta bur rtogs/ /rkyen 'khrul snang sgyu mar sbyong ba'i tshe/ /rgyud rkang 'dren gnyis 'dzin byed ma myong*/ /don de tsam ro snyom skor bzhi yin/ /dus phyi mo'i chos pa khengs sems can/ /rkub rta phos mi khyogs 'gro mkhan tsho/ /tshe mi chos mgo bskor bgyis bgyis nas/ /dus ma 'ongs lha chos ma brjed dam/ /tshig snyan grags rna bas bsrungs bsrungs nas/ /tshe rten gyi 'dun ma ma brjed dam/ /dus nam yang che 'dod bgyis bgyis nas/ /gzhan phan bkur snying rje ma brjed dam/ /lar bzang ngan rnam rtog 'dzin 'dzin nas/ /lam ro snyom spyod pa ma brjed dam/ /tshig de dag mi brjed rgyud bskul gyis/ /don de dag gol ba'i bogs 'don gyis/ /gnad de dag phyi rabs yid la zhog

/bdag de bas rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim/ /dus de ring dngos grub chen po thob/ /gnas ti sgro brag dkar brtan par bzhugs/ /bam tshogs 'khor dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bzhes/ /rkyen tshogs drug yams nad 'khrul pa chod/ /dpal 'bri gdan brtan cing bkra shis shog /yul lha srin sku khams ci bder bzhugs/ /mgur dbyangs snyan bla ma rje la 'bul/ /nyams mtshar ro gnas lugs ngang la 'gro/ /gnad don gyi brgyud pas smin grol shog /de skad mgur ma thar thor blangs pa dang*/ /rim bzhin nyang kha phyogs su bgrod nas song*/ /'di skor dbus yul lung pa thams cad la/ /rten 'brel 'grigs dang ma 'grigs mang yod kyang*/ /nyung ngur bsdus te tshigs su bcad pa yin/ /de nas kong po'i phyogs su sleb pa'i tshe/ /yul phyogs gang 'gro rten 'brel brtags pa la/ /kong po che ru 'gro bar lung bstan byung*/ /sde pa padma drag ces tshang la ni/ /ma nges tshul gyis rten 'brel 'grigs pa byung*/ /rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po'i phyag dpe zung*/ kho yi khyim du 'dug pa zhib par bklags/ /de yi mtshan ltas shin tu legs pa byung*/ /de nas rim bzhin bang ri mdun du song*/ /'ja' tshon snying po'i chos khri rtsa bar bsdad/ /nub mo chos khri steng du dkar mes gtams/ /snga phyi dus kyi rten 'brel brtags pa las/ /de yang mtshan rtags shin tu bzang bar byung*/ /de yi zhogs la zho khar bgrod de song*/ /brag gsum gyen la dris pas 'ga' yod zer/ /de nas lo chen la rtsar song ba dang*/ /lo chen la yang chod zin mi 'dug zer/ /de nas ka ma lha brag mdun du song*/ /rdzis pa mang po ru ba bskyal nas ni/ /ru ba rnams kyang de ru bsdad nas song*/ /rnal 'byor pa khyod 'di ru bzhugs shig zer/ /nub mo bsdad nas dbang dang tshogs 'khor bskor/ /de tshe nyams dang rmi lam za zi la/ /bud med nag mo shin tu mi bzad gzugs/ /skra lo dmar ser rting par sham me ba/

/lag tu be con thod khrag thogs par byung*/ /bud med de yis bdag la smras nas su/ /sang zhogs gter ston byon pa'i lam kha ru/ /lha lung rdo rje brag ces bya ba ru/ /zab mo rin chen gter gyi skal ba yod/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i tshogs rdzas thogs nas byon/ kho mo nga ni ma cig re ti yin/ /sang zhogs byon skabs bu yi grogs mo bya/ /da ni dus bab gter rgya 'bul lo zer/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal te song*/ /de yi zhogs la sbyin bdag tshang de yis/ /mar sogs tshogs rdzas bzang po byin nas byung*/ /rim bzhin song bas gnas kyi rtsa bar slebs/ /nub mo brag phug 'dug par nang du bsdad/ /tshogs 'khor btang zhing rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs/ /de yi zhogs la gter rgya btsal du phyin/ /ma mos lung bstan ji bzhin gsal bar 'dug /tha tshig bsgrags nas gter sgo brdung ba'i tshe/ /rdo lhu thams cad rang yal bye bar gyur/ /shog ser gdan drangs dbang blangs gsol ba btab/ /gter rdzong brgyab ste gter rgya sngar ltar 'grigs/ /shog ser gang 'dug mjal kha zhus pa'i tshe/ /dpal chen phyag na rdo rje'i chos ka 'dug /smon lam btab ste lus la gces par 'chang*/ /bka' srung rnams la gtor ma legs par byin/ /dga' ston mgur dbyangs 'di bzhin blangs nas song*/ na mo gu ru/ pha mtshungs med rgyal dbang padma 'byung*/ /rje 'gro mgon sangs rgyas bla ma'i gzugs/ /bdag mos pa'i cod pan spyi bor 'dud/ /gnas kong yul bdud rigs mun pa can/ /chos zab mo rin chen dben pa'i yul/ /phag bya mo nag chags mang ba'i sa/ kha ma rab zho lad mur ba'i grong*/ /zas gtso bo gro skrags skam po'i lto/ /gos re thul thang zhu nag po gyon/ /tshe 'dun mar rab rib smyo chang 'thung*/ /mi pho mo dom nag lam shor mtshungs/ /yul mi la bltas na mtha' 'khob 'dra/ /gnas zab chos bltas na zhing khams 'dra/ /pha gu rus byin rlabs sbas pa'i yul/

/yul kong rong gsang sngags sdong po'i gling*/ /mi skal ba bzang po'i bag chags can/ kha phyogs gcig gtad nas don gcig byed/ /las 'phro mtha' gang 'dzin mtha' thon skyel/ /phyi lta spyod snang ba ma rab la/ /nang byed tshul babs gnas ya rab 'dug /gnas bzang po lha lung rdo rje'i brag /kong mun nag gsal ba'i sgron me mdzod/ /gnas ngo mtshar che'o rdo rje'i brag /ri rtse mo rdo rje'i brag phug 'dra/ /brag pho brang tsitta'i snying bshos 'dra/ /mdun gtsang chab g.yu 'brug gyen 'khyil 'dra/ /shing spang ljongs bya rgod phung ri 'dra/ /zhing grong gling maṇḍal tshom bu 'dra/ /gnas zhal gzigs dkyil 'khor sgo phyes 'dra/ /yul ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i sa/ /dpal dgyes pa rdo rje'i pho brang nyid/ /mgur glu mchod 'bul lo mnyes par mdzod/ /dus da lan gnas chen khams bzang bzhugs/ /dus yang yang mjal bar smon 'dun 'tshal/ /dpal de ring bkra shis dge legs shog /de skad bgyis te ar tsa nang du song*/ /byol song kha tsha na ba mang du bcad/ /zang zing sgyu ma'i 'bul ba mang du byung*/ /ma blangs myur 'gros ngang la phyin nas song*/ /nub mo ar tsa lha ri'i rdzong du bsdad/ /grwa pa rnams la 'pho lung khyad 'phags byin/ /de zhogs nub mo kong la'i rtsa bar song*/ /phyir nangs rngod kyi a la'i mdo ru slebs/ /de dgong khang stong 'dug pa'i nang du bsdad/ /de ru bu mo gcig tsam slebs nas byung*/ /grub thob rnal 'byor ga ru byon zhes zer/ /rten 'brel gang 'grigs lam du 'gro yin smras/ /nged rnams zam btsugs gnye bor byon ces zer/ /zam pa 'dzugs yun gang 'gor dris tsa na/ /zla phyed tsam zhig 'gor nas 'ong zer 'dug /'o na de 'dra sdod long med ces smras/ /de yi zhogs nas rnam rgyal dgon du phyin/ /phyir nangs snga zhogs shar shar song ba las/ /thugs tshol kha ru 'dzar khar yol tsam slebs/ /tshogs 'khor zhabs tog legs par drangs nas byung*/

/gtor ma btang nas mgyogs par bgrod de song*/ /rta mdar nyi ma phyed 'grib tsam du slebs/ /gar 'gro ma thig cung zad bltas pa'i tshe/ /btsun ma rnal 'byor chas gos byas pa zhig /bskor ba brgyab ste de ru slebs nas byung*/ /grub thob nga yi nang du phebs ces zer/ /de yi phyi la gyen du phyin pa'i tshe/ /de ring u rgyan ri la bskyal ba de/ /mchod khang nang du gdan 'dren zhus yod zer/ /'o na mjal du 'gro'o smras tsa na/ /thog mar gsol ja bzhes nas byon no zer/ /nang nas 'tsho ba'i bza' bca' legs par byas/ /u rgyan gu ru'i mchod khang mjal du phyin/ /kun gyis tshogs 'khor rdzas kyang khur nas byung*/ /tshogs 'khor bskor zhing spyan 'dren la sogs skabs/ /bag dro lhun chags gdangs dbyangs btang ba'i tshe/ /kun gyis mos gus gdung ba skyes nas song*/ /de yi nyin la rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ /dgong mo btsun ma de yi rtsa ru bsdad/ /'tsho ba 'bul sogs mjal mkhan mang du byung*/ /de yi phyir zhogs nyi ma phyed tsam du/ /grwa pa shar gsar zhig ni slebs nas byung*/ khyed kyi zhabs phyi ngas ni bya'o zer/ khyod 'dra zhabs phyi sngar yang yod ma myong*/ /dpon med g.yog med rgyal khams 'grims pa yin/ /da yang nga rang gcig pur ma gtogs pa'i/ khyod 'dras dam tshig thub ni mi 'ong smras/ kha 'jam ya pho zhig ni 'dug pa de/ kho ni stag sham pa yi grwa pa yin/ /srog la bab kyang dam tshig thub 'ong zer/ /de tshe kho yi mgo ru phur pa bzhag /bka' 'gal chad pa 'byung ba'i tha tshig bsgrags/ /phugs su 'brang gtsang med par ha go yang*/ /lo shas skyon med yong ngam bsam pa dang*/ /grwa pa de ni khrid de phyin nas song*/ /rim bzhin rdo shod dag tu song ba'i tshe/ /mgon po lha dar tshang la zhag gsum bsdad/ /tshe dbang stsal dang zhi khro tshar gcig bton/ /de ru don gcod sde pa phebs zhes thos/ /dgong mo srod 'phros zhig la bgrod nas 'ong*/

/spu de la zhes bya ba'i rtsa bar bsdad/ /zhogs la wa ke rten lung tshang du phyin/ /de nyin dbang bskur chos bshad legs par byas/ /de yi nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /sbyin bdag tshang gi kau rī ma de yis/ /da lan bla ma rag ne brag tu byon/ /de yi grogs mo nga yis legs par bya/ /yang gsang rdo rje phur pa'i chos ka yod/ /sang zhogs nga yang khrid rogs gyis shig zer/ /de ma thag tu gnyid yang sad nas 'dug /zhogs la bdag gis grwa par skad cha dris/ /'di ru rag ne brag ces e yod smras/ /shwa sa mdo yi phu la yod ces zer/ /zhogs nas de ru mgyogs par phyin nas song*/ /rim bzhin rag ne brag tu song ba dang*/ /de ru yod pa'i grong pa thams cad kyis/ /gdan 'dren zhus nas zhabs tog legs par byung*/ /phyir zhogs grong pa'i mi rnams thams cad kyis/ /tshogs rdzas thogs te gnas nang bgrod de song*/ /tshogs 'khor btang zhing sba thabs gsang gter byas/ kha byang cung zad bris nas de ru bzhag /de khar zla shas gcig gnyis sdod bsam kyang*/ /ko dmar mgo zhes bya ba'i mi zhig gis/ kha ngan smra ba 'ga' re byas byung bas/ /rten 'brel ma 'grigs rim par bgrod nas 'ong*/ /ba gor rdzong nas yar tsam phyin pa dang*/ khyung tho la ru 'gro bar chas pa la/ /cung zad rten 'brel ma 'grigs phyir log brgyab/ /shing rong thang nag gru la bgrod nas song*/ /gru pas ring chad gru la ma phud pas/ /rlung thog drag po 'dra yang phebs dgos byung*/ /de nas shing rong dag la phyin nas song*/ /zhag gsum tsam la rgyang shod sa mdor slebs/ /de yi nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /mi dkar chas bzang dpa' bo'i rnam pa can/ /shel rmog khrab dang go mtshon thogs pa yi/ /che btsan dpon g.yog sum cu tsam du byung*/ /bdag la shin tu dgyes tshul dang bcas par/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i mdzes chas phul nas ni/ /gter ston rang yul phebs par rten 'brel 'grigs/

/da ni 'gro don 'dul zhing dus la bab/ /smin grol chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /sa rtags dus dang gnas skabs 'grigs pa yin/ /mi ring ba ru nga yi gnas su phebs/ /bdag kyang khyed kyi bka' bstan zab mo skyong*/ /sang nas 'gro don mgo mo 'dzugs dgos zer/ /de la bdag gis lan du 'di skad smras/ khyod cag su yin deng sang gang du 'gro/ /yul ni gang yin cho 'brang ci ltar yin/ /bdag ni da lta bya btang skabs yin pas/ /'di nas rong btsan gangs la ma bsleb bar/ /sbas tshul nges med rnal 'byor dgos pa yin/ /spyir yang zang zing dkor sdud byed mi 'dod/ /ma hā gu rus bdag la bka' stsal nas/ /dpon med g.yog med gyis shig gsungs pa yin/ /snyan grags chung na chags sdang dgra las rgyal/ /rnam g.yeng med na dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel/ /dgra nor nyung na sku tshe shugs kyis ring*/ /bdag ni dben pa'i brag phug rang la mos/ /lung ma bstan gyi spyod pa nyams kyang mtshar/ khyed kyis zhu na rang gis rten 'brel bsgrig /bdag ni da rung lo bdun red pa'i mtshams/ /'gro don 'dul zhing dus la bab pa yin/ /de tshun tha mal tshul du sdod dgos yod/ khyod kyis nga red gzhan la ma shod smras/ /de la dkar phyogs skyong bas lan btab nas/ /skyes bu chen po sems spobs chung mi nyan/ /bdag ni mdo khams yul gling kun gyi dbus/ /gnas chen lnga yi yon tan 'byung ba'i ri/ /jo bo gze rgyal ma yo gangs kyi ri/ /gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i pho brang ste/ /bdag ni dkyil 'khor de dag skyong ba yi/ /lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba zhes bya yin/ /rigs ni he ru ka yi rgyud pa yin/ /rus ni 'khor 'das kun gyi mtshams su gnas/ /cho 'brang mtho zhing dkar phyogs skyong ba yin/ /gter ston sngar yang nyams dang za zi la/ /gnas der lan gcig phebs pa mi dgongs sam/ /da lan 'dul zhing dus la bab pa yin/ /rten 'brel 'grigs tshe chos 'khor ma bskor na/

/phyir bzhag 'gro don gang 'byung cha mi chod/ khyed nyid gu ru'i rgyal tshab yin pa la/ /sprang chas bya btang byed nas su la sba/ /yon tan brjod na nang don gzhan gyis rig /kun gyi dad pa thob cing 'brel ba thob/ khyed kyis kun la sbas nas 'byon na yang*/ /bdag gis sang nas kun la khyab par byed/ /bstan pa'i me ro khyed kyis bslangs dgos pas/ /rong btsan gangs la re zhig bdag gis bshol/ /de bas 'di yi phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad na/ /zab mo rin chen gter gyi skal ba yod/ /yul 'dir bdud kyi sprul pa gsum yod pas/ /sang nas dbang bsdus dam la ma bzhag na/ /rdo rje theg pa'i bstan la gnod par yod/ /yul gru sa mtshams 'di dag rdzogs pa'i tshe/ /gter ston rang mi rang yul phebs par zhu/ /de skad zer nas 'ur 'ur log ste song*/ /de nas rgyang tsam song mtshams nam yang langs/ /de yi zhogs nas grong pa thams cad kyis/ /shin tu dad cing gnas su gdan 'dren byas/ /dgong mo dbang dang chos bshad dgos zhes zer/ /dbang bskur mi shes chos kyang bshad mi shes/ /sang nas 'gro dgos yod ces smras pa dang*/ khyed cag rnying ma'i bla ma 'dra bar 'dug /bod yul dbus nas byon pa'i bla ma la/ /gang yang mi dgongs gsung na thugs mi dag /'di ru zhag bdun bar du bzhugs rogs mdzod/ /sde 'dis dad 'dun gus 'dud che ba la/ /cis kyang dbang chos gnang rogs dgos zhes zer/ /de tshe bdag gis bsam blo bskor ba las/ /sngar gyi rmi lam dag kyang bden pa 'dra/ /chos 'khor bskor zhes rten 'brel che bar 'dug /grong 'dir dbang bskur phran bu byas pa dang*/ /de nas sba thabs bya ste bgrod 'gro bsam/ /de yi dgong mo khrom dbang zhig bskur bas/ /kun gyis bla ma khams chen yin 'dug zer/ /phyir nangs zhogs nas stong khrom tsam zhig byung*/ /rnying ma'i bla ma khams chen yin 'dug 'di/ /rdo rje brag pa 'dra zhig yin 'ong zer/

/bdag gis de 'dra ma yin smras pa'i tshe/ /yin min rang lugs chos kyis 'byed 'dug zer/ /de nas zhag po bzhi tsam song ba dang*/ /nag ru sde pa chos 'grub ces bya bas/ /de ru phebs zer gdan 'dren btang nas byung*/ /de ru song te zhag gsum tsam bsdad nas/ /bka' brgyad la sogs dbang lung 'ga' re gnang*/ /de nas sa mdor song nas zhag bdun mtshams/ /zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i zhal yang phyes/ /kun la dag snang dpag med thob par gyur/ /yul der ngang zo rtogs ldan yin zer bas/ /'brug pa'i bla ma 'dra zhig byon nas 'dug kho yi dkor la gnod par 'dug bsam nas/ /yul der dis mgo dgon pa zhes bya ba'i/ /dge lugs dgon pa rwa gyong lta bu des/ /'brug pa'i bla ma'i phyogs 'dzin gtam byas nas/ /dgon pa de yis ngan btsan tshul la ni/ /dgos dgos mang po 'dra zhig zer nas 'dug /phran bur byin zhing gtam bzang legs po smras/ /'bul ba zang zing mang po byung ba de/ /zhi khro la sogs gton nas med par byas/ /dpon slob gcig gnyis bza' bcas 'dang tsam zhig khyer nas sbas thabs 'gro dgos bsam pa'i tshe/ /de yi nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /bud med sngon mo gser gyi rna cha can/ /rin chen rgyan cha 'ga' res spras nas su/ /lag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram thogs/ /g.yon pas tshe bum dkar po bzung nas su/ /gter ston rtse drug gnas la byon dgos yod/ /lam 'gag shar shar bgrod pa'i dus ma yin/ /gnas der zab mo gter gyi skal ba yod/ /da lan chos kyi grogs mo bdag gis bgyi/ /gu ru rje yis bdag la bka' stsal byung*/ khyod kyi sku tshe'i bar chad 'phrang dag ni/ kho mo bdag gis sgrol ba'i rtel 'brel yod/ /de skad zer nas gser gyi rdo rje dang*/ /bum pa bcas te bdag la gtad nas byung*/ /bdag gis de la dri ba byas nas su/ khyed ni su yin ming la ji skad zer/ /gnas dang sa yul dag ni gang yin smras/

/bu mo de yis bdag la lan btab nas/ /bu mo sngo sangs de yi zhal na re/ /bdag ni las kyi mkha' gro'i sprul pa ste/ /ming ni kau rī puṇyai bya ba yin/ khar sang gter ston phebs pa'i dus la yang*/ /dbang bskur byin rlabs thams cad zhus pa yin/ /nga ni 'jig rten sha gzugs yod pa yin/ /bla ma rgod tshang phebs dang slebs yong gsung*/ /de ma thag tu 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /gnyid sad nam mkha' dag kyang langs nas 'dug /zhogs nas rim bzhin sbyin bdag mang po dang*/ /rta khal la sogs hrag par bgyis nas su/ /rta shod bye ma ri brgyud rtse drug gnas/ /rgod tshang dben pa'i ri la bgrod nas song*/ /de tshe rgod tshang dgon gyi mthong nas ni/ /bsu chang dang bcas ban btsun mang bar byung*/ /de nas rim bzhin rgod tshang song ste bsdad/ /zhag shas re zung tsam la phyogs 'gram sogs/ /'ong mkhan mang bas mtshams sgrub byed ma khom/ /de kha'i mtshams nas gu drag sgrub par bsdad/ /zhag bdun tsam zhig 'gro ba'i nub mo ru/ /tho rangs nyams dang rmi lam za zi la/ /mkha' spyod u rgyan yul nas yin zer ba'i/ /bud maid dmar mo zangs kyi a ṭa can/ /phyag na me long shel gyi mchod rten bzung*/ /dar zab gos dang ratnas brgyan pa zhig /bdag gi mdun du lhags nas 'di skad zer/ /kyai ho skal ldan shes rab can/ /mchog gyur lo tsā'i dwangs ma'i phud/ /gnubs ban skye ba blo graus can/ /rgyal ba'i sras gcig legs par nyon/ /bdag gis snying gtam tshig gsum smra/ /da res bcad rgya mdzad pa legs/ /da nas spyod lam 'di ltar dgos/ /'khor gsum yang dag pha rol na/ /bslab gsum 'gog pa'i bsrung sdom med/ /rang shes gnas lugs pha rol na/ /thos bsam sbyang ba'i 'bad rtsol med/ /tshogs drug sgyu ma'i pha rol na/ /lam khyer spyod pa'i dgag sgrub med/ /chos rnams bdag med pha rol na/ /sna tshogs grub mtha' btsal du med/ /shes rig kun 'byung pha rol na/

/'phags pa'i nor bdun bsgrub tu med/ /snang srid stong pa'i pha rol na/ /bag chags phung po sbyang du med/ /bzang ngan rgyu gcig pha rol na/ /spang blang dge ba bsgrub tu med/ /gang shar chos sku'i pha rol na/ /spang rtogs ro snyom btsal du med/ /rang lus dkyil 'khor pha rol na/ /mtshon byed gzhal yas btsal du med/ /dran rig yi dam pha rol na/ /spros bsgyur stong ra btsal du med/ /'byung 'jug sngags kyi pha rol na/ /bzlas brjod 'bad pa btsal du med/ /ka dag gnyug ma'i pha rol na/ /gnas 'gyu'i shes pa bsgrub tu med/ /gcig shar don gyi pha rol na/ /tshig tshogs grub mthas btsal du med/ /mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod pha rol na/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho btsal du med/ /rten 'brel lung rigs pha rol na/ /mkhas pa'i lo tsā btsal du med/ /bka' gtad lung zin pha rol na/ /chos can dbang lung btsal du med/ /brda bzhi mkha' 'gro'i pha rol na/ /gab pa mngon phyung btsal du med/ /rlung lnga nus smin pha rol na/ /'ja' lus yid smon btsal du med/ /'gyur bzhi'i gdams ngag pha rol na/ /lam bzhi'i man ngag btsal du med/ /yul kun dag phyogs pha rol na/ /bag chags rang yul btsal du med/ /tshig de ni gol sa'i mtha' gcod yin/ /don de ni bag yod blo yis zungs/ /sang nas nyin phyed rta yi dus/ /rin chen gter gyi skal ba yod/ /rten 'brel tshogs 'khor legs par grabs/ /'di nas cung zad 'das pa'i mtshams/ /brag dkar seṅge gshibs 'dra'i rtser/ /rgya rtags ri mo lam gyis yod/ /de ru rten 'brel legs par zungs/ /brda de bsgrub nas mi ring bar/ /sbas tshul rong chen bzhi la nyul/ /de nas mi ring de dag la/ /smin pa'i 'bras bu dus 'dir mchis/ /brda de yid la gnas par bcag /dha hi ka ni si ta tre/ /ha ri dhu yang bha ra yi/ /ga ta saja na ri ha/ /de skad zer nas mkha' ru thim nas song*/ /cung zad lon pas nam yang gsal te 'dug
