/langs shing thugs dam byas nas bsdad pa dang*/ /saṅgā tā res zhogs ja khur nas byung*/ /de la rten 'brel tshig gis bgyis pa ni/ /de ring ri bskor byed par 'gro'am smras/ /slob dpon dgongs mod ngas ni mi shis zer/ /nyi ma shar tsam grwa pa slebs nas byung*/ /de ring ri bskor byed du e 'gro smras/ /ma 'gro kha ba nang du mi thar zer/ /de nas rten 'brel ma 'grigs bsdad pa yis/ /zhag po bcu tsam song ba'i dus nyin par/ /sngar ltar lung bstan rten 'brel legs par byung*/ /nyi ma shar dros dus kyi skabs su ni/ /sngar gyi rmi lam ngogs su byung ba yi/ /bu mo de yis chang zom khur ba dang*/ /zla grogs zung bcas bla ma mjal du byung*/ /rten 'brel kha chos tshig dri 'di ltar bgyis/ khyed gnyis padma bkod du e 'gro smras/ /bla mas khrid na nged rnams 'gro'o zer/ /de ring gnas bskor byed du e 'gro smras/ /bla ma phebs na nged rnams 'gro'o zer/ /de yis rten 'brel legs par byung ba dang*/ /tshogs rdzas grabs nas sgo rtsar slebs pa'i tshe/ /don skor zhig nas grwa pa slebs nas byung*/ /grwa pas had de smras pa'i tshig la ni/ /de ring kha char mun rub 'di'i nang la/ /lam nas mi thar stong log yin no zer/ /de yis rten 'brel ma 'grigs nang du log /bdag kyang yid blo cung zad zhum pa dang*/ /da ni mi 'dug 'gro bsam yid la 'chang*/ /zla shas tsam zhig bsdad pa'i nub mo zhig /yo byad phran bu tsam zhig khyer nas ni/ /rim par sbas pa'i tshul du phyin nas song*/ /de nas gyang sngon thang la sleb pa dang*/ /kun gyis ha go dbang bskur zhu'o zer/ /de gar dbang lung gnang nas zhag gcig bsdad/ /de nas sba thabs bgrod 'gro bsam pa'i tshe/ /ngang zo dgon nas dge slong zhig 'das pas/ /'pho 'debs byed du de ru 'gro dgos byung*/ /de nas song bas kha lung bya ba ru/ /nub mo phyi 'phros tsam du 'byor ba dang*/

/rim par gnas la bgrod 'gro bsam pa'i tshe/ /yul de'i dpon dang rgan po thams cad kyis/ /'di ru chos ra legs 'dzug gnang dgos zer/ /de la lan du bdag gi 'di ltar smras/ /dbang chas sgar spyad chos ra byed pa la/ /nga ni bya bral chas med mi yong zhing*/ /lhag par rgyal mo rong du 'gro dgos yod/ /sbyin bdag rnams la dgongs pa zhu'o smras/ khong rnams thams cad nan cher byed pa dang*/ /dbang chas sgar spyad gang dgos nged la yod/ /ca lag thogs med 'grigs par yod ces zer/ /bdag gis bsam blo zhib tu bskor ba la/ /dus bab 'gro don rtags shig yin 'dra bas/ /dbang khrid lung gis re ba bskang ngo bsam/ /sbyin bdag rnams la legs par yong ngo smras/ /de ru dbang khrid sbrags mar byas nas ni/ /zla ba phyed gnyis tsam du zin par bsdad/ /de tshe yul gyi mi rnams pho mo la/ /rab kyis gnas lugs rang ngo shes pa dang*/ /tha mas gnas 'gyu srung shes tsam du byung*/ /de nas dbang khrid grol ba'i zhag 'ga'i mtshams/ /bla ma yai shes rgyal mtshan dpon slob 'ga'/ /grong pa de ru don skor byon nas byung*/ /gsung gleng la sogs zhib rgyas byas pa dang*/ /'brong pa rdo shul phyogs su phebs zhes zer/ /de nas zhag 'ga' 'das pa'i mtshams su ni/ /bla ma brtan pa tshang la phyin nas song*/ /dbang lung gnang nas rtel 'brel zhag gsum bsdad/ /de nas rdo shul 'ga' res gdan 'dren byung*/ /lam zhag gzho mda' bya bar bsdad pa'i tshe/ /nub mo nyal ba'i gung thun rmi lam la/ /dmag dpon 'dzi rgyal yin zer bdud chas can/ /go khrab rmog zhu ral gri ru mtshon can/ /rta nag rting dkar zhon pa dpon g.yog bdun/ /bdag gi mdun du byung nas 'di skad zer/ /gter ston da ltar byon pa rten 'brel 'grigs/ /ngas ni deng 'dir thab bsu byed pa dang*/ /'phral phugs la sogs gtam 'gar zhu ba yod/ /da lan mdo smad byon pa'i rten 'brel med/

/yul 'di'i gtso bo jo bo gze rgyal yin/ /de yi 'khor du nged 'dra rtsa gnyis yod/ /de rnams kun la gter dang gnas sgo yod/ /'byed pa'i dus dang rten 'brel khyed nyid yin/ /sngon dus rgyal bas lung bstan mang du yod/ /da ni 'byon lam rten 'brel rong 'di yin/ /de khar gu ru lung zhes sgrub gnas yod/ /de nas rgyang tsam song ba'i mtshams dag la/ /dmu bdud klu btsan bya ba'i ri yi mdun/ /lcags sdig nag po'i lto rgyab 'dra ba'i snar/ /ma hor zlog pa'i chos bka' zab mo yod/ /de nas cung zad 'das pa'i mtshams dag la/ /rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa bya ba la/ /'chi maid tshe sgrub gnas dang chos bka' yod/ /de ltar 'phral du rten 'brel de dag zungs/ /ji bzhin ma nor legs par 'grigs pa'i tshe/ /stod hor sde gsum 'phral du bzlog par 'gyur/ /de nas rim bzhin kha byang bstun ces zer/ /byin rlabs zhus te rang sar log nas song*/ /de nas tho rangs skabs su sleb pa dang*/ /gangs rgyal lha btsan yin zer dpon g.yog gsum/ /mi dkar chas bzang zhwa dkar ldan par 'dug /chu rgyud dge bsnyen yin zer dpon g.yog gsum/ /dbyibs ni mi lus ma he'i gdong pa can/ kha yi nang dang yan lag mi gis brgyan/ /'khor ni mi lus sbrul gdong can du 'dug /thams cad zhabs bro khrig khrig byed pa dang*/ /lha btsan dpon g.yog gsum gyi zhal na re/ /gze rgyal jo bos bdag ni mngags pa yin/ /gter ston thog mar gnas der phebs zhes zer/ /chu rgyud dge bsnyen de yi zhal na re/ /nga ni mangs mda' zhes pa'i chu gling nas/ /dgos 'dod nor sgrub 'bul gyis 'ong ba yis/ /gter ston snga ma de ru phebs zhes zer/ /de tshe bdag gis de la lan btab par/ /lha 'dre mi gsum byed las spyod 'gros gcig /chad mdo'i tshig la thog mar gtso bo ste/ /snga sor 'dzi rgyal lung bstan ji bzhin 'gro/ /slad mar khyed rang rnam gnyis sngar rim bzhin/

/phyogs rim 'byon pa'i rten 'brel bya'o smras/ kho rang rnams kyang rang sar log nas song*/ /de yi zhogs la gzhig 'brel btang ba dang*/ /ji bzhin 'di ni lung bstan yin 'dug pas/ /sa smad phyogs su song yang don med 'dra/ /de bas cis kyang 'dir phyogs sdod dgos grags/ /yid la de ltar 'chang ste grabs byas nas/ /grwa par rten 'brel brtags pas tshig 'di smras/ /de ring rong 'di rgyud nas 'gro'am smras/ /grwa pa de yis lan mo bgyis nas su/ /rong nag 'di las thar yang mi srid la/ /thar kyang mi 'gro rta khal dka' las che/ /de bas 'gra la rgyag nas byon na dga'/ /cis kyang khyed rang dpon slob byon dgos na/ /ngas ni rta khal 'tshags nas sdod kyis zer/ /de la bdag gis gzhig 'brel bgyis nas su/ /sngon yang rten 'brel ma 'grigs 'di la thug /'gro sar mi 'gro sdod sar mi chags pa/ /'di ni bdud rigs kho na yin 'dug pas/ /da ni bzhag ste nga rang 'gro'o bsam/ khal ma rnams dang chas ka thams cad ni/ /grwa par sbrags nas ske gzhung gyen la btang*/ /zhag po gnyis gsum mtshams su grwa pa des/ /gser dngul g.yu sogs chas ka gang khyag cig /sdos bcas khur nas gzhan du bros so skad/ /de la dkor bdag rnams kyang phyir 'brangs byas/ kho yi chas rnams mi gzhan lag tu shor/ kho rang smyo 'bog 'khrugs nas yod ces thos/ /de ni dam log gnod 'tshe bsgrub yin skad/ /da lta'i dus dang ma 'ongs thams cad du/ /'khor 'bangs ngan pa de 'dra srung mas sgrol/ /de nas dpon slob gsum tsam bgyis pa de/ /sa mdor bla tshang sbra ru phyin nas bsdad/ /dag snang byung tshul gsung gleng zhib par byas/ /de nas ba sog shog khag de dag gis/ /bla tshang de ru gdan 'dren byas nas song*/ /nged cag dpon slob rnams kyang byon ces zer/ /grol dil bya bar sgar pa brgyab nas bsdad/ /bla tshang dpon slob dmangs rnams thams cad ni/

/ba sha tshang la zhi khro 'don par byon/ /nged cag dpon slob phyag rgya rig 'dzin la/ /dza ha bhi ri'i snyan brgyud dgos zer bas/ /snyan brgyud dang ni mkha' 'gro drug skor gyi/ /zab lam gsang khrid la sogs mang bar khrid/ /de tshe khang par rlung rtags thon par 'dug /zhag po gnyis tsam song ba'i mtshams shig la/ /bcu bzhi nub mo nyams snang za zi ru/ /lha bdud btsan gsum cha lugs 'dzin pa la/ /rang 'dra'i 'khor gyis bskor ba dum pa zhig /bdag gi mdun du byung nas 'di skad zer/ /gter ston 'di ru phebs nas ci tsam song*/ /nged rnams lha sar dmag la 'gro dgos byung*/ /bod kyi mgur lha'i dpon po mi la shor/ /da lta nged rnams ra mda' log tsam yin/ /slar cung zad nyams dang smas 'dug pas/ /rang tshugs zin tsam mi zin phyed char 'dug /nged rnams 'phral du 'byor ba ma lags na/ /sa rtags dus skabs 'chug la nye sing grags/ /da ni 'di phyogs nyid kyi gter gnas dai/ /sang zhogs tshes pa bco lnga'i dus nyin la/ /rin po che las dras pa'i sa yi ming*/ /ma hor zlog pa'i chos bka' zab mo yod/ /'phral du de 'byin dbab cing ma spel na/ /mdo stod bzhag ra lha rtse'i yan chod la/ /ma hor bdud kyis dmyal thag gcod lags pas/ /rten 'brel dus bab yin pas ma 'gyang zer/ /de tshe bdag gis de la lan btab nas/ /'o na rten 'brel de ltar bzung dgos na/ /sa rtags rten 'brel lam kha gang la 'dri/ /'beb dang spel ba'i yul phyogs gang du byed/ /grogs dang rten 'brel 'dzin stangs ji ltar rigs/ /snga ma bdag gis gter rgya gsang shing sbas/ /bya btang sprang po'i spyod pa 'ba' zhig bsten/ /yig bris chas sogs shog leb tsam yang med/ /gter rgya da lta'i skabs su 'grol ba la/ /gegs rkyen legs nyes la sogs mi 'byung ngam/ khyad par bdag gis khrom gter bgyis pa la/ /mi sogs mgo skor bslu ba ma yin nam/

/ji bzhin rgyal ba'i lung dang ldan lags sam/ /bdag ni spyir yang bya btang mos pa dang*/ /dus ngan 'di 'drar rang mgo thon pa gtso/ /gter ston la sogs grags che mngon 'dod kyis/ /'gro don med la rang srog bskyal ba mang*/ /bsnyen bkur med la chags sdang skye ba'i rgyu/ /des na gter srung khyed rnams ngo ma na/ /ji bzhin lung bstan phyi nang 'phrod par dgos/ /de phan bdag ni bya btang skyes bu la/ /gu ru rje yi thugs kyis ma khrel zhing*/ /ma sring mkha' 'gros bka' chad btang ma myong*/ /gnas lugs rang tsho seng ltar zin pa yin/ /lha srin rnams kyang tha tshig ma nor cig /ces pa'i tshig de brjod par bgyis pa la/ /lha bdud btsan gyis de la lan btab nas/ /nged rnams rgyal bas lung bstan gnyer gtad de/ /bka' srung shan pa sde gsum bya ba yin/ /rig 'dzin khyod nyid buddha dzñā na'i dus /nged rnams bstan pa skyong ba'i tha tshig yod/ /de phyir nged rnams dus min cho 'phrul min/ /da ni gter gyi sa rtags bstan pa ni/ /sang zhogs gdan 'dren byed mkhan btang nas 'ong*/ /'byon pa'i lam khar rgya rtags ma nyams yod/ /brtul zhugs yid gnyis spongs la 'don par gyis/ /'bebs pa'i gnas ri grong dil ming 'di legs/ /spel ba'i yul ni gangs can ri bzhir dgos/ khyad par rdo rje theg chen dar ba'i gnas/ /sbas yul sa rtags skyong ba'i srog yin pas/ /padma bkod kyi phyogs su spel bar gyis/ /gnas der chos 'di 'phrod na don dang ldan/ /de yi zung du 'brel ba'i rten 'brel ni/ /gter gnas 'di yi drung du skyes pa yi/ /sngon tshe khyed nyid buddha dzñā na'i dus/ /slob ma padma swa ma'i skye ba zhig /da lta sbas yul phyogs su gnas yod pas/ /mtshams kyi grogs dag de yis byas kyang rung*/ khyad par skyes chen chos bdag kun gyi nang*/ /ye shes ming la 'phrod na shin tu dar/ /sde skyong sa 'dzin mi dbang kun gyi nang*/

/nam mkha'i ming la 'phrod na shin du dar/ /ghu ha si tri bhi ha la ti gnyis/ /de 'dra'i lag tu shor na yul kun phung*/ /de bas chos bdag spel la shin du brtag /da ni khyed nyid 'gro don dus bab yin/ /gter 'di gsang dang gud du sba dgos med/ /tshe 'dir sba nas phyi ma su la spel/ /de bas 'gro don chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus/ /nged rnams bran gyis zhabs phyi zhu lags pas/ /brda dang rten 'brel yid la bcag ces zer/ /de nas rim bzhin 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /de yi zhogs la nyi ma rtse shar dus/ /ba sha tshang gis gdan 'dren btang nas byung*/ /bang chen de yi ming ni dri ba'i tshe/ /karma zhes bya'i ming yin zer nas 'dug /de ni phrin las 'jug phyir rten 'brel legs/ /rim bzhin lam kha dag la song ba'i tshe/ /sngar lung bzhin du rgya rtags lam mer 'dug /dpon slob nyi shu skor tsam byas nas su/ /rdos brdung brag bshig gter rgya phyes pa'i tshe/ /bdud 'dul drag po'i las kyi shog dril ni/ /a ma ta la shing lpags shog dṛl 'dug /dbang bzhi blangs nas smon lam legs par btab/ /ba sha tshang gis tshogs chas khyer nas byung*/ /tshogs 'khor btang bas rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ /tshogs 'khor thon nas sbyin bdag nang du song*/ /bkra shis 'bum gyis mjal dar phul byung bas/ /mtshams sbyor ming gis rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ /de yi nub mo grong de'i sgar du song*/ /shog bu la sogs bca' gzhi legs par 'grigs/ /zhogs la nor bu bsam 'phel gling du song*/ /zhag lngar mtshams su bcad de gter chos phab/ /dbang drag padma khro rgyal kī la ya/ /snang srid zil gnon rtsa gsum 'dus pa grub/ kho bo'i brda lung hūm̐ nag drag po rtsal/ /gsang mtshan kā la sidhi dzwa la zhes/ /lung byang gab pa brda bkrol de ru btsug /de skabs nyung bsdus mgur 'di blo yis dpag na mo/ dbyings dgongs pa rgya mtsho'i spyi bo'i steng*/

/pha 'gran gyis zla bral padma 'byung*/ /drin 'khor med gtsug rgyan bha dra'i zhabs/ /blo gdung ba'i padmo'i 'dzum des 'dud/ /mi kho bo phyogs bcur bya btang ba/ /nyams mkhos chung bdag gi pha gcig de/ /rje nor bu pad 'byung 'od rab 'byin/ /gter dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i drin po che/ /bdag de ring gsang rgya mngon du ston/ /bu khengs 'dod snyan grags ma lags te/ /dbyings ḍākki'i rtags rgya bzo med 'di/ /rje gong mas gzigs na grub thob 'dra/ /ma mkha' 'gros gzigs na dpa' bo 'dra/ /mi zog paus bltas na tha mal 'dra/ /dmangs phal pas bltas na smyo spyod 'dra/ /bdud 'byung pos bltas na brtul zhugs 'dra/ /gos phyi tshul bltas na bya bral 'dra/ /nang gnas lugs bltas na sangs rgyas 'dra/ /de mi la mi mngon lha la mngon/ /bka' snang srid lha 'dres bsu ba byung*/ /gter bka' skyong rnams kyis phrin las sgrub/ /lung brda rtags ri mo rtags tsam go /mi skal ldan rnams ni dad pa skyes/ /mi rang snang can dag chags sdang langs/ /mi bdud rigs can gyis bar chad brtsam/ /mi las ngan dmangs kyis sgro skur 'debs/ /dus deng sang mi las lha 'dre drag /dad gdung shugs lung bstan rgyan du che/ /mi phal cher dud 'gro gti mug phag /phar phyogs bcur bltas nas lam ngan bsnyegs/ /zas bcud bzang bor nas mi gtsang za/ /tshig don med cho nge'i rjes su 'brangs/ /de rtsod ldan dus mtha'i cho 'brangs yin/ /bu nga 'dra bya rgyal khyung gi bu/ /lam mthong rtsal sgro gshog sgo ngar rgyas/ /don gcig shes kun grol mkha' la gdeng*/ /sa thob 'os bral bas gnam 'phang gcod/ /dus de ring rang rtsal rgyan du che/ /mi skal ldan padmo blo re grol/ /bdud mu stegs dam sri'i rgol ba bcom/ /gter yid bzhin nor bu mngon par bstod/ /yul gter gnas lha bdud zhal kha 'jam/ /dad sbyin bdag pho mo sku khams bzang*/ /bu bslab sbyang med pa'i drag po rtsal/

/tshig 'chad rtsod sdeb sbyor mi shes kyang*/ /chos kun gyis thos par 'chad pa yin/ /tshig tha snyad gzhom na rtsod pa yin/ /don sdeb sbyor mthun na brtsam pa yis/ /glu kha bshad sgyu ma'i tshig tshogs la/ /thugs khrel med dgongs pa so mar bzhugs/ /des mnyes shing gnas ri bzang por 'bul/ /dus deng sang dge bshes ca co tsho/ /blo ban bun shag kha mi gnang bar/ /mi sprang po'i rang gshis red dgongs gsan/ /glu 'di ni pha gcig rje la 'bul/ /don de ni kun snang dga' ston shog /ces pa'i glu ni thar thor blangs pa dang*/ /bla ma bde mchog la sogs dpon slob 'ga'/ /spo bo'i phyogs su byon grabs 'dug pa la/ /rten 'brel ched phyir kī la'i chos tshan bskur/ /rmi lam lung bstan ji bzhin ma nor na/ /'di yi mtshams su smon lam la brten nas/ /phyi 'phro mi nyams 'ong bsam bden tshig brjod/ /chos bdag rnams ni rgyus med dag ma la/ /chos tshan bskur kyang yid gnyis za gyur na/ /phyi 'phro nyams 'ong bsams nas rang sar bzhag /de nas rim bzhin ske gzhung rgyud de song*/ /rdo shul phal cher rnams kyis gdan 'dren byung*/ /rab gnas byin rlabs me tog bkra shis byas/ /de nas la dmar nang du song ba'i tshe/ /bla ma dkon mchog dpon slob byon nas byung*/ /thugs nang dag pas gsung 'phros zhib par byas/ /rim bzhin dkon mchog dpon slob tshang la song*/ /nub mo zhig tu nyal ba'i rmi lam la/ /mi ring dmar po mdung dmar thogs pa zhig /yud kyis bdag gi mdun du sleb pa dang*/ /dgyes tshul byas nas 'di skad smra bar 'dug /gter ston mkha' 'gro snying phug phebs mdzod dang*/ /'chi med tshe sgrub zab mo'i skal ba yod/ /bdag gis phrin las ji bzhin bsgrub par byed/ /grogs kyang dha hi dharma zhes yin zer/ /gzhan yang lung bstan 'ga' re byas nas song*/ /de yi zhogs nas rim par phyin te song*/ /tshogs 'khor la sogs phun sum tshogs par bshams/

/'brong pa chos mdzad nor bu bstan 'dzin sogs/ /dpon slob bzhi lnga tsam du byas pa dang*/ /rgya rtags brag la satwa res bshig pa'i tshe/ /me rgyas bsdams pas sol ba'i dkyil dag tu/ /ka ti ka yi zangs shog dmar po ni/ /mtho do tsam gyi tshad du long ba zhig /ngo mtshar ldan pa'i rtags dang rten 'brel byung*/ /dbang bzhi blangs dang smon lam legs par btab/ /a ma ril bu gzhan la ma bstan sbas/ /sgrub phug nang du zhag bdun bsdad nas ni/ /phab pas yang zab tshe yi sgrub pa yi/ /zab mo snying thig lcags kyi rgya mdud 'dug /gter sgrub la yang ngo mtshar 'ga' re byung*/ /de nas sgrub pa grol te zhag 'ga'i mtshams/ /sngar ltar rtags ldan lung bstan byung ba'i tshe/ /rta shod bye ma ri la bgrod nas song*/ /bar zhag gcig gis gnas kyi nang du 'byor/ /dus bzang ram zla'i tshes pa bco lnga'i nyin/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo bzang po grabs kyang byas/ /u rgyan bzhugs khri gong mar bgrod nas song*/ /tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor ba dang*/ /mkhar thung dpon dag tshang 'bum zhes pa sogs/ /dad ldan khrom pa stong phrag lhag tsam 'dus/ /gter rgya'i brag ni dam por yin 'dug pas/ /rdo yis brdungs pas phye ru ma thub nas/ /dgon pa'i nang la satwa re g.yar du phyin/ /satwa re rnyed nas skal ldan pho mo ni/ /bcu gsum tsam zhig gter rgya phye ru mngags/ /yun ring zhig ni bshig pa'i mtshams su la/ /bo chung skyid mo rkos mtshams slebs pa dang*/ /rta phag yid bzhin chos 'khor mjal nas byung*/ /gdan 'dren zhus pas kun gyis dad pa thob/ /la la bgad dang la la ngu bar 'dug /dbang bzhi blangs dang mjal kha kun la btang*/ /de nas rim bzhin dgon pa'i nang du log /srod 'phros gsang gter bzhes pa 'dir ma smras/ de yi zhogs la dge lugs dgon gsum nas/ /grwa pa sum cu skor tsam byung nas ni/ /gter kha bton par ma nyan zer ba dang*/

/slong mo yin zer 'phrog bcom jag pa'i gzugs/ /spyir ni ya pho ngan pa re zung gis/ /ngan mtha' rgyug dpag gnon pa'i bya ba dang*/ /dge 'dun mang por bskul ba'i las brtsams te/ /tshogs 'khor btang ya'i chas tsam mchod cha rnams/ /lam du brdzangs par 'phrad nas 'phrog song grags/ /de'i khar ngan shed sna tshogs byed nas 'dug /spyi'i chos sde snod lung nas bshad pa'i tshe/ kho rangs thams cad kha nas ngu lab bcas/ khyi zug wa brgyal lta bus 'di skad zer/ /nged rnams bong bu 'dra ba yin pa la/ /rna bar gser dang thal ba blugs pa mnyam/ /dge ba'i dam chos bstan la phan med zer/ /de la bdag gis lan du smras pa la/ khyed cag shākya gzhon nu'i chos brgyud la/ /mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga la sogs/ /bslab pa byang sems gzhir gnas 'dzem mkhan la/ /za 'dod tshul gyis rang rkang rdung ba yi/ /tshig tshogs de 'dra cis kyang nyan mi 'ong*/ /dge 'dun rkang 'dren skad cha yin par 'dug khyed rnams bden pa'i tshig la mi nyan na/ /lhas byin bdud kyi sprul pa ji bzhin red/ /nga yi ka cha de rnams ma gtad na/ /legs nyes ci mchis rgyab sor sgug dang gsal/ /nga yi gter 'di gangs can bde thabs te/ /'dzam gling nyi ma lta bu'i gdams ngag yin/ /gter 'di 'don par mi rung bshad yod na/ /ngan gtad yin na bum gter sba ba red/ /yang na gter ston mi rung 'byung gyur na/ /slob dpon padmas phung gtad sba 'dug gam/ /phung gtad bton na 'jig rten phung ba yin/ /de rnams ma lags sa bcud bsrungs 'dug pas/ /yang na gter 'di khyed tsho'i nor skal na/ /thob pa'i kha byang lung bstan yod lags sam/ /deng phan bton nas tshags su bcug 'os 'dug /gang phyir gter 'di sa bcud yin zhes na/ /slob dpon bod na ma phebs gong na dang*/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas gong ma byon skabs kyang*/ /sa 'di bcud med bye thang yin lags sam/ /slob dpon padma'i ma 'don zer 'dug gam/

/ci'i phyir khyed rnams ser skya tha mal bas/ /zab mo gter gyi lo rgyus khag mi yong*/ /nged rnams gu ru rje yis lung bstan la/ /las can 'gro ba'i don du gter 'don na/ /dam tshig zol zog med pa'i dpa' gdeng gis/ /rtse gcig yid gnyis med par gsol ba thob/ /pha nor bu yis lon par the tshom med/ /de skad gu ru rje yi gsungs pa yin/ khyed tshor tshad med mtha' can tshig de las/ /bdag gis 'os pa ci yang brjod du med/ /de bas khyod rnams dag kyang ci bde gyis/ /las kyi mtha' de sgug dang gsal 'ong smras/ /grwa mang de rnams phyi ru log nas song*/ /de tshe sgo mo brag 'dra bsdams pa dang*/ /chang zom gnyis tsam 'dug pa thams cad bsing*/ /nang du yod pa thams cad tshim par 'thung*/ /glu dang zhabs bro bzang po 'ga' yang btang*/ /'gro khar chos skyong gsol mchod las la rbad/ /de nas rim bzhin rdo shul phyogs su song*/ /yul gru de yi rten 'brel nyams song bas/ /dbyings nas bka' chad drag po los yin mod/ /mi 'dod ltas ngan sna tshogs tshang bar skad/ /bdag ni snying rje zab mos rgyud sbyangs las/ /bsam ngan tsam yang 'dzin don ga la mchis/ /gnas la dga' zhing 'dod de log nas 'ong*/ /lam du 'os tshig mgur 'di bzhengs pa'o/ na mo gu ru/ /bdag gdung bas 'dud tshig 'bul ba ni/ /dbyings dga' rab rdo rje'i lta ba'i klong*/ /chos gzhan nas gegs sel btsal dgos med/ /rgyud nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i zhabs la 'dud/ /mkhas shrī singha'i sgom pa'i klong*/ /rtags tshod 'dzin gzhan la re dgos med/ /rda rin chen gter mdzod zhabs la 'dud/ /pha gu ru padma'i spyod pa'i klong*/ /lung sde snod gsang rgyud btsal dgos med/ /skyabs mkha' ltar g.yo med zhabs la 'dud/ /ma mtsho rgyal lung bstan chos dbyings klong*/ /mi rtog ge'i kha tshig bcag dgos med/ /dbyangs snyan po'i gzi 'od 'bar la 'dud/ /gnubs lo tsā paṇḍi mkhas pa'i klong*/

/chos grub mtha' can la re dgos med/ /dbang snyan brgyud yid nor zhabs la 'dud/ na mo/ pha karma bha dra'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rtags ya mtshan lung bstan ma lags na/ /mi kho bo sa mthar ci la 'grim/ /de 'grims pa'i mtha' don ma yin na/ /gter yid bzhin nor bu ci la rnyed/ /de rnyed nas grags pas ma khyab na/ /yul za 'dod grub mtha'i ci la go /de go nas sdug chags ma langs na/ /brtan tshe rabs mnar med ci la sgrub/ /de bsgrubs nas bdud du ma skyes na/ /chos sangs rgyas bstan pa su yis snub/ /de bsnubs nas thar med ma skyes na/ /dus phyi mjug 'phro mtha' ci la gtsang*/ /de gtsang nas bstan pa ma dar na/ /bka' rdo rje theg pa ci la zhu/ /de zhu dgos 'bras bu smin lugs yin/ /mi kho bo de ring blo re bde/ /gter 'brel tshad don ldan yin bzhin lon/ /bdag 'tshing ba'i nor bu 'di la zer/ /dgon chags sdang can de'i sku glud blangs/ /gyod phung ba'i rdzas ngan de la zer/ /gter zab mo'i chos 'di lhong tshad che/ /rkyen chag sgo khur rogs thugs la btags/ /dus de ring rkyen ngan ma blang na/ /gyod chag sgo'i byur de mdud bsam med/ /nor phyug po 'dod der bsnan rogs la/ /sang phal lam 'phel rtags mngon te 'ong*/ /dus da lan sku khams bde bar bzhugs/ /gnas bzang po khyed la dga' ston 'bul/ /bdag ri khrod ras pa blo bder 'gro/ /ma mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho grogs la byon/ /mi kho bo'i phrin las dus 'dir sgrubs/ /lam gegs med bkra shis brjod so yag /de skad brjod nas rim par log ste song*/ /spu thog kha zhes bya ba'i byang thang du/ /mtsho chen padma'i bla mtsho'i mdun gyi char/ /bkra shis thang mgo bya ba'i yul dag la/ /chos rje sgar pa'i 'dra tshul de ru bkod/ /'brong pa'i dpon chen rnams kyis chos gzhi phul/ /thog mar khrid kyi mgo 'dzugs byed pa'i tshe/ /mi bzang tshangs pa'i dpon g.yog 'ga' re byon/

/gzhan yang khrom ni dpag med rgyas par 'dug /de ru dbang khrid dag ni rgyun ring byas/ /rta nor zang zing 'bul ba mang po byung*/ /mtha' rgyas bkra shis rab gnas byas pa'i nyin/ /mdun gyi mkha' nas gu ru rtsa ba gsum/ /bkrag mdangs lam mer dngos su zhal yang mjal/ /de yi nub mo srod kyi gung thun la/ /jo bo gze rgyal rtse nas 'ja' dkar zhig kho bo'i mdun du lam gyis zug pa dang*/ /de yi steng du bud med gzhon nu ma/ /bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod 'dra ba yi/ /bcu gsum tsam gyis rigs lnga la sogs pa/ /mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis legs par spras nas su/ /mchod rdzas sna tshogs lag tu thogs pa dang*/ /gar stabs lang ling mdun du lhags te byung*/ /bro skor gcig tsam 'khrab pa'i rjes su ni/ /grags stong pi wang sgra ltar 'di skad gsungs/ /kyai ho skal ldan thugs kyi sras/ /yid mtshar snyan pa'i ngag la nyon/ /sangs rgyas ye shes lo tsā ba/ /sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phro mtha' can/ /ma nged ming po bsu ru 'ong*/ /bu khyod de ring phar rtags su/ /brda bzhi'i lung bstan 'di ltar khrol/ /thog ma gsum gyi snang ba la/ /'od gsal mngon du ma gyur bar/ /rjes shes bya ra ma yengs 'tshal/ /bar pa gsum gyi 'gyu ba la/ /mnyam rjes bar lag ma gyes par/ /sgyu ma'i rtsal sbyong ma yengs 'tshal/ /tha ma gsum gyi gnas pa la/ /kun rtog zhen pa ma blag par/ /'khrul 'khor sbyong la ma yengs 'tshal/ /da ni gnas lugs gdeng tshad kyi/ /bu yis nyams dbyangs thongs shog dang*/ /nged rnams spro bas nyan no zer/ /bdag gis de la lan btab nas/ /sa mtshams mgur 'di bzhengs pa'o/ na mo gu ru/ pha skyabs kyi mchog gyur bla ma rje/ /drin 'khor med gu ru u rgyan dang*/ /mi bdag gi mgon gyur bha dra'i zhabs/ /yid gdung bas cod pan spyi bor 'dud/ khyed ye shes dbyings kyi ḍākki ma/ /sku snang stong drwa ba'i gar bsgyur nas/

/mi kho bo bsgom med ras pa la/ /glu nyams dbyangs mgur ma thongs skad gsungs/ /nga 'od gsal rdo rje'i bu rgyud ste/ /pha bla ma gu ru rje dang mjal/ /chos zab rgya rtogs pa'i brda bzhi gnang*/ /gnad kun shes mi 'gyur gdeng zhig lon/ /bu rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i tshad rdo bor/ /rdo ur mo brag la phur pa btab/ /bu sangs rgyas ye shes mngon gyur gsungs/ /ngas sbyangs pa'i lo chen pha bzang bu/ /mi phal cher bla ma mngal skyes te/ /bu nga yi bla ma brdzus skyes yin/ /mi kun gyi bla ma sa rim bgrod/ /bu nga yi bla ma zang thal yin/ /mi kun gyi bla ma lung rigs sbyang*/ /bu nga yi bla ma rang shar yin/ /pha brgyud pa de ldan 'dzin pa'i 'bangs/ /bu lus tshul chung yang ma nyams te/ /gyad byis pa'i gzugs la glang chen stobs/ /ngas nyams myong skyong dgos mi snyam ste/ /sems gzhon nu bum sku'i rtogs pa rdzogs/ /dbyibs kha dog med kyang rang rtsal ston/ /ngas sa lam bgrod dgos mi snyam ste/ /gnad gcig rdzogs 'dab bzang lha lam bgrod/ /gzhi rtsol med dbyings nas nam 'phang gcod/ /nga'i ngo sprod ma mthong mi snyam ste/ /sems gdod ma'i gshis lugs 'od gsal 'khyil/ /de kun byed rgyal po'i thog grol yin/ /nga'i 'gro lam ma thob mi snyam ste/ /rlung pho nya'i 'khrul 'khor bde stong bsgyur/ /gnad gzer bu drug gi sa mtshams shes/ /de kho bos sngon sbyangs bag chags yin/ /dus deng sang sbyangs par glu len ni/ /mi bdag gi gtsug rgyan bla ma de/ /lha mi kun gyi cod pan gcig /rje rarṇa karma bha tra yin/ khong che ba'i yon tan glu len na/ /sngon thog ma'i mgon po snang mtha' yi/ /skyabs thugs rje 'gro la shar ba'i 'od/ /byams snying rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs/ /de'i thugs bskyed sprul sku rim byon pa'i/ /rtags kun rdzogs paṇḍi ta yi tshul/ sku 'ja' lus drwa ba'i 'gying 'gros mkhan/

/ma mkha' 'gro'i gtso mchog dpa' bo yin/ /chos snyan brgyud sde snod gsang mdzod yin/ /pha brgyud pa ye shes lnga ldan te/ /sku che bas brgyan tshul de ltar gnas/ /de ji bzhin bdag gis bla mar bsten/ /thugs gsang rdzogs gcig la don kun rdzogs/ /chos mtshan nyid med pa'i grub mtha' shar/ /blo rnam rtog thum bu dus der bud/ /bdag de ring gnas 'gyu brjed nas song*/ /gnas gang shar 'dzin med gdams pa lon/ /bdag 'gog pa'i srung sdom chad de shor/ /dus nam yang rang rig bdag med rtogs/ /nyams 'phel ba'i lta ba yal ste song*/ /bya spyod lam kun kyang bden med go /blo a 'thas gtad so 'thor te shor/ /ma mkha' 'gror nyams myong rtogs 'bul kyang*/ /sgom dmigs gtad bral ba'i bdag med nga*/ /lam rgya yan lhug par bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /lus rnam snang chos bdun brjed nas song*/ /dus deng sang nyal thab tha mal gshis/ /nyams 'khrul snang bden snyam mi sems 'dug /mi kho bo'i gnas lugs de 'dra yin/ /dbyings ḍākki rnams kyis thugs ma khrel/ /de skad tsam gyi lan du btab pa la/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis zhal 'dzum ston pa dang*/ /nyams la 'phel 'grib med na de rang yin/ /da ni zhal gdams gnang dgos mi 'dug ste/ /sang ni lha ri 'od ldan gangs kyi khrod/ /gze rgyal jo bo'i gnas su phebs mdzod dang*/ /ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i snying thig chos bka' dang*/ /yang gsang bla med mdams ngag 'ga' re yod/ /de ru phebs dang nged kyis grogs bya gsungs/ /de ma thag tu rim par byon nas song*/ /de nas zhag po 'ga' la dpon khag 'gas/ /gdan 'dren byed pa yin zer de ru 'gor/ /zhag po bcu tsam lon pa'i mtshams su ni/ /chos sgar gzai rgyal gong du bkyags nas song*/ /de tshe yul grur char mun 'thib 'dug kyang*/ /gze rgyal gangs nas bdag gi mdun thad du/ /gnam mthongs phyes nas thag shar brkyangs 'dra 'dug /rim bzhin la rnams bgrod de phyin pa'i tshe/

/sum pa tshang sogs sbyin bdag las can rigs/ /gnas kyi mdun du yod pa thams cad kyis/ /mda' dar thogs nas bsu chang khyer te byung*/ /de yis rten 'brel shin tu legs par 'grigs/ /rim bzhin mtsho dkar kha ru slebs pa dang*/ /sbrang char zim me 'ja' gur 'khyil te byung*/ /de nas klu rgyal dbang lag spyil bur slebs/ /dkar gtor bsngos shing phrin las bcol ba las/ /ma gro gzi can khye'u lo brgyad tshul/ /sha yi zur phud ldan pa zhig byas nas/ /tha tshig gtor ma len phyir mchis nas su/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes rten 'brel bsgrigs/ /de nas rim bzhin rta mgrin sgrub par zhugs/ /zhag po bdun tsam song ba'i nub mo la/ /lha btsan rdo rje 'bar ba dpon g.yog gsum/ kho bo'i mdun du gdan 'dren byed du byung*/ /gsol ja la sogs mchod bstod legs par byas/ /de tshe lha btsan zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ /rig 'dzin chen po sngar nas phebs na yang*/ /nged rnams rgya nag yul du phyin lags te/ /nas khral sha khral la sogs ma 'dus nas/ /de ring phar btags nang du ma 'khor song*/ /da ni nged kyi nang du phebs ces zer/ /de nas bdag cag yon mchod thams cad ni/ /gze rgyal pho brang nang du song ba la/ /mkhar yang zhi drag tshul can gnyis 'dug pas/ /de yi nyin la zhi ba'i mkhar du song*/ /'jig rten dbang phyug bzhugs pa'i lha khang ni/ /rgyan mdzes legs pa'i bzhugs khri brgyab nas 'dug /de'i steng bsdad nas cung zad song ba dang*/ /ja chang bzhi skor tsam zhig drang ba'i rjes/ /gro ma gsar rnying mar khu la sogs pa/ /gsol 'dren la sogs rgyas par byas nas 'dug /mdun der bzhag pa'i sha yang phal cher ni/ /mi yi bam khog stod smad mang bar 'dug /de nas 'bul ba tshal du sgrig pa la/ /bkra shis kha btags g.yu yis mdzes pa dang*/ /slob dpon zhal thang bka' brgyad zhal thang dang*/ /bka' brgyad po ti la yang dum pa gsum/

/rta pho dkar ser gnyis dang go khrab dang*/ /gzhan yang brjod du mi shes spyad kha'i rigs/ /shin tu mang ba bdag la phul nas ni/ /bdag gis gtsor byas mdo khams yul phyogs 'dir/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor du gsol/ /deng nas bdag kyang khyed nyid gar pheb sar/ /grogs dang zhabs phyi zhu bar mchis pa yin/ /nga yi sras mo 'di nyid bla mar 'bul/ /'di yang theg chen lam la btsud nas ni/ /de nas gar pheb sa ru khrid rogs mdzod/ /de skad zer nas phyag gsum legs par phul/ /byin rlabs zhus te langs te song ba dang*/ /bu mo na chung byi ru'i thor tshugs can/ /lag tu mda' dar gter sgrom thogs nas su/ /bla mas bdag ni rjes bzung mdzod ces zer/ /gter sgrom de ni bdag la phul nas byung*/ /de nas cung zad song ba'i mtshams su ni/ /shar smad gangs dkar 'ob la yan chod dang*/ /dbus yul bag ra lha rtse man chod kyi/ /gzhi bdag thams cad gnas der 'tshogs nas byung*/ /chos ra'i khrom ni grangs las 'das pa ste/ /mig rgyang mthong tsam gral rim 'khod nas song*/ /bdag la gos lag ci yang mi snang bas/ /cung zad song mtshams lha btsan de nyid kyis/ /pad zhwa zab ber phod kha chos gos dang*/ /lus rgyan thams cad tshang bar khyer nas byung*/ /bdag gi lus la de dag gyon pa dang*/ /grwa pa rnams ni su yang mi 'dug pas/ /maṇḍal phul mkhan gang byed bsam pa la/ /sngar gyi lha btsan sras mo de nyid kyis/ khrom mang de ru brda' skad zer song bas/ khye'u bu mo bcu gsum slebs nas byung*/ /mdun nas maṇḍal phul zhing dbyangs ring ni/ na mo gu ru dza hi taṃ/ /si mi si ta kā li ta/ /ha ri bi ra ka hi laṃ/ /he ni dzñā na daṃ ka ra/ /'du ta wa ra laṃ he'o/ /zhes pa'i gdangs dang bcas par/ /rim par mchod rdzas thogs nas su/ /brda dang gar rtsed rol ba'i tshe/ /bdag gis bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa yi/ /byin 'bebs spyan 'dren gdangs dbyangs bgyis pa dang*/

/mdun gyi mkha' nas 'ja' dang 'od 'khyil nang*/ /gu ru padma snang srid zil gnon la/ /grub thob rig 'dzin brgyad kyis bskor nas su/ /lung bstan zhal gdams la sogs gnang ba dang*/ /bdag dang dkyil 'khor rnams la thim nas byung*/ kho bo'i lus kyang 'ja' mtshon lta bur gyur/ /de nas rim bzhin chos khrid bgyis pa'i tshe/ /kun gyis dad mos rtse gcig byed pa'i khrod/ /gral mdo de ru btsun pa rgan po zhig /dad mos med par kha phyir bltas nas 'dug /de yi phyi log gral ni bdun tsam mtshams/ /grwa pa mi nag pho mo mang po zhig kha ni phyir bltas mgo gtums bgyis nas 'dug /de yi phyi log gral ni bcu tsam mtshams/ /byis pa gcer bu mang po rgyab sprad 'dug /gral rnams rdzogs pa'i tha ma dag la ni/ /skyes pa pho mo gcer bu rgyan med tshogs/ /sgom chen yin tshul mnyam bzhag byas nas 'dug /de rnams lus la srin bu mang po dang*/ /sha sbrang gtibs pa lta bur g.yengs nas 'dug /bdag gis bu mo de la dris pa dang*/ /chos ra 'di ru byed lugs mi gcig pa/ /spyod pa 'di 'dra 'tshogs pa ci yin smras/ /bu mo de ni langs nas 'di skad zer/ khyed kyi g.yas phyogs nga yi pha rgan 'di/ khyed 'khor skyes nas chos rgyud 'dzin pa yi/ /snying khar sme ba dkar po yod par 'byung*/ /g.yon gyi phyogs su yod pa'i mi sngon 'di/ /chos rgyud 'dzin pa'i chos kyi ming can la/ /gzhog g.yon sha mtshan sngon po yod pa 'byung*/ /mdun zur mdzes pa'i khye'u dkar po 'di/ /chos brgyud 'dzin pa nu gong sme ba can/ /ngag gam rdo rje'i ming can zhig tu 'byung*/ /de yi g.yon phyogs rgas pa'i gzugs can 'di/ /grags pa'i ming can chos brgyud 'dzin par 'byung*/ /nga yis g.yon phyogs bu mo so zho can/ /skra lo kham pa sme ba gsum ldan 'di/ /zab gter chos la phan pa'i grogs su 'byung*/ /de nas gral bzhi yol ba'i mtshams dag la/

/byis pa bco brgyad bsgrigs nas 'dug pa 'di/ /lung gis zin pa'i skyes chen bco brgyad 'byung*/ /de rnams 'gro la nges par phan par 'byung*/ /de sogs las can dag kyang mang po 'byung*/ /gral mdo'i btsun pa rgas po'i chas 'dzin 'di/ /'gong po rta dmar bdud kyi sprul pa yin/ /'di la da lan dmigs pas dam btags dgos/ /de 'og grwa pa mi nag pho mo rnams/ kha phyir bltas nas mgo thum gtums pa'i tshogs/ /dang por dbang khrid 'brel ba thob na yang*/ /tha mar dad log dmyal bar 'gro mkhan red/ /de 'og byis pa gcer bu rgyan med tshogs/ /bskyed rdzogs phyi nang nor ba'i rigs dag yin/ /de yi phyi rol mi skya pho mo'i tshogs/ /gcer bu rgyan med sgom chen 'dra ba rnams/ /zog po dkor gzan mkhan gyi rigs dag yin/ /spyir ni 'dir tshogs khrom rnams thams cad kun/ /mi dang lha 'dre bsre ba'i tshul du yod/ /da lan 'di rnams lan gcig tshogs pa la/ /bla mas smon lam bzang po gnang dgos zer/ /de nas bdag gis dbang sgrub bgyis pa'i tshe/ /bu mo rnams kyis phyag g.yog byas nas ni/ /rim bzhin khrom la dbang bskur tshar lnga dang*/ /bka' bsgo rab gnas dag kyang legs par grub/ /de nas badzra bgyis te khrom byer song*/ /lha btsan shin tu dgyes tshul mdzad nas su/ /da lan 'gro don legs par byung gsungs te/ khong yang dge bsnyen sdom pa blangs nas song*/ /bu mo de yang sngags sdom zhus pa dang*/ /de nas sngar ltar yon mchod so sor log /de ma thag tu gnyid kyang sad pa dang*/ /mgo gtums phud nas phyi log lta ba'i tshe/ /bsa' la sogs pa'i gcan gzan 'ga' re yis/ /spyil bu'i phyi nas bskor ba byed nas 'dug /nam mkha' dag kyang sangs sangs gsal te byung*/ /de nas bdun gsum tsam du phyin pa'i tshe/ /sngar bzhin rtags dang lung bstan 'ga' re byung*/ /tshogs rdzas la sogs rten 'brel chas rnams khyer/

/zhing skyong mgon po la sogs dpon slob bcas/ /dmar nag rakta'i mtsho khar song ba dang*/ /lha sman klu sman rnams kyis bsu ba byung*/ /tshogs mchod phul zhing tha tshig bka' bsgo bsgrags/ /yud tsam mtsho rnams lhog lhog khol ba dang*/ /klu mos gter sgrom thogs te phul nas byung*/ /dbang bzhi blangs te gsol ba smon lam byas/ /de tshe lung pa dri bzang ngad kyis khyab/ /gter sgrom thog tu ḍākki seng gdong ma/ /mthe bong tshad tsam gsal 'tsher lam mer mjal/ /rten 'brel legs tshogs gang yang 'grigs par byung*/ /de nas gter rdzong brgyab cing nang du log /nyin gcig char pa zam zim 'bab pa dang*/ /gze rgyal dbu rtser char sprin 'khrigs nas byung*/ /de tshe gnas bstod mgur 'di bzhengs pa'o/ na mo gu ru/ gnas 'khor lo lnga yi dwangs rtse ru/ /gdan pad sdong 'dab brgya yangs pa'i steng*/ /rje yid kyi nor bu gtsug gi rgyan/ /dpal 'dod rgu'i mnga' bdag padma 'byung*/ /pha 'gro ba'i mgon mchog thugs rje'i gter/ /dgos bdag la rtsol mdzad rin po che/ /gtan 'bral med mgon gcig spyi bor 'dud/ na mo/ dpal dgongs pa'i dbyings chen cod pan brgyan/ /blo padma'i nor bu 'od rab gsal/ /lung gtad rgya snyan brgyud nam mkha' mdzod/ /drin 'khor med gnang ba'i bha dra ba/ /pha skyabs gcig mtshungs med de la 'dud/ /mi kho bo'i dga' ston glu zhig btang*/ /sngon sbyangs stobs bzang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnas mthon rtser rten 'brel 'bab pa yin/ /lam rgya yan gnyug ma sgom pa'i tshe/ /pha gu ru'i dgongs pa'i 'od klong nas/ /zer ma 'gags shar ba'i mkha' 'gro yis/ /brda lung bstan rtags rgya'i kha byang babs/ /gnad 'gyur ldog med pa'i go yul rtogs/ /lha btsan rgod rdo rjes sbyin bdag mdzad/ /bka' snang srid lha 'drer chos 'khor bskor/ /don gcig shes kun grol khrid kha btab/ /bdud mi min 'byung po thabs kyis btul/

/bka' gter srung pho nyas phrin las bsgrubs/ /chos zab rgya'i theg chen sgo mo phyes/ /mos snying rjes 'gro la chos sbyin btang*/ /bu rems blo nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /sems gu yangs klong nas glu len na/ /gnas ya mtshan che ba mdo tsam bshad/ na mo/ gangs can yul gyi lte ba'i cha/ /mdo khams lha khang gze yi cha/ /spo ri padma'i yang steng dbus/ /gnas chen jo bo gze rgyal gangs/ /rtse mtho shel gyi ba gam can/ /sprin dkar lang ling ldem pa'i gang*/ /dung gi nor bu cha gsum dbyibs/ /sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i sa/ /gangs ri 'ja' 'od ldem ma ldem/ /me tog skyed tshal lhang ma lhong*/ /bung bas glu dbyangs kyu ru ru/ /dung mtsho gzi 'od me re re/ /g.yu mtsho mdangs bzang ta la la/ /zangs mtsho dmar chen kyi li li/ /chu klung drag sngags 'u ru ru/ /gangs can mdo khams sham bha la/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gtibs pa'i gnas/ /btsan rgod laṅka 'gyu ba'i sa/ /rngam lhun ma la ya yi tshul/ /skal ldan dngos grub len pa'i sa/ /gsang sngags pho brang sgrom bu'i mkhar/ /theg chen don dang ldan pa'i gling/ /ngo mtshar che'o khyad par 'phags/ /gnas mchog dbu 'phang dgongs ltar bstod/ /nam yang byin chags bzhugs par zhu/ /de skad tsam du mgur ma bgyis pa dang*/ /gnas la tshogs 'khor gtang rag bzang po phul/ /de yi nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /sngar gyi na chung bud med gzhon mo des/ /phyag tu mda' dar me long thogs nas su/ /brda skad zab mo'i tshig la 'di skad gsungs/ /kyai ho sngags 'chang rnal 'byor pa/ /rtsa gsum gling pa legs par gson/ /sngon sbyangs skal ldan las 'phro can/ /da lta'i bag chags sad pa'i dus/ /'phro mtha' bzang pos gnas 'dir byon/ /gsang mdzod rin chen gter sgo phyes/ /da yang 'gro 'dul phan bde'i ched/ /gsang sngags pho brang gnas 'di la/ /sgom sgrub bskor ba'i srol gtod 'tshal/ /lam grogs bu mo bdag gis bgyi/

/'dul zhing don yod byung ste mchis/ /de skad zer nas mkha' la gshegs te song*/ /phyir nangs de yi zhogs la bcad rgya grol/ /grwa 'khor rnams dang dad ldan sbyin bdag gi /pho mo rten 'brel 'tshogs pa bdun bcas par/ /gze rgyal gangs su gnas sgo 'byed du song*/ /ji bzhin gnas kyi zhal gzigs yi ger btab/ /dgong mo btsan ri srog bdag shwa ra yi/ /mdun nas dam rdzas shog dril 'ga' re bton/ /sa der sdod pa'i sdig can skye bo'i rigs/ /'gong po rta dmar bdud kyi sprul pa ni/ /zog po dam nyams khrims ral ser gzugs can/ /snying ngan nor gnag g.yo sgyu'i mi chos mkhan/ kha lag 'brel tshad ngan song 'khrid pa yi/ /so skye cog ge ba zhig 'dug pa des/ /ngan smras blun gtam tshig gis bshad rgyang la/ /gter 'di bton na kho la gnod zer nas/ /mi rung tshad btsug rgol ba sna tshogs brtson/ kha yis dug gtor lag gis bsha' gri brdar/ /yid kyis slob dpon gu ru rje la smad/ /dam tshig gnyer ba'i chos skyong khyad du bsad/ /zhing bcu tshang ba'i spyod 'gros kun kyang bstan/ /de ltar sdig to can zhig 'dug pa la/ kho bos mgur dbyangs glu 'di blangs pa'o/ na mo/ rje 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje dang*/ /skyabs gcig 'dus gu ru u rgyan pa/ /thugs zlos gar rnam 'phrul bha dra'i zhabs/ /mi skal bzang spyi bo'i rgyan du bdud/ /bdag de ring 'dra tshul glu len na/ /bu nga yi bla ma padma 'byung*/ /rje rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ /chos dgongs brda rgya mtsho'i 'od zer gyis/ /bu skal ldan rig pa'i mthong lam phyes/ khong rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i slob dpon 'dra/ /de 'dra yang mtshungs la don yang yin/ /mi bdag gi pha gcig pad 'byung de/ /dpal 'bri zhes bzhed pa'i rdo rje ni/ /rje ratna karma bha dra ba/ /bka' zab rgya snyan brgyud rdo rje'i mdzod/ /bu las can smin grol sa bon 'debs/

khong paṇa grub lung gnyis 'dzin pa 'dra/ /de 'dra yang mtshungs la dngos kyang yin/ /mi kho bo rtsa gsum gling pa ste/ /brda bka' bab rgyud sde'i rten 'brel dag /lung ma nges grub thob tshul gyis 'dzin/ /lam brtul zhugs ngang gis sa mthar 'grim/ /gnas rten 'brel sna tshogs bdag po yin/ /lung sgra bsgyur ston pa'i lo tsā 'dra/ /de 'dra yang mtshungs la don yang yin/ /mi kho bos gnas ri nyul ba'i don/ /gter yid bzhin nor bu len pa 'di/ /babs res med rku 'phrog bcom pa min/ /brda rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa'i tshig /ma mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod 'byed pa 'di/ /don pha nor bu yis len pa yin/ /'di thos kyang 'dra la don yang mtshungs/ /'di mtshungs pa 'dra tshul bzhi yi mgur/ /gnas gze rgyal gangs la snyan dbyangs bstod/ kyai/ /nyon dang gson dang rgyal khams mi/ /'od mkha' nas ma gsal sa nas shar/ /chu mthur du ma babs gyen du ldog /kun bla mas ma grol zog pos grol/ /gter bdag po'i nor la yi dwags rngam/ /gnas bzang po'i mtha' nas 'gong pos bskor/ /chos bden pa bsnubs nas rdzun ma spel/ /bka' tshul bzhin zad nas bdud rigs bstod/ /lha yi dam bskyur nas the'u rang bsgrub/ khyod 'gong po rta dmar blo re 'khrul/ /mi 'khrul tshab che na nyams kyang mtshar/ /mi 'gong po khyod kyi grub mtha' la/ /bka' rgyud sder med pa'i lung zhig 'dug khyod gtum mo nang nas 'bar bar skad/ /nyams dmar khrid rlung khrid slob par skad/ /gos slog pa gyon pa ma 'khrul lam/ khyod gangs ri'i rtse la sgom par skad/ /bka' thub chu yis byas par skad/ /zas khyi phag spyod ltar ma 'khrul lam/ khyod rtsa rlung rgya mdud grol bar skad/ /bran mor bde stong rol zhes skad/ /nor 'khrul bka' de ma 'khrul lam/ khyod sum ldan dge slong yin par skad/ /gos slog rul steng na chos gos gyon/ /shig sro ma'i skra cog ma 'khrul lam/

khyod chos lugs sa skya yin par skad/ /ro snyom gcod lugs yin par skad/ /bka' lung med phaṭ sgra ma 'khrul lam/ khyod chos rje 'gro don yin par skad/ /smin grol sdom pa 'dogs par skad/ /dbang mgo mjug med de ma 'khrul lam/ khyod bya btang chos byed yin par skad/ /rgyu 'bras phra zhib 'dzem par skad/ /nor bum gter rku ba ma 'khrul lam/ khyod gcig pur ri khrod 'grim par skad/ /gzhan mi chos thams kyis byol bar skad/ khyim gzhis nag 'dzin pa ma 'khrul lam/ khyod dus gsum sangs rgyas yin par skad/ /lnga ldan mngon shes yod par skad/ /rang gar 'gro cha med ma 'khrul lam/ /mi kho bo'i glu 'di ma go na/ /tshig phyung rdeg pha rol rgod 'joms yin/ /don btab pa lan med ral gri yin/ /bdud 'gong po 'joms pa'i thog char yin/ /dmangs rtog ge bshig pa'i dbal phur yin/ /mi khyod la sun 'byin spu gri yin/ /glu yag snyan 'gong po'i kha gnon mdzod/ /gdangs snyan po 'jig rten rna bar sgrogs/ khyab dgos so lha 'dres bshad rogs gyis/ /de skad tsam zhig mgur du bzhengs pa dang*/ /rim par gnas sgo 'byed cing bgrod nas 'ong*/ /de nas zhag kyang ring por ma 'gor bar/ /sbyin bdag kun la bskor brda byas pa dang*/ /'brong pa'i dpon bzang chos skyong bsam 'grub dang*/ /lcam mo rig ldan rting dkar skyid la sogs/ /brgya lhag tsam zhig lhan du bskor bar byon/ /zhing skyong dam can mkha' 'gro'i lam bgrod nas/ /de yi nub mor khra mo gzi mtshor bsdad/ /phyir nangs yi dam la brgal rim bzhin song*/ /de yi nub mor maṇḍal gling du bsdad/ /phyir nangs zhogs la sgrol ma'i la brgal nas/ /nub mo mtsho dkar dpa' bo thang la bsdad/ /zhogs la 'dzam gling rgyan gyi chos khrir phyin/ /de gar khrom pa rnams la dbang bskur nas/ /bkra shis smon lam bgyis te brdzangs nas btang*/ /de nas zhag shas tsam du lon pa'i tshe/

/ske gzhung dang ni dred rong dag la song*/ /de nas zla shas tsam du 'gro ba'i skabs/ khyung po dme ru nang du song ba'-i tshe/ /dbang bskur chos bshad zhag shas byas pa'i tshe/ /bla tshang bla ma dkon mchog gshegs zin 'dug /grwa pa re zung gdan 'dren byed du byung*/ /phyir nangs zhogs nas rim bzhin bgrod de song*/ /sku gdung khrus gsol 'pho 'debs ngo sprod byas/ /de nas rim bzhin ba sha bla ma ni/ /dgon pa bag med gling du byon nas song*/ /de yi dgun la de ru bsdad pa dang*/ /skabs shig gnas gsum gzhung du chos sgar brgyab/ /lha rtse nas bzung bkra shis sgang la sogs/ /mangs mda' yan du chos ra mang du tshugs/ /de nas mkha' 'gros lung bstan ji bzhin du/ /glu bdud dge bsnyen drag po'i pho brang nas/ /nor sgrub yi bzhin nor bu gdan yang drangs/ /nor skyong klu mo gsang ba'i reg mar bsten/ /nor bu ma ṇi la sogs 'ga' re rnyed/ /de'i skabs rten 'brel shin tu 'grigs pa byung*/ /de nas rim bzhin dgon par log ste song*/ /phyogs kyis gdan 'dren mang po'i phebs zer kyang*/ /de nas zhag 'gar mtshams bcad byas te bsdad/ /zab pa'i chos tshan rnams kyang legs par phab/ /dus kyi dgu gtor la sogs spyi rim la/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i las tshogs brtsam pa'i tshe/ /dus skabs bde ba'i rtags dang rten 'brel byung*/ /de tshe lung bstan rten 'brel ji bzhin du/ /rga rgyal rin chen spungs pa'i gnas la song*/ /zab mo rin chen gter gyi sgo mo phyes/ /tshe sgrub yang zab padma snying thig dang*/ /'jam dpal gshin rje dug ri me 'bar gtsos/ /gzhan yang dam rdzas la sogs zab rgyas tshogs/ /'brel tshad don ldan mang por gdan yang drangs/ /de ru zla ba gcig tsam gter sgrub byas/ /de sogs thams cad nyung ngur bsdus pa yin/ /rim bzhin sgrub pa grol ba'i skabs su ni/ /dbang lung la sogs mang du grub pa'i gsham/

/'gro skabs gnas la mgur 'di bzhengs pa'o/ na mo gu ru/ rje mtshungs med rdo rje 'gro ba'i mgon/ /dpal padma kā ra'i zhabs la 'dud/ /brda rten 'brel mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan bzhin/ /lam go yul shes pas gnas su byon/ /yul khrog shod spre'u gdong pa'i zum/ /mi pho mo phag nag mun pa 'thib/ /blo las sgo nag rdzong 'thug po btsan/ /dad mdun pa brag phug sgo yi dben/ /tshig 'chol gtam ri bong spu las nyob/ /chos dam tshig sdong rgan rtsa ba rul/ /rku jag khram 'byung po ngan pa'i tshogs/ /byed dpa' rtsal rgya shing lo ma'i ngogs/ /yul mi la bltas na dgod re bro/ /bdud mi ru brdzus nas chags pa'i yul/ /gnas ya mtshan bltas na dwang ba skye/ /dpal lha ri rga rgyal rin chen spungs/ /yul mtha' 'khob gsal ba'i sgron me mdzod/ /sde ba sog shog ka'i kha gnon gyis/ /mi kho bos dga' ston glu zhig len/ /gter yid bzhin thon pas 'gro don dga'/ /gnas rga rgyal mjal bas las 'phro dga'/ /grogs nā ga dha ri'i rten 'brel dga'/ /yul gtad so med pa'i nyams snang dga'/ /sems bya rtsol bral ba'i rtogs pa dga'/ /lam rtsa rlung sbyangs pa'i 'khrul 'khor dga'/ /brda mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan las 'phro dga'/ /rlung gtum mo'i ras gos rkyang gcig dga'/ /gnas dben pa'i ri khrod phug par dga'/ /bka' snang srid lha 'dre'i sbyin bdag dga'/ /yul phyogs med 'grims pa'i bya btang dga'/ /pha bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pas dga'/ /sems dga' ba'i dga' glu ring mo 'di/ /gnas rga rgyal jo bo khyod la 'bul/ /bu ras pa dga' bo lam du 'gro/ /yul rgyal khams pho mo khams bzang zhu/ /de skad mgur du bzhengs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ /sa der 'khod pa'i sbyin bdag 'ga' re yis/ /zab pa'i dbang lung khrid gsum zhus pa'i mthar/ /bla mar skur zhus phran bu byas pa dang*/ /gter kha ma 'don zer ba la sogs rigs/ /bcos gtam smyo gtam mang po bshad 'dug pas/

/nyams mtshar ku re'i dga' glu bzhengs pa'o/ /de nas rim bzhin song ba'i la rtse ru/ /byang nas snyan pa'i 'brug sgra grags pa dang*/ /rten 'brel nyams mtshar mang po de ru 'grigs/ /de nas hor zla gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la/ /'on 'bu bla ma'i dgon pa de ru song*/ /de ru dpon slob grwa btsun brgya tsam la/ /zhag bcur bsdad nas dbang lung bgyis pa'i tshe/ /yul mi dad ldan khrom yang mang po byung*/ /kun la dag snang la sogs khyad 'phags dang*/ /rten 'brel dag kyang bzang ba tsam du 'grigs/ /zang zing lo dha'i rigs 'bul mang po byung*/ /de nas rim bzhin lam du zhugs pa dang*/ /hor zla gsum par nor bu gling du sleb/ /de gar mi ring ba ru de nyid du/ /lung bstan brda bzhin rdo rgyal ston par song*/ /dbu rtse longs sku'i ri zhal skor lam phyes/ /chos khri brtsegs shing dag snang zhal gzigs tshe/ /brag dkar logs su zhabs rjes gnyis tsam bzhag /kun gyis dad phyir rten 'brel legs par byung*/ /slar yang rim bzhin dgon par log ste song*/ /skabs shig grwa tshang dpon slob 'ga' byas te/ /dmu rgyal mdun zhol lung pa'i cha ru song*/ /sngon tshe rgyal bas byin brlabs rab gnas pa'i/ /'tsho byed sman gyi chu rgyun gter nas bton/ /gso rig mnga' ba chen po'i rtel 'brel byung*/ /de nas nye zhing nye ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /yid las skyes pa'i ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rong btsan gangs nas gdan 'dren byed du byung*/ /de ru 'gro bar chas pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /lho phyogs padma bkod pa 'dra ba yi/ /bud med nag mo bong bu zhon pa la/ /skra lo dmar ser rting par sham me ba/ /gcer mo g.yang gzhi gyon nas 'dug pa des/ kho bo bong bu de la bskyon pa dang*/ /lho phyogs spungs pa'i ri la khyer nas su/ /lde mig bcu gsum lag tu gtad pa dang*/ /brda tshig 'dra ba mang po zer ba'i mtshams/ /bud med de ni 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/

/de nas rim bzhin phyir log shom pa'i tshe/ /bud med dkar mo dngul gyi wang long can/ /lag tu pi wang thogs pa zhig dang 'phrad/ khyed kyi gter grogs nga yis bya'o zer/ /lag gi pi wang bdag la gtad nas byung*/ /bdag gis pi wang de ni btang ba dang*/ /rang gi thugs las 'od zer dkar po zhig /lam gyis chad nas bud med de la thim/ /cung zad song mtshams bud med de nyid la/ khye'u ral pa can zhig skyes pa des/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ zer nas sdigs mdzub byas te 'dug khyed kyi ming ni su yin smras pa'i tshe/ /hūm̐ bdag sras yin hūm̐ bdag sras yin zer/ khye'u dang ni bud med de gnyis la/ /brda sprod tshul gyis bka' gtad bgyis pa dang*/ kho bo'i phyi la khrid ste phyin pa rmis/ /de la sogs te lung bstan mang yod kyang*/ /sgyu ma lta bur bcad nas ma bris so/ /de nas za zi rmi lam sad ste 'dug /da ni rong btsan gangs su 'gro bsam ste/ /lan gnyis chas kyang sa der bgrod ma thub/ /de nas rim bzhin lung bstan byung ba dang*/ /sngar gyi kha byang lung bstan rnams kyang dran/ ched du rten 'brel mtshams sbyor khyad par las/ /ba sha bla ma u rgyan dpal 'byor gyis/ /nan cher yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ /rim gyis spo bo'i phyogs su phyin nas ni/ /ba sha bla ma dpon slob thams cad la/ /dbang lung khrid sogs rgyas par btab pa'i tshe/ /maṇḍal dar chen gos dang rin chen sogs/ khyu mchog rta drel la sogs legs par byung*/ /de nas hor zla brgyad pa'i yar tshes la/ /bcu gsum skar 'dzin bco brgyad nyin par khyog /de tshe mdo smad gter srung thams cad kyis/ /bshol ma 'debs shing sdug bsngal bgyis pa yi/ /lha 'dre'i cho nge rna bas thos tsam byung*/ /de ma thag tu 'brug dang ser sprin gyis/ /lung pa khol zhing 'ur sgra sna tshogs 'byin/ /gnam char 'tshubs te kha char 'thib pa yis/ kha bas bgrod lam mi rnyed tsam du byung*/

/de nas rim bzhin wa zhabs gnas su song*/ /tshong dpon tshang la rten 'brel 'grigs pa dang*/ /lung bstan ji bzhin brag dmar g.yang la 'grims/ /thog mar gro lod gsang sgrub chos skor blangs/ /dad ldan khrom par dbang bskur smin par byas/ /de nas zhag po gnyis tsam song ba'i mtshams/ /yang gcig g.yon phyogs brag dmar 'debs zhal la/ /he ru ka yi chas bcug rim par song*/ /de tshe gter grogs med par gter blangs pas/ /bdud mo zhig gis bar chad brtsams nas su/ /mtha' la g.yug tshe mgur 'di btang ba'o/ na mo gu ru/ rje padma 'byung nas zhabs la 'dud/ /drin 'khor med phrin las bzang po mkhyen/ /bdag sngon sbyangs bag chags ri mo sad/ /rtags ngo mtshar che ba'i kha byang rnyed/ /lung gzhan dang mi 'gal rgyud byang thob/ /lam 'chug med rig pa'i btsan sa zin/ /rtags rmi lam mthong ba ji bzhin du/ /chos zab mo gter gyi sgo 'byed dus/ /lus he ru ka yi chas zhugs te/ /brag me long 'dra ba'i ngogs la 'dzegs/ /pha bla ma dran cing gsol ba btab/ /ma mkha' 'gro bos shing maṇḍal phul/ /gter bka' srung rnams la tha tshig bsgrags/ /sngon tha tshig ma nor gnas bdag gis/ /brda shog dril ri mo dngos su byung*/ /lar gegs med dga' 'o snyam zhing log /sngon song ba'i lam shul yal nas 'dug /lar ci yin bsams shing bltas tsa na/ /bdud sha za nag mo'i skye ba de/ /mig kha rgyang ring por lta bar mthong*/ /bdud bar chad yin par ngos zin nas/ /bus pha nor len pa'i rnal 'byor nga*/ /dgra g.yang sar 'jigs kyang kho rang shes/ /rkyen bdud mo rgyal yang sngon gyi las/ /lar skyid sdug dkon mchog gsum la 'dri/ /de bsam zhing glo bur phyin pa'i tshe/ /rdo 'bur 'bur rus sbal 'dra de zhig /rtswa spungs spungs phyags ma 'dra de gog /mig dbang por khra zi khyug ge dus/ /chos yid bzhin lon kyang rang srog phung*/ /lar dug sbrul nor bu'i dpe yang dran/

/bdag de ring 'byung bzhi 'thor ram snyam/ /sems skyo zhing bla ma sgom pa'i tshe/ /rlung 'khor lo gcig gi steng du phog /yar thim rim tsam zhig btegs pa mthong*/ /mi kho bo'i snying tsa yam yam khol/ /bdud 'dre mos bar chad brtsam lugs kyis/ /bdag rnal 'byor dam tshig bral lags bsam/ /rkyen g.yang sa 'di ru lhung lugs kyis/ /ma mkha' 'gros mgo bskor yin nam bsam/ /lam yangs mo'i mkha' la 'phur stangs 'di/ /rje grub thob rnal 'byor yin nam bsam/ /lam bskyed rim 'di yi brtan lugs kyis/ /pha gu ru'i thugs sras yin nam bsam/ /rdo tsher ma'i bar chad bsrungs lugs kyis/ /bu sangs rgyas ye shes yin nam bsam/ /lus 'byung bzhi tsog por 'dug lugs kyis/ /pha padma 'byung gnas drin gcig bsam/ /'khor sbyin bdag grwa slob sngangs lugs kyis/ /bdag sdod pa'i snying stobs che lags bsam/ /rlung srog rtsol gsum tsam bzung ba'i tshe/ /lus 'byung bzhi rnams kyang rim gyis sos/ /pha bla ma dran pas gsol ba btab/ /dgos grwa slob sbyin bdag rten 'brel byas/ /nyams mtshar ba'i rnam thar e ma ho/ /yang gcig ngal gso brten te mgur 'di blangs/ pha padma 'byung gnas zhabs la 'dud/ /dgos drin can bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /bu rin chen gter sgo 'byed pa'i tshe/ /snying stobs chen 'chang ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /log g.yang sa'i sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i tshe/ /bya gnam 'phang gcod pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /lha btsan bdud bran du khol ba'i tshe/ /rgyud seṅge 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bdud 'dre mor thog brdzis byed pa'i tshe/ /rngam rgya stag 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /ma mkha' 'gro las la bskul ba'i tshe/ /sgra g.yu 'brug ldir ba'i rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo tsher ma'i thang la lhung ba'i tshe/ /lus rdo rje'i go khrab rnal 'byor pa/ /lam rtsa rlung gtum mo sgom pa'i tshe/ /zer nyi zla kha sbyor rnal 'byor pa/

/'khor bu slob sbyin bdag mthong ba'i tshe/ /bu grub thob 'ja' lus rnal 'byor pa/ /pha ngo mtshar che'o padma 'byung*/ /brag sra mkhregs phur pa 'debs pa'i 'bangs/ /gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes ma lags sam/ /gter yid bzhin nor bu len mdzad de/ /bu gter bdag gling pa ma lags sam/ /brag g.yang la bya ltar 'phur ba de/ /sngon sbyangs stobs bzang po ma lags sam/ /'khor kun gyis ya nga mthong ba de/ /mi kho bos grub rtags ma lags bsam/ /pha mkhyen no pad 'byung e ma ho/ /bdag yin pa'i glu gcig len tsa na/ /pha pad 'byung spyi bor sgom pa ni/ /chos brgyud pa gcig chog bla ma yin/ /gnas gang dgar bag nyal byed pa ni/ /chos rdzogs chen dgag sgrub bral ba yin/ /lam sgo gsum gang shar spyod pa ni/ /gzhi 'gyur med ka dag rang skad yin/ /zas zhim dgu'i longs spyod rol ba ni/ /lus yi dam tshogs 'khor dgyes pa yin/ /gos 'jam dar rgyan sogs mnyes pa ni/ /zhing lha dang lha mo'i rgyan 'chang yin/ /ngag bzlas brjod spros pa bcad pa ni/ /rlung 'byung 'jug rdo rje'i rang sgra yin/ /lus bskyed rim spangs pa'i sos dal ni/ /don ma bsgoms rang shar mngon rdzogs yin/ /sems gnas 'gyu spangs pa'i rgya yan 'di/ /gzhi khregs chod chos nyid lta ba yin/ /rgyan he ru ka yi cha byad 'di/ /rlung gtum mo spyod pa'i brtul zhugs yin/ /'khor btsun mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba 'di/ /lam 'ja' lus rdo rje'i gsang khrid yin/ /yul gang yang ngan dgu bsten pa 'di/ /rgyud rnam rtog gcod pa'i ro snyom yin/ /gdon dme mdze yugs mor bsre ba 'di/ /bdud nyon mongs rang rgyud 'dul ba yin/ /dgra sha 'khon snying rjes skyong ba 'di/ /ma sems can pha mar rgyud sbyangs yin/ /mi che yang spro ba mi skye ba/ /rgyud khengs sems kyi mgo bo smad pa yin/ /mar dma' yang 'bu shu mi bskur bar/ /snang srid chos sku'i rol rtsal yin/

/nor yod kyang 'tsho skyong mi shes pa/ /gter snag shog goms 'dris che ba yin/ /lar mi chos blo bstun mi shes pa/ /rkyen yal kha'i 'jigs dang bral ba yin/ /rang bslu ba'i dkor sdud mi mkhas pa/ /brda rten 'brel gang shar goms pa yin/ /chos zab gter gsang rgya mi shes pa/ /ma mkha' 'gror phyi nang bral ba yin/ /gnas phyogs ris gtad so ma mchis pa/ /yul skyid sdug bdag 'dzin med pa yin/ /gar thod thod smyo spyod byed pa 'di/ /chos chos can bdag 'dzin bral ba yin/ /yul phyogs bral gter sgo 'byed pa 'di/ /mgon pad 'byung yab yum thugs rje yin/ /rtags shog ser ri mo bkra ba 'di/ /sngon bsal bzhag rig pas sangs pa yin/ /glu kha mtshar gyi bshad pa 'byed pa 'di/ /lus rtsa rlung rgya mdud grol ba yin/ /de go'am skal ldan rjes 'jug rnams/ /don rtogs sam sbyin bdag pho mo tsho/ /blo bde'o rnal 'byor rjes 'brangs nga/ /yid spro'o u rgyan gter bdag gling*/ /zhe dga'o rgyal khams 'jig rten bod/ /sems skyo'o sems can chos med tsho/ /ngo tsha'o rang rgyud ma mthong tsho/ /blo rmug go 'khor ba'i khyim 'dzin tsho/ /rkub tsha'o dge bshes dreg pa tsho/ /mi sdug go yul ngan dpon po tsho/ /zhe khrel lo blo ngan mi ser tsho/ /nyams dma'o btsun pa sdom shor tsho/ /yi mug go a ne smad 'tshong tsho/ /sems pham mo bu mo go ma tsho/ /yid skyo'o stag shar gzhon pa tsho/ /ngo mtshar ro gter ston smyo spyod can/ /glu yag snyan dbyangs char sil ma 'di/ /pha mnyes shig pad 'byung yab yum mchod/ /don bzang pos chos brgyud smin grol shog /nyams mtshar de ga tsam zhig mgur du bzhengs/ /de nas rim bzhin lam du bgrod nas 'ong*/ /yi dwags la ru bsdad pa'i nub mo la/ /sngar gyis gnod pa'i gson 'dre nag mo des/ /wa mo dmar mo lce brgyad bzhon nas su/ /mi sha lag pa 'dra zhig thogs pa dang*/

/bdag la 'tshe zhing gur la bskor nas 'dug kho bo drag sngags ting nge 'dzin la bsdad/ /dam tshig rdo rje dmigs nas dam la bzhag /phyir nangs song nas zhabs dbye zam khar bsdad/ /zam pa de yi mtshams su sleb pa dang*/ /sngar gyi lha srung thams cad log nas song*/ /padma rong tshun gnas kyi gzhi bdag dang*/ khyad par gter gyi srung ma ma lus kun/ /mdun bsu ja 'dren tshul gyis slebs pa la/ khams 'dri bgyis sogs rogs ldan legs par byung*/ /de yi zhogs la rim bzhin bgrod de song*/ /lho rong bkra shis chos rdzong bya bar phyin/ /de ru bsdad pas mi dbang dam pa ni/ /sde pa bsam dar kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis/ /gdan 'dren byung bas rten 'brel legs par 'grigs/ /chos bdag mnga' gsol chos tshan 'ga' re phul/ /dbang lung la sogs zhib rgyas gnang ba dang*/ /de tshe sde pa nyid kyis legs 'bul ni/ /bkra shis maṇḍal rdzas kyi rim pa la/ /gser dngul g.yu dang kha dar rin po che/ /dar yug gos chen rta dang khrab la sogs/ /rten 'brel che ba'i 'bul tshan sna tshogs dang*/ /gzhan yang gzhung gi sgar dpon grong skor sogs/ /dad ldan mang pos rdzas 'bul sna tshogs byung*/ /de nas rim bzhin song ba'i lam du ni/ /tshongs dpon la sogs sbyin bdag mang po yis/ /rim bzhin rten 'brel rdzas sogs mang po byung*/ /de nas khyung tho la rtser phyin pa'i tshe/ /sde brgyad 'ga' res cho 'phrul byung ba la/ /rdo rje phur pa btab nas bka' bsgo byas/ /de nas be shod rdzong rtsar phyin pa'i tshe/ /rim bzhin rten 'brel legs tshogs brtags pa la/ /thog mar yul gru bde ba'i rten 'brel brtags/ /zam srung de yi ming ni dris pa'i tshe/ /ming la thod sho yin zer bshad 'dug pas/ /gshag ral rmas pa'i ming ni zer ba la/ /yul gru 'thab rtsod cung zad 'ong ba'i rtags/ /gter gyi kha byang rten 'brel brtags nas su/ /bu mo mtshan bzang zhig ni 'dug pa la/

/nyungs ma bzang po khur shog bgyis pa'i tshe/ /nyungs ma chos 'byung yod pa khur nas byung*/ /de yis shin tu rten 'brel 'grigs pa byung*/ /de nub shing chang tshong la bsdad pa'i tshe/ /las can mkha' 'gro mi nor rten 'brel du/ /a dzi wan zhes zer ba 'dug pa la/ khyod la lus yig gang 'dug ston smras pas/ /gcer bur phyung ste lus yig bstan nas byung*/ /de yis gsang rgya mi nor rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de nas chu mdo zam khar bsdad pa'i tshe/ /'gro don 'dul zhing rten 'brel brtags pa la/ /zam srung tshang gis gcod dmigs zhu bar byung*/ /nub mo gcod btang lha 'dre dbang du bsdus/ /bka' bsgos dam bzhag tha tshig legs par bsgrags/ /de yis 'gro don 'dul zhing rten 'brel byung*/ /de nas mdong chu byams pa'i mdun du song*/ /ka nam sde pa chos bdag zhal ngo la/ /dam tshig sbrel bsam rten 'brel brtags nas ni/ /byams pa'i phyag tu snyan dar phul ba la/ /phyag g.yon srin mdzub de yis blangs nas song*/ /de yis las kyi chos bdag rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de nas bal phu ri khrod bgrod nas song*/ /mchod rdzas tshogs 'khor rten 'brel brtag pa'i tshe/ /sha chang la sogs phun sum tshogs par 'dug /de yis dngos grub mchod sprin rten 'brel 'grigs/ /de yi phyir nangs snga zhogs dang rtse ru/ /mi dbang ka nam sde pa tshang la ni/ /las stobs bden tshig bslu med smon lam bzhin/ /chos bdag mnga' gsol lung rgya bkrol ba'i phyir/ /zab pa'i chos tshan 'grigs chags dang bcas pa/ /ba sha bla mar bskul te 'bul rgyur brdzangs/ /de yi nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /nam mkha'i gos can 'dra ba'i lha mo lnga/ /mda' dar bhandha thogs te mdun du byung*/ /gar stabs shig ge brda skad 'di ltar gsungs/ kyai ho lanti sha ya dza/ /gu ru bi mu so yag he/ /ni ra ka taṃ la ni ho/ /si ma dzñā bu ma taṃ dza/ /zhes pa'i sgra tshig des bskul nas/

/mi dmigs 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /de nas cung zad yun gyi mtshams/ /mi lus gcer bu lag brgyad pa/ /dge bsnyen smyon pa'i gzugs can zhig /bdag gi mdun du lhags nas byung*/ /sgra tshig skye med 'di skad zer/ kyai ho/ /sngags 'chang gar gyi dbang*/ /lo tsā'i dbang phyug dzñā na ba/ /rje yi gdung 'tshob sku nyid la/ /mdun 'dir sngon gyi tha tshig bstan/ /bdag ni gzi can me gro'i sprul/ /chu chen bco brgyad gnas kyi bdag /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i gter srung mchog /dge bsnyen smyon pa smyo kha ba/ /nā ga raksha srin po'i rigs/ /padma'i bka' nyan las 'dzin te/ /dus 'dir bab pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ /brda 'di dang por 'dzin pa la/ /bdud ri nag po rngam 'dra'i zhal/ /dar snar kun gyi thog ma zungs/ /sgrom bu rta yi mgo zhes nang*/ /rta mchog nyi ma'i snying po yod/ /rgya der sang nas ma 'byor na/ /mi lo bcu gsum don mi 'gyur/ /ji bzhin phebs kyis 'bul lo zer/ /yud kyis nam yang lang nas song*/ /de nas cung zad tsam zhig song ba ru/ /skya rengs shar dang gnyid kyang sad nas 'dug /de yi zhogs la lung bstan ji bzhin du/ /grwa 'khor kun la tshogs rdzas legs grabs bcug /dam chos dkon mchog zhes pa'i grwa pa gnyis/ khrid de lam zhugs rten 'brel brtags pa'i tshe/ /bal phu mtsho yi 'gram du sleb pa dang*/ /mi skya pho mo ming bzang 'ga' re yis/ khengs pa'i chu zom khur ba dag dang 'phrad/ /de nas dar sna'i zam khar sleb pa'i tshe/ /rigs ldan bud med chas bzang 'ga' re 'phrad/ /de nas gter gnas drung du sleb pa dang*/ /tshogs 'khor btang zhing rten 'brel brtags pa'i tshe/ /ra gzhi dpon rgan tshe dbang bkra shis kyis/ kha dar dang ni bcud kyi sbrang khyer nas/ /rems blo mi zhum tshul gyis slebs nas byung*/ /gzhan yang dad ldan rigs dang the tshom can/ /ser skya 'dres ma mang po don nas byung*/

/rim bzhin tshogs 'khor grub rjes gter rgya btsal/ /gter srung rnams la tha tshig brjod pa'i tshe/ /gter rgyar me tshag kem kem 'thor nas 'dug /the tshom med pa brtul zhugs smyo spyod kyis/ /rdo ril sbom pos brdungs te brag bshig nas/ /rlung gi 'khor lo'i rgya dag bkrol ba'i tshe/ /dri zhim ngad ldan 'ub kyis 'khyil ba dang*/ /rin chen zab mo'i shog ser mjal nas byung*/ /gdan drangs rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ /rta skad thengs gsum sing sgra dang bcas thos/ /de nas mjal zhing gang 'dug bltas pa'i tshe/ khro rgyal rta mchog nā ga klu 'dul gyi/ /yang zab chos tshan 'brel tshad don ldan 'dug /dar tshon dril nas sgrom bur bcug pa dang*/ /gter rdzong brgyab ste longs spyod tshogs la rol/ /de skabs za zi bar ma'i nyams snang la/ /mi bdud shan pa 'dra ba mang po yis/ /tshogs 'khor 'bul lo cung zad bzhugs dang zer/ /snying dang klad khrag cha gcig phul nas byung*/ /bdag gis phud de cung zad rol ba dang*/ /lhag ma gter srung rnams la mchod pa phul/ /de nas ra gzhir phebs zer 'ong ba'i lam/ /grong ltag rdo phung zhig gi rtsa ba ru/ /bud med nag mo zangs kyi mche ba can/ /gcer bu rgyan med spu gri thogs pa bdun/ /mgo gsum mig dgu yod pa'i sde tshan gyis/ /mi skya pho mo ser skya bcu bdun tsam/ /bsha' bzhin sha khrag dmar 'gyed btang ba dang*/ /rgyu ma dag ni thag ltar lam du bran/ /cung zad bltas shing phyogs bzhir log nas song*/ /de nas ra gzhi'i grong smad sleb pa dang*/ /bud med gdong la sme ba yod pa yi/ /tshe yi ming can 'dra ba zhig gis ni/ /mi yis rkang lag gnyis tsam khur nas byung*/ /rib rib lam 'og de ru lang nas song*/ /ra gzhi dpon tshang nang du sleb pa dang*/ /dbang lung gnang nas zhag gsum de ru bsdad/ /dngul sogs zang zing 'bul ba mang du byung*/ /rim bzhin chos gling phyogs su log nas song*/

/de yi nub mo nyams dang za zi la/ /mdun gyi mkha' nas dpag tshad khyab pa yi/ /'ja' 'od me dpung thig le'i klong dkyil du/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma gu ru padma ni/ /bde chen rgyal po thugs rje'i gzi 'od can/ /pad zhwa za ber phod kha chos gos gsol/ /dpa' bo rol stabs tshul gyis lam me ba/ /mtsho rgyal manda ra ba la sogs pa'i/ /gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor nas su/ /phyag tu brda sprod chas dag bsnams nas 'dug /de yi 'og tu las mgon bya rog gdong*/ /sde dpon dregs pa 'bum gyis bskor nas 'dug /de 'og sa gzhi'i gling khams thams cad kun/ /stong gsum lha 'dre 'dus pa khrom ltar snang*/ /de dag kun gyis spyi bor thal sbyar nas/ /gu ru rje la gsol ba 'debs nas 'dug /gzhan yang gu ru rje yi mdun phyogs su/ /gar mo mchod sprin thogs pa grangs med 'dug /de tshe bdag kyang gdung bas rtse gcig gis/ /skyabs mchog pha la gsol ba 'di skad btab/ na mo hūm̐/ khyab bdag 'gran gyis zla bral mtshungs med rje/ /rgyal ba kun las lhag pa'i 'gro mgon mchog /pha gcig gtan gyi skyabs gyur u rgyan rje/ /pad 'byung drin can bla ma yab yum la/ /rtse gcig snying nas gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /smin grol dbang bzhi thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /ḍākki 'bum gyis bdag sogs bar chad sol/ /dam can rgya mtshos phrin las myur du bsgrubs/ /snang srid skye 'gro'i tshogs rnams dbang du bsdus/ /'gro kun bde dga'i chos la spyod par shog /oṃ gu ru ḍākki sarba siddhi hrīḥ de skad bdag gis gsol ba btab pa dang*/ /bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'bum phrag chad/ /bdag la zhu lum tshul gyis thim nas byung*/ /de tshe rje yi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ kyai ho/ legs par nyon dang thugs kyi sras/ kho bo'i 'bangs rnams kun gyi dwangs ma'i phud/ /lo tsā nus ldan sangs rgyas ye shes pa/ /yid kyi snying po rig pa'i lcags kyu yis/

/brda bzhi mngon gyur bstan gyis legs par zung*/ /bka' bab 'bras bu smin pa'i dus 'di ru/ /sgo gsum bag med yal bar ma dor bar/ /phangs pa'i srog ltar gdams ngag 'tshol bar gyis/ sa ma ya/ yid las skyes pa'i ri mo rtags rtsal can/ /snying po 'dod gzugs shes rab zim bu ris/ /sgo lnga rtsal sgron rnam dag ri mo can/ /kun gyi spur byed gshis lugs mthong ba'o/ /sgyu 'phrul du ma'i rnam 'byed 'dus ba rtsal/ /gnas dang gar bsgyur bsre ba spros shing spro/ /mkhyen rab nam mkha'i 'phrul mos ti la rgya/ sa ma ya/ thugs bcud man ngag zab mos lung rigs sbyongs/ /rnam pa kun tu nyams len snying po 'bod/ /yang dag don 'di ma g.yos gtsor bzung nas/ /so mtshams rig pa'i rten 'brel du ma'i sgor/ /'jug thabs mkha' 'gro'i brda bzhin bslad med zungs/ /nam yang zhum pa med pa'i btson 'grus gyis/ /'chad rtsod rtsom dang spel ba'i rgyal sa zungs/ /ring lugs so ma'i bab rgyun 'khrul med skyongs/ /man ngag bsdebs pa'i pha tshan dag phyogs skyongs/ /snyan brgyud rkang gi cha dang cha phran mthud/ /lta ba'i slob dpon zhal lnga gzhung re bsrang*/ /mthun 'jug ma yi lag nas phra zhib lon/ /zla babs gzhung 'dzin nyi ma'i mkha' srang bsgyur/ /dbugs kyi kha srog bye brag cho 'phrul ston/ /man tra ngag gi zhing rdul grangs mtha' yas/ /dper na chos su kun rtog rgyu nges ma/ /yid kyis sgyu ma khyad mos bye brag rtsal/ /snod gzugs bsdus mo ri lha mo btsun ltar/ khyad don srad bu ma bcings chos rtogs 'dra/ /mtshon na dpe 'dres kun la dbus su tshugs/ /gzhung la nyi ma'i bu mo gsang lam gcig /rtags rtsal mthun kyang bye brag bsrub pa'i chad/ /ma ning kun kyang ma yi bu gar 'jug /gter gyi zla ba rgya yi de mthong yin/ /lung rtags lung gis nyul de rig pas zungs/ /dha ti hi ma laṃ ta bā ri ya/ /bi ṭa bu ṣi dzis bu tha ni sa/

/ha dan ku la sha yi bi sa ta/ /dzā ho pam̐ so ma du ti ta ti/ /tra la shug yaṃ bi ta dzā la taṃ/ kyai ho skal ldan thugs kyi sras/ /bud dha dzñā na'i rnam par 'phrul/ /rtsa gsum gling rang legs par nyon/ /deng sang snyigs ma lnga brgya'i dus/ /sdig spyod bdud kyis sde dgu 'khrug /nyi ma rgas pa'i tshal chen bdun/ /zla ba bkum pa'i dur khrod brgyad/ /skar ma 'thor ba'i sde tshan gsum/ /glog gi zhags pa lce 'bam gnyis/ /zhing sa med pa'i lo thog gsum/ /de sogs spyi dang bye brag kun/ /smin dang skam la cha med tshe/ /gnyen po gso byed gdams pa ni/ /gangs can bod kyi sbas yul du/ /ka ma ru pa rgya gar byang*/ /rngam pa lha btsan ging gi mdun/ /dur khrod laṅka 'dra ba'i tshal/ /chu klung 'ur sgra 'byin pa'i rong*/ /sha za las mkhan 'gyu ba'i srang*/ /mtshon nag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dbus/ /klu bdud nā ga rakshi khyim/ /chu gri bsnol ba'i pho brang nas/ /nyin mo khu rlangs dud pa phyung*/ /mtshan mo tsha tshwa kem kem 'bar/ /bar med 'gyu ba'i drag sngags sgrogs/ /skabs su sman mos rgyangs glu len/ /dus drug pho nya lam lam 'gyu/ /rlung dang chu sgra 'thab pa'i tshe/ /srid pa'i ri rab yom zhing 'ur/ /de 'dra 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog tu/ /rgyud sde kun gyi yang snying ni/ /gcig tu dril ba'i khyad par can/ kho bo bdag gi mgul khug ma/ /bka' brgyad kun gyi bcud bsdus ni/ /gsang ba zil gnon chen po ste/ /sngon chad sa steng ma grags shing*/ /mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs bun ne ba/ /ti ka thugs kyi dpe'u nyid/ /mthong grol sgrom du bskyil nas kyang*/ /nag po klu la bcol te yod/ /da lan sa rtags dus mnyam ste/ /skal ldan khyod kyis 'byin pa yin/ /smin grol 'bras bu'i dus la bab/ /sang nas zhag gsum tshun chod du/ /rten 'brel lung bzhin 'grigs par gyis/ /ci ste 'di la ma thon na/ /skye ba gsum gyi 'gro don chad/

/'dzam gling gangs can sil bur 'thor/ /lo bdun khrag gi char pa 'bab/ /me yi ser ba phyogs bcur g.yo/ /bod khams srin po'i dmag chen 'khrid/ /sems can bde skyid dmyal ba'i gling*/ /'pho 'chug 'du chen de ltar lags/ /smon lam mtshams sbyor 'bungs shig bu/ /ji bzhin 'di nyid thon gyur cing*/ /skal ldan chos bdag rim pa bzhin/ /chos tshan lung byang 'phrod pa dang*/ /ma nyams rten 'brel 'grigs gyur na/ /mdo sngags rgyal bstan 'tsho ba dang*/ /chos bdag rnams kyi bar chad sel/ /yul gru rnams kyang bkra shis 'gyur/ khyad par chos 'di 'brel tshad rnams/ /byang chub thar pa'i lam sna zin/ /mthong thos dran rig mngon sangs rgyas/ /yang dag sa bcu'i rtse mor bsnyegs/ /rgyal ba'i thugs rje kun 'dus pa'i/ /mchog gi dam pa sprul sku nyid/ /rab 'byams zhing la 'gro don byed/ /de phyir yang snying bla med chos/ /gdams pa 'di dang 'phrad pa'i tshe/ /'gro ba 'dul zhing gdul bya 'ur/ /rjes 'jug skal ldan dad can la/ /smin grol chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed/ /thugs rje'i rang gzugs dus der mngon/ /lung 'di zhal gdams yid la bcag /brda de mi 'gyur rgya rtags ni/ /nub byang shar lho rim pa bzhin/ /bhan ya bi ra ni ra dang*/ /dun du sa mu ku la sha/ /dza haṃ wa ra tanta ṣe/ mi sa ta ye bā tu satwaṃ/ /ji bzhin rgya rtags de ltar lags/ /de dag shes rab spyan gyis rtogs/ /chos de len dang phebs pa'i grogs/ /maṅga : puṇyai : ā yur : de wi : ind+ra te : shrī dza ya nyya/hrī: la : badzra : padma : u ṭa :ma ṇi : dharma : a dza ya : ratna : karma : rtags ldan de ni nges 'byung pa/ /'grigs pas gegs med mthar phyin 'gyur/ /dregs dpung kun 'dus dmag tshogs la/ /sha khrag dmar gyi gtor mas mchod/ /sba yi mngon 'dod skabs dang bstun/ /ci phyir smon lam de 'grigs na/ kho bo'i zab chos smin grol khyad/ /'gro la rems blo ma chung 'tshal/

/dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ /nga nyid snying gi dkyil du sgoms/ /legs par bcags so rtsa gsum gling*/ /ti la ka ni sa ta rakta rgya/ /de skad gsungs nas gu ru rigs 'dus tshogs/ /gter srung dang bcas bdag la thim pa dang*/ /dregs pa'i dmangs rnams 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /de nas gnyid sad nam mkha' langs nas 'dug /de yi zhogs nas tshogs rdzas bzang po thogs/ /dpon slob brgya skor ma zin tsam bcas nas/ /bal phu ya 'brog mtsho la phyin nas song*/ /de yi nub la dkyil 'khor thang du bsdad/ /grwa slob thams cad gter rgya btsal du btang*/ /lung bstan lta bu'i rgya rtags ma rnyed tshe/ kho bo bdag ni yi mug blo re zhum/ /lus kyang gter lhong drag pos yin 'dug pas/ /na tsha gnyan rgod brgyab pa lta bur 'dug /'du phung ma snyom ngang la nyal te bsdad/ /nam phyed zin pa tsam gyi tshun chod la/ /lus kyang bag tsha gnyid kyang ma khug cing*/ /blo sems bun cing zhe kha mong bar 'dug /tho rangs gnyid pa'i rmi lam za zi ru/ /gnod sbyin mi bdud seng mgo yin zer ba'i/ /mi ring dmar po seṅge'i mgo can gyis/ /dred mong kham pa ri log chung ba tsam/ /mi mgo'i phreng bas sna thag brgyan pa zhon/ /bud med gcer mo stong phrag tsam khrid nas/ /lung pa 'ur gyis 'gengs shing mdun du byung*/ /nga ro 'dra ba'i sgra las 'di skad zer/ /ha ha ka ni khying khying rong 'di sha za'i yul/ /sngags pa khyod dag 'di ru ci phyir bgrod/ /nged kyi sde tshogs lha btsan nag po ste/ /rong chen bzhi yi gter gyi rgya srung yin/ khyod la lung bstan kha byang yod lags sam/ /gter rgya 'byin na lde mig yod lags sam/ /dregs pa mnyes pa'i dmar mchod yod lags sam/ /klu bdud zil gnon gdams ngag yod lags sam/ /de ltar med na 'di ru slebs pa 'khrul/ /de la ji bzhin lan mo gyis shig zer/ /bdag gis de la brda don bkrol ba ni/

/mi lus seng mgo dred chibs dpon g.yog rnams/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo bdag la legs par gson/ /nga ni rgyal bas lung bstan gdung gi tshab/ khyod ni gnyer gtad dam la gnas pa'i rigs/ /sngon tshe gu ru'i bka' la ma 'da' bar/ /rgya rtags lung bzhin ri mo myur du ston/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas 'bul mchid thogs te yod/ /nag po klu 'dul bya khyung ting 'dzin shes/ /nga ni de tsam rems blo zhum pa min/ /de bas dam la ma 'da' gter rgya ston/ oṃ yaksha singha mu kha hriṃ hriṃ nan ma tri ya tsitta nan bi sha thi phrum thi phrum swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags de brjod pa'i tshe/ khos kyang ji bzhin 'di skad zer/ ho/ dpa' bo rdo rje bdud 'dul che/ /gsungs pa'i bka' de tshig gi mchog /bdag gis 'ub cing srog snying phul/ /da ni rgya rtags legs par ston/ /'di nas yar tsam bsnyegs pa'i rong*/ /pha bong bya rog 'dra ba yi/ /lto ba klu bdud nag po'i khar/ /chu gri'i 'khor los bsdams te yod/ /sid ta mtshan dho'i 'og tu ni/ /ti ra gzugs kyi ka rar yin/ /mu la ka yi gong la yin/ /sha la kum pa'i ba mer yin/ /thim rgya mi ti ṭa de zungs/ /hu ti wa ra yaṃ wa ra yaṃ/ /si mi bi shom gu ra he ya ga ta dza tha traṃ ha he big satwaṃ/ de skad zer nas 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /de nas rgyang tsam song mtshams nam yang sangs/ /lus kyang cung zad bde nyams tsam du 'dug /de ru chos khri legs par brtsegs pa dang*/ /tshogs 'khor btang zhing rten 'brel brtags pa'i tshe/ /ka nam sde pa'i bka' shog 'bul mkhan byung*/ /bka' shog de yi 'bru don legs tshogs la/ /sbas yul chen mo 'di la dbang ba yi/ /bdag po gnyan 'di nged cag tshang yin pas/ /gnas mchog khyad 'phags lho phyogs gling 'di ru/ /gangs can bde ba'i chos bka' 'dug lags na/ /gter sgo zab mo gang 'dug 'byed rogs zhu/ /nam mkha'i ming gis lha reg dmar po phul/ /bsdus don ltar na de ltar 'dug pa las/

/de yis rten 'brel ji ltar 'grigs zhe na/ /nam mkha'i ming bzhin kun la khyab pa'i brda/ /lha reg dmar po shes rab mkha' 'gro'i brda/ /mi shigs mi reg gsang rgya 'byed pa'i brda/ /'bul mkhan dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i brda/ /the tshom med pa'i las rnams ma nor brda/ /brda lnga 'grigs nas rngam pa rong du song*/ /sa rtags thams cad zhib par brtags pa'i tshe/ /gter gnas pha bong de yi steng du ni/ /klu sman chen mo gsang ba 'od ldan ni/ /sbrul sngon chen mo zhig tu brdzus nas kyang*/ /gter rgya mdun du mgo bo thon tsam 'dug /de ma thag tu the tshom med par phyin/ /bden tshig brjod nas gtor ma phul ba dang*/ /gtsod ru smug chung bya khyung nag po bskyed/ /sbrul gyi thad dkar mtsho 'khor dkrugs pa'i tshe/ /gter sgrom khyad 'phags mthong ba don ldan nyid/ /sbrul gyis kha stabs lang ling bkyags nas byung*/ /de skabs mig btsums glo bur bsnyabs pa'i tshe/ /tsha 'ub chil chil lag tu tshud nas byung*/ /blangs shing byin brlabs smon lam bgyis pa dang*/ /de nas klu la rin chen gter rdzong phul/ /gnas la bkra shis rab gnas bgyis pa dang*/ /dga' brod bzod blag med par log nas song*/ /sngar ltar chos khri steng du bsdad pa dang*/ /gter sgrom mjal kha bgyis nas tshogs 'khor phul/ /'gro ba kun gyis mi phyed dad pa thob/ /de tshe kun kyang spro ba bskyed nas su/ /gnas la mchod 'bul zhabs bro rgyag zer nas/ /skal ldan khrom kun rang 'os bro brdungs nas/ /rgan rgog rnams ni 'khun pa di ri ri/ /skyes pa rnams ni skad gri sha ra ra/ /bu mo rnams ni rgyan cha khro lo lo/ /byis pa rnams ni bzhad gad tse re re/ /spo bo'i bro brdung 'di 'dra rgyag yin zer/ /rdog sgra khrig khrig gdangs 'di gtong ba skad/ /'jag gnas ri zhig ma mjal gnas ri mjal/ /'jag gnas ri de zangs mdog dpal ri 'dra zhig mjal/

/zangs mdog dpal ri de 'ja' 'od gur du 'khyil/ /'jag bla ma zhig ma phebs bla ma phebs/ /'jag bla ma u rgyan padma 'dra zhig phebs/ /u rgyan padma de dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor/ /'jag gter sgo ma phye gter sgo phyes/ /'jag gter sgo u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas phyes/ /rtsa gsum gling pa'i thugs rje'i gter chos phob/ /rtsa gsum gling pas thugs rje'i sa gzhir byin chen phob/ /sbas pa'i yul 'dir bkra shis rab gnas shog /zhabs bro gnyis len gsum brgyab ma shes na/ /shar po kong phrug gzhon pa ma yin pa 'dra/ /rdog bro 'di ni sag 'gros 'dra zhig thongs/ gcig so a/ gnyis so a/ gcig gnyis gsum brgyab lan mo 'dra thongs shog a/ zhes pa'i bro 'bul de tsam bgyis nas song*/ /de nas bkra shis rab gnas bgyis pa dang*/ kho bo dag kyang bsam don 'grub pa'i tshe/ /dga' ston gnas la mchod 'bul bgyis pa'i ched/ kho bos dga' glu 'di tsam bzhengs pa'o/ na mo gu ru/ mi kho bos dad mos mtho rtse'i steng*/ /blo rtse gcig gdung ba'i lang tsho'i dbus/ /pha rgyal ba kun las lhag pa yi/ /skyabs mtshungs med pad 'byung prog zhu de/ /bdag rtsa gsum gling pa'i thod la brgyan/ /mgon 'gro ba'i dpung gnyen thugs rje'i gter/ /byams khyab bdag kun 'dus 'od zer de/ /brda gcig bsdus karma bha dra ba/ /bdag skal ldan mig gi padmor shar/ /dbyings mkha' ltar dwangs pa'i gshis lugs la/ /rlung sor rtse'i sbu gu'i gra bsdebs nas/ /bka' lung rigs mkhyen gnyis ri mo bkod/ /de 'gro ba'i dga' ston bla ma'i drin/ /bu sngon 'phros mjal de ngo mtshar che/ /pha mtshungs med rgyal de'i zhabs la 'dud/ /bu da ni kha mtshar glu len na/ /gzhi dang po bslab pa gsum nas len/ /lam gnyis pa kṛ yog rgyud nas len/ /'bras 'khor gsum a ti'i gzhung nas len/ /tshig snang srid dpe ru sbyar nas len/ /don gnad 'gag khog tu phug nas len/

/sgra sdeb sbyor rgyan du bkod nas len/ /mkhas khyad chos zur gyis ngom nas len/ /de rgyud don kho bos glu phugs yin/ /de sa mtshams so so'i gdangs shig btang*/ /mi kho bo rab byung mgo ril dus/ /gzhi rnam rtaug sgom zhing sangs rgyas 'grub/ /lam 'dzin pas bcings nas bros sa btsal/ /sems ma rig long bas kha chos bshad/ /gzhi chags sdang dgon du grub thob rlom/ /las rgyu 'bras gsod pa'i bla ma 'dod/ /rang gar 'gro cha med tshe 'das 'dren/ /sang nam 'chi cha med sdod ches bsgrubs/ khyod theg dman sgrub pa'i rtsa gsum gling*/ /gzhi gshis lugs rtogs la ma bskos zin/ /lam grol cha thob pa ya re cha/ /'bras don med min nam rtsa gsum gling*/ khyod nyan thos bslab pa'i grong khyer du/ /gzhi theg dman bud med skyong skyong nas/ /lam gol sa ri rdo ma brdzis sam/ /chos phar phyin 'dul ba drug ldan gyi/ /tshul rnam dag dge slong kho thag chod/ /de go'am rtsa gsum gling pa ba/ kha stong bshad ne tsho ma ṇi can/ /lung gcig shes kun grol rgyab log la/ /bka' bcu yang ma lags gcig kyang sdug /phyi zog zog 'ba' la'i rgyal mtshan phyar/ /rgyud khengs sems ha la'i 'dam rdzab can/ /mi khyod 'dra'i btsun pa mgo ril las/ /brag srib ri nag po'i 'ug pa dga'/ /de go'am padma gter bdag gling*/ khyod dang 'dra ba gzhan yod na/ /las don med bsam zhing snying rlung ldang*/ /de go yul rang mtshang can gyis longs/ /bdag rtsa gsum gling pa'i smyo spyod la/ /tshig kha bshad de tsam go go nas/ /sems grol cha lcags phur ngar ma'i rno/ /bzhu rgol btul 'dod na byed ran 'dug /de nyan thos gsum gyis glu len yin/ /da kṛ yog gsum gyi glu len na/ /pha kun tu bzang po thog ma'i mgon/ /gnad gcig shes de la rgyud sde rdzogs/ /gzhi ka dag zang thal zer ba yin/ /brda snang srid lung rigs ri mo mkhan/ /dbyings dga' rab rdo rje ma lags sam/
