/tshig mtshon du med pa'i thig le che/ /de chos sgo brgyad khri 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gnad don gnyis klong la shar ba nyid/ /mkhas shrī singha ma lags sam/ /phyi tshogs drug sgyu ma'i nyan thos kun/ /don gang shar ngo bo bdag med rtogs/ /tshig rang bcings sdom pa'i mu ge yal/ /dgra dug lnga'i dmag tshogs bde stong rol/ /phyi mtshan nyid lta ba'i ba gam rgyas/ /nang gnas lugs sgom pa'i nyi ma shar/ /dbyings 'khor 'das snod bcud dbang du bsdus/ /lung gnyis su mkhas shing brtan pa thob/ /rje sangs rgyas kun gyi spyi gzugs te/ /pha padma 'byung nas ma lags sam/ /rje de yis byin brlabs thugs kyi sras/ /mi kho bo rtsa gsum chos kyi rgyal/ /skyabs gong ma'i gsung rgyun gnas lugs la/ /lam go yul a ti'i glu len na/ /lus ma bcos tshogs drug lhug pa bde/ /ngag ma bcos 'byung 'jug bzlas pa bde/ /sems ma bcos 'du shes bzod med bdi/ /rgyan ma bcos bklubs pa'i gos dkar bde/ /skra ma bcos ral pa'i lcang lo bde/ /grogs ma bcos bde stong pho nya bde/ /mkhar ma bcos dben pa'i brag phug bde/ /zas ma bcos blang dor bral ba bde/ /nor ma bcos rang sems kun 'byung bde/ /yul ma bcos gtad so bral bas bde/ /zhing ma bcos chos sku'i rgyal sa bde/ /bu bde sdug a ti bla med drin/ /dus phyi mo'i sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling*/ /lung spyi nas grags pa'i gter bdag gling*/ /brda gsang mtshan gnam lcags rdo rje ba/ /spyod smyo ba lta bu'i drag po rtsal/ /mi phal cher rnam rtog 'khrul nas smyo/ /mi kho bo nyams rtogs 'bar nas smyo/ /mi smyo tshab che ba'i 'jig rten pa/ /mig had kyis blta nas ngan 'gror mchongs/ /las rgyu 'bras rig cing dkon mchog spangs/ /lar 'chi ba shes kyang sdod chos bsgrubs/ /chos bde 'gro'i ched du sdig pa 'bad/ /sems dran rig sangs rgyas 'khor bar bcug /lus mi gtsang rdzas la byi dor byed/

/tshe rten gyi 'dun ma rgyab la bskyur/ /las mi dge'i sna thag mdun nas 'then/ /drin bskyangs pa'i sgo nor log par gsod/ /rten skyabs kyi bla ma snying nas smad/ /dus nam yang phung ba'i nye ba bstod/ /dgra 'khor ba'i btson ra khyim 'dzin brtse/ /las don med 'khor ba'i so nam bsgrubs/ /zog snying med zang zing mig ltar skyong*/ /tshe 'di yi 'dun ma rab rib des/ /don ma rig ngang la 'chi ba slebs/ /mi smyo tshab chen po 'jig rten pa/ /tshe 'di phyi med pa'i smyo lugs yin/ /mi khyod rnams 'phral du rtsad bcad nas/ /phyis ngan song 'bras bu yal te bde/ /mi kho bo smyo ba'i smyo lugs ni/ /sems gtad so bral ba'i smyo smyo 'dra/ /yul nges med 'khyams pas smyo smyo 'dra/ /lus tshul 'chos mi shes smyo smyo 'dra/ /zob mi chos mi mkhas smyo smyo 'dra/ /bab che tshul zad pas smyo smyo 'dra/ /chos bdag med rtogs pas smyo smyo 'dra/ /yul nges med 'khyams pas smyo smyo 'dra/ /gnas dur khrod 'grims pas smyo smyo 'dra/ /lam ro snyom sbyangs pas smyo smyo 'dra/ /nyin 'khrul pa'i snang ba bdag med smyo/ /nub nyal ba'i rmi lam sgyu mar smyo/ /lam bar do'i yid lus stong par smyo/ /rgyud rigs drug rang gzugs chags med smyo/ /smyo che ba ma lags shi yang shi/ /sems rig pa'i klong du dug lnga 'chi/ /lam rgyu yi klong du tshogs drug 'chi/ /rtsa dhū ti'i sbubs su las rlung 'chi/ /grogs dga' bzhi'i gnas su 'dod chags 'chi/ /drod gtum mo'i mdangs kyis lhag pa 'chi/ /rlung 'ja' lus stobs kyis bsdus phung 'chi/ /gzhi chos sku'i klong du nyon mongs 'chi/ /de sngags rgan 'chi ba'i 'chi lugs yin/ /gnad 'chi ba'i man ngag drod tshad 'di/ /pha gu ru'i gdams ngag drin las thob/ /dgos tshad bla ma'i thugs la btags/ /mi bdag kyang rtsa rlung rgya mdud grol/ /'di kho bos 'dra tshul glu len te/

/rje gong ma rnams kyis thugs ma khrel/ /dgos sbyin bdag rnams kyis shag ma gnang*/ /de yin lugs gnas ri bzang por 'bul/ /gnad 'dra tshul mgo nag mi la sbyin/ /tshig bab chos thugs la ma gnang yag /nang dug lnga shi ba'i ye shes gsal/ /gzhi ka dag klong du gnas lugs bde/ /gter yid bzhin lon pas 'gro ba 'tshings/ /dus rten 'brel 'grigs pas bkra shis dge /rten nam yang yar ldan 'byung bar shog /de skad tsam du mgur du bzhengs pa dang*/ /rten 'brel dga' brod ngang du log ste song*/ /de nas nyer lnga nas bzung tshes gcig mtshams/ /ka nam sde pa tshang gis gdan 'dren byung*/ /tshes gsum snga dror brag rtsar 'gro bar byas/ /gsang sngags bstan skyong zhes bya'i mtshan can la/ /mchod yon rten 'brel 'grigs bzhin mjal 'phrad byas/ /gter sgrom shog ser la sogs mjal kha phul/ /tshes bdun nyin la padma yang rtser byon/ /'chi med tshe yi gter sgrub zhag bdun bsdad/ /dngos sam rmi lam nyams dang za zi la/ /grub rtags rtags dang lung bstan 'ga' re byung*/ /skabs su shog ser rnams kyang 'ga' re phab/ /bcu gsum nam langs dngos grub blangs pa'i tshe/ /pad zhwa chos gos la sogs phul byung bas/ /zab mo'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i rten 'brel 'grigs/ /byang chub char sogs thun mong dngos grub byung*/ /de nas nyi shar skabs su slebs pa dang*/ /sde pa zhal ngo padma 'jigs med dang*/ /nam mkha' dang ni padma dbang rgyal dang*/ /gzhan gyi blon chen dpon rigs la sogs pa/ /dam tshig ldan pa'i tshogs ni mang po la/ /zab pa'i dbang lung cha tshang bgyis pa dang*/ /de nas grol te nyi 'od mthil du bsdad/ /rin chen maṇḍal 'byor ldan dang bcas nas/ /gter sgrom khyad 'phags mthong ba don ldan gyi/ /gter rgya bkrol te zhal kha phyes pa'i tshe/ /nang du bzhugs pa'i yang zab snying po ni/ /bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi/ /shog dril a ma la sogs mang po dang*/

/slob dpon na bza' mtsho rgyal dbu skra bcas/ /drag sngags kun 'dus ril bu la sogs pa/ /gter gyi rtsi sman la sogs mang du 'dug /gter sgrom dag la bdud rtsi bab pa dang*/ /dbyings nas rdo rje phag mo'i zhal gzigs sogs/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas kyang mang po byung*/ /de tshe yon mchod kun gyis dad pa thob/ /dam rdzas myong zhing smon lam btab pa'i tshe/ kho bo dag la lung bstan mang byung ste/ /yi ger 'jigs nas skabs 'dir sbas pa'o/ /de nas zhag ni mi ring de dag la/ /mtshams nas grol te chos sder song ba'i tshe/ /bka' brgyud kun gyi gtsug rgyan sgam po pa/ /mnyam med dwags po'i sprul sku rin po che/ /bcu bzhi dgong mo chos sder phebs byung bas/ /de tshe mtshams sbyor bzang po'i rten 'brel du/ /sde pa zhal ngo gsang sngags bstan skyong dang*/ /ba sha dpon sgom u rgyan dpal 'byor bcas/ /zhal gros legs par bstun pa'i nang rgyas nas/ /lung zin chos bdag skyes bu 'dug pa bzhin/ /tshes pa bco lnga'i snga zhogs mjal phrad mdzad/ /thugs yid gcig 'dres gsung 'phros rgyas pa'i mtshams/ /gter sgrom chen mo mthong ba don ldan dang*/ /rdo sku gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro dang*/ /shog ser la sogs rten rigs khyad 'phags rnams/ /sprul sku rin po che la mjal kha phul/ /rtse gcig dbang bzhi smon lam mdzad pa dang*/ /a ma dam rdzas khyad par 'phags pa phul/ /lhag tu drag sngags kun 'dus ril bu ni/ /sku tshe'i bar chad sel ba'i ched du phul/ /legs 'bul rin chen gser dang bkra shis dar/ /dgyes shing mnyes pa'i tshul gyis gnang nas byung*/ de tshe kho bo'i nyams snang za zi la/ /mchog gi sprul sku'i dbu yi gtsug tor steng*/ /'ja' gur gnyis sbrel zhig gi nang du ni/ /snang ba mtha' yas mnyam bzhag skyil krung can/ /res gsal res mi gsal ba lan gnyis mjal/ /de tshe bdag nga mi phyed dad pa thob/

/thun mong ma yin thugs yid gcig tu 'dres/ /de nas sprul sku spo stod byon nas song*/ /bdag kyang de yi phyi nyin bgrod nas 'ong*/ /mdong chu yan dang ra gzhi mar btags la/ /dbang bskur chos ra zhag shas tsam du byas/ /mdong chu'i mtshan brgyad lha khang gnas pa'i tshe/ /de skabs nub mo nyal ba'i rmi lam du/ /bka' srung legs ldan 'bar ba mched bzhi yis/ /rang rang gzugs dang cha byad rdzogs nas su/ khang chung sgo nas shar gyis slebs nas byung*/ /dga' spros phyag 'tshal gus 'dud byed pa dang*/ /skye med gdangs las sgra tshig 'di skad zer/ kyai/ rgyal ba'i sras po lo tsā ba/ rtsa gsum gling pa legs par gson/ khyed nyid yang rdzong mchims phu ru/ /rje yi drung du bsdad pa'i tshe/ /lung byang bka' rgya 'bogs pa yis/ /ma nges 'byung gyur bstan pa de/ /rtags dang rten 'brel gnas 'dir yod/ khyad par yang zab drag po'i skor/ /yul gru dge ba'i chos ka yod/ /mtshams sbyor lung bstan dus 'dir yin/ /nged rnams las kyi bka' skyong yin/ /sang nas 'grogs dang rten 'brel 'grigs/ /zab pa'i mthar thug nyid la 'bul/ /nyid kyang gnas 'di'i sa bdag mdzod/ /'dul zhing bzhugs yul dus la bab/ /gter srung nged rnams bka' skyong ngo*/ /de nas 'ja' ltar yal nas song*/ /phyir nangs brel g.yeng che nas ma khom pas/ /nyi nub tsam nas gter srung slebs nas byung*/ /rten 'brel ma yengs 'phral du phebs shig zer/ /de ma thag nas tshogs rdzas bsgrigs pa dang*/ /de tshe bdag dang slob ma drag rim dang*/ /ka nam sde pa bsod nams rab mdzes dang*/ /phyag g.yog drung 'khor drag rim re zung bcas/ /yon mchod thams cad byams khang nang du song*/ /tshogs 'khor phul zhing tha tshig brjod pa'i tshe/ /gza' bdud nag po dngos su gzugs bstan nas/ /me yi kha rlangs tsha 'ub rab 'khyil nas/ /lce yi steng du shog dril 'dzin nas kyang*/ /byams pa'i sku rgyab gyang log khengs nas 'dug

/de tshe bdag gis lag pa zad pa'i tshe/ /byams pa'i snyan g.yon shog nas bab 'dra ba'i/ /tsha tshwa thor thor lag tu slebs nas byung*/ /dbang bzhi blangs shing gsol ba smon lam btab/ /dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyis dbang bzhi blangs/ /slar yang rab gnas bskyar te gter rdzong phul/ /phyi nangs zhogs nas sgrom bu kha phyes pas/ /drag po nam lcags 'khor lo'i chos tshan 'dug /de skabs yid 'ong gzhung nas yin pa zhig /gnas po sgam bu bkra shis bya ba dang*/ /gnas po dpal lu bya ba la sogs pas/ /rten 'brel mjal dar 'bul du byung ba dang*/ /sgam bu drug dkar g.yu zhig sprad nas kyang*/ /dgon sde mang po 'dzugs par mdzad pa dang*/ /smin par mdzad phyir yid 'ong phebs zhes zer/ /de yis ma bsgrigs rten 'brel 'ga' re 'grigs/ /de sogs rten 'brel mang po byung na yang*/ /yi ger 'jigs pas bri ba ma long ngo*/ /bal phur 'go nad 'dug pa mtshams kyang bcad/ /rnam dkar zang zing 'bul ba dag kyang byung*/ /de nas bal phur zla gcig mtshams la bsdad/ /de skabs sprul sku tshang nas mi 'grims byung*/ /'di lor sprul sku rtsub skag che yin pas/ /srung skyob sku rim mdzad rogs gyis shig zer/ /de ru bgrod nas zhag po bdun tsam la/ khro rgyal drag po kī la'i bzlog pa bcas/ /zhogs dgong tshe sgrub sngags phreng bgrang ba dang*/ /mchog sprul tshang yang srung 'khor yang yang bgyis/ /de tshe bon byad lan gsum byung ba'i tshe/ /de tshe gshin rje'i dmigs pas rang gshed dbab/ /de nas sgrub pa de dag grol ba dang*/ /mchog sprul tshang la lung dang bka' gtad phul/ khyad par 'byon pa'i bar chad sel ba yi/ /zhing skyong mgon po'i las tshogs dag kyang phul/ /de tshe phyir nangs rten 'brel mtshams sbyor la/ /gsang sngags bstan skyong rgyun du de ru bzhugs/ /'byon kha sprul sku tshang gis legs 'bul la/ /rnam rgyal bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings bcas/

/mchog gi sprul sku'i na bza' cha tshang dang*/ /rta mchog ngang dkar mdzes pa dar snas brgyan/ /gzhan yang ja dar dang snam thag sogs/ /tshan grang rgyas pa dag tu phul nas byung*/ /'gro kha tshogs 'khor bkra shis rab gnas byas/ /yang yang mjal ba phyag sbrel smon lam mdzad/ /de nas mchog sprul sgam por phebs nas song*/ kho bo bdag dang bstan skyong yon mchod bcas/ /ri khrod chos sder log ste song ba dang*/ /de nas dus nye zhig tu yin pa ru/ /dus 'khrug nad yams zhi ba'i rten 'brel du/ /drag po kī la'i gtor zlog rgyas pa brdzangs/ /phyogs phyogs bar chad sel ba'i zor sna bstan/ /de tshe blo bur byad kha gyu 'dug pas/ /ar gtad drag dmigs yang yang bya dgos byung*/ de nas sgrub pa grol ba'i dus su la/ /chos sde dpon slob grwa tshang thams cad la/ khro rgyal drag po kī la'i dbang chen bskur/ /rten 'brel bkra shis dag kyang 'grigs pa byung*/ /shog ser bu dpe phab pa'i shog bu rnams/ /gsang sngags bstan skyong lags kyis thugs gnyer khur/ /de nas rim bzhin nang du log nas song/ /zla ba gsum du mtshams bcad byas pa dang*/ /ma hā gu ru'i lung bstan gsal bkod la/ /gter sgrub bgyis nas bka' brgyad chen mo phab/ /gzhan yang padma khrag 'thung la sogs pa/ /dgos rim lan tsha 'ga' zhig phab pa'i tshe/ /yar zla'i tshes bcu'i nub thun nyams snang la/ /ci yang mi snang nam mkha' g.ya' dag la/ /blo bur yud kyi 'ja' tshon khra le ba/ /bun lang phung por spungs pa zhig gi nang*/ /mthong snang yul du rtsis la mi thub pa'i/ /padma 'byung gnas skar tshogs phreng ba ltar/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshom bu re re bcas/ /gsal snang sgyu ma'i gar sgyur skur bzhengs nas/ /mgrin gcig gdangs las rang sgra 'di ltar gsungs/ kyai ho/ nyon dang las can skal bar ldan/ /nga ni kun gzhi a ti chos sku yin/ /dbyings las ma g.yos mi 'gags longs sku'i rtsal/

/ma chags mtsho skyes sprul sku padma yin/ /skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs gdams pa 'dogs/ /dran pa'i lcags kyus ma gtong yid kyis zungs/ /sgo gsum tha mal rgya yan dor byas nas/ /sku gsum dam tshig bskyed rdzogs snying po zungs/ /bla med snying po theg pa che ba'i lam/ /skal bzang blo yis mi phyed yid la 'chang*/ /thig le rang sgra stong pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /mtshan nyid 'di ko lus kyang rtogs par dka'/ /de bas gsang sngags rgyal po brda yi don/ /kun byed sgyu ma'i rol pa ji bzhin du/ /sna tshogs grangs med rnam pa kun ldan du/ /rnam par phye ba rnal 'byor dang po'i gzhung*/ /shes rab nor 'dzin 'khor lo'i bum pa can/ /dbyings las ma g.yos kun la khyab pa'i gter/ /zad med rin chen brda yi rgya rtags kyis/ /don dang ldan pa'i kha byang 'di ltar 'chang*/ /shrī ṭa mu laṃ ka pa ka ri du a ka la kṣam̐: de ltar kha byang lung rgya gtad pa ltar/ /sa khyi nas bzung lcags khyi nye tshun la/ /sbas yul 'di yi brda rtags lam du khyer/ /lo shas tsam du gzhan phan smon lam gyis/ /dus bzhi smin tshe ri dwags bya ra bzhin/ /stod smad kun tu kha byang ri mo ltar/ /dus kyi 'gyur ldog byung tshe rgya so srungs/ /de nas phral du rig pa lcags chugs/ /blo bur glogs 'gyu lta bu'i rten 'brel sgrigs/ /phyir nangs rkyen rtog mi rgod gcig rgyug ltar/ /bzang ngan kha ma 'jigs la blo stungs/ /phyi dus ma 'debs mi rtag slebs kyin yong/ /rtog pa'i 'gyu lam snang bas ma bkag la/ /rgyal po lta bu blon po rjes ma btsal/ /snyigs dus bdud kyi dpyid ka'i kha rlangs ltar/ /nyi zla g.yogs bzhin chos la gnag pa 'byung*/ /de tshe ting 'dzin rlung gis shugs bskyed dang*/ /phug mi bdog pa rgyu 'bras las don yin/ /chos bdag dam ldan rnams la ra mda' sbron/ /spyir yang yon bdag snang srid lha 'dre la/

/dgos pa'i dus su gser skyems brngan cha byin/ /dam gnas dregs pa 'di rnams gnyan gyi mchog /pha rol bdud la rbad tshe tha tshig sgrogs/ /rin chen gter sgo 'byed tshe pho nyar bskul/ /phyi yi lam sel 'od zer can ma gyis/ /grogs kyi bye brag kha byang so sor bstun/ /gnad kyi go rim bdag la gsol ba thob/ /mos pa'i snying du nga nyid 'du 'bral med/ /dad ldan tshogs rnams spyi bor rtag tu mchod/ /dngos nyams rmi lam lung bstan the tshom med/ dzñā na kā ra u ti taṃ: de skad bka' stsal gu ru gtso 'khor rnams/ /'od zer 'bum phrag nyi mar 'dus pa bzhin/ /dmigs med mkha' ru sgyu ma'i gar ltar ldang*/ /bdag kyang nyams snang 'gyu ba had kyis sangs/ /go rim nyams myong bgyis nas gtan la phab/ /mi brjed yid du 'chang ba de ltar ro/ sa ma ya/ de nas re zhig rten 'brel dus kyi tshe/ /lung bstan sna tshogs byung ba'i 'phro zhig la/ /gnas chen rnams la rten 'brel brtag tu phyin/ /lho lam nag por rim par bgrod nas kyang*/ /ye gong chu bar sgar pa gnas pa'i tshe/ /ma rkung lung pa'i gnas bdag phal cher gyis/ /bsu ba dang ni tshogs 'khor khyer du byung*/ /dus la bab pa'i chos ka byin cig zer/ /de ltar gyis smras gnas la chas pa'i tshe/ /rdzong dpon snying du 'gong po zhugs nas kyang*/ /lam du zhugs pa'i cha lag mi snang zhes/ /gnas chen phag mo gsang ba lung du phyin/ /gnas kyi sgo phyes mthong snang gtan la phab/ /mgon po ma ning chos ka gdan drangs tshe/ /rgya mtsho'i dkyil nas shog dril dngos su blangs/ /dam ldan klu bdud bka' yi srung mar bgyis/ /bkra shis rab gnas bgyis nas brag skas phyin/ /padma shel phug dha na ko sha yi/ /ya mtshan mtsho nas thugs rje chen po yi/ /'khor 'das zil gnon spyan drangs rab tu gnas/ /seṅge gnam rdzong mtsho rgyal sgrub phug nas/ /sbas yul lam yig gu ru'i thugs sgrub dang*/

/dam rdzas gter dang gsang gter 'ga' re 'byin/ /brag skas stod smad lung pa thams cad kyi/ /sde dgon mchog dman spyi dang bye brag tu/ /zhi khro bka' brgyad gtsor byas gsang sngags kyi/ /dkyil 'khor mang po zhal phyes gdams pa gtad/ /smin byed dbang dang grol byed khrid la sogs/ /'di phyi gtan srid kun gyis smon lam gyis/ /dad dang mos gus gdung ba phul byung gis/ /zang zing 'bul ba rnams kyang mang po byung*/ /mkha' 'gro khrus chu dge bsnyen pho brang sogs/ /ma nges gsang gter sna tshogs 'big tu gyur/ /mtsho rgyal gsang gter padma rgyal po sogs/ /snying thig zung gi chos ka sgrub rdzas bcas/ /gdan drangs gnas chen khrim gzigs nang du phyin/ /bla ma lha dang srung mas lung bstan bzhin/ /gsang ba bde chen mchog gi rgya mtsho nas/ /rig 'dzin srog sgrub sku tshab phyag mtshan dang*/ /dam rdzas a thaṃ dregs pa'i bla rdo bcas/ /gzhan yang 'jam dpal gshin rje'i chos ka sogs/ /zab cing rgya che du ma gdan drangs nas/ /gegs med lam lhongs bkra shis rab tu gnas/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor sogs la rten 'brel byung*/ /slar yang yid 'ong lung pa'i yon bdag rigs/ /skal ldan du mar gsang sngags lung yang 'bog /dmangs pa phal mo che la dbang bskur bgyis/ /bsod nams zang zing dngos po mang du byung*/ /gzhan yang legs nyes rten 'brel nyams 'gyur dang*/ /lung bstan rgyas bsdus sems can so so yi/ /bzang ngan tshig dang bya ba du ma'i rigs/ /mang por yod kyang yi ger 'jigs pa dang*/ /skyes rabs brtsams 'phro yun ring lus pa yi/ /sngar gyi nyams rtogs sbrul shun ltar byin nas/ /rgad po'i lung gtam bri bar ma byas so/ /padma'i lung bstan rin chen za ma tog /skal med rnams kyang mthong ba shin tu 'phang*/ /lung bstan gter rgya smyon pa nga rang mkhas/ /skyes rabs bshad lugs dus mtha'i sbyin bdag mkhas/ /sdig pa bsam na bdud rigs thams cad mkhas/

/ngan 'gror ltung na skal med mtha' dag mkhas/ /mkhas pa rnam bzhi 'dzoms pa'i dus tshod skabs/ /bsdus pa 'di tsam 'khyer bde e ma ho/ /de nas re zhig bal phu ri khrod ni/ /gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser phab/ /rtags dang rten 'brel gzhan bas khyad 'phags byung*/ /de skabs rgyud sde dper 'khod ka tho ni/ /tshe sgrub rnam bzhi yang phur dmar nag dang*/ /drag po rigs gsum thugs rje chen po dang*/ /mkha' 'gro seng gdong zhing skyong sde tshan gnyis/ /ye shes mgon po sde lnga la sogs dang*/ /dregs pa 'bum tig dang bcas ma lus kyi/ /snga phyir gdan drangs dgos rim khol phyung la/ /me rta'i phan chad shog ser bu dpe ni/ /po ti'i sde lang bcu bzhi lhag tsam byung*/ /de yi nang nas chos skor mang tshan zhig /mi dbang ka nam sde pa zhal ngo yi/ /rig pa 'dzin pa khu dbon dbu mdzad pa'i/ /'od gsal gling gi sku zhabs grwa tshang la/ /'dus pa chen po khyab bdag 'khor lo yi/ /gzhi lam 'bras bzhi so sor 'big pa la/ /dang po lugs su 'byung ba'i theg pa gsum/ /dmyal ba mu stegs mi min theg pa dang*/ /de nas lugs su ldog pa'i theg pa gsum/ /dgra bcom nyan thos rang rgyal gzhi ru bzung*/ /de nas sgo 'byed gzhung gi theg pa gsum/ /kṛ ya u pa yo ga rnal 'byor rgyud/ /de nas bla med yang rtse'i theg pa gsum/ /ma hā a nu a ti dbyings dkyil rdzogs/ /rang gzhung de yi rgyud kyi dkri ba yi/ /gsang sngags brda yi dkyil 'khor sngon du bkod/ /rig pa'i lha bkram lung gi rnam bshad brjod/ /rigs lngas dbang bzhi chu bo rgya gar phab/ /rgya gar dbang bzhi'i chu bo bod du phab/ /bod du mkhan slob chos gsum sku ring la/ /rgyu skar rgya mtsho'i dbus su nyi zla bzhin/ /rmad byung thabs shes gtsug tu phra bkod nas/ /gzi 'od 'bum gyis ri rab gsal ba bzhin/ /rnam dpyod blo gros gter gyi bum pa'i bcud/

skal ldan rjes 'brangs tshogs la gang gdams pa/ /chu bran sna tshogs rgya mtshor 'jug pa ltar/ /ro brgya ting 'dzin bcud kyis rlan pa'i rtsi/ /yid can kun gyis mos blo bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bskyed rim lha sku phyi yi me long bstan/ /rdzogs rim 'od gsal dri med thig le bsnun/ /bskyed rdzogs don smin dbang bzhi bcud dril bskur/ /man ngag lung gi mtshams sbyar bka' rgya bsdams/ /rjes shes rgyas 'debs la sogs sgrub pa'i tshe/ /bstan 'gro kun gyi dpyid du legs 'jo'i phyir/ /gter sgrom mthong ba don ldan gtsor byas pa'i/ /sku tshab shog ser a ma ril bu dang*/ /gter rdzas ma nges la sogs bu ltar phog /de tshe bsod nams 'dus byas maṇḍal rigs/ /gos dar rin chen gser dngul rta drel bcas/ /yon du spungs pa brgya yi gtang rag byung*/ /gzhan yang lhag bsam rnam dag rgyas thebs shing*/ /zang zing dngos por sdug rtsir mi 'ching ba'i/ /chos bdag gsang sngags bstan skyong mtshan can gyi/ /pad zhwa chos gos rnal 'byor sngags pa'i chas/ /rten 'brel snga phyi legs tshogs che bar byung*/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gtsang sprul sku mched kyis/ /shes rab dbyings dang mi shigs phyag mtshan can/ /rin chen la sogs gos dar bzang bsgrigs kyi/ /rten 'brel legs tshogs shin tu che bar byung*/ /de bzhin bkra shis smon lam grub pa'i rjes/ /bal phu gsang sngags chos gling log pa'i tshe/ /lam du zhugs pa'i sa mtshams shig tu ni/ /mi ma yin gyi gzugs 'chang srin po'i lus/ /lag tu rtsis kyi shog khra ring mo thogs/ /snang srid rtsis la 'debs pa 'di ltos zer/ /de la sems can mang po'i gzugs bkod nas/ /stod smad kun gyi lung bstan mang du 'dug /ri mo la ni 'di bzhin zer ba snang*/ bal phu la ni zhag shas shig tu gnas/ /bal phu'i gzhi bdag rnams la bka' bsgo bgyis/ /yul gru bkra shis dge ba'i smon lam btab/

/de nas mdo smad phyogs su 'gro ba yi/ /sgar gzhi bkyags nas lam du nye bar zhugs/ /de tshe spo bo phyogs kyi gzhi bdag rigs/ /dkar phyogs nag phyogs che phra ma lus kun/ khyung tho mtsho gong bar du skyel ma byung*/ /tshangs pa dung thod dkar pos gtsor byas pa'i/ /lha rnams kun gyis sems bskyed zhus pa'i lan/ /go bde dga' ba'i glu 'di lta bur smras/ kye ho kye ho kye ma ho/ /rje bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ /sgos bka' drin can gyis byin gyis rlobs/ /lha tshangs pa mi bus gtsor byas pa'i/ khyod dkar phyogs rnams kyis glu 'di nyon/ /lha khyod rnams spyod 'gros bdag gis mthong*/ /nga smyon pa rnal 'byor skyel lo skad/ /don byang chub sems bskyed zhu'o skad/ /zhal bzang pos rgyas 'debs snang lags kyang*/ /don thog tu 'bebs pa brgya lam zhig /lar thos thos tshig la nyan nyan nas/ /don snying po bsdu ba brgya lam zhig /phyi tshogs drug bdag tu 'dzin 'dzin nas/ /nang bdag 'dzin grol ba brgya lam zhig /lar dkar po'i gzugs la nag po zhig /lha kha 'jam sems can bslu brid mkhas/ /lar ma rig ngang la bslus bslus nas/ /phyis ma 'ongs blo gtad ci zhig 'cha'/ /lha dang po zhi tshul bag glod po/ /phyi 'jam pa'i ngang nas khog dug zhig /lar gang nyer se shing sdong po 'dra/ /lha bar pa rgyan bzang yid 'phrog mkhas/ /mi snying med kun gyis yid gtan 'cha'/ /mnyen 'bol ba'i ngang nas khong skran zhig /dus nam du nye yang gdol pa bzhin/ /gang 'bag pa'i mi la dug sbrul 'dra/ /lha tha ma ri khyi'i khyim mtshes bzhin/ /yun ring mor bag chags ngan goms kyis/ /sha za lam 'gyu la bzod blag med/ /lha nga yi rigs dang tshong dpon 'dra/ /mi gzhan rgyu 'phrog nas rang nor smra/ /mi sems pa bsad cing rang yul bskyed/ /dpe ne tso lta bu'i bslab pa bzhin/ /srung sdom pa bsad nas lha chos smra/ /re che bas mgo bskor phog phog nas/

khyed lha chos sgrub la nga re 'jigs/ /skyon de kun gsal nas skyabs yul 'bog /spyod dge bar mthun na gsang sngags sbyin/ /lha zhes khyod bzang 'dzin rnam rtog rgyu/ /nyams bzang por mchog tu ma re zhig /nyams bzang por mchog tu re ba na/ /don yid bzhin nor bu sgrog tu tshud/ /lar de bas pham ltung sdoms par gyis/ /snang ban bun skyon du ma 'bebs shig /snang ban bun skyon du 'bebs pa na/ /byams snying rje'i sa bon me yis tshig /lar de bas khong khro sdoms par gyis/ /phyi 'dod yon bsod nams re ba che/ /phyi 'dod yon bsod nams re che na/ /lar de skabs g.yeng ba'i bdud kyis khyer/ /don de ltar zhen 'khri sdoms par gyis/ /gnad gdams pa de yi gzer thebs na/ /lha 'khrul snang rgya yan grol bar 'gyur/ /don go'am lha rgyal tshangs pa ba/ /tshig thos sam snang tshul stong gzugs can/ /brda de yis 'khrul 'khor grol bar shog /ces pa lha yi rgyal por gdams pa yis/ /lha yang snang stong sgyu mar grol bar 'gyur/ /de bas nag phyogs rnams la smras pa ni/ kyai/ nyon cig nag po ngam gyi bu/ khyod nag phyogs rnams la bskul ma 'debs/ /gzhi dang po ma rig rgyud las byung*/ /lam tshogs drug 'khrul pa a 'thas pas/ /don gnas lugs byams pa'i me tog yal/ /rgyud khengs sems dug gi lo 'dab phyur/ /las chags sdang 'bras bus nag phyogs bskyed/ khyod nag po'i phyogs rnams ngan dbang che/ /dbang che ba'i gdeng bsran ma bor na/ /byams phan sems zhu yang dam nyams rgyu/ /gnad go na dam tshig 'di ltar longs/ kyai ho kyi hud/ /mi chen mgo la nga rgyal 'ding zhu gyon/ /nga rgyal thog gis tshe rabs gtan mkhar bshig /gtan gyi mdun ma 'dod na dam tshig longs/ /che 'dod spongs la byang chub snying po sgrubs/ /snyan grags che la sgro skur sham bus brgyan/ /rnam g.yeng dmag gis rig pa'i rgyal sa bcom/ /dran pas btsan sa bzung rnams dam tshig longs/

/dpon med g.yog med byang chub snying po sgrubs/ kha drag can rnams 'khrul rtsod gshog rgyang ring*/ /phrag dog ser bas snying rje'i lo thog bcom/ /dal 'byor stong log go rnams dam tshig longs/ /kun khur dman sa bzung la byang chub sgrubs/ /phyogs 'dzin can rnams nyon mongs pha tshan hrag /chags sdang spu gris thar pa'i 'ju thag gcod/ /dag snang phyogs med shar rnams dam tshig longs/ /nga bdag 'gong po chom la byang chub sgrubs/ /ngo srung can la bdud kyi sna thag 'byar/ /chos brgyad sgrog gis mtho ris rta pho bcing*/ /mthun 'jug zam pa stor rnams dam tshig longs/ /'dus byas sgyu mar spyod la byang chub sgrubs/ /longs spyod nor la zhen pa'i 'byar rtsi yod/ /'dod yon dug bsregs dal 'byor rten bzang snyol/ /phyi ma'i gtan rgyag 'dod rnams dam tshig longs/ /chog shes 'dug pas bskul la byang chub sgrubs/ /gzhis dgon 'dzin la chags sdang gtod phur dam/ khong khro'i chad pas dge bcu'i rgya mtsho skem/ /zab srang blo sna bstung rnams dam tshig longs/ /gcig pur ri khrod 'grim la byang chub sgrubs/ /sdig can kha la dmyal ba'i me zhags yod/ /bzod blag med par thar pa'i srog 'phrog byed/ /'di phyi gnyis phung go na dam tshig longs/ /rang byas rnam smin bsam la byang chub sgrubs/ /nyams sgom mkha' la stong lta rgyug 'byams yod/ /rkyen dang 'phrad tshe rang tshang jag pas bcom/ /lta ba'i phu thag gcod rnams dam tshig longs/ /nges don snying por sbyongs la byung chub sgrubs/ /mo btsun lus la dmyal ba'i zangs kha yod/ /tha mal zhen pas ded rnams na rag ltung*/ /'khor bar phyi phyag btsal rnams dam tshig longs/ /nyon mongs tshad gdung rtogs bzhin byang chub sgrubs/ /bag chags 'thug la gti mug rgyun nyal yod/ /shing rta'i rgyun bzhin rnam smin 'dam du tshud/ /mun gling g.ya' bral 'dod rnams dam tshig longs/

/'od gsal rnal 'byor ngang srings byang chub sgrubs/ /che 'dod rlom la rang mthong mdung ring rno/ khong srin dar mas rgyu 'bras slob dpon gsod/ /bdag 'dzin 'gong po thul rnam dam tshig longs/ /sems can bsun du ma phyung byang chub sgrubs/ /g.yo can rigs la bdud kyi 'dun 'gros yod/ /mu tig tshong pas dal 'byor nor bu 'phrog /zong zad slar log go rnams dam tshig longs/ /don med lag stong ma 'khyams byang chub sgrubs/ /tshogs drug lha 'dres rtag lta'i bsun ma yod/ /a 'thas rlung gis rig pa'i sgron me gsod/ /lha 'dre rang mtshang rtogs rnams dam tshig longs/ /'khor 'das sems su shes pa'i byang chub sgrubs/ /nag po'i phyogs la rnam smin sku mkhar yod/ /grangs med bsags pas 'char sgo'i 'dan bu dam/ /ye shes mthong lam phye rnams dam tshig longs/ /bla med 'bras bu thob par byang chub sgrubs/ /dam srungs byang chub bco lnga bsgrags pa 'di/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i chos kyi skal ba mdzod/ khyad par nag phyogs rang bzhin smin grol nas/ /sdig spongs dge ba sgrub nas sngags bstan skyongs/ /las 'bras bslu ba med do dam ma nyams/ /yang dag snying po sgrub pa'i 'bras bu 'di/ /gsang bdag gos sngon can gyis bshig mi nus/ /mnar med sdig las bsags pa'i dngos po 'di/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams kyis bzlog mi gtub/ /rdo rje btsun mo'i gsang sgo rgod ma kha/ /dbang phyug ma hā de bas brtol mi nus/ /shes rab dbyings phyug stong pa'i mkha' lam la/ /thab mchog rdo rje rgyal pos tshad mi long*/ /snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i zhing khams la/ /'khor 'das sangs rgyas rgyu yin bshad mi gtub/ /yul brgyad 'gyu ba'i lha srin sde brgyad la/ /rgyu yi mtshan mar grub pa brjod mi nus/ /kun rdzob chos kyis don dam ston pa la/ /dpe yi dngos pos mtshon par khas mi len/ /rang byung ye shes rang 'od 'bar ba la/

/don 'jug me yis gsal bar rgyur mi mthong*/ /zag med longs spyod ting 'dzin myong ba la/ /bcud yin ro yis tshim pa tshig ma thos/ /gtum mo bde drod lus la rgyas pa la/ /drod yin 'bar bas tsheg pa cha ma mchis/ /sgom du ka dag gdod nas mnyam gzhag la/ /thabs yin rgyas btab grol ba'i gnad ma tshor/ /yul du chos nyid rgyal sa bzung ba la/ /gnas yin dben pa'i ri gzhan gang mi snang*/ /grogs su dbus kyi nor 'dzin bu mo 'di/ /mo yin lus kyi chags tshad brdar ma shar/ /nor du 'phags pa'i dkor mdzod bsten pa la/ /srid yin zog gi dngos pos ci ma chad/ /sbyin bdag 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bsten pa la/ /mi min gzugs kyi bkod pa mthong ma myong*/ /lam du gang shar chos skur 'char ba la/ /bgrod yin sa yi rnam par sleb ma thub/ /'khor 'das rig pa'i sbubs su grol ba la/ /skyong dogs mnyam rjes phye ba'i mtshams ma rnyed/ /smyon pa rnal 'byor bdag gi spyod pa la/ /long yin gcig tu nges pa brjod mi lang*/ /de ltar go'am snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs/ /dkar po'i lha khyod rang bzhin dkar du med/ /nag po'i phyogs khyod rang bzhin nag tu med/ /dkar nag brjod la dngos po bstan du che/ /mtshan mas mtshon khyod mtshon med ngang du grol/ /thos par gyur ram phan gnod lha 'dre'i tshogs/ /mkha' lding sdigs mdzub sbrul gyis mi bzod bzhin/ /don 'di rtogs pas 'khrul snang ring du byed/ /lta ba gyad kyis stobs bcu'i sgyogs thogs bzhin/ /phra rags gang gis rgol kyang blo mi zhum/ /nges 'byung byang chub sems dpa' ral gri ltar/ /rab rib nyon mongs tshogs kyis reg mi nus/ /nus ldan rdo rje shing rtas drangs pa'i tshig /'byung po yid can rnams kyi srog tu bcag /rang bzhin dbyings su grol ba'i dkyil 'gyur 'tshal/ /de ltar lha 'dre'i tshogs la gdams pa'i tshe/ /lha 'dre rnams kyang rang bzhin shugs las grol/

/skyel dar yag zer so sor gnas su log /nged cag rnams kyang khyung tho la brgal nas/ /mdo khams phyogs su gegs med 'byor ba'i tshe/ /sems can smin grol bkod cing rgyas btab bo/ /bkra shis des kyang dge legs 'grub gyur shog sarba garbhe dha tu ā/ lho phyogs sbas yul chen po'i nye 'dabs spo bo phyogs su rten 'brel brtags nas gter kha rnams gdan drangs shing shog ser gtan la phab nas chos 'khor dang po bskor ba'i le'u ste thog mar chu pho stag yan chod kyi skyes rabs hrag thus tsam bgyis nas bkod pa 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa rdo rje sngags kyi rgyud pa sbyangs pa sde pa gsang sngags bstan skyong gis dbu mdzad pa'i grwa slob du mas yang yang bskul ngor brtsams pa 'di la rang res kha thab kyi 'os mi 'dug kyang gsung ma ldog tsam zhig bgyis pa 'di la rgyud lung mi mthun pa ci mchis pa mkhyen ldan dam pa rnams la bzod par gsol/ 'di'i yan skyes rabs kyi stod cha'o/ sa ma ya/ ༈ na mo sarba ka ra mu pa ta ye tri/ /phan bde'i lam bzang ston mdzad bla ma rje/ /gu ru padma kā ra'i zhabs la 'dud/ /rnam dag mkha' la rnyog pa'i g.ya' bral bzhin/ /longs sku'i rtsal snang cir yang kun mod kyis/ /byed las sna tshogs sprul pa sgyu mar ldang*/ /nges pa'i rnam dbye lung gi bka' khyud las/ /rin chen phreng ba phyogs med 'khor yug sgo/ /'byed mdzad gsal bkod sde mig 'od bzang po/ /shar ri'i 'od 'khyil 'bum bzhin mtho bsnyegs rtser/ /rang bzhin rta bdun 'khor lo'i mgrin pa bzhin/ /sngags kyi ring lugs theg chen gaṇḍi'i dbyangs/ /dus kyi dun du bhi ltar chem gyis btegs/ /sham kha la sogs bslab bzhin mtha' rten nas/ /lhun po'i gtsug rgyan bzhin ltar mchod pa'i yul/ /sum cu'i gnas dang tshangs yul 'jig rten gsum/ /g.yo ba'i mdangs ldan skyon med padmo'i rigs/ /ji bzhin brgyan pa'i cha lugs cod pan 'chang*/

/'dzam gling grangs med kun tu 'gran zla bral/ /bgrang yas bskal pa'i btsas su 'das pa 'di/ /thog ma'i mgon mchog bla ma za hor pa/ /rgya gar dam pa de yi byin rlabs sprin/ /skye dgu'i tshad gdung bsil g.yab legs shar ba/ /nyon mongs me 'od 'joms mdzad gnubs lo'i gar/ /bsgyur mdzad bstan pa'i bdag po snyigs ma'i zhing*/ /dum rgya'i sprul pa dus las mi 'da' phyir/ /snyigs ma'i skabs su rtsod med gter chen grags/ /bal bod khams kun mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod nas/ /rtsa gsum bka' 'dus chos kyi bsdu ba mdzad/ /grol lam theg chen rin chen gtad rgya dkrol/ /smin grol zab mos 'gro la chos 'khor bskor/ /rnga yab la sogs dag zhing sna tshogs bgrod/ /rten 'brel du ma'i chos kyi sa bon bzhag /yang mtha'i bar du bden pa'i mtshams sbyor gtam/ /bskyed rdzogs rnam gsum 'bras bu myur du smin/ /bka' 'grel man ngag lo 'dab phyogs bcur rgyas/ /rtsa ba 'dab lag rdo rje'i sdong po brtan/ /smon lam mos pa'i sa gzhi khyon yang mdzes/ /kun kyang dbyar dus 'khrungs pa'i skyed tshal ltar/ /ngos bzung bral ba chos nyid rol pa'i ngang*/ /mi rtog ye shes ji bzhin klong las 'khrungs/ /gya gyur 'gyur ba ka la ping ka'i dbyangs/ /rol rtse rdo rje sbu gu'i sgra sdeb smra/ /zhes pa rtsa gsum gling pa'i chos glu 'di/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dkar mo rgyang grags te/ /skal ldan blo gros can la gdams pa nyid/ /lam log lam nor rnams kyis spyod yul min/ /gsang sngags bcud dril si la ma gi ta/ /mu ku ṭa ru smra ba la li ta'o/ oṃ gu ru ma hā mu ṭa mu la kshoṃ/ de yang thor tho'i le'u rim pa las/ /gnas chen gsang sngags pho brang khrom gzigs lung*/ /dge bsnyen rdo rje btsan drag gter rgya skyongs/ /smon lam bka' bzhi chu bo 'bab pa'i yul/ /de ru re zhig 'khor ba'i dus nyid du/ /yul gru sa rten skyong ba'i 'gur lha rnams/

/mu stegs 'ga' zhig dmag ni g.yo ba'i skabs/ /seṅge gnam rdzong khrag gi char pa babs/ /phu mda' lung gsum mtshon cha'i na bun gtibs/ /de tshe lha dang srung mas lung bstan ltar/ /rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes pas/ /yul gru bkra shis smon lam ldan pa byung*/ /tha lir u rgyan khrus chur sgrub pa skabs/ kha 'bar gtor chen rdzong skabs dge bsnyen gyis/ /yul grur 'khu bar brtsam pa'i nyams shig la/ /skyes pa 'ga' zhig mtshon cha 'khrugs par gyur/ /bar chad zlog dmigs drag po bgyis pa yis/ /yul la ma gnod rkyen kha gzhan la phog /de nas ye gong lung pa stod smad la/ /dbang bskur chos bshad khrid kyi smon grol skabs/ /rgya 'dre 'gong po 'khrugs pa'i kha rlangs las/ /gnam la char med tshad pa che bar 'dug /yul gru rnams kyis char 'bebs bskul na yang*/ /kun gyis phab pas 'bebs par ma gyur bas/ /sku tshab mthong ba don ldan rten khrus bgyis/ /de yi thugs rje'i bsil las char rgyun gyis/ /skye 'gro che phra rnams la rten 'brel legs/ /re zhig nyal ba'i nyams dang rmi lam du/ /lung pa mgo bo byang du kha gyu bar/ /sgo mo lho gtad cig gi thang du slebs/ /mdun nas 'ja' tshon lhags pa ji bzhin du/ /zhing skyong chen po kun dga' gzhon nu dang*/ /rig ldan bu mo gcig dang btsun ma'i chas/ /gsum tsam mdun du 'gro ba'i skad cha la/ /yar ltos ri mthon 'di la legs brtags dang*/ /sngar gyi lha rabs chags pa'i ri bo yin/ /sngon tshe dmu thag lha yi mkha' la bzung*/ /de yang chad nas mi rabs bdun tsam yin/ /'di la bskal pa bzang por gangs chags yod/ /ri bo 'di yang da lo yo nas 'dug /de skad zer tsa skyed tshal kha gtad phyin/ /ri bo de la mig gis lta tsa na/ kha ba gsar pa skya yam yod tsam snang*/ /ri bo 'di dag gang yin dris tsa na/ /rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyab ri yin/ /da lta'i bskal pa 'di ga tsam yin zer/

/de nas shing nags tshal du slebs tsa na/ /mi ma yin gyi gzugs dang rgyan 'dogs pa/ /lag tu mtshon cha'i rnam pa mang po zhig /thogs nas lung pa'i mi rnams thams cad bsdus/ /mgo lag snying gi ston mo chen po zhig /bshams nas rgyal khams kun la 'gyed pa dang*/ khrag gi yon chab phyogs su lan mang gtor/ /'di yi las 'bras kun la yod do zer/ /skabs shig ljongs chen zhig la na bun 'khrigs/ khrag gi bu yug 'di la ltos shog zer/ /re zhig lcags po ri yi gdong de ru/ /sbrul nag zhig gis mdud pa gsum brgyab nas/ /mtha' bskor thams cad nang du tshud pa dang*/ /kle bo rgyal po da shog las gyis zer/ /mi lus lcags sdig mgo can zhig gis ni/ /lag na nad rkyal mtshon dug thogs pa des/ /de gnas kun gyi mgo bor bzhag nas su/ /bros pa 'dug na mig gis da ltos zer/ /phyogs mtshams kun tu shwa ba'i mgo can gyis/ /gshin rje'i khram shing grangs med thogs nas su/ /gshin skad bla 'bod yin zer zangs dung 'bud/ /drwa mig ji bzhin mtha' nas bskor te snang*/ /mdun gyi mkha' ru rje btsun rin po che/ /za hor cha lugs 'chang ba ḍākkis bskor/ /mdun du kong btsun de mo yin zer ba'i/ /bu med dkar mo mda' dar sgron bu thogs/ /'khor du 'jig rten bud med bzhi bcas nas/ /rje la phyag bgyis bden tshig zhu zhing snang*/ /rje yi zhal nas gdams pa'i snying po ru/ /mos gus can rnams nga phyir 'brongs shog gsungs/ /de nas kong btsun de mos mdun byas nas/ /bdag gis rje yi zhabs 'brang bgyis nas su/ /gnas ri 'ja' 'od gtibs pa'i yul du slebs/ /gnas chen 'di nyid gang yin zhus tsa na/ /ma 'ongs 'dul zhing 'di yin rjes su gnang*/ /mkha' 'gro slob dpon 'ja' ltar yal ba'i shul/ /sngar bzhin chos skyong dang ni rogs dan gnyis/ /rang bcas gnas su log pa'i mtshams shig la/ /ma 'ongs lung bstan me long chen po zhig

/gnas bdag dge bsnyen chen pos phul ba rmis/ /nang du bltas pas spo bo'i lung bstan rnams/ /ji bzhin mngon sum gsal por 'dug pa mthong*/ /gnyid sad yid la bkod kyang gsal por 'dug /slar gcig bkod rtsis bgyis par brtsam pa'i dus/ /sde pa tshang gi yig 'grim khur mkhan zhig /slebs pa'i kha nas gtam gyi byed po la/ /gter ston sing pos bzi ba yin yod zhes/ /yang thos skad du de ltar go ba dang*/ /'phral phug mkho ba'i lung bstan mang po zhig /snang yang ma bris dam bcas rgyas kyang btab/ /de sogs rkyen 'ga' dus kyi lung bstan dang*/ /sku rim sa nad bcos lta la sogs pa/ /phal cher thams cad dus las yol bar gyur/ /re zhig gnas skabs rtsub nyams rmi lam dang*/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i bka' yis bskul ba dang*/ /mi dbang sde pa zhal ngo na rim bzhin/ /dge bas yang dag dus rim bskul ba las/ /dang po sde pa'i pho brang nang nas bzung*/ /spo bo tshan gsum rnams la dbang khrid bgyis/ /gnas chen dga' ba lung mdun nas bzung ste/ rgyal bas byin brlabs mdong chu gtsug lag sogs/ /mtha' 'dul yang 'dul sa gnad phal cher dus/ /bstan pa spyi la phan pa'i sku rim dang*/ /dgos su yon bdag skal ldan bsod nams ched/ /ri rlung thams cad gter gyi bum pas bkang*/ /lha srin sde brgyad rnams la tha tshig bsgrags/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i re kha yas kyis bkang*/ /bya khyi gnyis kyi lo ni sne sbrel 'gor/ yul gyi lha sde mi sde bcas pa dang*/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /nye lam gter bdag klu yi dge bsnyen dang*/ /dkor bdag rgyal po dpe dkar la sogs pa'i/ /dngos yod dngos med dang bcas rten 'brel las/ /rin chen gter gyi sgo mo phye ba dang*/ /zang zing mthun rkyen maṇḍal rim pa las/ /gser dngul zangs lcags ja dar gos chen dang*/ /gzhan yang rin chen sna tshogs ma nges pa/ /dkor cha ka cha rta mdzo dre'u sogs/

/'bru mar dang bcas go khrab zangs dkar dmar/ /yul du ci srid 'bul ba dpag med byung*/ /gzhan yang sde pa yas mas thams cad nas/ /rta khrab dar gos spyad cha sna tshogs byung*/ /de skabs drag las sbyin sreg mang ba dang*/ /yul grur dus kyi chad pa cher gnas pas/ /gdong thug lta bur khams gzugs cung ma bde/ /de yang mi ring zla ba gcig gnyis nas/ /cung tsam 'tsho skabs yul la nad yams sogs/ /shin tu rtsub nyams che ba zhig gi dus/ /dkor bdag rgyal po dpe dkar lung bstan nas/ /sngar nas khyod la lung bstan gsum tsam bgyis/ /go med nyan sdug blo rmongs phag pa ltar/ /ma sdod gter rgya thams cad yol la khad/ /'jig rten nyi ma shar nub gar 'gro ltos/ /lung bstan 'di dag yid la zhog zer nas/ /tshig 'phang shin du rtsub par byas nas song*/ /de skabs kong po o rong sde zhal dang*/ /rgyal ba arya dhe ba la sogs pa/ /phyogs nas rten 'brel brtags dang spyan drangs dang*/ /nye lam brag skas phyogs nas brag gsum sogs/ /che phra kun nas 'bod nan che skabs snang*/ /gar 'gro cha ma theg par byung ba'i tshe/ /rang re'i blo la rang gzu'i chod pa na/ /lha srin sde brgyad yin kyang ya mi nga*/ /dus kyi lung bstan 'di bzhin snang ba la/ /rang chos rang gi gzab na yang rab yin/ /rta pho gyen du rgyug na mgo chag med/ /bslab kha pha mas bgyis na mdo sdug med/ /nyams len bla mas gnang na nor 'khrul med/ /rgyal pham rang gis byas la 'gyod pa med/ /lto tshod drod pas bzung la skyed du med/ /shi tshod gshin rje'i bzung la bshol ma med/ /las 'bras rnam smin 'khor la bros sa med/ /de bas blo sna bstung ba'i las 'di la/ /sdod nas bsam gtan sgom na lha chos yin/ /'gro nas gzhan phan sgrub na lha chos yin/ /don med dkor 'khyams rgyab na zog po yin/ /ngo srung sna thag mkhan de mi chos yin/ /blo sna bdud kyis bsgyur de dam sri yin/

/de bas nges par 'byung gyur gang 'grub bgyi/ /snyam nas thor thun dag tu mtshams grol nas/ /nyin mo 'gro chas thams cad tshags su bcug /phyi nangs zhogs nas lam du zhugs par chas/ /de skabs lha 'dre rnams kyis bshol ba la/ /dkar gtor gser skyems bgyis nas phrin las bcol/ /yon bdag rnams kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs/ /zhib rgyas rten 'brel rnams kyang 'ga' re byung*/ /'di skabs rmi lam lung bstan zhal gdams sogs/ /mang tsam yod kyang lung gtam dgos chad med/ /de nas rim bzhin lam du zhugs pa dang*/ /lam gyi yon bdag pho mo thams cad kyis/ /pha ma spun zla bral ba'i nyams tsam snang*/ /kun gyis bsngo smon 'bul ba la sogs pa/ /smon lam mtshams sbyor rten rnams dpag med byung*/ /zangs lung btsan rdzong mdun du sgar pa gnas/ /shwa pa sde pa'i nang du lung bstan bzhag /rim nas brag rtsar dwags po lha rje yis/ /sprul sku mjal 'dzoms byin rten rten bcas phul/ /sde pa zhal ngo grwa nang gling gsum sogs/ /thams cad kun la spo stod 'gro yin smras/ /res 'gar gar 'gro cha med skad kyang bgyis/ /gzugs snang gza' klu rgyal po gsum bcas la/ /mdun bsu rgyab skyol rogs dan legs par bcol/ /chu mdo sgrol zhing yar lung gnas po'i mdun/ /gsol kha bgyis shing gnas mdun thams cad kyis/ /'bul ba tshogs sogs shin tu legs par byung*/ /yon bdag rnams kyis khyung tho la ru bskyal/ /rim bzhin spang leb rnying ma bla ma tshang*/ /sprul sku rnams kyis spyan 'dren byed du byung*/ /bla ma dpon slob rnams la dbang bskur phul/ /gtsug lag chos 'khor rnams la rab gnas bskyar/ /maṇḍal legs 'bul dpag tu med pa byung*/ /rim bzhin yon bdag thams cad rtsa ru phyin/ /dbang bskur smin grol rten 'brel gdams pa sbyar/ /rim bzhin wa zhib tshong dpon tshang du song*/ /dbang lung smon lam bkra shis mtshams kyis sbyar/

/maṇḍal rin chen gser dngul gtsor byas pa'i/ /rnam dkar legs tshogs maṇḍal rgyas 'bul sogs/ /yul gru rnams kyis phyogs dang phyogs bzhin du/ zang zing rgyu tshogs dpag med 'bul ba byung*/ /rim bzhin 'brong pa rdo shul nang du slebs/ /bla ru bla ma mkhan slob thams cad dang*/ /hor bsags mgon gsum stag gsar la sogs dang*/ /the ru bla ma ser rtsa bla ma sogs/ /gzhan yang ser mo ba yi rigs byad bcas/ /'brong pa stod smad dpon blon thams cad dang*/ khyung po dkar ru sde pa ma sogs pa/ /gzhan yang phyogs nas byung dang yul du 'khod/ /skal ldan smon lam ldan pa thams cad la/ /zhi khro bka' brgyad rdo rje phur pa sogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho dang*/ /zhal phyes smin grol chos kyi sa bon bzhag /de tshe gzugs can gzugs med thams cad kyis/ /mos gus mchod 'bul phyag bskor la sogs pa/ /rten 'brel dge ba rnam dag legs po byung*/ /maṇḍal la yang dam tshig dgos pa'i phyir/ /phyi nang gsang gsum maṇḍal sna tshogs byung*/ /zang zing ka cha dkor nor la sogs pa/ /'bul ba rigs byed dpag tu med pa byung*/ /de nas 'brong pa a 'bum rgyud pa dang*/ /smad ma'i dpon g.yog ma lus 'khor bcas dang*/ /jo bo gze rgyal mdun gyi yon bdag bcas/ /thams cad spu gze rin chen spungs pa'i mdun/ /mchod sbyin 'tshogs nas gnas bstod rten 'brel bcas/ /legs par bgyis nas chos 'khor bskor bar byas/ /de nas rim bzhin ri smad phyogs nas song*/ /rdzong thang sleb skabs mi dbang rgyal blon gyis/ /ja 'dren thabs bsru rten 'brel che bar byung*/ /rim bzhin lung bstan lta bur sgar du 'byor/ /rgyal pos dbu mdzad rje blon rnams dang mjal/ /rten 'brel legs tshogs shin tu legs par byung*/ /dgun kha zla shas sgar du gnas pa dang*/ /tshe sgrub la sogs dkyil 'khor gcig gi khog /sgrub pa mthar phyin dge la gzhol ba'i nyin/

/rje yi sku tshab mthong ba don ldan dang*/ /gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel bcas/ /gya nom nang chen rgyal po'i phyag tu phul/ /blon po a shag maṇḍal bum cha byung*/ /maṇḍal rin chen bum pa kha rgyan can/ /rin chen gnyis pa gtsos pa'i go khrab sogs/ /rim can phul ba'i rten 'brel dang bcas byung*/ /de nas lha dang srung mas bskul ba dang*/ /mi dbang rgyal po'i bka' yis legs bskul nas/ /dus kyi chad pa zhi ba'i smon lam dang*/ /bsod nams sa bcud 'phel ba'i gter bum bcas/ /yas rdzong nad bdag dpung bcom la sogs dang*/ /ri bstod gsas mkhar bstod pa la sogs pa/ /dkyil 'khor brtsams nas chas pas snga sor du/ /shod rlung mkhar khrom sgrub pa dbang khrid sogs/ /dgos pa'i dus rim sa bdag gter bum sogs/ /bkra shis rab gnas bgyis nas gtam khog phyin/ kha la rong sogs gzhi bdag phal cher gyis/ /dam tshig blangs dang rten 'brel du ma bgyis/ /de nas rdza yi nyin srib thams cad slebs/ /rdo rje tshe brtan tshang nas legs 'bul byung*/ /dge bsnyen gang yod sa ru rten 'brel byung*/ /kun la dbang khrid chos ni sngar bzhin bgyis/ /rdza yi ri pa sgar du chos ra la/ khrom pa stong phrag gnyis long khad tsam snang*/ /rten 'brel de yi 'gro don legs par byung*/ /gzhan yang dge bsnyen gnas pa'i phyogs phyogs nas/ /klu yi dngos grub sna kha re re byung*/ /mdo khams sku rgyal zangs ri rtse dgu la/ /chas pa'i lam kha mang po zhig tu ni/ /rje btsun chen po nyi zhal gtso 'khor dang*/ /zla zhal ma yang lan 'ga' mkha' ru byon/ /sku rgyal mgul du sprin zhal sam bha wa/ /de sogs dag snang skor ni mang byung rung*/ /rtag tu rgyun mjal bri tshod ma long bar/ /dag snang la yang ngos mjal nye bar snang*/ khyad par zangs ri rtse dgu'i gnas chen du/ /ri bstod rgyan dar phul ba'i dus nyid du/ /rten 'brel legs tshogs dge bar nges can byung*/

/de nas sgar du 'khor nas lci la phyin/ /'ja' dmar dang ni bre khu brag zhabs su/ /chos 'khor bskor dang dge ba'i legs tshan sgrub/ khyung po dpon tshang gdan 'dren maṇḍal sogs/ /legs tshogs dang bcas 'bul ba dge mtshan byung*/ /smug po lha rtse kaḥrgyal gsang rgyal sogs/ /gnas chen rnams la ri bstod rgyan nyid spras/ /ri rlung thams cad rin chen gter gyis bkang*/ /tha tshig g.yar dam skyong ba'i srung mar bskos/ /rten 'brel legs tshogs bdag ni rgyas par byung*/ /snang srid lha 'dre'i yon bdag legs po byung*/ /gtang rag maṇḍal 'bul ba'i rig byed ni/ /shod rlung dbu 'jug mdzad pa'i dper drangs nas/ /phyug dbul med pa'i maṇḍal chag chag byung/ /yon bdag dad ldan mang po 'brel thogs byung*/ /zang zing dgos rim gang 'dod der ston byung*/ /chos kyi maṇḍal dpag tu med pa la/ /badzra gu ru dung brgya lhag tsam byung*/ /dge sbyor lha 'dre mi gsum spyi mthun nas/ /skal par ldan pa yin 'dra mang po byung*/ /'di skabs ma ltos lo shas tsam zhig nas/ /lung bstan mgur 'bum 'gro don bgyis pa sogs/ /shin tu mang ba yod kyang bsdus don bgyis/ /ci phyir rnam thar rtsom zhes spros snang rung*/ /bzang bzang bsgrigs na ngan pa gang du sba/ /ngan ngan bsgrigs na bzang po gang la bshad/ /de bas rnam thar lung bstan bshad che na/ khyad par dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i skabs/ /rten 'brel mgo mjug mi 'khyong spyid kha ltar/ /dro grang khod mi mnyam pa khu rlangs ltar/ /lha srin bzang po mtha' yi 'gong pos dkrug /bla ma bzang po grwa slob ngan pas dkrug /dpon po bzang po dam sri blon pos dkrug khyad par rgya 'dre 'gong po'i kha rlangs las/ /mi yi blo 'gyur snying la dam sri zhugs/ /de yi rkyen gyis ci bya log par gol/ /des na rang sems rang gis mi bslu gtso/ /rmi lam bzhin du rnam thar mtha' 'khyong dka'/

/gter ston smyon pa rtsa gsum gling pa nga*/ /lha chos ltar la 'jig rten sgrog zhig yod/ /nga yi sbas yul spo bo lung pa 'di/ /sa dong rdzub la tsher ma'i dbal zhig yod/ /nga yi pha yul nang chen lung pa de/ /sa cha bsil la zhu kheg nyams gcig yod/ /nga yi yon bdag snang srid lha 'dre yin/ /dngos grub myur kyang nor brnag rgyu zhig yod/ /nga yi dkor bdag rgyal po dpe dkar 'di/ kha zhud 'jam la khong srin cung zhig yod/ /des na kun kyang de yi cho 'phrul ste/ /rnam thar phal cher bla ma zog por 'gro/ /des na sum cu tshun de nyams kyang mtshar/ /de phan snang srid sgyu mar shar ba la/ /skye 'gro rnam g.yeng bkod la ci cha yod/ /'dod khams lha ni gnyid log lta bu dang*/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa bkod dang mtshungs/ /zhes par bya bas zhing rdul grangs rnyed ltar/ /mi smra cog bzhag 'phral du de tsam las/ /phug yul rten 'brel gong mthar rgyas pa'i phyir/ /nges par 'jug pa klu yi rdzong zhol du/ /bsam pa lhun grub ma yi sgrub thabs rnams/ /shog ser gtan la 'bebs skabs khol bur phyung*/ /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad skyel bsu sogs/ /mi la gtam bzhin byung ste bri ma long*/ /rtsa thor 'khod pa'i le'u'i rim pa'o/ ma hā shrī na thā u ya mar smra/ zhes mi dbang sa bdag rgyal po nang chen dpon chen nas bka' yis bskul ba dang*/ /bka' yi ram 'degs pa blon chen tshe 'bar bcas rgyal blon gyis rnam thar gyi mthar cung bsnan dgos gsungs pa la gsung ma ldog tsam rtsa thor yi ger bkod pa yin/ de bas dkyil 'khor gyi dbu phrin las kyi gzhung bya ba'i mtha' gsum cha ma 'dzoms par ci bris cha thig par ma byung*/ gter ston grub thob gnyis kyi rnam thar ni brtags dka'/ 'brug pa kun legs dang grub chen me long rdo rje/ khyad par gcig lam sgron gyis kong po nga la ru tshul btsugs pa rnying ma'i zhabs drung yol mo ba rgya gar gyi ku ku ri pa lha sa'i bram ze a tsa ra dmar po sogs rnal 'byor che phra rnams kyi dkar chag la yon bdag phal mo mkhas par bshad/

ci zhe na rgyal ba'i gsung sgros las/ bzang po chos dpyad mkhas/ ngan pa mi dpyad mkhas/ zog po g.yo sgyu mkhas/ phyug po bse rag mkhas/ med po za 'dod mkhas/ skyid po nyal la goms/ sdug po 'gro la goms/ bong bu khur tsa goms/ chos pa snying rus goms/ las ngan sdig pa goms/ mkhas pa lnga goms pa lnga 'di thun mong yin par snang*/ yang lung gi 'gal ba rnam gsum de/ sgom chen phyi ba spi li'i zhal na re/ kyai/ dka' thub byas pa'i ltogs yus de dang gcig /tsog pur sdod pa'i sgom yus de dang gnyis/ /mang po thos pa'i tshig yus de dang gsum/ /de gsum yang chos spong las shig 'dra/ /chos gsha' ma zhig byed na de gsum bor/ /nga phyi tshul ser pa pags pa tsam/ /yang dag chos gos ser po min/ /'gro la dga' ba'i chos pa rnams/ /rkang lag bran du bkol ba dang*/ /lho tshong byang du skyel ba dang*/ /don med sa mtha' 'grims pa gsum/ /de gsum chos spong 'dra ba'i rgyu/ /nyams len med pa'i 'chad 'dod rnams/ /ma mthong mngon shes bshad pa dang*/ /mi thub nad pa'i sngas srung dang*/ /dmangs po'i phrug gu gso ba gsum/ /de gsum chos spong 'dra ba'i rgyu/ /longs spyod phal cher btsal sgrub de/ /sdig byed khra bo sha za dang*/ /smyo byed ser po chang 'thung dang*/ /bslu byed na chung gzhon nu gsum/ /de gsum chos spong 'dra ba'i rgyu/ /'di phyi gnyis med las sgrub na/ /rgyal po nang khrims gcod pa dang*/ /dmag dpon zhal lce gcod pa dang*/ /shan pas spu gri thogs pa gsum/ /de gsum chos spong 'dra ba'i rgyu/ /don med 'bras bu sgrub pa na/ /sdig pa'i sa bon bu rgyud dang*/ /dmag 'khrug mkhar khang bzo ba dang*/ /chos phyir sdig pa spyod pa gsum/ /de gsum chos spong 'dra ba'i rgyu/ /'tshing na 'dzoms pa 'di gsum la/ /'bag na gnyis med 'di gsum yin/ /zin pa med pa'i 'jig rten dang*/ /thon so med pa'i so nam dang*/

/'bras bu med pa'i lung gtam gsum/ /'di gsum don med min nam ci/ /dka' thub sgom chen phyi bas byed/ /rlung ni rtsangs phag sbal pas 'gam/ /brag phug gla bas yun ring bzung*/ /'khrul 'khor spra dang sprel la yod/ /ma ṇi a bo ne tsos 'don/ /gtsug lag rtags chung bung bas brtsegs/ /zhe sa khwa ta nag chung mkhas/ /gdong pa bya rigs rnams kyis 'khru/ kha ni gcan gzan rnams kyis bshal/ /byi dor byi la gwa pa mkhas/ /rgyan spyod bya rigs spu kha legs/ /longs spyod mtha' 'khob yul la che/ /'ja' lus khams gong lha la bzang*/ /de kun thar pa'i rgyu ma lags/ /zab mo'i lta ba ma rtogs na/ khyi ro dar zab rgyan dang mtshungs/ /sgom pa gnad kyis ma zin na/ /rkun ma khang stong 'phrad dang mtshungs/ /zab lam gnad bdun ma shes na/ /skya ba med pa'i gru rdzing 'dra/ /zhen log chos bcu ma shes na/ /skam 'dod mar gyi nyi 'od 'dra/ /g.yo sgyu can gyi chos 'dod de/ /rlan 'dod lcags dmar chu bcug 'dra/ /bskyid rim man ngag ma shes na/ /long bas lha khang 'grims dang mtshungs/ /bzlas brjod tshig don ma rtogs na/ /brag cha lha mo'i ku co 'dra/ /gdams ngag ngo bo ma rtogs na/ /'ja' tshon lag pas myong dang mthun/ /de bas phyi nang 'ga' zhig gi /cha lugs mi mthun chos lugs smad/ /nyan lugs mi mthun rna log go /za lugs mi mthun grod pa na/ /lta spyod mi mthun gshis lugs de/ /dan phag thar pa gnyis dang nye/ /bsgoms pas ston pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bshad pas legs skar mu stegs gol/ /zla med gcig pur ma 'khyams bar/ /tshom bu'i dus su ci bya rung*/ /sgyu lus mi rtag g.yar khang la/ /rkyen char thigs pa ya re nga*/ /sa mdo gyang ral kyi re hud/ /sgo med rdzong btsan lcags mkhar de/ /chos med dred po'i pha khang yin/ /rnam rtog rgya lam ngan shul de/ /log lta skal med 'byon lam yin/ /rdo rje theg pa'i sgrub khang de/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i phebs lam yin/

/gsang sngags pho nya nye lam 'di/ /rig 'dzin rnams kyi gshegs lam yin/ /so so 'bras bu'i rnam nges de/ /'di bzhin snang zhes smra ba yang*/ /sgom chen phyi ba'i zhal nas gsungs/ zhes pa sgom chen phyi ba ser pos 'dab chags go bo'i pha tsho dang*/ khyim mtshes ti lo gwa ma la gdams pa ste so so rnams kyi go yul dkar chag gi 'bras de yi ge'i ris su hor gtam du smras pa'o/ ༈ dkar chag ni/ e ma ho/ gling gi mchog gyur 'dzam gling rdo rje gdan/ /ston pa'i mchog gyur mnyam med bcom ldan 'das/ /mdzad pa bcu gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /thugs rje chen pos byin brlabs 'phags pa'i yul/ /dbus kyi lte ba dpal gyi bsam yas su/ /rdzu 'phrul rmad byung padma 'byung nas kyis/ /brtul zhugs bcu gnyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /rgyal ba de yis lung bstan sbas pa'i tshal/ /padma bkod kyi nye 'dabs ye gung lung*/ /de yi lte ba dag pa shrī zhes/ khrom gzigs gsang sngags pho brang gnas kyi zhol/ /gtsug lag chen po bdud 'dul sngags pa'i gling*/ /grub pa'i pho brang de yi phyogs mtshams ni/ /phu na gangs dkar ti se dgung la bsnyegs/ /mda' na klu rgyal gser ldan dal du 'khyil/ /bar du ljon shing lo 'bras g.yu ru smin/ /thang rnams mthil mnyam g.yu yi maṇḍal 'dra/ /me tog sna tshogs dbyar dgun med par 'khrungs/ /ma rmos lo tog ri klung kun la skye/ /sems can phal cher so nam de la byed/ /grub pa'i gnas chen de yi phyogs bzhi na/ /shar du rta mchog gnas chen dga' ba lung*/ /lho ru gshin rje'i gnas mchog rgya la dang*/ /nub tu mkha' 'gro'i gnas mchog bang ri ba/ /byang du bka' brgyad gnas mchog ma rkung lung*/ /gnas chen rnams dang gnas phran du mas bskor/ /gzhan yang phyogs bzhi'i phrin las ri bcas ni/ /shar du btsun mo rnga rgyan zhi ba'i ri/ /lho ru jo bo nor bu rgyas pa'i ri/

/nub tu mkhar mo dgyes bzang dbang gi ri/ /byang du sman mo chos 'byung drag po'i ri/ /phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa yin/ /gnam gyi bkod pa 'khor lo rtse dgu 'dra/ /sa yi dbyibs ni bhandha'i bdud rtsi 'dra/ khyad par drag po'i gnas chen de dag la/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mngon sum lta bur 'du/ /mi ma yin gyis sgra skad dngos su sgrogs/ /nyin mo rlung 'khrug mtshan mo me chen 'bar/ /mi ma yin gyi yul dang cung zad nye/ /de ru gnas pa'i skal ldan ma lags pa'i/ /mi skya pho mo phal cher thams cad kyis/ /rnam pa kun tu mtshon cha sna re thogs/ /phu yi ri dwags rnams la dug mda' bsnun/ /mda' yi nya sram tshag dang drwa bar btsud/ /ri la me 'gyed mtsho la dug rnams phyo/ /bya dang byi'u mthong tshad phal cher za/ /phag dang mdzo mo a ghe la sogs pa/ /rgas gzhon med pa gsod la hab khyer byed/ /na ba'am ni shi ba la sogs pa/ /lha chos bya zer sngags pa kha yar 'gug /drin gyis gsos pa'i srog chags gang mang gsod/ /yul gyi grong pa mi nag thams cad sdud/ /dang po nang rol rgyu ma dmar 'gyed byed/ /de nas phyi sha thams cad rim par 'gyed/ /de nas mgo dang brang gi ston mo byed/ /pags pa gang byung sngags pa mkhan pos thogs/ /slar yang lung pa'i mi nag thams cad sdud/ /mar nas thams cad grong pa rnams la 'gyed/ /'pho 'debs byed mkhan phal cher a mchod 'gug /sman mo lha bab rnams la skyabs gnas zhu/ /dkon mchog mchod pa'i tshab tu kha mchu sgrub/ /lo zla mi 'gyang phan tshun nang rnams 'thab/ /mtshon cha'i las byed phal cher gri ru 'chi/ khyad par pha spun nang tshan 'thab pa mang*/ /bud med phal cher gri dang mda' gzhu smra/ /chos la 'gro rnams mi khyu'i gral mi tshud/ /rten du chags sdang dug lnga rgya 'byams nas/ /dge bcu kha 'don sems bskyed dben pa yi/ /phreng ba lag tu thogs pa re zung tsam/ /lha bskyed sngags bzlas sgom ni ga la zhig

/lhag tu mi skya pho mo thams cad kyi/ /snang ba nang mi gnas pa'i skad cha la/ /nged rnams lung pa btsan po'i mi rgyu yin/ /sngar nas 'dir skyes sa yi gzhi ba yin/ /sa btsan 'gag dam chu brag mda' gzhu can/ /su la yin kyang 'jigs pa ga la srid/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal che yang kho rang btsan/ /nged cag kho yi mdun du 'gro dgos med/ /yang nas yang du mi lus byed pa yin/ /mi rigs ser ser rnams la ci cha yod/ /de skad brjod cing byed pa'i dpe srol yod/ /de rnams thams cad yul de'i gnas bdag ste/ /rnal 'byor pho mo phal cher der mi chags/ khyad par raksha ko ṭa nye 'dabs mtshungs/ /smyon pa gnam lcags rdo rje ma lags pa'i/ /yul gru de ru gnas pa shin tu dka'/ /lha chos byas na mi chos mgu mi thub/ /mi chos byas na lha chos rtsa ba skam/ /gnyis ka bgyis na kun gyis phra ma g.yeng*/ /phal cher rnams ni klu dang the'u rang mtshungs/ /de rnams 'dul zhing dkar chag phra rags tsam/ /he ru ka pa zhig gis snang ngogs su/ /pho mo thams cad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang*/ /snang srid thams cad buddha'i zhing khams dngos/ /gzugs rnams thams cad lha yi rol pa nyid/ /sgra rnams gang grags sngags la rgyun chad med/ /yid kyi 'gyu ba kun kyang chos dbyings dang*/ /sems can kun gyi srog tu sangs rgyas gnas/ /rig dang ma rig bye brag de dka'i gnad/ /de bzhin sprang po nga ni ci byas rung*/ /mi rtag 'chi ba mi shes a re 'gyod/ /rgyu 'bras dkar nag ma mthong thang re chad/ /las 'bras bslu med ma rtogs nyon re mongs/ /sgyu lus g.yar khang dor dgos ya re nga*/ /rogs med gcig pur 'gro dgos kyi re hud/ /rnam shes gar 'gro cha med yi re mug /kye ma kyi hud 'khor ba 'di na re/ /de ltar dkar chag phra mo bkod pa ni/ /nyams mtshar bgyis la dgongs khrel mi gnang zhing*/ /long med dran pa lcag gis bskul bar 'tshal/ dha thim/
me lug zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes la bsgrigs chags bgyis pa bkra shis dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis par shog /maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// //

༄༅/ /gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i rnam thar bsdus pa mkhyen brtse gong mas mdzad pa bzhugs so// gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi skye mtha' rtsa gsum gter bdag gling pa'am/ gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje zhes grags pa ni/ lho zla nang chen gyi sa'i cha gnas chen jo bo gze rgyal dang*/ sku rgyal she ne sogs kyi 'dabs nags rong zhes par yab 'bru chen rlangs kyi rigs bkra shis dang*/ yum dge legs ma gnyis kyi sras su rab 'byung bcu gcig pa'i nang 'khrungs/ lo rta gsal bar mi snang*/ 'khrung rtags dang gzigs snang sogs ngo mtshar che ba mang du byung*/ cung zad nar son pa na nang chen dge lugs grwa chang ka mda' chos rje rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi sprul par grags pa zhig las skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i sdom pa bzhes mtshan bkra shis phun tshogs gsol nas bla brang du chos skor zhugs/ 'don cha sogs ci rigs thugs la bzung*/ sku na phra mo'i skabs gter chen stag sham pa nang chen sgar du byon par chos 'brel tsam gsan/ de ma gtogs bla ma gzhan la la'ang chos bka' 'dra gsan tshul mi snang*/ kun spyod shin tu 'tshubs pas grwa rigs rnams dang mthun dka' tsam byung*/ bar skabs bla brang gi gte dpon 'dra 'ang mdzad/ chos rje bod du 'bul skyel byon skabs zhabs phyir bkra shis/ thugs rab gsal bas bla mas ri bo dge ldan du mtshan nyid sbyang bar bskur na'ang/ dus babs zab gter gyi lung bstan byung nas ma bzhugs par khams su byon/ 'di skabs pad dkar 'dzin pa ye shes rgya mtsho dang rgyal po lha bzang mchod yon dus yin 'dra/ slar 'bri gung du byon nas dkon mchog phrin las bzang po rtsa ba'i bla mar bsten/ grwa tshang du lo gsum tsam bzhugs/ bka' chos ci rigs dang*/ lhag pa rlung dza bīr snyan brgyud kyi skor zhib nan tu gsan pas nyams rtogs khong nas brdol/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes rtsol med du shar/

lung bstan dus babs bzhin rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang*/ rlung sems las su rung ba'i rdzu 'phrul la brten nas gnas chen mang po thog med du nyul bas kha byang lung bstan ltar/ gzho stod til sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang chen mo nas/ gu ru drag po padma khrag 'thung gi skor thog mar bzhes/ mnal lam gyi snang char padma 'od du phebs pa'i gzigs snang 'byams klas pa byung*/ de nas mon sha 'ug stag sgo/ tsā ri zil chen phug kong gnas sogs nas/ yang phur gwa'u dmar nag dang*/ tshe sgrub chen mo 'chi bdag zil gnon/ bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus sogs zab gter mang du bzhes/ 'bri gung pa dkon mchog phrin las bzang po dgongs pa gzhan don du gtod par rig nas myur bar byon kyang lam stabs bde min gyis cung zad 'gor bas bla ma zhing gshegs nas sku gdung zhugs 'bul gyi skabs tsam phebs/ 'di bod du jun 'gar byung skabs yin 'dug de nas khams su byon/ tsā ri gnyis pa gze rgyal gyi gnas sgo phye bas mtshon gnas gter gyi sgo'ang mang du phyes/ nang chen rgyal po sogs dang mchod yon 'brel zhing de phyogs yas man du phrin las cung zad rgyas/ khyad par sbas gnas spu bo phyogs su byon pas ka gnam sde pa dang mchod yon legs par 'brel zhing*/ spu bo ye gong khram gzigs rngams chen sgang du bdud 'dul sngags pa'i gling zhes 'dus sde chung ngu'ang btab/ 'di'i shar phyogs rta mgrin gnas chen dga' ba lung*/ lhor gshin rje'i gnas rgyal seng gtams/ nub tu mkha' 'gro'i gnas bong ri/ byang du bka' brgyad gnas rma kung lung sogs yod par gsungs/ rngams chen rong nas bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi gter kha chen po bzhes pas mtshon/ de phyogs yas man nas kyang zab gter mang du byung*/ phal cher gtan la phab nas dbang lung khrid gsum 'chad spel sogs kyang mdzad/ slar rang gnas su byon/

'di yan gyi rnam thar me shel gsal ba'i phreng ba zhal gsungs tshigs bcad ma ldeb sum brgya lhag tsam yod rung*/ bar skabs kyi zhal gzigs lung bstan gsung mgur sogs ha cang mang drags pas rnam thar dngos gzhi de tsam gsal po zhig mi snang*/ mjug gi kha skong rnam thar 'dra ni med skad/ spu bor byon skabs dwags la sgam po'i zhabs drung byon nas chos bdag tu mnga' gsol tshul snang ba/ bzang po rdo rje sprul sku'i dus yin 'dra/ mtshan gyi rnam grangs padma gter bdag gling pa/ karma las 'brel gling pa/ rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa/ gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje/ sngags 'chang hūm̐ nag drag rtsal/ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje/ gter chen padma smon grol sogs su grags/ mchims phur phebs skabs skyid mo grong nas rigs ldan zhig las rgyar bzhes pa'i sras rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rje 'khrungs skad/ gter chos kyi rnam grangs rje nyid spu bor bzhugs skabs tshigs su bcad pa/ de skabs rgyud sde dper 'khod ka tho ni/ tshe sgrub rnam bzhi yang phur dmar nag dang*/ drag po rigs gsum thugs rje chen po dang*/ mkha' 'gro seng gdong zhing skyong sde tshan gnyis/ ye shes mgon po sde lnga la sogs dang*/ dregs pa 'bum tig dang bcas ma lus kyi/ snga phyi gdan drangs dgos rim khol phyung la/ me rta yan chad shog ser bu dpe ni/ po ti'i sder long bcu bzhi lhag tsam byung*/ zhes gsungs pa ni rags rim tsam zhig yin snang ba las gter chos rgya cher bzhugs skad/ deng sang dbang lung gi rgyun yod pa bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang nas spyan drangs ba'i bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus zhes gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun grub pa'i spyi sgrub dang*/ sgos sgrub so so'i dbang*/ bskyed rdzogs las tshogs dang bcas pa pusti gnyis/ gzho stod til sgro tshogs khang chen mo nas spyan drangs pa gu ru drag po yang zab padma khrag 'thung zhes rgyud lung man ngag dang 'brel ba dbang bzhi'i zab khrid khyad 'phags las tshogs mtha' rgyas bcas pusti gnyis/

spu bo khrims gzigs rngams chen rong padma'i sbas tshal nas spyan drangs pa'i yi dam bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba gzil gnon rgyud sde bcu bzhi sogs rgyud lung man ngag phrin las dang bcas pa shin tu rgyas par bzhugs pa'i pusti bdun/ mon sha 'ug stag sgo nas spyan drangs pa'i yang phur gwa'u dmar nag shin tu zab pa pusti gcig tsā ri zil chen phug nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon/ lho wa zhabs brag ri tshe bum 'dra ba nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub rdo rje go khrab/ rdo shul smad jo bo sga rgyal rin chen spungs pa'i mgul nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe grub padma gsang thig rdo shul stod smad mtshams mkha' 'gro'i snying phug nas spyan drangs pa'i tshe sgrub lcags kyi rgya mdud 'chi bslu sogs las tshogs mang bar bzhugs pa bcas tshe sgrub skor bzhi la pusti gnyis tsam/ sbas yul brag gad padma shel phug nas spyan drangs ba'i thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon pusti gcig spu bo dar sna pha waṃ rta mgo nas gdan drangs pa'i rta mchog rol pa nyi ma'i snying po/ rta mgrin khro rgyal stobs 'dus/ gser gling ri che'i nor bu'i bag mdzod nas gdan drangs pa'i rdor sems ye shes 'od kyi drwa ba'i skor/ lho zla lce rgyud smug po lha rtse nas gdan drangs pa'i phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon/ dbang chen gsang ba tha nag gi ser srung spu gri dmar po/ 'brong rgyal gnod sbyin gyi gsol mchod/ dud sol lha mo'i mchod bstod/ spu bo 'dung chu'i rgyal ba byams pa'i snyan nas gdan drangs pa'i dbang drag padma yang gsang*/ rdo rje gro lod kyi skor le tshan gsum bcas 'di rigs pusti gcig tsam/ khram gzigs rngams chen rong nas spyan drangs pa'i 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed rdo rje 'jigs byed dug ri me 'bar gyi skor pusti gcig gzho stod til sgro brag dkar mkha' 'gro ke'u ri gsang mdzad nas gdan drangs pa'i gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog gi las tshogs dang bcas pa pusti gcig

jo bo gze rgyal gyi gangs khrod dmar nag rakta'i mtsho nas spyan drangs pa'i mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo'i skor pusti gcig tsam/ dpal tsā ri nas spyan drangs pa'i zhing skyong mgon po'i skor pusti phyed tsam/ mdo smad chab mdo la gong dge bsnyen pho brang nas gdan drangs pa'i bla ma'i nor sgrub padma rgyal po'i skor rgyas pa dang*/ gser gling nor bu'i bang mdzod dam/ brag nag bdud rdzong nas gdan drangs pa'i du ru ka sogs mtha' dmag zlog byed bla ma drag po'i chos skor chog bsgrigs mang ba dang bcas 'di rigs la'ang puste re re tsam yod pa bcas khyon dril gter chos pusti stabs bde can bco brgyad tsam yod snang*/ shog ser 'bebs ma grub pa dang*/ dpe rgyun yod kyang dbang lung gi rgyun mi bzhugs pa'ang mang du yod 'dra/ 'jam dpal mkhyen brtse padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas mdzad pa'o// // ༄༅/ /gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa'i rnam thar kong sprul gong mas mdzad pa bzhugs so// gnum chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul rtsa gsum gter bdag gling pa'am gar dbang gnam lcags rdo rje zhes grags pa ni/ lho zla nang chen gyi stod gnas chen gze rgyal gyi nye 'dabs su 'gru chen rlangs kyi rigs su ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ rdor blo ldan shes rab kyi sprul par grags pa'i dge lugs chos rje zhig las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus pa'i mtshan bkra shis phun tshogs su gsol/ bslab sbyang ci rigs mdzad/ gter chen stag sham rdo rje nang chen sgar du byon pa las chos 'brel tsam gsan/ phyis 'bri gung du byon nas dkon mchog phrin las bzang po bla mar bsten nas bka' chos ci rigs dang lhag par rlung dzā bir snyan brgyud kyi skor zhib nan tu gsan nas lo gsum tsam bzhugs te sbyangs pa mdzad pas nyams rtogs khong nas brdol/ rdzu 'phrul dang mngon shes rtsol med du shar/

lung bstan dus bab bzhin rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa dang gnas chen mang po thogs med du nyul bas kha byang lung bstan ltar gzho stod til sgro'i tshogs khang nas yang zab padma khrag 'thung zhes rgyud lung man ngag zab 'dril gyi skor thog mar bzhes/ bsam yas mchims phu nas bla ma'i thugs sgrub bde gshegs kun 'dus dang bsam pa lhun grub kyi skor/ spo bo rong padma'i sbas tshal nas yi dam bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon rgyud lung man ngag rgya che ba glegs bam bdun/ des mtshon gter gnas so so nas yang phur gwa'u dmar nag tshe sgrub 'chi bdag zil gnon sogs tshe sgrub skor bzhi/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 'das zil gnon/ rta mgrin nyi ma'i snying po dang khro rgyal stobs 'dus/ rdor sems ye shes 'od drwa/ phyag rdor dregs pa zil gnon/ dbang drag padma yang gsang*/ rdo rje gro lod kyi skor/ gshin rje dug ri me 'bar/ gsang ba ye shes yid bzhin nor mchog mkha' 'gro bdud 'dul drag mo/ bla ma'i nor sgrub/ chos skyong mgon po zhing skyong skor sogs rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi smin grol gdams skor mang du spyan drangs pa shog ser las phabs grub rigs pusti bco brgyad tsam gyi dbang lung gi rgyan da lta'ang ma chad par rdo shul dang*/ khyung po/ spo bo sogs su bzhugs par snang*/ gdan sa'i mthil spo bo khram gzigs rngams chen rang du mdzad/ slob tshogs ci rigs par 'dus shing phrin las rgyas par byung na'ang*/ dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa tsam la sku gshegs pas mdzad pa mthar phyin ma byung bar snang*/ gshegs rjes kyi bya ba slob tshogs rnams kyi legs par spel shing*/ sku'i sprul pa rong smyon o rgyan rig 'dzin khram gzigs gdan sar bzhugs/ gsung gi sprul pa kun bzang 'chi med nor bu spu bo dga' ba lung gi phyogs su byung bar grags kyang sprul brgyud mi gsal/

thugs kyi sprul pa rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje khyung po phyogs la bzhugs pa ste gong 'og gnyis kyi sprul brgyud da lta'i bar yod/ slob ma'i gtso bo thugs sras rig 'dzin thugs mchog rdo rjes zab gter phal cher zung mkhar theg chen gling pa sogs la stsal nas rgyun 'phel bar byung*/ gzhan yang dkon seng paṇḍi ta dang*/ rje kun dga' blo gros/ yeshes rgyal mtshan sogs bstan pa spel nus pa'i zhal slob kyang 'ga' zhig byung*/ 'di nyid rig 'dzin gter bdag gling pa dang mtshan gyi zur mthun pas phan tsun mthun min dogs gzhi tsam slong na'ang/ gnyis ka'i lung bstan du ci'ang mi gsal bas rang grib sha zar 'khrul pa'i dper zad/ rgyal dbang zhwa dmar nag zung la mtshur phur gter phud 'bul bar phebs skabs gzim 'gags pa'i rkyen gyis phyag tu 'bul ma thub cing*/ gter ston thugs gshis rtsub pas bstun phyogs cher ma mtshad par brten lung don thog tu ma khel rung*/ yab sras rnams kyis thugs la mi bab pa'ang ma mdzad pa bcas gter ston tshad ldan du grags pa ltar kho bos kyang padma khrag 'thung don dbang tsam chos 'brel du mnos pa yin no// // ༄༅/ /gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul gter chen pad rgyal gling pa'i rnam thar nyung bsdus dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ('di min 'dug)
